# 一呼 · Yihu

> Voice-first iPhone workspace for your own HTTPS Agent services. 在 iPhone 上口述草稿、整理录音笔记、检查音频输入，并查看自己的每日跟进简报。

Canonical site: https://getyihu.com/
Source: https://github.com/alexlee2046/yihu-ios
Full bilingual content: https://getyihu.com/llms-full.txt
Privacy: https://getyihu.com/privacy/ | https://getyihu.com/en/privacy/

## Start with a task / 从真实任务开始

- Voice drafts / iPhone语音AI草稿: /guides/iphone-agent-voice-drafts/ compares a voice-first workspace with mobile-browser copy and paste.
- Bluetooth / 蓝牙与停车后车载排障: /guides/bluetooth-audio-input-troubleshooting/ checks input, playback, a short sample and device switching. AirPods and other headset routes depend on device/system conditions.
- Voice notes and meeting action items / 录音与结构化待办: /guides/recording-notes-handoff/ retains the original and hands material to your chosen organizing tool.
- Foreign-trade daily brief / 外贸每日跟进: /guides/multi-project-radar-watch/ displays your own inquiry/task JSON, sources and next steps; Apple Watch can show paired-phone summaries.
- Offline / 弱网准备: /start/ explains setup and the difference between prepared local transcription and a remote workspace.
- FAQ / 选型与使用条件: the website is a source release requiring iOS 18+, signing, speech models and your own workspace. Review drafts before sending; the destination may save or sync them. Preview cards use samples, not live AI results.

## Reading index / 阅读索引

The index follows the sitemap's 174 indexable bilingual URLs. Six technical-reference routes remain accessible with noindex,follow and are not exported here. 中文根路径为/，英文为/en/。Descriptions explain workflows, not measured accuracy, background recording, radio range, delivery, search indexing or AI-citation guarantees. No App Store listing, hosted Agent/CRM service or inquiry collection is supplied.

## Complete page text / 逐页完整正文

### 一呼 Yihu · 工作台，随身带走。

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/

下一步，先说下来。 用语音草稿、录音笔记和每日简报，接续你已有的 Agent 网页工作台。 试试免登录预览 源码版本 · 查看接入条件 → 不用登录，先试一个场景。 场景预览 · 合成样例 无需登录 · 无需麦克风 0 1 · 网页朗读与草稿 示例材料 → 可编辑回复 0 2 · 蓝牙四步自检 四个问题 → 一个排查方向 0 3 · 外贸每日简报 询盘 / 市场 / 跟进样例切换 选择合成材料 网页材料样例 会后录文样例 示例原文 → 预设摘要 项目资料里还缺规格参数。先确认报价需要的信息，再回复价格和交期。 朗读示例材料 预设摘要： 先补规格资料；价格与交期核过再答复。 编辑示例草稿 请先确认还缺哪些规格参数，方便继续核对报价范围与交期。 填入本页示例草稿 重置 交接真实材料前，先核对文字和目的地。 合成材料与预设结果，不是真实AI处理。App需自有工作台、语音模型与签名；网页朗读由浏览器语音服务提供。 看这个场景怎么用 → 查看接入条件 → 启用JavaScript以切换预览或编辑样例，也可直接阅读场景指南与接入步骤。 把说出来的想法，接到手边的工作。 一呼是面向自有 Agent 网页工作台的 iPhone 语音工具：口述草稿、保存录音笔记、带入文字和资料，也能查看你自己的结构化事项简报。先用下面的示例试试，再判断是否适合你的工作方式。 让想法，离工作更近一点。 端侧语音 想法刚出现，就说下来。 在 iPhone 上将语音转成可编辑的文字，检查后再交给工作台。语音模型需单独下载。 录音笔记 长一点的想法，也装得下。 先记录，再由手机分段转写。音频和文字留在本地，随时回来整理。 系统分享 看到的，也能带回来。 把文字、链接和文件暂存进分享收件箱，再选择交给工作台的内容。不会自动发送。 语音工作台，还是浏览器复制粘贴？按任务选择。 转文字工具，还是行动项工作流？ 工作台是你的， 节奏也是。 连接你自己信任的 HTTPS 工作台。一呼在它周围，补上 iPhone 的原生能力。 打开你已在用的可信 HTTPS 工作台，需要原生增强时，再按该服务的说明接入。 通知与实时活动需要兼容服务。一呼不托管 Agent，也不提供后端。 了解使用条件 你想先解决哪件事？ iPhone 语音 AI 草稿 口述一个想法，校对后接续网页工作台，少一次应用切换。 已有工作台，还是只需转写？ → 蓝牙与停车后的车载拾音 听得到却录不到？用四步对照，先找对输入设备。 停车与展会的试录清单 → 录音整理成下一步 从原录文提炼结论、待办和待确认项，保留核对依据。 转录工具与行动项工作流怎么选 → 外贸每日跟进简报 把你已有的询盘和市场简报放在手机上，先看今天该跟什么。 准备你自己的结构化简报 → 左右滑动表格，查看完整使用前提。键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 能力 可以做什么 前提与边界 语音草稿 在手机转写，校对后交给兼容的网页输入框。 准备语音模型、麦克风权限和自己的工作台。发送由你确认。 外设拾音排障 按输入、播放、试录和切换结果逐步对照。 停车后操作；具体可选输入依设备与系统界面而定。 结构化笔记 保留录音与文字，再选择整理与交接方式。 摘要与待办由所选工作台或工具整理，并对照原文确认。 每日跟进简报 读取你准备的JSON事项，查看来源和下一步。 需自有导出或兼容来源，询盘与市场资料由你提供。 开始前，先了解这些 一呼更适合谁？ 已有 Agent 网页工作台、希望在 iPhone 上少打字接续工作的人。如果只想得到一份录文，独立转录工具可能更省配置。 现在如何安装？ 目前提供源码：需要 iOS 18+、Mac、Xcode/XcodeGen、自有签名和可信 HTTPS 工作台；语音模型另行下载。安装步骤在接入指南中。 网页预览会录我的声音吗？ 预览使用示例材料，无需麦克风或蓝牙权限。它帮助理解流程；实际录音和工作台体验在 iPhone App 与所选服务中完成。 草稿什么时候发送？ 一呼填入文字时不会按下发送。网页工作台仍可能保存或同步草稿，私密材料交接前请了解所选服务的数据设置。 录音之后就有会议纪要了吗？ 一呼保存本地录音并分段转写。你可交给所选工作台或工具整理，再对照原文确认人名、数字和待办负责人。 商机简报从哪里来？ 来自你现有工作流准备的 JSON 导出或兼容数据源。一呼负责呈现事项，客户数据与询盘资料由你提供。 查看接入与安装条件 了解数据如何处理 把工作台，带在身边。 开源，为 iPhone 而做，连接你自己的服务。 开始使用 目前提供源码，需 iOS 18+、自有工作台、语音模型和签名配置。

Yihu brings voice drafts, local voice notes, sharing and your structured task brief to an iPhone connected to your own Agent web workspace. Choose what to hand off to your workbench. Nothing is sent automatically. Voice workspace or browser copy and paste? Choose a workflow. Transcription app or action-item workflow? Your workbench. Bring your own export or compatible feed, inquiry data and market material. Before you start Who is Yihu for? People who already use an Agent web workspace and want to continue by voice on iPhone. If you only need a transcript, a standalone recording tool may be simpler. Can I install it from the App Store? Yihu is currently a source release. Setup requires iOS 18+, a Mac with Xcode and XcodeGen, your own signing and a trusted HTTPS workspace. Speech models are downloaded separately. Does this preview use my microphone? The preview uses sample material and runs without microphone or Bluetooth permission. It illustrates a workflow; the iPhone app and your chosen service provide the actual recording and workspace experience. When does a draft get sent? Yihu inserts reviewed text without pressing Send. Your web workspace may save or sync drafts, so review its data settings before handing over private material. Will it write finished meeting minutes for me? Yihu keeps local audio and segmented transcription. Choose a workspace or tool to organize it, then check names, numbers and action owners against the original. Where does the sales brief come from? You supply a JSON export or compatible feed from your existing workflow. Yihu displays your tasks; it does not supply a customer database or automatically collect inquiries. ### iPhone Agent 工作台接入与语音草稿 · 一呼 Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/start/

在 iPhone 接入你的 Agent 工作台 一呼目前提供源码，不是 App Store 安装成品。先完成自有 HTTPS 工作台、源码签名和模型预检，再用一条合成文字验证“确认目标 → 转写与草稿交付 → 核对未发送草稿”；本指南到草稿为止，不发送消息或执行任务。 接入前：六项预检 先构建，再连接 首次语音草稿：合成数据走读 失败分流：只停受影响步骤 接入前：六项预检 左右滑动表格可查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 接入前：六项预检 检查与操作 成功信号 失败去向 只填自有 HTTPS origin，例如 https://workbench.example.com；不带账号密码、路径、查询参数或片段。示例域名不能当成可用服务器。 你有自己可用的 HTTPS 源地址，而不是带 /chat?mode=1#draft 的完整页面链接。 地址格式不符 → 地址分流；不要把访问令牌或密码放入网址。 在同一台 iPhone 的 Safari 打开你自己的地址，检查可达性、TLS 和已有登录。手机上的 localhost 指手机本身，不是电脑。 手机能访问预期服务且没有证书警告；登录后看到自己的工作台。Safari 成功只是网络/页面预检，不证明原生增强已兼容。 无法访问、TLS 警告或登录失败 → 网络与权限分流；不关闭证书校验，不为此开放公网端口。 准备 iOS 18+ iPhone，以及带 Xcode、iOS 18+ SDK、Swift 6、XcodeGen 的 Mac。按仓库构建说明配置自己的 Team、Bundle ID 和共享 App Group。 用自己的签名构建并在目标 iPhone 打开一呼。此项需要你实际验证；网页演示或源码合入不是安装证明。 构建/签名错误 → 构建分流；不复制别人签名、凭据或配置，不把签名材料提交到仓库。 在 App 中单独下载兼容的 Qwen3 ASR 模型并等待校验；使用语音需要存储、带宽、适用设备与麦克风权限。 实际版本的模型状态显示可用、录音入口可用；此处先不录音，完成目标与合成内容检查后再按下方走读操作。 模型缺失、校验/权限失败 → 模型分流；不跳过哈希校验，不绕过声纹验证要求。 先确认目标工作台、页面与最后聚焦的可编辑草稿框；确认它不会把输入自动当成提交。不要选终端、发送中界面或未知编辑器。 目标明确、草稿可编辑且应用允许填入；转写后仍需用户检查与单独发送。 宿主拒绝或目标不明 → 草稿分流；不强行写入，不通过改宿主绕过拒绝。 只用合成内容和获准的空白草稿练习，不触碰已有真实任务、私有台账、录音或顾客数据。 你能区分官网静态演示、App 本机转写、工作台草稿及最终发送这几个阶段。 无法确认目标是否会执行或是否含真实数据 → 停在本地笔记，不继续填入。 源地址示例，不是连接测试 正确的输入形态是下面的 origin；网页深层路径不是配置入口。源地址能通过格式检查，也不等于服务器可达或原生功能兼容。 https://workbench.example.com 不要填：https://workbench.example.com/chat?mode=1#draft 先构建，再连接 获取源码，按 README 的 Build locally 配置 project.yml：YIHU_BUNDLE_ID、YIHU_APP_GROUP 与 DEVELOPMENT_TEAM 使用你自己的值；主 App 和分享扩展使用同一 App Group。 按仓库步骤运行 XcodeGen，打开 Yihu.xcodeproj，选 CollieiOS scheme 与自己的设备完成签名构建。推送及相关会员/服务配置是独立前提；不要为了第一份草稿新购服务或配置中继。 打开一呼，输入你自己的可信 HTTPS origin，并按服务端规则登录或配对。不要把其他系统的 Android/SSH 配对说明当成一呼安装步骤。 查看当前版本完整构建说明 首次语音草稿：合成数据走读 合成语句: 整理一份示例读书清单，仅保留草稿，不发送或执行。 流程示意，不是一次已通过的真机测试；官网演示不访问麦克风、不连接你的服务。App 短语音转写后可能自动尝试安全填入，不应假定一定还有二次填入按钮；自动填入不等于自动发送。 预检通过 → 确认工作台/页面/空白草稿框 ↓ 主动录音 → 手机转写 → 守卫下的草稿交付（可能自动） ├─ 已填入 → 核对文字、目标和未发送状态 → 停止 └─ 拒绝/不明 → 保留转写 → 复制到受控本地笔记 → 停止 任一步失败 → 下方故障分流；不盲目重复填入或发送 左右滑动表格可查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后使用方向键。 首次语音草稿：合成数据走读 步骤与操作 成功信号 不满足时 1. 确认目的地 在你获准使用的工作台打开空白草稿，最后聚焦目标编辑框；记录你要填入的工作台和页面。 目的地明确、没有正在发送/执行的任务；编辑器已确认可保留草稿。 目标不明就停在本地笔记；不要跨页面或跨工作台盲目重试。 2. 主动录音并转写 授予所需麦克风权限，用上面的合成语句作短录音。转写结束后，App 可能自动尝试安全填入；先看草稿与原生面板，不要假定还要再点一次填入。 能在草稿或原生面板核对文字；不保证准确率、任意时长或设备性能。填入不是发送。 按模型/麦克风分流处理，不绕过缺失模型或验证要求。 3. 检查草稿或保留的文字 若已自动填入，只核对文字与目标，不要再次填入。若文字保留在面板，先核对目的地；只有宿主允许且实际界面提供明确手动入口时才选择填入，不把明确拒绝当成再次尝试的理由。 文字位于预期的未发送草稿，或安全保留在面板；没有按下发送。宿主明确拒绝后不降级绕过。 拒绝或不兼容时保留转写，按草稿分流处理；不要为了测试点击发送。 4. 在草稿处停止 只检查合成文字、目标与未发送状态，不触发 Agent。若结果不确定，先核对目的地。 走读结束在未发送草稿或受控本地笔记；不把成功转写当成任务已执行。 不确定时不要盲目再次填入；保留原文，按实际界面处理。 失败分流：只停受影响步骤 地址格式不通过 从自己的服务信息取 HTTPS origin，移除路径、查询参数与片段；不要移除认证边界来“让它通过”。只有示例网址、没有自己的服务时先停；一呼不提供预配置服务器。 手机打不开、TLS 或登录失败 先区分电脑能开与手机能开，检查你已有且获准的网络/私网路径、服务在线状态和证书信任。交由服务维护者修复登录或证书；不忽略安全警告，不公开私有台账，不自行新增隧道、端口或权限。 构建或签名失败 回到当前版本 README 的构建前提，核对 Xcode/SDK、scheme、自有标识、Team 与 App Group。原维护者确认具体错误后再继续；不要上传签名材料或照抄别人开发者配置。 模型、录音或校验失败 按实际 App 提示检查模型下载完整性、设备空间/兼容性和麦克风权限；下载需要网络。不以关闭校验、强行替换模型或跳过声纹验证来恢复。可以先停在文字/本地笔记路径。 宿主拒绝、编辑器未知或填入结果不确定 保留原生面板里的转写，不自动改走其他编辑器，不改宿主绕过明确拒绝。可显式复制到你控制的本地笔记；只有确认另一目标允许草稿且不会自动提交，才考虑手动粘贴，否则停止。结果不确定先查目的地，不盲目再次填入。 接入成功后，仍要分开的能力 HTTPS 页面能打开，不代表任意工作台原生增强兼容；Collie、OpenClaw、Hermes 仅是网页工作台示例，一呼不是它们的官方客户端，不托管 Agent 或提供后端。 端侧转写和本地笔记不等于所有数据不出手机：模型下载、网页访问、用户交接/上传及可选中继涉及相应服务。请先读隐私说明。 PM Radar 需要自备 JSON 导出或兼容数据源；通知、实时活动与 Watch 还有独立服务、配对/授权和设备验收要求。它们不是第一份语音草稿已通过的附带承诺。 隐私与数据边界 · 返回能力与前提核对表 对照系统听写、备忘录与原生工作台草稿边界 查看手机待决策、来源时效与确认回执边界 从源码构建

### Connect your Agent workbench on iPhone · Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/start/

Connect your Agent workbench on iPhone Yihu is a source release, not an App Store binary. Check your own HTTPS workbench, source signing and models first, then use synthetic text to test target confirmation → transcription and draft delivery → review of the unsent draft. This guide does not send a message or run a task. Before connecting: six checks Build first, then connect First voice draft: a synthetic walkthrough Troubleshooting: stop only the affected step Before connecting: six checks Swipe the table to read all columns. Keyboard: focus it and use the arrow keys. Before connecting: six checks Check and action Success signal If it fails Enter only your own HTTPS origin, for example https://workbench.example.com, with no credentials, path, query or fragment. The example is not a working server. You have your own usable HTTPS origin, not a full page link containing /chat?mode=1#draft. Invalid format → address troubleshooting. Do not put access tokens or passwords in a URL. Open your own address in Safari on the same iPhone to check reachability, TLS and existing login. localhost on the phone is the phone, not your computer. The expected service opens without a certificate warning and you can sign in. Safari success is only a network/page precheck, not proof of native integration. Unreachable, TLS warning or login failure → network and permission troubleshooting. Do not disable certificate checks or open public ports for this. Prepare an iOS 18+ iPhone and a Mac with Xcode, the iOS 18+ SDK, Swift 6 and XcodeGen. Follow the repository build guide with your own Team, bundle identifiers and shared App Group. Yihu opens on your target iPhone after you build with your own signing. You must verify this yourself; a website demo or merged source is not installation evidence. Build/signing error → build troubleshooting. Do not copy someone else's signing, credentials or configuration, or commit signing materials. Download compatible Qwen3 ASR models separately in the app and wait for verification. Speech needs storage, bandwidth, a capable device and microphone permission. Your version reports a usable model and recording entry point. Do not record yet; finish the destination and synthetic-content checks before following the walkthrough below. Missing model, verification or permission failure → model troubleshooting. Never skip hash checks or speaker-verification requirements. Confirm the target workbench, page and last-focused editable draft field, and that input will not be auto-submitted. Do not select a terminal, a sending interface or an unknown editor. The target is clear, its draft is editable and the app permits insertion. Review and a separate user send remain necessary. Host refusal or unclear target → draft troubleshooting. Do not force insertion or modify the host to bypass refusal. Practice only with synthetic content and an authorized empty draft, not real tasks, private ledgers, recordings or customer data. You can distinguish the website demo, phone transcription, workbench draft and final send. If you cannot confirm the target will not execute or contains no real data, stop in a local note instead of inserting. Origin example, not a connection test Use the origin shape below, not a deep page URL. Passing format validation does not establish server reachability or native compatibility. https://workbench.example.com Do not enter: https://workbench.example.com/chat?mode=1#draft Build first, then connect Get the source and follow Build locally in the README. In project.yml, set YIHU_BUNDLE_ID, YIHU_APP_GROUP and DEVELOPMENT_TEAM to your own values; the main app and share extension must use the same App Group. Follow the repository's XcodeGen steps, open Yihu.xcodeproj, and select the CollieiOS scheme and your device to configure signing and build. Push and any membership/service setup are separate prerequisites; do not buy a service or configure a relay just to try the first draft. Open Yihu, enter your own trusted HTTPS origin, and authenticate or pair according to your server. Another project's Android/SSH pairing instructions are not Yihu installation steps. Read the current full build guide First voice draft: a synthetic walkthrough Synthetic phrase: Draft a sample reading list; keep it as a draft, without sending or running it. A process illustration, not a passed physical-device test. The website demo does not use your microphone or connect to your service. Short-speech transcription may automatically attempt guarded insertion; do not assume a second insertion button always appears. Automatic insertion is not automatic sending. Prechecks pass → confirm workbench / page / empty draft field ↓ Intentional recording → phone transcription → guarded draft delivery (possibly automatic) ├─ Inserted → review text, destination and unsent state → stop └─ Refused / unclear → retain text → copy to a controlled local note → stop Any failed step → troubleshooting below; no blind repeat insertion or send Swipe the table to read all columns. Keyboard: focus it and use the arrow keys. First voice draft: a synthetic walkthrough Step and action Success signal Otherwise 1. Confirm the destination Open an authorized empty draft and last-focus the intended editor. Identify the workbench and page you intend to use. The destination is clear, no task is sending/running, and the editor is confirmed to retain a draft. If the target is unclear, stop in a local note; do not retry blindly across pages or workbenches. 2. Intentionally record and transcribe Grant required microphone access and make a short recording of the synthetic phrase. After transcription the app may automatically attempt guarded insertion. Inspect the draft and native panel first; do not assume another insertion click is required. Text is available for review in the draft or native panel. Accuracy, arbitrary recording length and device performance are not guaranteed. Insertion is not sending. Follow model/microphone troubleshooting; do not bypass missing models or verification requirements. 3. Inspect the draft or retained text If already inserted automatically, review the text and target without inserting again. If retained in the panel, verify the destination first. Use a manual insertion action only if the host permits it and your actual interface offers one; explicit refusal is not a reason to retry. Text is in the intended unsent draft or safely retained in the panel, without pressing Send. Explicit host refusal never falls through to a bypass. If refused or incompatible, retain the transcript and follow draft troubleshooting. Do not press Send for this test. 4. Stop at the draft Inspect only the synthetic text, destination and unsent state; do not trigger the Agent. If the result is uncertain, inspect the destination first. The walkthrough ends in an unsent draft or a controlled local note. Successful transcription is not task execution. Do not blindly insert again after uncertainty; retain the original text and follow the actual interface. Troubleshooting: stop only the affected step Origin format rejected Use the HTTPS origin from your own service details, without a path, query or fragment. Do not remove authentication boundaries to make it pass. If you only have the example URL and no service, stop; Yihu provides no preconfigured server. Phone cannot connect, TLS or login fails Distinguish access from your computer from access on the phone. Check your existing authorized network/private route, service availability and certificate trust. Ask the service maintainer to fix login or certificates; do not ignore warnings, publish private ledger data, or add tunnels, ports or permissions yourself. Build or signing fails Return to the current README and check Xcode/SDK, scheme, your own identifiers, Team and App Group. Continue after the maintainer identifies the error; never upload signing material or copy another developer's configuration. Model, recording or verification fails Use the app's actual messages to check download completeness, device space/compatibility and microphone permission. Downloads need network access. Do not disable verification, force replacement models or bypass speaker checks. You can stop at a text/local-note path. Host refuses, editor is unknown or insertion is uncertain Keep the transcript in the native panel. Do not automatically switch editors or modify the host to bypass explicit refusal. You may explicitly copy to a local note you control. Consider manual pasting elsewhere only after confirming that target permits drafts and does not auto-submit; otherwise stop. Inspect the destination before repeating an uncertain insertion. Capabilities that remain separate after connecting Opening HTTPS does not certify native enhancements for arbitrary workbenches. Collie, OpenClaw and Hermes are web UI examples; Yihu is not their official client, does not host Agents and supplies no backend. On-device transcription and local notes do not mean all data stays on the phone: model downloads, web access, user handoffs/uploads and optional relays involve their respective services. Read the privacy explanation first. PM Radar requires your own JSON export or compatible feed. Notifications, Live Activities and Watch have separate service, pairing/authorization and device-acceptance prerequisites. They are not implied by a successful first voice draft. Privacy and data boundaries · Back to capabilities and prerequisites Compare Dictation, Notes and native workbench drafts Read mobile decisions, source freshness and phone confirmation boundaries Build from source

### 数据流与声纹权限边界 · 一呼 Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/privacy/

每阶段的数据，去了哪里？ 端侧语音只说明识别发生的位置，不代表整个 App 永不联网。这份说明区分官网演示、手机本地处理、网页工作台及可选通知服务，依据当前公开源码与 README；不是完整设备、备份或第三方服务隐私审计。 先区分官网演示与 iPhone App 逐阶段数据流对照表 声纹不是身份认证或写入授权 先区分官网演示与 iPhone App 官网演示播放随站点提供的合成语音，不请求麦克风、不连接你的工作台、不发送消息。编辑文字和演示草稿只存在当前页面的 React 状态中，刷新后不保留。 官网生产环境默认加载 Google Analytics 4（GA4）并采用区域 Consent Mode v2：EEA 30 国（AT、BE、BG、CY、CZ、DE、DK、EE、ES、FI、FR、GR、HR、HU、IE、IS、IT、LI、LT、LU、LV、MT、NL、NO、PL、PT、RO、SE、SI、SK）及英国 GB、瑞士 CH、巴西 BR、日本 JP 默认 analytics_storage=denied，其他地区默认 granted，由 Google 按区域规则应用，不按浏览器语言判断。ad_storage、ad_user_data、ad_personalization 始终 denied。区域默认拒绝不等于零网络：Google 标签仍可能发送无 Cookie ping 及访问/设备相关信息。浏览器持久保存显式允许或拒绝，在页面配置事件前恢复并覆盖区域默认；可在页脚「统计偏好」更改或撤回。显式拒绝/撤回优先禁用此浏览器后续 GA 采集、更新同意状态并清除本站可访问的 GA Cookie，但标签文件仍可请求；已发请求与 Google 已收到的数据不会撤回。存储不可用时当前页仍尊重拒绝并显示保存失败；后续页面可能恢复原保存偏好，需重新选择。初始页面统计使用固定规范网址，不发送查询参数、片段或来源网址；预览环境不加载标签。关闭 Google signals 和广告个性化，不将演示草稿正文作为事件发送。托管平台仍可能处理请求日志。这不是法律合规认证、Google 实收或真实区域流量验收。 逐阶段数据流对照表 左右滑动可查看完整表格；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 逐阶段数据流对照表 阶段 / 数据 手机侧发生什么 何时涉及外部服务 不能据此承诺 1. 模型下载 Qwen3 ASR 模型需单独下载到手机；当前模型存储代码检查固定版本、文件大小与 SHA-256。 下载从 Hugging Face 或 ModelScope 发起网络请求，需要带宽与空间，服务方可处理相应请求。 下载模型不等于上传录音；模型可本地运行也不代表安装和所有功能都无需网络。不要跳过校验。 2. 手机端侧转写 兼容模型在手机处理语音。短语音结束后可能自动尝试守卫下的草稿填入；被拒绝或结果不明确时可保留文字。 一旦文字交给网页工作台，就进入对应服务的数据边界；不能把整条交接链统称为离线。 端侧识别不是全 App 不联网的证明，也没有在这里承诺准确率、任意录音时长或所有设备性能。 3. 本地录音笔记 录音笔记在 App 本地保存音频与转写；当前代码为笔记目录尝试设置系统备份排除标记。 用户之后的复制、分享或工作台交接会产生新的数据去向，不能用原笔记的本地保存替它们担保。 源码设置备份排除不等于已经核验某台设备的备份或清除结果；不承诺所有副本都只在此手机、或已永久删除。 4. 网页工作台与草稿交接 WebKit 打开用户自己的 HTTPS 来源；当前网页数据存储是持久化的，可保留该来源的网页数据。语音文字可交给兼容草稿框。 网页加载、登录、草稿处理及用户发送/上传由对应服务参与；其脚本可能保存或同步已收到的草稿。 一呼不替你按发送，不等于网页在发送前不处理数据。HTTPS 和网页能打开，也不等于服务已获得所有原生增强或相同隐私规则。 5. 系统分享收件箱 文字、链接和文件先存到 App Group 收件箱，主 App 与分享扩展共享这份暂存；暂存本身不自动发送。 用户选择交接后，文字可进入网页草稿，文件通过页面的附件/上传入口交给服务；上传时机和后续处理取决于工作台。 暂存、交接、附件上传与消息发送不是同一个步骤。消息未发送不能证明附件未上传；不把 App Group 误称为云服务或绝对加密承诺。 6. 可选中继、通知与实时活动 通知功能还需系统授权、兼容网页桥/服务端接口与匹配签名环境的 APNs 配置；实时活动可依赖自有兼容中继。 启用兼容路径时，注册所需的设备/通知标识及活动更新会涉及相应服务与 APNs；APNs 私钥应由服务端保管。 默认中继是不可用占位地址，不会自动创建服务。能浏览网页不证明推送已送达，也不把可选通知注册描述为纯本地处理。 声纹不是身份认证或写入授权 声纹匹配是可能误判的便利过滤，不是账号身份认证。当前源码将登记特征保存在本地，并设置文件保护与备份排除；这不是对设备备份或防攻击能力的验收证明。兼容 WeSpeaker/CAM++ 模型未随仓库提供，缺失时依赖它们的验证路径不可用，不应关闭验证来绕过缺失模型。 左右滑动可查看完整表格；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 声纹不是身份认证或写入授权 层面 由什么决定 不代表什么 声纹便利过滤 本地登记特征与兼容模型提供匹配判断。 不证明账号归属、当前操作意愿、活体检测、防重放或写入权限；不能把“匹配”当成身份认证。 工作台身份认证 你自己的工作台处理登录、配对和会话权限，具体机制以该服务为准。 一呼能打开页面或填入草稿不表示已获得其他账号、设备或资源的权限。 写入与确认 服务端决定目标与操作是否允许；PM Radar 决策/验收回复还需独立写入授权、手机明确确认与回执核验。 声纹通过不授权写入；读台账不自动改状态，不自动执行任务、合并或部署。 使用前，按目的地核对 先核对工作台来源和草稿目标；短语音可能自动尝试填入，录音前就应确认目的地。宿主明确拒绝后不降级绕过，结果不确定先查目标，不盲目再次填入。 复制到本地笔记或其他 App 后，是新的数据副本与处理边界；核对其同步/备份规则。不要在截图、日志或公开反馈中放服务地址、账号/设备标识、录音、私有任务正文或签名材料。 本说明没有替第三方承诺数据保留期、司法地区、删除保证或合规认证；请检查你实际版本、服务配置、系统备份及目标服务政策。录音、推送和 Watch 余项仍沿原设备/服务验收，不由这张表补成已通过。 查看当前实现与接入前提 源码与能力限制 · 安全说明 · 接入预检与首次草稿 对照系统听写、备忘录与原生工作台草稿边界 查看手机待决策、来源时效与确认回执边界

Parameter/comparison tables (HTML) / 参数对照表：

<table><caption>逐阶段数据流对照表</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">阶段 / 数据</th><th scope="col">手机侧发生什么</th><th scope="col">何时涉及外部服务</th><th scope="col">不能据此承诺</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="flow-download"><th scope="row">1. 模型下载</th><td>Qwen3 ASR 模型需单独下载到手机；当前模型存储代码检查固定版本、文件大小与 SHA-256。</td><td>下载从 Hugging Face 或 ModelScope 发起网络请求，需要带宽与空间，服务方可处理相应请求。</td><td>下载模型不等于上传录音；模型可本地运行也不代表安装和所有功能都无需网络。不要跳过校验。</td></tr><tr id="flow-transcription"><th scope="row">2. 手机端侧转写</th><td>兼容模型在手机处理语音。短语音结束后可能自动尝试守卫下的草稿填入；被拒绝或结果不明确时可保留文字。</td><td>一旦文字交给网页工作台，就进入对应服务的数据边界；不能把整条交接链统称为离线。</td><td>端侧识别不是全 App 不联网的证明，也没有在这里承诺准确率、任意录音时长或所有设备性能。</td></tr><tr id="flow-notes"><th scope="row">3. 本地录音笔记</th><td>录音笔记在 App 本地保存音频与转写；当前代码为笔记目录尝试设置系统备份排除标记。</td><td>用户之后的复制、分享或工作台交接会产生新的数据去向，不能用原笔记的本地保存替它们担保。</td><td>源码设置备份排除不等于已经核验某台设备的备份或清除结果；不承诺所有副本都只在此手机、或已永久删除。</td></tr><tr id="flow-workbench"><th scope="row">4. 网页工作台与草稿交接</th><td>WebKit 打开用户自己的 HTTPS 来源；当前网页数据存储是持久化的，可保留该来源的网页数据。语音文字可交给兼容草稿框。</td><td>网页加载、登录、草稿处理及用户发送/上传由对应服务参与；其脚本可能保存或同步已收到的草稿。</td><td>一呼不替你按发送，不等于网页在发送前不处理数据。HTTPS 和网页能打开，也不等于服务已获得所有原生增强或相同隐私规则。</td></tr><tr id="flow-sharing"><th scope="row">5. 系统分享收件箱</th><td>文字、链接和文件先存到 App Group 收件箱，主 App 与分享扩展共享这份暂存；暂存本身不自动发送。</td><td>用户选择交接后，文字可进入网页草稿，文件通过页面的附件/上传入口交给服务；上传时机和后续处理取决于工作台。</td><td>暂存、交接、附件上传与消息发送不是同一个步骤。消息未发送不能证明附件未上传；不把 App Group 误称为云服务或绝对加密承诺。</td></tr><tr id="flow-notifications"><th scope="row">6. 可选中继、通知与实时活动</th><td>通知功能还需系统授权、兼容网页桥/服务端接口与匹配签名环境的 APNs 配置；实时活动可依赖自有兼容中继。</td><td>启用兼容路径时，注册所需的设备/通知标识及活动更新会涉及相应服务与 APNs；APNs 私钥应由服务端保管。</td><td>默认中继是不可用占位地址，不会自动创建服务。能浏览网页不证明推送已送达，也不把可选通知注册描述为纯本地处理。</td></tr></tbody></table>

<table><caption>声纹不是身份认证或写入授权</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">层面</th><th scope="col">由什么决定</th><th scope="col">不代表什么</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="identity-speaker"><th scope="row">声纹便利过滤</th><td>本地登记特征与兼容模型提供匹配判断。</td><td>不证明账号归属、当前操作意愿、活体检测、防重放或写入权限；不能把“匹配”当成身份认证。</td></tr><tr id="identity-account"><th scope="row">工作台身份认证</th><td>你自己的工作台处理登录、配对和会话权限，具体机制以该服务为准。</td><td>一呼能打开页面或填入草稿不表示已获得其他账号、设备或资源的权限。</td></tr><tr id="identity-authorization"><th scope="row">写入与确认</th><td>服务端决定目标与操作是否允许；PM Radar 决策/验收回复还需独立写入授权、手机明确确认与回执核验。</td><td>声纹通过不授权写入；读台账不自动改状态，不自动执行任务、合并或部署。</td></tr></tbody></table>

### Data flow and privacy boundaries · Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/privacy/

Where data goes at each stage On-device speech describes where recognition happens, not an app that never uses the network. This explanation separates the website demo, phone-local processing, web workbenches and optional notification services using current public source and README evidence. It is not a complete device, backup or third-party privacy audit. Separate the website demo from the iPhone app Data flow, stage by stage Speaker verification is not authentication or write authorization Separate the website demo from the iPhone app The website demo plays a synthetic sample served with the site. It does not request microphone access, connect to your workbench or send a message. Edited text and its demo draft live only in the current page's React state and are not retained after reload. The production website loads Google Analytics 4 (GA4) by default using regional Consent Mode v2. analytics_storage defaults to denied in the 30 EEA countries (AT, BE, BG, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, ES, FI, FR, GR, HR, HU, IE, IS, IT, LI, LT, LU, LV, MT, NL, NO, PL, PT, RO, SE, SI, SK), plus the UK (GB), Switzerland (CH), Brazil (BR) and Japan (JP); it defaults to granted elsewhere. Google applies these regional rules, not browser-language detection. ad_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization always remain denied. Regional denial is not zero network: the tag can send cookieless pings and visit/device-related information. This browser persists explicit allow or decline choices and restores them before page configuration events, overriding regional defaults. Change or withdraw your choice using Analytics preferences in the footer. Explicit decline/withdrawal disables future GA collection in this browser, updates consent and clears accessible GA cookies, but the tag file can still be requested; in-flight requests and data already received by Google cannot be recalled. If saving is unavailable, this page still honors refusal and shows a save-failure warning; later pages may restore a previous saved preference and require a new choice. Initial page measurement uses a fixed canonical URL without query, fragment or referrer. Previews do not load the tag. Google signals and ad personalization are disabled, and demo draft text is not sent as events. Hosting providers may still process request logs. This is not legal certification, proof of Google receipt or real-region traffic acceptance. Data flow, stage by stage Swipe to read the full table. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Data flow, stage by stage Stage / data On the phone When external services are involved What this does not promise 1. Model downloads Qwen3 ASR models are downloaded separately to the phone. Current model-store code checks pinned revisions, file sizes and SHA-256 hashes. Downloads make network requests to Hugging Face or ModelScope, requiring bandwidth and storage; the provider can process the corresponding requests. Downloading models is not uploading recordings. Local inference does not make installation or every feature network-free. Do not skip verification. 2. On-device transcription Compatible models process speech on the phone. Short-speech completion may automatically attempt guarded draft insertion; refused or uncertain delivery can retain text. Once text is handed to a web workbench, it crosses the service boundary in the next relevant row; the whole handoff is not an offline operation. On-device recognition does not prove the entire app makes no network requests. No accuracy, arbitrary recording-duration or all-device performance guarantee is made here. 3. Local voice notes Voice notes retain audio and transcripts in app-local storage. Current code attempts to mark the notes directory as excluded from system backups. Later copying, sharing or workbench handoffs create new destinations; local retention of the original note does not guarantee how those copies are handled. Setting backup-exclusion flags in source is not verification of a particular device's backups or erasure. It does not promise every copy stays on that phone or has been permanently deleted. 4. Web workbench and draft handoff WebKit opens your own HTTPS origin. Its current website data store is persistent and can retain that origin's website data. Speech text can be handed to a compatible draft editor. Page loads, login, draft handling and user sends/uploads involve the corresponding service; its scripts may save or sync drafts they receive. Yihu not pressing Send does not mean the page cannot process data beforehand. HTTPS access also does not certify native enhancements or uniform privacy practices. 5. System share inbox Text, links and files are staged in an App Group inbox shared by the app and share extension. Staging itself does not automatically send them. After a user-selected handoff, text can enter a web draft and files can be handed to the page's attachment/upload control. Upload timing and subsequent handling depend on the workbench. Staging, handoff, attachment upload and message submission are distinct. An unsent message does not prove no file was uploaded. App Group is not a cloud service or a blanket encryption guarantee. 6. Optional relay, notifications and Live Activities Notifications also need system permission, a compatible web bridge/server and APNs configuration matching the signing environment. Live Activities may depend on a compatible relay you control. Enabled compatible paths involve the service and APNs for registration-related device/notification identifiers and activity updates. APNs private keys belong on the server. The default relay is an unusable placeholder, not an automatically provisioned service. Browsing does not prove push delivery, and optional notification registration is not purely local processing. Speaker verification is not authentication or write authorization Speaker matching is a convenience filter that can misidentify people, not account authentication. Current source stores enrolled features locally and sets file protection and backup exclusion; that is not device-backup or attack-resistance acceptance evidence. Compatible WeSpeaker/CAM++ artifacts are not included in the repository. Verification-dependent paths are unavailable without them; do not disable verification to bypass missing models. Swipe to read the full table. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Speaker verification is not authentication or write authorization Layer What determines it What it does not establish Speaker convenience filter Local enrolled features and compatible models provide a matching decision. It does not establish account ownership, current intent, liveness, replay resistance or write permission. A match is not authentication. Workbench authentication Your own workbench handles login, pairing and session permissions under its particular implementation. Opening a page or inserting a draft does not grant access to other accounts, devices or resources. Writes and confirmation The server authorizes the target and operation. PM Radar decision/acceptance replies also need separate write authorization, explicit phone confirmation and receipt readback. A voice match does not authorize a write. Reading the ledger does not automatically change status, execute tasks, merge or deploy. Check each destination before use Confirm the workbench origin and draft target before recording because short speech may automatically attempt insertion. Explicit host refusal never falls through to a bypass. Inspect the target after uncertainty instead of blindly inserting again. Copying into a local note or another app creates another copy and handling boundary; check its sync/backup settings. Do not put service origins, account/device identifiers, recordings, private task text or signing materials in public screenshots, logs or feedback. This explanation does not promise third-party retention periods, processing jurisdictions, guaranteed deletion or compliance certification. Check your actual app version, service configuration, system backups and destination policy. Remaining recording, push and Watch acceptance is not established by this table. Inspect the current implementation and setup prerequisites Source and limitations · Security guidance · Connection checks and first draft Compare Dictation, Notes and native workbench drafts Read mobile decisions, source freshness and phone confirmation boundaries

### iPhone 语音 AI 草稿与工作台选型 · 一呼 Yihu

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/iphone-agent-voice-drafts/

场景指南 iPhone 语音 AI 草稿，把想法接到网页工作台 想法出现时，先说下来。一呼在手机转写，并可把文字填入兼容的工作台草稿。检查后，再由你决定什么时候发送。 场景预览 · 合成样例 无需登录 · 无需麦克风 0 1 · 网页朗读与草稿 示例材料 → 可编辑回复 0 2 · 蓝牙四步自检 四个问题 → 一个排查方向 0 3 · 外贸每日简报 询盘 / 市场 / 跟进样例切换 选择合成材料 网页材料样例 会后录文样例 示例原文 → 预设摘要 项目资料里还缺规格参数。先确认报价需要的信息，再回复价格和交期。 朗读示例材料 预设摘要： 先补规格资料；价格与交期核过再答复。 编辑示例草稿 请先确认还缺哪些规格参数，方便继续核对报价范围与交期。 填入本页示例草稿 重置 交接真实材料前，先核对文字和目的地。 合成材料与预设结果，不是真实AI处理。App需自有工作台、语音模型与签名；网页朗读由浏览器语音服务提供。 看这个场景怎么用 → 查看接入条件 → 启用JavaScript以切换预览或编辑样例，也可直接阅读场景指南与接入步骤。 少切一次应用，把下一步说清楚 例如：看完项目资料，口述一个追问或回复提纲，不必先切到笔记再来回复制。文字留作你自己工作台里可检查的草稿。 语音工作台，还是手机浏览器手动复制粘贴？ 方式 适合什么任务 你接着做什么 手机浏览器 + 手动输入/复制粘贴 已有文字，或系统听写已能满足输入需求。 选好目的地，带入文字再检查。 独立录音/转录工具 主要想保存录音并得到文字。 了解存储方式，需要整理时再选后续工具。 一呼 + 你自己的 Agent 网页工作台 想在 iPhone 上用语音接续已有工作台任务。 准备 App 与模型，口述、检查草稿，再决定发送。 如果当前浏览器里的系统听写已经够用，可以先用最短的路径。一呼更适合已有 Agent 网页工作台，希望在周围加上端侧语音、录音笔记和自主分享的人。 先从一件能核对的小事开始 打开你信任的工作台，选好合适的草稿位置。 说一个追问或简短回复提纲，再结束录音。 核对文字与目的地。一呼不会按下发送，网页仍可能保存或同步草稿。 使用前准备什么 当前提供源码：需要 iOS 18+、Mac 与 Xcode/XcodeGen、自有签名、可信 HTTPS 工作台及另行下载的语音模型。接入指南列出了可用路径。 FAQ 它是能控制所有手机应用的语音助手吗？ 一呼聚焦你自己的网页工作台，不替代 Siri，也不提供 Agent 后端；所连接服务提供各自能力。 任何网页输入框都能用吗？ 使用兼容草稿并查看结果。页面无法接纳文字时，保留录文，再选择明确的复制方式。 可以一直在后台听我说话吗？ 录音在前台并需麦克风权限，按需开始和结束；车载操作请先停车。 在哪里下载？ 目前按源码构建指南安装，这里没有可直接下载的 App Store 成品。 查看接入条件 · 录音笔记工作流选型 · 检查音频输入 · 隐私 实现与平台参考 Yihu source release · Apple Dictation

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/iphone-agent-voice-drafts/

What to prepare The current release is source code: iOS 18+, a Mac with Xcode/XcodeGen, your own signing, a trusted HTTPS workspace and separately downloaded speech models. Setup instructions explain the supported paths. FAQ Is it a general-purpose phone assistant? Yihu focuses on your web workspace. It does not replace Siri or supply an Agent backend; the connected service provides its own capabilities. Will any web editor work? Use a compatible draft and check the result. If a page cannot accept text, keep it and choose an explicit copying path rather than forcing another input. Can it listen continuously in the background? Capture is a foreground interaction with microphone permission. Start and stop deliberately, and park before operating vehicle controls. Where is the download? Follow the source-build setup guide. There is no App Store binary linked here. See setup requirements · Compare note workflows · Check audio input · Privacy Implementation and platform references Yihu source release · Apple Dictation

条：demo-acceptance。 等待验收不等于已经通过；手机需要查看证据与下一步。 在本例清除筛选，回到未完成范围 2 条。 来源未改变。项目、优先级、搜索与状态条件相交；其他条件仍有限制时不要把零结果误报为没有任务。 tasks 表示完整任务集合，decisions 表示待决策/待验收子集；当前 Swift 视图的管理计数和状态分组从筛选后的完整任务形成，不把 decisions 当成全量台账。完成/搁置默认隐藏，可通过历史范围查看；缓存年龄或最近 Git 活动都不是任务完成/阻塞的依据。[R1][R7] 来源读取时间，不是手机刚联网的时间 左右滑动查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 来源读取时间，不是手机刚联网的时间 信号 源码 / README 的语义 不能推断什么 date_str 最后一次成功来源读取的时间；当前模型按 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm、UTC+08:00 解析。样例故意固定该值。 刷新按钮被点过、手机刚下载或命中缓存，都不能把旧来源时间改成新鲜来源。 source_refreshing / source_refresh_failed 区分再验证中与来源读取失败。手机可先显示有界缓存，再用一次 no-cache 跟进同一次读取，不启动轮询循环。 失败时保留旧快照不是刷新成功；不能把没读到的新增事项记成零。 过期 / 未来时钟提示 当前模型把超过 24 小时的数据标为旧数据；超过当前时钟五分钟的未来时点会触发时钟警告。这些是来源时效提示。 旧缓存不代表条目已搁置或阻塞；任务状态必须来自显式字段。 可选只读适配器 README 描述按请求触发的有界内存缓存：30 秒新鲜、来源再验证期间最多使用五分钟旧快照；私网/权限检查仍独立。 [R6] 这些是特定适配器策略，不是所有 JSON 服务的承诺，不是五分钟一定有新业务数据。 Radar 数据源不复用网页 Cookie、不存储数据源凭据或跟随重定向；需要认证的来源当前按 README 用文件导出。它与浏览工作台 origin 的配置不同，不能通过公开端口、移除认证或把密码放进 URL 来解决接入。请沿已有获准的私有访问路径核对。[R2][R5] 只读 → 手机明确确认 → 服务端回执 / 不确定停止 下列是源码/README 描述的可选写路径，不是本例已经可以写入：本例 reply_supported=false，也没有可连接服务。任何实际回复都需要独立服务端授权和符合条件的原条目。 左右滑动查看完整内容；键盘用户可聚焦此区域后用方向键阅读。 读取快照 / 筛选（不写状态） ↓ 原条目是否可回复 + 服务端独立授权？ ├─ 否 → 只读 / 保留草稿 → 停止 └─ 是 → 读取最新目标与版本 → 手机完整核对并明确确认 ↓ 持久保存同一 request_id → 服务端提交 ├─ recorded 回执 → 已记录，待负责人处理（不等于执行/验收通过） └─ 超时 / 不确定 → 冻结输入，查回同一请求；不盲目重发 目标 / 来源变化 → 重新读取并确认；未解决的待核结果不当作从未写入 左右滑动查看全部列；键盘用户可聚焦表格后用方向键阅读。 只读 → 手机明确确认 → 服务端回执 / 不确定停止 阶段 必须成立的条件 停止 / 回读边界 只读 / 草稿 筛选只是读取；未获得服务端独立写权限或目标不符合条件时停在只读。 界面可见、Watch 可见或能读历史，都不授予写权限。 手机明确确认 获取最新标题、链接、状态、下一步及完整回复，再在第二次确认界面由用户确认。 来源或目标版本变化后重新确认；不能把旧缓存目标直接当本次写入凭证。 提交 / 回执 提交前持久保存请求身份，服务端核对授权和目标；recorded 才表明该回复被记录。 记录回复不是改任务状态、执行 Agent、合并或部署；负责人是否处理另需证据。 不确定 / 停止 超时或结果不明时保留待核状态并查回同一请求；丢失回执不等于没有写入。 不生成新请求来盲目重发，不以重启服务器后的查无结果强行当作从未提交。 本指南不提供写入启用命令或真实回复入口，也不替你操作服务。源码中的同一请求/回执保护不是全链路 exactly-once 保证；实际设备、服务与真机回复仍需原验收。[R3][R5][R6] Watch 和通知：把边界放在能力之前 watchOS 11+ 伴侣通过已配对 iPhone 的 WatchConnectivity 接收待决策/待验收摘要；手机桥检查配对和 Watch App 状态。摘要不是任意 Agent 后端直连，也不是完整来源数据或凭据传输。[R4] 所选事项或受保护草稿可以接续到手机；Watch 收到“草稿已保存”类确认，只代表手机安全保留了提案，不等于服务端回复已记录。手机仍要读取最新目标并明确确认，直接手表写入/独立审批仍未授权。[R4] 读取 JSON feed 不是推送事件源。原生通知与系统镜像需要兼容服务、权限及设备条件；现有源码里的通知事件解析不证明上游事件源已获准或推送已送达。不开新通知后端、不加轮询，不把独立 Watch APNs 当作已有能力。[R1][R4][R5] 这份演示没有验收什么 只有合成 JSON、离线模型解码/筛选与静态页面检查；未导入真实设备、未读私有台账、未登录服务、未发回复、未配对 Watch 或注册通知。 读数/筛选、手机已保存草稿、服务端已记录回复、任务已处理/已执行，是不同状态，不互相代替。界面显示和文案不能补成真机回复或推送验收通过。 不提供后台、签名、账号凭据或默认可写源，不承诺完整离线、全链路 exactly-once 或自动运营；使用自己的可信服务并遵守原授权。 源码依据与接续 [R1] Snapshot fields, exact filters, source-time parsing [R2] Bounded feed reads, one revalidation follow-up, cache storage [R3] Phone confirmation, pending request and receipt/readback [R4] Paired-phone Watch summaries and protected draft acknowledgement [R5] README: workbenches, Watch, notifications and reply prerequisites [R6] Optional private read adapter and separately authorized reply path [R7] Current management counts, status groups and clear-filter behavior 接入预检 · 数据流与权限边界 · 语音草稿选择与交接 · 返回能力概览 多项目 Radar：JSON、缓存与 Watch 交接

Source-read time is not the phone's last download Signal Source / README meaning What it does not establish date_str The last successful source read. The current model parses yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in UTC+08:00; this fixture intentionally fixes it. A refresh tap, phone download or cache hit cannot make an old source-read time fresh. source_refreshing / source_refresh_failed Distinguish revalidation from failed source reads. The phone can paint bounded cache and make one no-cache follow-up joining the same read, without a polling loop. Keeping the old snapshot after failure is not successful refresh. Missing new items must not be counted as zero. Stale / future-clock warnings The current model marks data older than 24 hours stale and warns when the source time is more than five minutes ahead. These are source-freshness signals. Old cache does not make a task paused or blocked; task state comes from explicit source fields. Optional read-only adapter The README describes request-triggered bounded memory caching: 30 seconds fresh, at most five minutes old while revalidating. Private access/permission checks remain separate. [R6] These are this adapter's policies, not a guarantee for every JSON service or of new business data every five minutes. Radar feeds do not reuse web cookies, store feed credentials or follow redirects; the README currently directs authenticated feeds to file export. This differs from configuring a browser workbench origin. Do not fix access by exposing public ports, removing authentication or putting passwords in URLs; use the existing authorized private path. [R2][R5] Read-only → explicit phone confirmation → receipt or uncertain-stop This is the optional write path described by source/README, not permission enabled by this fixture: reply_supported=false and no reachable service are provided. Actual replies require separate server authorization and eligible original items. Scroll sideways to read the full content. Keyboard users can focus this block and use the arrow keys. Read snapshot / filter (no status write) ↓ Eligible original target + separate server write authorization? ├─ No → read-only / retain draft → stop └─ Yes → fetch fresh target/version → full phone review + explicit confirmation ↓ persist the same request_id → server submission ├─ recorded receipt → recorded, awaiting owner handling (not execution/acceptance) └─ timeout / uncertainty → freeze input, read back the same request; no blind resend Changed target/source → fresh read and confirmation; unresolved is not proof of no write Swipe to read all columns. Keyboard users can focus the table and use the arrow keys. Read-only → explicit phone confirmation → receipt or uncertain-stop Stage Required condition Stop / readback boundary Read-only / draft Filters only read. Stay read-only without separate server write permission or an eligible target. Visibility, Watch visibility or history-read access do not grant write authority. Explicit phone confirmation Fetch current title, link, status, next step and the complete reply, then let the user confirm in the second confirmation view. Changed source/target versions require new confirmation; an old cached target is not a current write credential. Submit / receipt Persist request identity before submission; the server checks target/authority. Only a recorded receipt establishes the reply was recorded. Recording a reply does not change task status, execute an Agent, merge or deploy; later handling needs separate evidence. Uncertain / stop After timeout or an unclear result, retain pending state and read back the same request. A lost receipt is not proof of no write. Do not generate a new request to resend blindly or treat an absent result after server restart as proof no submission occurred. This guide supplies no write-enabling command or real reply endpoint and does not operate a service. Request/receipt guards are not an end-to-end exactly-once guarantee; actual device/service replies still need their original acceptance. [R3][R5][R6] Watch and notifications: prerequisites before promises The watchOS 11+ companion receives pending decision/acceptance summaries through the paired iPhone's WatchConnectivity. The phone bridge checks pairing and Watch-app installation. This is not arbitrary Agent-backend connectivity or transfer of complete source data/credentials. [R4] Selected items or protected drafts can hand off to the phone. A draft-saved acknowledgement only means the phone retained the proposal, not that a server reply was recorded. Fresh phone target checks and explicit confirmation remain necessary; direct Watch writes/standalone approval are not authorized. [R4] A JSON GET feed is not a push event source. Native notifications and mirroring depend on compatible service, permission and device support. Notification-event parsing code does not prove an authorized upstream event source or delivered push. No new notification backend, polling or independent Watch APNs is enabled here. [R1][R4][R5] What this demonstration has not accepted Only synthetic JSON, offline model decoding/filtering and static page checks are involved. No real device import, private ledger, service login, reply, Watch pairing or notification registration was tested. Read/filter results, a phone-saved draft, a server-recorded reply and a handled/executed task are different states. Displayed content cannot substitute for device reply or push-delivery acceptance. No backend, signing, account credentials or preconfigured writable feed is supplied. There is no promise of full offline behavior, end-to-end exactly-once or autonomous operations; use your trusted services and original authorization gates. Source evidence and next steps [R1] Snapshot fields, exact filters, source-time parsing [R2] Bounded feed reads, one revalidation follow-up, cache storage [R3] Phone confirmation, pending request and receipt/readback [R4] Paired-phone Watch summaries and protected draft acknowledgement [R5] README: workbenches, Watch, notifications and reply prerequisites [R6] Optional private read adapter and separately authorized reply path [R7] Current management counts, status groups and clear-filter behavior Setup checks · Data and permission boundaries · Voice-draft choices and handoff · Back to capabilities Multi-project Radar: JSON, cache age and Watch handoff

<table><caption>Source-read time is not the phone&#39;s last download</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Signal</th><th scope="col">Source / README meaning</th><th scope="col">What it does not establish</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="freshness-source"><th scope="row">date_str</th><td>The last successful source read. The phone can paint bounded cache and make one no-cache follow-up joining the same read, without a polling loop.</td><td>Keeping the old snapshot after failure is not successful refresh. Missing new items must not be counted as zero.</td></tr><tr id="freshness-age"><th scope="row">Stale / future-clock warnings</th><td>The current model marks data older than 24 hours stale and warns when the source time is more than five minutes ahead. These are source-freshness signals.</td><td>Old cache does not make a task paused or blocked; task state comes from explicit source fields.</td></tr><tr id="freshness-adapter"><th scope="row">Optional read-only adapter</th><td>The README describes request-triggered bounded memory caching: 30 seconds fresh, at most five minutes old while revalidating. Private access/permission checks remain separate. [R6]</td><td>These are this adapter&#39;s policies, not a guarantee for every JSON service or of new business data every five minutes.</td></tr></tbody></table>

### 把录音整理成行动项：原文、结论与下一步放在一起

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/recording-notes-handoff/

场景指南 把录音整理成行动项：原文、结论与下一步放在一起 从iPhone录音笔记到可跟进的结构化待办，展示一份合成会后笔记，并比较纯转写与行动项工作流。 场景预览 · 合成样例 无需登录 · 无需麦克风 0 1 · 网页朗读与草稿 示例材料 → 可编辑回复 0 2 · 蓝牙四步自检 四个问题 → 一个排查方向 0 3 · 外贸每日简报 询盘 / 市场 / 跟进样例切换 选择合成材料 网页材料样例 会后录文样例 示例原文 → 预设摘要 会上讨论了规格资料缺口，要先列出缺少的参数，还没约定负责人和时间；交期核过再回复。 朗读示例材料 预设摘要： 待办：列出缺少参数。负责人和时间：待确认。交期：先核对。 编辑示例草稿 待办：列出缺少的规格参数。负责人、截止时间待确认；对外回复前先核对交期。 填入本页示例草稿 重置 交接真实材料前，先核对文字和目的地。 合成材料与预设结果，不是真实AI处理。App需自有工作台、语音模型与签名；网页朗读由浏览器语音服务提供。 看这个场景怎么用 → 查看接入条件 → 启用JavaScript以切换预览或编辑样例，也可直接阅读场景指南与接入步骤。 先找到一个有用的下一步 先保留原录音与转写，再把材料交给你选择的工作台或工具整理。把“已确认的事”“要跟进的事”“还要问的问题”分开，下一次打开手机就知道先做什么。 一份会后笔记，可以更容易接着做 以下为合成示例，不含真实会议或客户资料： 材料 示例 如何使用 原录文 “规格资料还不齐，先确认报价需要哪些参数，交期等核过再回复。” 保留原话，回来检查数字和条件。 结论 报价前先补齐规格资料。 与原文核对后再使用。 待办 列出缺失参数，交给对应同事确认。 负责人和时间未提供时写“待确认”。 待确认项 交期、最终报价范围。 资料齐后再答复，不从摘要补出承诺。 转文字工具，还是录文→行动项工作流？ 你的任务 更合适的起点 需要多做的一步 只要保存录音并得到文字 独立录音/转录工具 核对文字、存储与分享设置。 要整理讨论结论和待办 原录文加整理工具 对照原文确认负责人、时间、提议与结论。 已有Agent网页工作台，要在手机继续处理 一呼录音笔记加你的工作台 准备模型与接入条件，选择交接方式并检查结果。 用一呼接续 在iPhone录音，保留本地音频和分段转写。 核对人名、数字与前后语境。 选择整理提示及交接目的地；较长文本可通过已有Markdown材料路径带入。 在所选工作台/工具查看整理结果，再决定下一步。 “会议纪要”是整理提示，不是本机已经生成的完整纪要。开始前请征得参与者所需的录音同意，并准备语音模型和自己的工作台。 FAQ 只有转写需求，需要配置工作台吗？ 独立录音或转录工具可能更省步骤；一呼更适合本来就有网页Agent工作台、想继续整理和跟进的人。 负责人和截止时间能自动补出来吗？ 先以原文为准，缺的标待确认。整理工具生成的结果仍应核对，尤其报价、交期和对外承诺。 交接的是录音还是文字？ 现有笔记交接使用文字或Markdown全文材料。音频与文字在本地保留，按你选择的出口分别检查交接内容。 整理后为什么还留原文？ 方便发现识别差异、回看上下文，并区分讨论提议与真正结论。 接着看 语音草稿 · 音频排障 · 录音笔记 · 每日简报 · 接入条件 · 隐私 实现参考 冻结实现 · README

### 外贸每日跟进简报：在iPhone先看询盘、依据与下一步

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multi-project-radar-watch/

场景指南 外贸每日跟进简报：在iPhone先看询盘、依据与下一步 把已有询盘与市场资料整理成受支持的JSON事项，在手机上查看优先跟进内容、来源与下一步；含合成示例。 场景预览 · 合成样例 无需登录 · 无需麦克风 0 1 · 网页朗读与草稿 示例材料 → 可编辑回复 0 2 · 蓝牙四步自检 四个问题 → 一个排查方向 0 3 · 外贸每日简报 询盘 / 市场 / 跟进样例切换 询盘 市场 跟进 可读简报 JSON 按当前Radar结构制作的合成样例。真实数据由你的工作流提供；这里不是真实询盘或市场情报。 事项 询盘规格待补 状态 / 优先级 等你决策 · P1 下一步 确认缺少的参数，再起草报价回复 依据 合成询盘资料 示例时间 2026-10-22 09:00:00 合成材料与预设结果，不是真实AI处理。App需自有工作台、语音模型与签名；网页朗读由浏览器语音服务提供。 看这个场景怎么用 → 查看接入条件 → 启用JavaScript以切换预览或编辑样例，也可直接阅读场景指南与接入步骤。 先找到一个有用的下一步 每天打开手机，先看需要你决定或跟进的事项，再核来源和下一步。一呼读取你自己的结构化简报；客户资料与市场信息由你现有的业务工作流准备。 三类材料，三种下一步 你已有的材料 手机简报怎么写 下一步 询盘资料不完整 规格参数待补，报价范围待确认。 列出要问的问题，核对后回复。 市场资料有变化 标明资料来源与更新时间。 回看原资料，确认是否影响当前报价。 昨日跟进未完成 写清当前卡点和下一次联系准备。 在自己的业务工具中继续处理。 一个当前格式的合成简报 示例只演示结构，不是真实商机或市场情报。下面的任务project与项目path对应；完整数据还包含decisions和active/stale/cold集合。 { "date_str" : "2026-10-22 09:00:00" , "tasks" :[{ "id" : "sample-inquiry" , "project" : "export-demo" , "title" : "询盘规格待补" , "status" : "等你决策" , "priority" : "P1" , "next" : "确认缺少的规格参数后起草回复" , "url" : "https://example.com/brief" , "evidence" : "合成材料，仅供预览" }], "decisions" :[], "active" :[{ "name" : "外贸跟进" , "path" : "export-demo" , "timestamp" : 1792630800 , "message" : "合成示例，非实时资料" }], "stale" :[], "cold" :[]} 把已有资料按受支持格式准备好，再通过兼容来源或文件导出接入。需要登录的数据按既有文件导出路径处理；网页账户登录与简报读取各自准备。 与日常业务工具怎么分工 一呼便于在手机查看事项和接续工作台；你现有的邮箱、CRM或业务文档继续负责数据和实际跟进。一呼不自动连接这些账户，也不提供客户数据库或商机采集服务。来源时间不清时先回看原资料。 配对Apple Watch可接收手机摘要，方便提醒你回手机继续查看；关键决定仍在手机和原业务流程中确认。 FAQ 简报会自动抓取客户询盘吗？ 数据由你的业务工作流提供。一呼读取已准备的结构化来源，不代替邮箱/CRM接入或市场数据服务。 一定要自己搭一个后端吗？ 先看现有工作流能否提供兼容JSON或受支持的文件导出；一呼本身是客户端，接入步骤见使用条件。 手机显示了事项，就代表来源是最新的吗？ 查看来源时间与读取状态。遇到旧资料或读取失败时，先在原业务系统核对再做决定。 看完就会自动回复客户吗？ 不会。你先选择和核对下一步；实际回复取决于原业务工具和已配置的工作台能力。 接着看 语音草稿 · 音频排障 · 录音笔记 · 每日简报 · 接入条件 · 隐私 实现参考 冻结实现 · README

<td>市场资料有变化</td>

<td>回看原资料，确认是否影响当前报价。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>昨日跟进未完成</td>
<td>写清当前卡点和下一次联系准备。</td>
<td>在自己的业务工具中继续处理。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### 一呼、传统对讲机与语音群聊：按交接对象选工具

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/voice-workbench-vs-radio-chat/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 一呼、传统对讲机与语音群聊：按交接对象选工具 先看接收方：Agent 草稿不等于人与人对讲 一呼是访问自有 HTTPS Agent 工作台的 iOS 浏览器壳，增加手机端语音转写、录音笔记与 PM Radar JSON 读取。传统对讲机用于符合设备制式与当地规则的无线通话；普通语音群聊用于相应服务里的联系人或群组。若需求是持续的人与人现场调度，不应把一呼当作已经验证的对讲机或语音群聊替代品。下表比较使用边界，不是三种方案的实测排名。 先分清三种交接 对人说话 ：先确认收听人、通信制式或服务、现场权限和备用联络方式。不同对讲机与聊天软件的能力不能一概而论。 把想法交给 Agent ：先选工作台与页面草稿框，再使用已配置模型的手机转写；草稿填入不是消息发送，更不是任务执行。 先保留记录 ：录音笔记保留本地音频和文字，核对后再显式交接。会议记录不自动变成确认无误的纪要或分配给团队的任务。 参数与选型边界对照 核对项 一呼当前范围 传统对讲机 普通语音群聊 接收对象 自有网页工作台的草稿，或本地笔记；不是群组语音频道 兼容设备/系统内的收听方，按具体设备确认 相应聊天服务里的联系人或群组，按实际产品确认 连接条件 网页需手机可达的可信 HTTPS；转写需另下载兼容模型 频段、制式、覆盖与当地使用规则需核实 账号、权限、网络和服务状态需核实 蓝牙与耳机 近场采集源码配置 voiceChat 与 allowBluetoothHFP；不等于任意耳机适配认证 配件接口、协议与麦克风行为看具体型号 输入输出与通话行为看软件、系统和耳机组合 离线/弱网 已备模型的端侧处理、本地笔记和既有 Radar 缓存各有边界；网页交接不保证离线 不据工具类别推断是否依赖中继或网络 不据类别承诺离线收发；检查实际服务 发送与回执 不自动按 Send；Radar 回复另需服务端授权、手机确认及回读 按设备通话操作与现场回读规程，不由本页认证 按实际软件的发送/接收提示，不等同对方已处理 距离与延迟 没有本轮对讲距离、端到端时延或持续通话测试结果 不给出脱离设备、环境和制式的统一数值 不给出脱离网络与服务的统一数值 锁屏与免按键 不承诺锁屏唤醒、持续免按键对讲或耳机按键触发 以具体设备说明和验证为准 以软件版本、系统策略和验证为准 可审阅文字 可核对转写、目标与显式交接；识别可能出错 是否带录音/文字功能以具体设备为准 文字、转写、录音保存规则以实际产品为准 蓝牙音频预检不是免提通话认证 CollieAudioCapturePreferences 的近场模式配置了 playAndRecord 、 voiceChat 和 allowBluetoothHFP ；关闭近场时配置不同。这说明源码会请求相应音频会话，不证明某一款 AirPods、头盔耳机或蓝牙适配器已通过真机验证，也不证明风噪抑制、回声控制或长时续航达标。 在安全静止环境先确认系统输入、输出及录音权限，用一条无真实任务的合成语句检查转写和草稿目标。更换耳机、来电或音频服务重置后重新检查。录音笔记源码有输入设备变化后的重定向和失败提示路径；不能由此保证中断无损恢复。不得在行驶中操作手机或为了测试绕过宿主拒绝。 离线、会议与外贸需求怎样分流 弱网或离线 ：已下载且可用的模型与本地音频不等于网页可访问。缓存卡片只是既有快照，失败或旧来源须显示；不要把点刷新、蓝牙已连接或本地识别完成当作远端已收到。 AI 会议录音纪要 ：一呼提供的是录音、分段转写和保留原文，会议纪要需要另外核对并在获准的目标流程里整理。本页不承诺说话人分离、自动提炼行动项或识别准确率；录音前确认参与者知情和适用规则。 外贸雷达 ：若你的自有台账把询盘或跟进任务导出为符合 PM Radar 契约的 JSON，可按项目与状态阅读；这不是内置海关数据库、市场情报订阅、客户资料搜集或自动发信服务。 tasks 与 decisions 、来源时间、缓存状态以及写授权仍须分别核对。 FAQ 一呼能直接替换门店或车队对讲机吗？ 不能据当前源码这样承诺。它的交接对象是自己的工作台草稿，不是已验收的多人语音频道。现场实时联络应另选符合条件的设备/服务并做当地环境验证；一呼可在安全静止时辅助整理文字记录。 蓝牙耳机已连接，是否代表一呼正在使用耳机麦克风？ 不代表。配对状态、实际输入路由和当前音频会话是不同事实。需要在实际设备上核对输入、输出和合成录音结果；源码选项不替代耳机型号兼容证明。 Apple Watch 能作为独立对讲或审批终端吗？ 当前 Watch 伴侣接收配对手机的既有摘要并接续到手机，需配对及系统条件。它不提供本页承诺的独立对讲、台账刷新或独立审批；手机确认与服务端授权仍独立存在。 没有网络时转写完成，能算已经交付吗？ 不能。识别文字只说明该处理步骤有结果。网页、附件上传或真实回复仍依赖目标服务与权限。结果不确定先保留原文并核对目的地，不自动重试。 外贸团队可以导入询盘任务吗？ 只有在团队有权使用并自行导出符合模型契约的 JSON 时才可按现有 Radar 规则阅读。来源身份、字段、日期与缓存必须明确；本页不新增外贸数据源、客户名单、通知后台或自动跟进。 在哪里下载 App Store 成品？ 当前是源码发行，没有已发布成品链接。请按构建指南使用自己的签名、模型和工作台。本页不会用虚构商店链接或“已上线源码”替代安装与设备验收。 依据与下一步 README：能力、前提与限制 音频会话策略源码 录音输入变化处理源码 户外骑行与门店：静止预检及文字交接指南 · 开始 · 隐私 · 录音笔记 · 多项目 Radar 与 Watch

### Yihu, two-way radios or voice group chat: choose by destination

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/voice-workbench-vs-radio-chat/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Yihu, two-way radios or voice group chat: choose by destination An Agent draft is not a person-to-person radio call Yihu is an iOS browser shell for your own HTTPS Agent workbench, with phone transcription, recording notes and PM Radar JSON reads. Two-way radios serve compatible radio systems under the applicable local rules; ordinary voice group chat serves contacts or groups in a particular service. If you need continuous person-to-person field dispatch, do not treat Yihu as a tested replacement for either. This is a boundary comparison, not a benchmark ranking. Three different destinations Speak to people : identify listeners, compatible equipment or service, permissions and a fallback contact method. Radio models and chat applications are not interchangeable. Hand a thought to an Agent : choose the workbench and draft editor before transcribing with a configured local model. Draft insertion is neither message submission nor execution. Keep a record first : recording notes retain local audio and text for review before explicit handoff. Meeting recordings are not automatically verified minutes or assigned team actions. Parameters and selection boundaries Check Current Yihu scope Two-way radio Ordinary voice group chat Destination Your workbench draft or local note, not a group voice channel Listeners in a compatible device/system; check the actual equipment Contacts/groups in the particular service; check the actual product Connectivity Reachable, trusted HTTPS for web work; separately downloaded compatible models for transcription Verify frequency, system, coverage and local operating rules Verify account, permissions, network and service availability Bluetooth/headset Near-field source requests voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP; not arbitrary-headset certification Accessory connector, protocol and microphone behavior depend on the model Routing and call behavior depend on app, system and headset combination Offline/weak network Prepared local models, notes and existing Radar cache have separate limits; no offline web-handoff promise Do not infer independence from repeaters or networks from the category Do not assume offline sending/receiving from the category Send and receipt Never presses Send; Radar replies need separate server authority, phone confirmation and readback Follow device controls and your field readback procedure; not certified here Follow actual send/receive indicators, which do not prove handling Range and latency No radio-range, end-to-end latency or continuous-call benchmark from this work No universal number detached from equipment, environment and system No universal number detached from network and service Lock screen/button-free use No promise of lock-screen wake, continuous button-free intercom or headset-button triggering Check the specific manual and validation Check the app version, system policy and validation Reviewable text Review transcript, destination and explicit handoff; recognition can be wrong Recording/text features depend on the actual model Text, transcription and recording retention depend on the actual product Bluetooth audio checks are not hands-free call certification The near-field configuration in CollieAudioCapturePreferences requests playAndRecord , voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP ; disabling near-field processing uses a different configuration. These are source-level audio-session choices. They do not certify any AirPods model, helmet headset or Bluetooth adapter, nor wind-noise reduction, echo control or battery endurance. In a safe stationary setting, check the actual input, output and microphone permission. Use one synthetic phrase with no real task, then inspect transcription and the destination draft. Recheck after changing headsets, interruptions or an audio-service reset. The recording-note source has input-retargeting and failure paths; these are not proof of lossless interruption recovery. Do not operate the phone while moving or bypass a host refusal for a test. Route offline, meeting and trade needs separately Offline or weak connectivity : an available downloaded model and local audio do not make the web reachable. A visible Radar card may be an old snapshot; stale sources and failures must remain distinguishable. Refresh taps, Bluetooth pairing and finished local recognition are not receipts from a remote destination. AI meeting minutes : Yihu provides recording, segmented transcription and retained originals. Minutes still require review and a separately authorized destination workflow. This page promises neither speaker diarization, automatic action extraction nor accuracy. Confirm participant awareness and applicable recording rules before recording. Foreign-trade Radar : a team can read its own authorized inquiry/follow-up tasks if it exports JSON matching the existing PM Radar contract. This is not a built-in customs database, market-intelligence subscription, customer-list scraper or automated email service. Keep tasks , decisions , source dates, cache status and write authority separate. FAQ Can Yihu directly replace a store or riding-team radio? Not on the evidence here. Its destination is your workbench draft, not an accepted multi-person voice channel. Choose and validate suitable equipment/services for live field contact; Yihu can help organize text while safely stationary. Does a paired Bluetooth headset prove Yihu uses its microphone? No. Pairing, the actual input route and the active audio session are different facts. Check input/output and a synthetic recording on the actual device; source options do not certify a headset model. Can Apple Watch be a standalone intercom or approval terminal? The companion receives existing paired-phone summaries and hands work back to the phone, subject to pairing and system prerequisites. This page promises no independent intercom, ledger refresh or approval. Phone confirmation and server authority remain separate. Is completed offline transcription proof of handoff? No. It only establishes a result for that processing step. Web access, attachment upload or a real reply still needs the destination service and permissions. Retain the original and inspect uncertainty before trying again. Can a foreign-trade team import inquiry tasks? Only through its own authorized JSON export matching the model contract. Make source identity, fields, dates and cache status explicit. This page adds no trade-data feed, customer list, notification backend or automatic follow-up. Where is the App Store download? This is currently a source release, without a published binary link. Use your own signing, models and workbench as described in the build guide. A made-up store link or merged source cannot replace installation and device acceptance. Evidence and next steps README: capabilities, prerequisites and limits Audio-session policy source Recording input-change handling Outdoor/store stationary checks and text handoff · Start · Privacy · Recording notes · Multi-project Radar and Watch

### 户外骑行与餐饮门店：蓝牙语音预检和工作台文字交接

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/outdoor-store-voice-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 户外骑行与餐饮门店：蓝牙语音预检和工作台文字交接 这是一份安全静止时的文字工作流，不是对讲部署教程 一呼可围绕自有 Agent 网页工作台，把手机转写、录音笔记和已有 JSON 台账串成可核对的文字流程。户外骑行应停车并到安全位置再操作；门店应避开热源、车辆和正在服务的区域。蓝牙耳机配对不等于当前录音输入正确，也不等于多人免提对讲可用。即时联络、紧急通知和现场安全调度需要另有经验证的通信方式，不能依赖本指南。 先准备一个不会执行真实任务的样例 自行构建并签名一呼，准备可用的兼容模型、麦克风权限和你有权访问的可信 HTTPS 工作台。选一个空白草稿框，确认输入不会自动提交；不要测试到已有订单、客户沟通、付款或生产指令里。本页和官网演示不会接入麦克风、真实工作台或客户数据。 合成语句 ：“整理一份示例物品检查清单，只留草稿，不发送、不下单、不执行。”这条语句是流程示意，不是已经跑过的真机用例。先明确目标，再选择短语音草稿或录音笔记一条路径；不要把同一段内容同时交接两次。 路由、模型与交接的参数检查表 项目 当前源码/流程依据 检查动作 不满足时 运行环境 iOS 18+、自有签名；语音需另下载兼容模型 确认模型可用、权限与可用空间，再选目标 停在准备步骤，不跳过校验或权限 蓝牙输入 近场策略请求 voiceChat 与 allowBluetoothHFP 静止时检查实际输入/输出，用合成语句核对 更换路由后重新检查；不从“已配对”推断输入 短语音 有守卫的草稿交付，不自动按发送 先聚焦目标输入框；转写后看是否已填入 不再盲目填入；拒绝或不明确时保留原文 录音笔记 本地 audio.caf / note.json，前台可处理时分段转写 核对人名、数字、否定词与分段接缝 中断/失败与完成分开，不承诺任意录音时长 笔记直接填入 当前界面门槛为 3000 个 Swift Character，且需完成与目标检查 3000/3001 ASCII 字符仅作门槛解释 长文走已有 Markdown 暂存；不解释为时长上限 附件交接 先存分享托盘，文字不附带原录音 核对文字和目的地，再单独选择后续操作 暂存不等于上传；未发送不证明未上传 Radar 时效 既有缓存、来源 date_str 与刷新失败状态各有意义 阅读来源时间和错误，区分 tasks 与 decisions 无新读成功证据不标“最新”，不把零结果当空台账 Watch 与回执 手表接续手机已有摘要；真实回复另需手机确认及授权 核对手机可达性、目标、确认界面及服务回读 queued/saved 不当作发送、审批或执行完成 户外骑行：停车后的记录路径 先停稳并选择安全位置 ，不要在行驶、过路口、下坡或需要注意环境时操作手机或隔绝环境声。头盔耳机和 AirPods 没有由本轮验证为一呼兼容设备。 核对音频与模型 。风、头盔遮挡和输入切换都可能影响实际录音；源码设置音频处理不等于实测风噪指标。若环境不适合，改用安全的手动记录或推迟。 区分本地与远端 。模型已就绪时的手机处理、保存音频以及网页可达是三件事。没有网络时不要承诺上传、回复或网页草稿同步；缓存卡片也不是本次成功刷新。 只走合成草稿 。转写完成后核对文字和目标。已有填入只检查不重复；未知编辑器或宿主拒绝不绕过。结果不明先留原文，使用既有通信方式处理真正紧急事项。 餐饮/酒店/零售门店：非紧急记录的交接路径 把演练限定为不含订单和个人信息的内部样例，例如整理下次例会要核对的三个设备问题。录音前确认现场参与者知情、权限和服务规则；不要把顾客对话、餐桌信息或员工私密内容当演示材料。 在静止安全处打开正确工作台，选短转写草稿或录音笔记。短语音可能自动尝试受守卫填入，因此先核对目的地；结束录音笔记则不等于已经交给 Agent。笔记的显式填入/分享暂存先保留一次交接标记，结果不确定也不自动重试或换另一条交接路径。核对目的地已有内容后再决定是否手动复制。 若团队自行把设备检查或询盘跟进事项导出成 Radar JSON，只读筛选不会修改台账。所谓“外贸雷达”在这里仅指自有任务数据的解释与阅读，不是外贸商机抓取、自动采购、自动发信或实时门店调度系统。任何真实回复仍需独立写权限、手机确认与回执，不能由本页走读代替服务验收。 FAQ 能用耳机按键或语音一直免按键调度吗？ 本指南不提供这种承诺。蓝牙会话配置不是耳机按键触发、锁屏唤醒或持续群组对讲的证据。当前候选只是安全静止时的音频预检和文字交接。 voiceChat 模式是否保证骑行风噪被消除？ 不保证。它是源码中的系统音频模式请求，不是特定耳机、风速、头盔或骑行条件下的测试成绩。环境影响识别时应停止并改用适当方法。 弱网下是否可以完全离线完成工作流？ 不能这样概括。已就绪模型、本地笔记和既有快照有本地处理路径，模型下载、网页、附件交接和服务回复分别有网络与权限前提。应明确停在哪一步而不是统称“全部离线”。 录音结束后就生成可信的 AI 会议纪要了吗？ 没有。一呼源码提供分段转写和原文保存；核对、摘要和行动项整理需要另走获准流程。识别文本可能错误，保存本地也不代表备份与后续交接副本都不存在。 换耳机或来电后是否能保证录音无损继续？ 不能。源码包含输入变化处理以及中断/失败提示，但不是所有设备与干扰组合的验收。检查保存状态、音频和转写接缝；不要用恢复路径的存在宣称绝不丢字。 门店紧急调度能把草稿填入当作送达吗？ 不能。草稿、上传、发送、回执和对方处理分别是不同状态。本页不做时延、覆盖距离或生产送达承诺；紧急事项应使用已有经验证的联络与安全流程。 继续阅读与源码 一呼 vs 对讲机/语音群聊选型 · 接入预检 · 隐私 · 录音笔记与一次交接 · 多项目 Radar 与 Watch 依据： README 的功能与限制 、 音频采集策略 、 笔记输入变化处理 。这是源码/静态内容说明，不是真机、工作台写入、会议准确率或生产调度验收。

### Outdoor riding and stores: Bluetooth checks and workbench text handoff

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/outdoor-store-voice-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Outdoor riding and stores: Bluetooth checks and workbench text handoff A stationary text workflow, not an intercom deployment guide Yihu can combine phone transcription, recording notes and existing JSON-ledger reads around your own Agent web workbench. Stop riding and reach a safe place before operating it; in stores, move away from heat, vehicles and active service areas. Bluetooth pairing proves neither the active recording input nor multi-person hands-free intercom capability. Use a separately validated contact method for live communications, emergencies and safety dispatch, not this guide. Prepare a sample that cannot execute real work Build and sign the app yourself, prepare compatible models and microphone permission, and use a trusted HTTPS workbench you are authorized to access. Choose an empty draft editor that does not submit input automatically. Do not test against existing orders, customer conversations, payments or production instructions. This page and the website demo do not access your microphone, real workbench or customer data. Synthetic phrase : “Prepare a sample equipment checklist; keep only a draft, without sending, ordering or executing.” This is a process illustration, not a passed device test. Confirm the destination, then choose short dictation or recording notes, rather than handing the same content over twice. Route, model and handoff parameter checklist Item Current source/workflow basis Check Stop boundary Runtime iOS 18+, own signing; speech requires downloaded compatible models Check model availability, permission and free space before choosing the target Stay in setup; never bypass verification or permission Bluetooth input Near-field policy requests voiceChat and allowBluetoothHFP Check actual input/output while stationary and review a synthetic phrase Recheck after a route change; paired does not prove the input Short speech Guarded draft handoff, without pressing Send Focus the intended composer first; inspect whether text was already inserted Do not blindly insert again; retain text on refusal or uncertainty Recording notes Local audio.caf/note.json; segmented transcription when foreground processing is available Review names, numbers, negations and segment joins Distinguish interruption/failure from completion; no arbitrary-duration guarantee Direct note insertion Current UI threshold is 3,000 Swift Characters, plus completion and target checks ASCII lengths 3000/3001 only illustrate the boundary Longer text uses existing Markdown staging; not a recording-duration limit Attachment handoff Stage in the share tray first; raw audio is not attached Inspect text and destination before a separate next action Staging is not uploading; unsent does not establish not uploaded Radar freshness Existing cache, source date_str and failed reads are distinct signals Inspect source time/errors and distinguish tasks from decisions Do not label data latest without a successful source read or treat zero matches as an empty ledger Watch/receipts Watch hands off existing phone summaries; replies need separate phone confirmation/authority Check phone reachability, target, confirmation and service readback queued/saved are not proof of sending, approval or execution Outdoor riding: a record after stopping Stop and find a safe location first . Do not operate a phone while riding, crossing, descending or needing environmental awareness. Do not block necessary ambient sound. This work does not certify helmet headsets or AirPods for Yihu. Check audio and models . Wind, a helmet and input changes can affect actual recording. Requesting system audio processing is not a measured wind-noise result. Delay recording or choose an appropriate manual method when conditions are unsuitable. Separate local and remote steps . Prepared-model phone processing, audio retention and web reachability are distinct. Without a network, do not promise uploads, replies or web-draft sync; cached cards are not a successful new refresh. Use only the synthetic draft . Review text and destination. If already inserted, inspect instead of inserting again. Unknown editors and host refusals are not bypassed. Retain originals on uncertainty and use established channels for urgent matters. Restaurant, hotel and retail stores: non-urgent text handoff Keep a trial free of orders and personal information: for example, three equipment questions for a future internal meeting. Before recording, check participant awareness, permissions and service rules. Customer conversations, table details and private employee information are not demo material. In a safe stationary location, open the correct workbench and choose a short-speech draft or a recording note. Short speech may automatically attempt guarded insertion, so choose the destination first. Stopping a note recording is not handing it to an Agent. Explicit insertion or staging reserves one note-handoff marker; uncertain results do not automatically retry or switch to another route. Inspect existing destination content before deciding whether manual copying is appropriate. If your team exports equipment checks or inquiry follow-ups as its own Radar JSON, read-only filtering does not change ledger status. “Foreign-trade Radar” here only describes authorized task-data interpretation and reading, not lead scraping, automatic purchasing, automatic email or real-time store dispatch. Real replies retain separate write permission, phone confirmation and readback; this walkthrough is not service acceptance. FAQ Can headset buttons or speech provide continuous button-free dispatch? This guide makes no such promise. Bluetooth session configuration is not evidence of headset-button triggers, lock-screen wake or continuous group intercom. The candidate covers safely stationary audio checks and text handoff only. Does voiceChat guarantee riding wind noise is removed? No. It requests a system audio mode; it is not a test result for a headset, wind speed, helmet or riding condition. Stop and use an appropriate alternative if the environment prevents reliable recognition. Can the whole workflow run offline in weak coverage? No blanket claim is appropriate. Prepared models, local notes and existing snapshots have local paths. Model downloads, web access, attachment handoff and service replies have separate network/permission prerequisites. Identify the actual stopped step instead of calling everything offline. Does stopping recording produce trustworthy AI meeting minutes? No. The source provides segmented transcription and retained originals. Review, summarization and action extraction need a separate authorized workflow. Recognition can be wrong; local retention does not rule out backup or later handoff copies. Can recording always continue losslessly after a call or headset change? No. Input-change handling and interruption/failure messages exist in source, but are not acceptance of every device/interrupt combination. Check saved status, audio and transcript joins. A recovery path is not a guarantee against lost words. Can a store treat inserted draft text as delivery for an urgent instruction? No. Drafts, uploads, sends, receipts and handling are separate states. This guide promises no latency, range or production delivery. Use established validated communications and safety procedures for urgent work. Reading and source evidence Choose between Yihu, radio and voice chat · Setup checks · Privacy · Recording notes and one handoff · Multi-project Radar and Watch Evidence: README capabilities/limits , audio-capture policy , note input-change handling . This is a source/static-content explanation, not device, workbench-write, meeting-accuracy or production-dispatch acceptance.

### iPhone 蓝牙耳机能听到却录不到？四步检查输入设备

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/bluetooth-audio-input-troubleshooting/

场景指南 iPhone 蓝牙耳机能听到却录不到？四步检查输入设备 用四个实际检查区分播放与拾音，排查蓝牙耳机、停车后的车载音频和手机麦克风；附清晰的下一步。 场景预览 · 合成样例 无需登录 · 无需麦克风 0 1 · 网页朗读与草稿 示例材料 → 可编辑回复 0 2 · 蓝牙四步自检 四个问题 → 一个排查方向 0 3 · 外贸每日简报 询盘 / 市场 / 跟进样例切换 按你的实际观察选择；网页不会读取设备或请求权限。车载操作请先停车。 四步本地自检问答 1. 想检查哪种设备？ 请选择 iPhone 蓝牙耳机 停车后的车载设备 2. 回放能听见声音吗？ 请选择 有 / 正常 没有 / 异常 还不确定 3. 选定设备试录一句，有声音吗？ 请选择 有 / 正常 没有 / 异常 还不确定 4. 切回手机自身麦克风，对照录音正常吗？ 请选择 有 / 正常 没有 / 异常 还不确定 查看排查建议 0 /4 完成四问后，根据你的答案给出排查建议，不作硬件诊断。 合成材料与预设结果，不是真实AI处理。App需自有工作台、语音模型与签名；网页朗读由浏览器语音服务提供。 看这个场景怎么用 → 查看接入条件 → 启用JavaScript以切换预览或编辑样例，也可直接阅读场景指南与接入步骤。 先找到一个有用的下一步 先停车或停在安全位置，暂停通话与其他播放，再试录一句。按“当前设备→能否听见→录音回放→切换后再试”对照，比反复重连更容易定位问题。 四步自检 步骤 你要确认什么 下一步 1. 当前设备 手机、蓝牙耳机，还是停车后的车载设备？ 先确认想用哪一支麦克风；配对名称不等于当前输入。 2. 播放声音 暂停其他播放后，系统提示或回放能听见吗？ 听不见先查音量与输出；听得见后继续查录音。 3. 试录一句 在有权限的录音App录一句再回放。 若无声或很小，检查该App麦克风权限，并用手机自身麦克风对照。 4. 切换再试 断开外设、用手机试录，再连接外设对比。 手机正常而外设异常时，核系统可用的输入选择、外设状态和App兼容。 看结果，选一个动作 **能播放、录不到：**先看所用App的麦克风权限。系统提供输入选择时核对实际设备，再试一句。 **手机能录、耳机不能录：**保留这组对照结果，再查耳机/车机设置和连接；不要把输出正常当作麦克风已就绪。 **切回前台或接完电话后异常：**先停当前录音，再在前台重新选择录音入口，检查保留的文字后再开始新一段。 **都能录，只有网页没文字：**检查转写模型、当前工作台与输入框；可先保留录文，再核对目的地。 一呼在这条流程里做什么 一呼使用iPhone的音频输入并在准备好模型后转写，随后把文字交给兼容的网页草稿。这个检查清单帮助你选择下一步，不读取或切换网页访客的蓝牙设备。具体输入选择取决于系统、机型与所用App。车载检查请停车后进行。 FAQ 耳机能播放音乐，为什么录音还是来自手机？ 播放和拾音是两个选择。先做一段手机/外设的对照录音，查看系统提供的实际输入选项。 去哪里查麦克风权限？ 在iPhone“设置→隐私与安全性→麦克风”核对所用App；网页工作台的权限与原生录音入口也应分别确认。 可以边开车边完成检查吗？ 请停车后操作。这里是音频排障清单，不提供驾驶中操作指引或CarPlay专用界面。 能保证某款耳机的录音效果吗？ 先在自己的设备和环境试录。没有逐机验证的数据时，不给耳机型号、风噪、距离或准确率承诺。 接着看 语音草稿 · 音频排障 · 录音笔记 · 每日简报 · 接入条件 · 隐私 实现参考 冻结实现 · README · Apple microphone help

### iPhone Bluetooth mic not recording? Check the input in four steps

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/bluetooth-audio-input-troubleshooting/

All scenarios iPhone Bluetooth mic not recording? Check the input in four steps A practical check for Bluetooth headsets, parked-car audio and the iPhone microphone: separate playback from recording, then choose a next step. SAMPLE PREVIEW No login or microphone needed 0 1 · Read & draft Sample material → editable reply 0 2 · Audio self-check Four questions → a useful next step 0 3 · Daily sales brief Inquiry / market / follow-up samples Answer from your own observations. This page does not read devices or request permissions. Park before operating car audio. Four local self-check questions 1. Which device are you checking? Choose an answer iPhone Bluetooth headset Parked-car audio 2. Can you hear playback? Choose an answer Yes No Not sure yet 3. Does a short recording have sound? Choose an answer Yes No Not sure yet 4. Does a comparison recording on the phone work? Choose an answer Yes No Not sure yet See a suggested next step 0 /4 Complete the four answers for a suggested check, not a hardware diagnosis. Preset samples, not live AI processing. App setup requires your workspace, speech models and signing. Browser read-aloud uses the browser’s voice service. Explore this workflow → See setup requirements → Enable JavaScript to switch previews or edit the sample. You can still read the scenario guides and setup instructions. Start with a useful next step Park or move somewhere safe, pause calls and other playback, then record a short sample. Compare the device, audible output, recording playback and a second sample after switching. Four checks, in order Step What to check Next action 1. Device Phone, headset or parked-car audio? Decide which microphone you intend to use; a paired name alone does not select it. 2. Playback Can you hear a prompt or recording after pausing other playback? Check output and volume first if not, then check recording. 3. Sample Record a phrase in an app with permission and play it back. For quiet/silent input, check that app’s mic permission and compare the phone mic. 4. Switch Disconnect the accessory, record on the phone, then reconnect and compare. If only the accessory fails, inspect available input choices, device settings and app compatibility. Turn the result into one next step Playback works, recording does not: inspect the recording app’s microphone permission and any available system input selector, then test a phrase. Phone records, accessory does not: keep this comparison and check the accessory connection/settings. Output alone does not establish input readiness. Trouble after a call or returning to the app: stop the current capture, reopen recording in the foreground and inspect retained text before starting another clip. Recording works, but the page has no text: check speech models and the intended workspace/editor. Keep the transcript while reviewing the destination. Where Yihu fits Yihu uses iPhone audio input, transcribes with prepared local models and hands text to a compatible web draft. This checklist suggests a next action; it does not inspect or switch a website visitor’s Bluetooth hardware. Available inputs vary by system/device/app. Operate car controls only while parked. FAQ Why does recording use my phone when the headset plays music? Playback and capture are separate choices. Compare short phone/accessory recordings and inspect the input options your system provides. Where do I check mic permission? Open Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone for the recording app. A web workspace and native capture can have different permission requirements. Should I do this while driving? Park first. This is a troubleshooting checklist, not driving guidance or a dedicated CarPlay interface. Is a particular headset guaranteed to work well? Try it on your own device and in your environment. No headset, wind-noise, distance or accuracy promise is made without device evidence. ### 离线转写完成却没交付？弱网工作台与Radar缓存排障

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/offline-workbench-handoff-troubleshooting/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 离线转写完成却没交付？弱网工作台与Radar缓存排障 离线不是一个全局开关：先指出哪一步有证据 一呼的已就绪本地模型、录音笔记和既有 Radar 快照各自有本地处理路径，但模型下载、HTTPS网页、附件交接与服务回复另有网络和权限前提。转写完成只证明这一段处理有文字结果；既有卡片只证明有可显示快照。排障应记录“本地已完成、远端未知”之类的分层状态，不把整条工作流统称为已离线成功或全部失败。 不做破坏性复现的最小顺序 先核对正在查看的工作台、页面和数据源，保留原文与现有状态。只用没有真实业务含义的合成内容，不主动断开他人的网络、不删除缓存、不重置账号，也不向真实任务发送测试回复。若已有不确定写入，先按原请求身份回读，不能为了“看看能不能发”制造新请求。 网络与状态分层表 所在步骤 现有证据或字段 仍需检查 停止/保留方式 模型准备 已下载、校验通过的兼容模型 是否真的可用、权限与资源；不能只看过去下载过 模型缺失就停，不跳过校验或承诺离线识别 本地录音笔记 本机音频、文字及待处理/失败/完成状态 来电、空间、输入切换及可转写前台时段 保留原文，检查中断位置，不承诺永不丢字 HTTPS网页 当前手机实际访问结果 手机可达、证书信任、服务登录和编辑器兼容 不关闭TLS检查，不公开私有源或放宽权限 草稿填入 预期目标里的未发送文字 捕获页面与当前目标、宿主拒绝/忙碌状态 已填入只检查；不确定不盲目重试 附件暂存 分享托盘的文字/Markdown 后续用户交接是否发生，目标是否先行上传 暂存不是上传，未发送不等于附件未上传 Radar源 date_str、source_refreshing、source_refresh_failed 来源身份与最后成功读取时间 保留旧快照并明示失败/时效，不改写时间为现在 Radar集合 tasks 全任务、decisions 待决策/验收子集 项目/状态/搜索/历史开关交集 零结果不是无任务；先核筛选，不改真实台账 真实回复 已保存 request_id、服务端回执或不确定状态 独立写权限、手机确认、原目标与回读 不生成新ID重发；回执不等于已处理或执行 Radar“有卡片但刚刷新失败”怎么解释 date_str 是来源最后成功读取时间，当前模型按 UTC+08:00 解释；不能用手机请求时间或缓存命中把它改成现在。 source_refreshing 与 source_refresh_failed 用来区分读取进行中和失败。客户端对超过24小时的来源标旧，对超前超过5分钟的时间提示时钟问题；这些是时效信号，不是任务已暂停、阻塞或完成的推断。 可选只读适配器的30秒新鲜/最多五分钟旧值缓存是另一层请求触发的服务器策略，不是所有数据源的固定轮询周期，也不是手机刷新SLA。客户端现有一次 no-cache 跟进不能被描述成永久轮询。本页不新增后台调度器、缓存库或私有台账服务。 三个常见分流例子 例一：录音有字，网页打不开。 把已识别文字与网页连接分开记录，保留本地原文；检查手机的现有授权路径、TLS与服务，不为了交接放宽安全边界。恢复后也先核对目标内容，不能假定此前没写入。 例二：Radar显示旧日期，但筛选后为零。 先看是否提供 tasks 。缺失时旧源会回退待处理子集并提示范围不完整；然后检查项目、状态、优先级、搜索与历史开关。来源旧和集合空是不同问题，不能相互解释。 例三：点过确认后超时。 超时不是“没有写入”。沿原请求身份与既有不确定处理检查，保留待处理信息；不要换源、清标记或新建请求来绕过冻结。服务已记录回复也不等于任务状态改变或有人完成处理。 FAQ 模型曾经下载过，是否足够保证离线转写？ 不是。仍需确认实际版本的兼容模型可用并已校验、权限和资源满足。模型准备、音频采集与文字识别是独立步骤，没有任意设备、语言或性能保证。 手机显示刚刷新，date_str为什么还是旧的？ 手机发起请求不等于源成功读取。当前契约保留来源时间，缓存命中或失败不应更新为当前时刻；应结合刷新/失败状态看待旧卡片。 网页已登录，为什么原生Radar源仍不能读？ 两条会话不同。原生JSON读取不复用网页Cookie、不存源凭据且不跟随重定向；认证源按现有说明走有权取得的文件导出，不把密码或令牌拼进URL。 托盘中已有Markdown，能算服务器已收到吗？ 不能。暂存、用户后续交接、附件上传和消息发送分别核对；文字附件不包含原录音，目标工作台可能在发送前先上传。 回执超时可以换一个request_id再试吗？ 不应这样做。不确定结果保留原请求身份与冻结/回读边界，新ID盲目重试可能重复写入；不存在由本页承诺的端到端绝对一次保证。 手表同步成功能证明源台账已更新吗？ 不能。Watch同步重传手机已有快照；queued或saved只对应各自的传输/保存阶段。源刷新、手机确认和服务回读仍需各自证据。 继续阅读与依据 蓝牙输入排障 · 录音笔记一次交接 · 多项目Radar与Watch · 手机决策与时效 · 字段化纪要与简报 · 隐私 · 开始 源码依据： README 、 Radar模型 、 源读取与缓存 。本页是排障与合成场景说明，不连接真实源或触发写入。
