### 结构化笔记与Radar简报改版前：字段兼容性和语义变更评审

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/brief-format-change-compatibility/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 结构化笔记与Radar简报改版前：字段兼容性和语义变更评审 改版声明不是兼容证明，笔记模板也不是Radar协议 人工结构化笔记可以有自己的编辑版本，但这不会让它成为一呼导入schema。Radar读取的是当前版本源码定义的快照。评审改版时，应分别检查编辑模板的语义变化与生产者JSON契约变化；把键名改得像 tasks 或在文件里写“v2”，不代表App会迁移、识别新功能或批准执行。 与已有版本/类型指南的分工 单份JSON类型校验检查文件形态；两批快照比较检查同源记录值。这里的任务是 生产者或编辑模板准备改版时，目标消费者和既有确认含义会不会被改变 。不根据旧客户端或未来客户端作通用承诺，只对照实际准备使用的源码/版本与已有流程。 格式改版评审表 改版项 应核对的原契约 风险例子 继续/停止依据 人工笔记键名 原字段是编辑标签而非App字段 proposals改名decisions就被当成批准 先保留含义；不能靠改名产生授权 必需根键 date_str、decisions、active/stale/cold的现有类型 合并成projects后丢失必需数组 对照目标模型，缺键就停，不伪造默认数据 可选tasks 缺失/null回退与[]明确空集合不同 改版从未提供变为[]导致范围变化 记录来源范围和语义，不称业务任务已清零 类型变动 String、Double、Bool、数组的字段形态 数字改文本、Bool改字符串 不依赖自动强转；需实际消费者验证 新增字段 目标版本实际认识和验证的字段 新增键被误认为已有UI/能力 不从键存在推断支持；核目标实现 时间口径 来源读取时间、任务时间与编辑时间 新版本把date_str改成导出时间 来源语义必须明确，不能伪造“最新” 身份/范围 project/path/id与权限范围 改名/换源被当作同一批任务 不自动关联，保留未确认与原始来源 回复含义 可读、reply_supported和写授权分开 新版标true就自动发起真实回复 原资格、手机确认与回执门不能变 一个合成的编辑版本变化 旧人工模板：unconfirmed_proposals = 建议核对示例清单。 拟改模板：confirmed_decisions = 建议核对示例清单。 风险：只换了键名，却把未批准提案误标成已确认。 评审决定：不采用该语义变更，保留未确认提案；不创建任务。 这些是人工编辑标签，不是可导入JSON或已经运行的迁移测试。若团队另有获准导出器，应由该流程维护实际契约；本文不把上述模板转换为Radar记录，也不提供更改真实源的脚本。 固定消费者版本再评估 先记录目标App源码/构建版本，再对照已有快照字段；不要只说“新格式兼容”。保留不含私密数据的旧/新合成样例，逐项标出必需键、类型、缺失值与语义差异。能解析不等于通过后续大小、日期、标识和时间戳验证，更不等于真机/权限/生产验收。 如果发现差异，不为消除错误而填当前时间、复制旧任务或把未知状态写成完成。先停止新格式采用，向既有生产者维护流程反馈；不自行修改来源权限或让客户端绕过验证。本页也不新增schema版本协商、自动降级或历史迁移数据库。 FAQ 人工纪要模板改版会自动更新一呼字段吗？ 不会。编辑标签和App模型是不同契约，模板版本不自动创建App界面、导入字段或服务能力。 JSON写了v2是否就有版本协商？ 不能这样推断。应核目标源码实际实现，文件里的声明不是客户端已支持新格式的证明，本页不新增协商机制。 把提案字段改名为决定字段可以保持内容不变吗？ 键名可能改变读者理解，必须核语义；没有独立批准就不能把未确认提案归为确认结论，不能靠重命名授权执行。 生产者新增键就能认为所有客户端都兼容吗？ 不能。是否识别、忽略或校验取决于目标版本；新增键也不意味着已有UI或原生增强，需实际版本证据。 把缺失tasks补成空数组只是格式整理吗？ 不是无语义变化。缺失/null会走旧源回退，[]是明确空全量集合，范围含义可能变化，应由来源确认。 这里的检查表能替代Swift解码与真机验收吗？ 不能。它是人工改版评审，既不运行App解码，也不验证服务权限或生产数据；测试必须绑定实际消费者版本与范围。 继续阅读与依据 单份JSON类型与空值 · 同源两批比较 · 人工纪要字段 · 降级交接前检 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar字段与decode 、 README来源与写权限边界 。

### Before changing a structured-note or Radar brief format: compatibility and meaning

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/brief-format-change-compatibility/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before changing a structured-note or Radar brief format: compatibility and meaning A revision label is not compatibility evidence, and a note template is not the Radar protocol An editorial structured note can have its own revision, but that does not make it an app import schema. Radar reads the contract in the actual source version. Review editorial meaning and producer JSON changes separately. Renaming keys to resemble tasks , or writing v2 in a file, does not establish migration, feature support or execution approval. A separate task from types and batch values Single-file checks inspect shape; batch comparison inspects source-record differences. Here the question is whether changing a producer/template would change consumer compatibility or confirmation meaning . Do not make universal promises for old/future clients; compare the actual intended source/build and existing workflow. Format-change review table Change Existing contract to inspect Risk example Go/stop evidence Editorial key name An editorial label, not an app field proposals renamed decisions implies approval Preserve meaning; renaming grants no authority Required root keys Existing date_str, decisions, active/stale/cold types Replacing arrays with projects loses required fields Stop on missing keys; no invented defaults Optional tasks Missing/null fallback versus explicitly empty [] Adding [] changes interpreted scope Record scope/meaning rather than claiming all tasks vanished Field type Actual String/Double/Bool/array declarations Number becomes text; Bool becomes string No assumed coercion; validate the actual consumer Added fields Fields recognized/validated by the intended version New key assumed to provide UI/capability Key presence is not support; inspect implementation Time meaning Source read, task update and editorial time date_str becomes export time Keep source meaning explicit, not artificially fresh Identity/scope project/path/id and permissions Renaming/changing sources treated as the same tasks Do not match automatically; retain unknown provenance Reply meaning Read access, reply_supported and write authority differ New true flag triggers real replies Original eligibility, phone confirmation and receipt gates remain One synthetic editorial revision Old editorial label: unconfirmed_proposals = Suggest reviewing a sample checklist. Proposed label: confirmed_decisions = Suggest reviewing a sample checklist. Risk: Renaming falsely turns an unapproved proposal into a decision. Review decision: Reject this meaning change; retain an unconfirmed proposal. Create no task. These labels are not importable JSON or an executed migration test. A team with an authorized exporter must maintain its actual contract through that process. This page neither converts templates into Radar records nor supplies scripts to modify a live source. Fix the consumer version first Record the intended source/build, then compare its snapshot fields instead of declaring the new format compatible. Keep non-sensitive synthetic before/after fixtures identifying required keys, types, absence and meaning. Parsing is not post-decode size/date/identity/timestamp acceptance, much less device, permission or production acceptance. On a mismatch, do not fill now, copied tasks or completed status merely to hide an error. Stop adoption and report through the existing producer-maintenance workflow. Do not alter source permissions or bypass validation. No schema negotiation, automatic downgrade or migration database is added. FAQ Does changing the minutes template update Yihu fields? No. Editorial labels and app models are different contracts. A template revision creates no interface, import field or service capability. Does a v2 label establish version negotiation? No. Inspect actual source support; a file declaration does not certify the consumer supports a new contract. This guide implements no negotiation. Can proposals simply be renamed decisions without changing content? Names can change interpretation. Without separate approval, unconfirmed suggestions cannot become decisions or execution authority by renaming. Does an added producer key work with every client? No blanket claim follows. Recognition, ignoring and validation depend on the actual version. A new key also supplies no UI/native enhancement without implementation evidence. Is adding empty tasks only formatting? No. Missing/null trigger legacy fallback, while [] explicitly supplies an empty ledger. Scope meaning can change and needs source confirmation. Does this replace Swift decoding and device acceptance? No. It is manual revision review, not execution of app decoding or checks of real permissions/data. Tests must bind to an actual consumer version and scope. Reading and evidence Single-file types/nulls · Same-source batch values · Editorial minutes fields · Degraded-handoff decision · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar fields/decode , README source/write boundaries .

### 弱网时改用复制或附件前：降级交接许可与重复风险核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/degraded-handoff-go-no-go/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 弱网时改用复制或附件前：降级交接许可与重复风险核对 网络不好不是换路径的许可，先核原结果和目标权限 当本地文字已保留、网页或服务不可达时，可以先停止在本地；不能因此把同一内容自动改走剪贴板、附件或另一个来源。本文在弱网故障定位之后，检查是否允许改变交接方式，以及旧尝试是否可能已产生副本。它不新增自动降级、重试或可靠送达队列，也不能用人工路径绕过宿主拒绝和一次交接边界。 与弱网排障的分工 弱网指南定位模型、网页、缓存和真实回复各层故障；这里假定已知道受影响层，专门作 继续保留还是采用另一个已获准人工动作 的决定。最安全的结果可能是“不再交接，待核”，而不是必须找一条能发出去的路线。 改交接方式前的决定表 当前情形 先核证据 可保留的安全状态 不允许借此做什么 本地有字，尚未交接 原文、拟用目标、是否确实未尝试 原文留本地待用户选择 自动上传或选定新来源 目标明确拒绝 宿主拒绝/未知响应 保留文字并停止该路径 换编辑器强塞或用另一附件路径绕过 笔记已有尝试 一次交接标记、目标已有内容 不确定停止，保留原文 清标记、改名或复制后自动再交付 附件已暂存 实际版本及是否有后续上传 核托盘与目标阶段 把未发送解释为没有上传 想手动复制 获准目的地、已有内容与其处理规则 用户明确选择且已核范围的人工动作 声称复制绝不重复或所有内容仍本地 想换数据源 来源身份、缓存清理与未决回复 按既有换源条件检查，失败就停 为规避冻结或权限失败切源 真实回复超时 原request_id、待处理与回读状态 沿原身份核结果 生成新ID补发或把超时当没写入 必须立即联络 团队既有经验证的通信流程 退出本试用，按已有安全流程处理 把草稿、暂存或queued当紧急送达 一个合成的“保留而不转送”决定 已知：样例文字在本地；网页交接结果不确定。 未知：目标是否已经出现同一段文字。 拟改方式：复制到另一个草稿。 决定：先不复制/转送，保留原文并核目标已有内容。 原因：新副本不能证明旧尝试未发生，也没有去重保证。 这不是强制所有情况下都禁用人工复制；它要求复制前先核授权、已有内容与不确定性。不存在由本页提供的跨目标统一去重或自动撤回机制，也不要求为测试断网、清缓存或重置任务。 降级前先问四个问题 改变的是什么？ 本地保留、复制、托盘暂存、附件上传和真正发送不是同一步，不把它们都叫“降级发送”。 旧结果是否明确？ 先看原笔记或真实请求状态及目的地，不能从没有回执推断未写入。 新目标是否独立获准？ 读取网页、下载模型或蓝牙连接都不等于可向任意服务交接资料。 哪些副本会留下？ 剪贴板、文档同步、工作台附件可能扩大处理范围；如果无法确认，就继续保留而不交付。 恢复网络后也不应自动把待核材料全部重发。原目标、来源身份、权限与当前内容可能已变化，应继续原守卫与确认流程。本页没有新增离线待发箱、后台补偿或跨源迁移。 FAQ 一呼会在弱网时自动把笔记改走附件吗？ 本页不声明这种能力。现有显式交接与一次标记保留，弱网不自动授予换路由重试或上传权限。 目标拒绝文字，能用文件上传达到同一目标吗？ 不能把附件路径当绕过拒绝的方法。先保留原文并停止受影响路径，按实际宿主许可处理，而不是寻找能强行进入的编辑器。 手动复制是否一定安全且不会重复？ 不一定。复制会产生副本，目的地可能同步、保存或已有同样内容。需用户明确选择并先核范围，本文不给绝不重复保证。 旧请求不确定时可以换工作台重发吗？ 不应为绕过不确定状态而切源或重发。保留原请求身份和待处理状态，按既有回读/确认边界处理。 网络恢复后是否应自动发出全部本地记录？ 不是。网络恢复不等于权限、目标与内容仍适用，必须重新核对相关状态；本文不实现自动待发队列。 只保留本地算工作流失败吗？ 不应混为一谈。本地保留可以是明确的安全停止结果；它既不是远端交付成功，也不抹去已完成的本地处理。 继续阅读与依据 弱网分层排障 · 一次交接与附件边界 · 人工修订副本 · 交接证据审计 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 笔记一次交接模型 、 来源读取与变更条件 、 README不确定回复 。

<td>原request_id、待处理与回读状态</td>
<td>沿原身份核结果</td>
<td>生成新ID补发或把超时当没写入</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>必须立即联络</td>
<td>团队既有经验证的通信流程</td>
<td>退出本试用，按已有安全流程处理</td>
<td>把草稿、暂存或queued当紧急送达</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Before copying or staging under weak coverage: degraded-handoff permission checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/degraded-handoff-go-no-go/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before copying or staging under weak coverage: degraded-handoff permission checks Weak coverage is not permission to change paths; inspect the original result and authority With local text retained and a page/service unreachable, stopping locally is an option. Do not automatically move the same content to clipboard, attachments or another source. After diagnosis, this checklist evaluates permission to change the handoff and whether a prior attempt already created a copy. It adds no automatic fallback, retry or reliable-delivery queue, and manual actions do not bypass host refusal or one-handoff guards. A decision after, not another weak-network diagnosis The troubleshooting guide locates model, web, cache and real-reply failures. Here the affected layer is known; decide whether to keep waiting or perform a separately authorized manual action . A valid outcome may be retain pending review, not a requirement to find any path that sends. Go/no-go before changing handoff Situation Evidence first Safe retained state Not authorized by it Text local, no handoff yet Original, intended target and actual absence of an attempt Retain pending user choice Automatic upload or a newly selected source Explicit host refusal Refusal/unknown response Retain text and stop the path Force another editor or bypass through attachments Note already attempted One-handoff marker and destination content Uncertain-stop with originals Clear markers, rename or copy then redeliver automatically Attachment staged Actual version and any later upload Inspect tray and destination stage Unsent interpreted as not uploaded Manual copying proposed Authorized destination, existing text and handling rules Explicit user choice within reviewed scope Duplicate-free copying or local-only retention claims Source change proposed Identity, cache-clear conditions and unresolved replies Follow existing conditions; stop on failure Bypass a frozen/unauthorized result by changing sources Real reply timeout Original request_id, pending state and readback Inspect through original identity New-ID resend or timeout treated as no write Urgent contact needed Existing validated communication/safety process Leave this trial for that process Treat draft, staging or queued as urgent delivery A synthetic retain-without-forwarding decision Known: Sample text is local; web handoff result is uncertain. Unknown: Whether the destination already contains it. Proposed alternative: Copy to a different draft. Decision: Do not copy/forward yet; retain originals and inspect destination content. Reason: A new copy cannot prove the earlier attempt did not happen or prevent duplicates. This does not ban all manual copying. It requires permission, destination-content and uncertainty checks first. No cross-target deduplication/recall is supplied, and no network disconnection, cache deletion or task reset is required for a test. Four questions before fallback What changes? Local retention, copying, staging, attachment upload and sending are different actions, not one fallback-send operation. Is the old result known? Inspect original note/request state and destination content. An absent receipt is not proof of no write. Is the new destination independently authorized? Web read access, model download and Bluetooth pairing do not authorize sharing data to any service. Which copies remain? Clipboard, document sync and workbench attachments can expand processing. Retain without handoff if the scope is unclear. Connectivity returning does not authorize automatically resending everything pending. Target, source identity, permission and content may have changed. Keep existing guards/confirmation; no offline outbox, background compensation or cross-source migration is added. FAQ Does Yihu automatically turn notes into attachments on weak coverage? No such capability is asserted here. Explicit handoff and reservation remain; weak coverage grants no path-switch, retry or upload authority. Can a file upload bypass a refused text target? Do not use attachments to bypass refusal. Retain originals and stop the affected path, following actual host permission rather than searching for a permissive editor. Is manual copying always safe and duplicate-free? No. It creates a copy and the destination can sync, save or already contain the same text. Explicit user choice and scope checks are needed, without a duplicate-free guarantee. Can I switch workbenches and resend an uncertain request? Do not change sources to bypass uncertainty. Preserve the original identity/pending state and existing readback/confirmation boundary. Should all local notes send automatically when connectivity returns? No. Connectivity does not establish unchanged permission, destination or relevance. Recheck state; this page implements no automatic outbox. Is retaining locally simply a failed workflow? Not as a blanket label. It can be an explicit safe-stop result. It is not remote delivery and does not negate completed local processing. Reading and evidence Layered weak-network diagnosis · One-handoff/attachment boundaries · Correction and copies · Handoff evidence review · Start · Privacy Evidence: one-handoff model , source-read/change conditions , README uncertain replies .

### 团队交接真的完成了吗？最小证据包与完成主张人工审计

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/handoff-evidence-audit-checklist/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 团队交接真的完成了吗？最小证据包与完成主张人工审计 审计先判断证据能支持什么，不为了补证重做一次操作 一呼的本地文字、草稿交付、附件暂存、Radar回复记录与后续处理有不同结果。团队复核时应比较“声称完成了什么”和“实际已有哪一层证据”，不能为了拿到回执而重新发送、换请求ID或执行真实任务。本页是最小人工证据检查表，不是App新增审计日志、跨账号追踪器、不可篡改存证或合规认证。 与责任认领、归档清单的分工 责任清单确定谁按已有流程认领、资料存哪里；这里由另一个获准复核角色，对 已经声称完成的一次交接 作证据范围判断。不分配新任务、不更改档案规则，也不要求收集原始录音、个人信息或顾客正文。 最小人工证据包 检查项 可接受的既有依据 能支持的有限结论 不能扩大为 来源/版本 已知版本、原记录引用与已核范围 复核针对哪一份材料 任意设备或未来版本都有效 目标绑定 原工作台/页面/任务的可核身份 已核的交接对象 任意相似标题或另一个来源 内容范围 获准的必要文字与人工核对记录 这些字段/片段已核 全文或全部副本已核 本地状态 原文、完成/失败及交接尝试状态 本地处理或尝试的相应阶段 远端未收到或必然已收到 草稿/附件 目标未发送草稿或托盘版本 草稿可见或内容已暂存 已发送、已上传或对方已处理 原请求/回执 既有请求身份与服务记录证据 原服务确认记录了相应回复 任务自动完成、状态改变或执行成功 后续处理 原来源独立确认/反馈及其范围 该项已证实的处理步骤 所有动作与下游系统都完成 缺口/未知 缺失的依据、权限或不确定状态 保持待核或不确定 用新请求补发、编写新日志或推测结论 一份合成的主张—证据记录 被复核主张：样例事项“已发送并处理”。 已有依据：仅能看到目的地未发送草稿；没有服务回执。 支持结论：草稿可见；发送和处理未获证实。 保留缺口：原请求/回执未提供，不能推断没有写入。 复核决定：保持待核；不重发、不生成ID、不执行。 这些是人工编辑字段，不是App导入或审计API。不能为了让证据包完整而制造新事件，或把事后写下的说明当作操作时的原始记录。若需引用私有依据，应在原有获准范围中复核，而不是复制到公开评论或未授权文档。 复核顺序与最小披露 明确被复核的主张：是转写完成、草稿可见、回复已记录，还是人已处理？先拆分，避免一个“完成”混合多层。 核来源与目标，确认复核者有权限读取对应材料。网页可读、历史可读与写权限不同，不为审计索要他人凭据。 对照已有证据，只记录可公开或已获准的引用位置、字段和缺口。不要上传真实录音、客户正文、工作台参数或设备标识。 有超时或回执未知时，保留原请求身份和既有不确定边界，不能用新动作来补做“原操作”的证明。 报告最窄结论，说明哪些层未核；复核结果本身不授权合并、发布、下单或发信。 不能由这个清单认证的事 本页不证明第三方日志保留、时间戳可信度、端到端绝对一次、数据删除或法律合规。源码、静态网页、样例和服务回执分别有范围；即使服务记录了回复，也不等于被提及的Agent执行了动作。读取回复历史也不建立任意资料的完整追踪链。 FAQ 一呼是否自带完整不可篡改审计日志？ 本文不作此声明或新增日志功能。只比较已获准的现有证据；缺失就保留缺口，不把人工清单当原生存证系统。 有草稿截图就能说明消息已发出吗？ 不能。草稿截图最多支持相应可见状态，也可能缺版本和目标上下文；发送、服务记录和处理另需证据。 服务回执能证明Agent已经执行吗？ 不能一概而论。现有回复回执证明相应服务记录边界，不自动改任务状态或提供下游执行结果。 为补审计证据可以重新发送一次吗？ 不应这样补证。新操作不能证明旧操作，且可能重复；不确定结果应沿原请求与回读边界处理。 没有权限读某份依据，能让别人导出全部材料吗？ 不以审计名义放宽权限或收集不必要数据。按已有授权流程核最小范围，无法取得的部分明确未核。 清单填满就算满足合规或绝对一次认证吗？ 不算。人工复核不提供法律认证、不可篡改证据链或端到端送达保证，必须保留范围和未知项。 继续复核与依据 责任认领与归档 · 手机回复与回执 · 降级前许可 · 证据主张二次核实 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： README交接、回复与历史边界 、 笔记一次标记 。

### Was a team handoff complete? Minimal evidence and manual claim review

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/handoff-evidence-audit-checklist/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Was a team handoff complete? Minimal evidence and manual claim review Review what evidence supports; do not repeat an operation to create proof Local text, draft delivery, attachment staging, a recorded Radar reply and later handling have different outcomes. Compare the completion claim against the actual evidence stage. Do not resend, change request IDs or execute work merely to obtain a receipt. This is a minimal manual review checklist, not a new app audit log, cross-account tracker, tamper-proof record or compliance certification. Different from responsibility and archive planning The ownership guide checks who acknowledges work and where material belongs. Here another authorized reviewer evaluates evidence for a handoff already claimed complete . It assigns no new task, changes no retention rule and requires no collection of original audio, personal information or customer text. Minimal manual evidence package Check Existing evidence Limited conclusion supported Not established Source/version Known version, original reference and reviewed scope Which material was reviewed Every device or future version works Target identity Verifiable workbench/page/item identity The checked destination Similar title or another source is equivalent Content scope Necessary authorized text and review record These fields/passages were checked Full text and every copy checked Local state Original, complete/failed and handoff-attempt state The corresponding local/attempt stage Remote receipt or absence of receipt Draft/attachment Actual unsent destination draft or tray version Visible draft or staged content Sent/uploaded/handled status Original request/receipt Existing request identity and service record The service recorded that reply Automatic task completion, state change or execution Later handling Independent source confirmation/feedback with scope The evidenced handling step Every action/downstream system completed Gaps/unknowns Missing evidence, permission or uncertain state Pending or uncertain remains New-ID resend, invented logs or guessed conclusions A synthetic claim-evidence record Claim under review: Sample item was sent and handled. Available evidence: Only an unsent destination draft is visible; no service receipt. Supported conclusion: Draft visible; sending/handling unverified. Gap: Original request/receipt not supplied; do not infer no write. Decision: Keep pending; do not resend, create an ID or execute. These are editorial labels, not app imports or an audit API. Do not manufacture new events to complete a package, or represent a retrospective note as an original operation-time record. Review private references in their existing authorized scope, not copied to public comments or unapproved documents. Review order and minimal disclosure Split the claim: transcription complete, draft visible, reply recorded or person handled? One done label should not conflate stages. Check provenance/target and the reviewer’s read permission. Web/history readability is not write authority; do not request another person’s credentials. Record only necessary authorized references, fields and gaps. No real audio, customer text, workbench parameters or device identifiers in public artifacts. Preserve original request identity and uncertain-stop state after timeouts/missing receipts. A new action cannot supply proof of the old action. Report the narrowest conclusion and unreviewed stages. A review finding does not authorize merging, deployment, purchasing or email. What this checklist cannot certify It does not establish third-party log retention, trustworthy timestamps, end-to-end exactly-once behavior, deletion or legal compliance. Source code, static pages, examples and service receipts each have scope. Recording a reply does not establish execution by the named Agent. Reading reply history is not complete tracing of arbitrary material. FAQ Does Yihu provide a complete tamper-proof audit log? No such feature is asserted or added. Compare authorized existing evidence; retain missing-evidence gaps rather than treating this checklist as native recordkeeping. Does a draft screenshot establish sending? No. It supports at most the visible stage and may lack target/version context. Sending, service recording and handling need separate evidence. Does a service receipt establish Agent execution? Not as a blanket claim. Existing reply receipts establish the relevant service-record boundary, not automatic task-state changes or downstream outcomes. Can I send again to obtain audit proof? Do not manufacture evidence that way. New operations do not prove old ones and can duplicate. Use original-request/readback boundaries on uncertainty. Can I request a complete export when lacking access to evidence? Do not expand access or collect unnecessary data under an audit label. Use existing authorization and minimal scope, marking inaccessible material unreviewed. Does a completed checklist certify compliance or exactly-once delivery? No. Manual review supplies neither legal certification, a tamper-proof chain nor end-to-end delivery guarantees. Preserve scope and unknowns. Reading and evidence Ownership/archive checks · Phone replies/receipts · Fallback permission · Second-check evidence claims · Start · Privacy Evidence: README handoff/reply/history limits , one-handoff reservation .

### 手机、Watch、网页与附件为何字段不同？跨端简报呈现核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/cross-device-field-presentation/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 手机、Watch、网页与附件为何字段不同？跨端简报呈现核对 不同载体不是同一份全量副本，字段少不等于数据丢失或任务完成 一呼的手机Radar、配对Watch摘要、网页草稿和分享附件有不同的数据与权限边界。Watch拿到的是手机已有待决策/验收摘要，并可裁剪；网页和附件则是用户选择交接的文字，不是手机台账镜像。跨端核对应先确认载体、来源身份和集合，再检查时间与字段，不从外观相似推断全字段同步或独立刷新。 与批次比较、模板改版的分工 批次比较面对同源两次导出，格式兼容面对生产者契约变化；这里比较 同一工作流程里不同载体本来就不同的呈现 。缺字段可能来自子集选择、裁剪、未提供数据或尚未交接，不能直接称作同步故障，更不能填造数据让各端看起来一样。 跨端字段与范围表 载体/字段 当前实现范围 核对方法 不可推断 手机tasks/decisions 全任务与待决策/验收子集，旧源可回退 先看来源有无tasks、界面筛选范围 子集少就代表台账没任务 Watch事项集合 配对手机提供的待处理摘要 看源时间、读取失败、手机可达性和裁剪提示 手表拥有完整台账或独立刷新源 Watch title/project/next 桥接时分别取最多160/80/600个字符前缀 回手机看完整来源，不从截断句作最终判断 每个字段都完整或字节与字符相同 Watch载荷 decode大小最多50000字节、事项最多200个，桥接可继续裁剪 结合truncated与“回手机”提示 200项保证全传、截断表示业务删除 来源/采集时间 sourceDate与capturedAt含义不同 用来源时间判断数据时效，不用封包时间替换 新封包意味着刚读源成功 目标身份 workbench/task及受保护来源/事项标记 由既有手机校验原事项，不自行构造标记 标记等同账号认证或手表直写授权 网页草稿 已选择目标里的未发送文字 核工作台/页面和具体草稿内容 自动成为Radar字段或已发送回复 文字附件 托盘暂存文字/Markdown，不附原录音 核版本和后续交接/上传阶段 全量台账镜像、原音频或自动跨端更新 这些数字是固定源码的载荷/前缀边界，不是网络吞吐、响应时间或所有设备配对成功率。前缀按Swift字符串处理，不能直接等同UTF-8字节。载荷受总大小限制，可能在200项之前就裁剪。 一个合成的字段缺口走读 手机：样例tasks有三项，其中一项等待决策。 Watch：只见这一项摘要，next文字被截短。 网页：尚未选择交接，所以没有该文字草稿。 正确解释：载体范围不同；回手机核完整来源。 不能解释：其余任务已完成、手表丢数据或网页同步失败。 样例不是本轮真机传输记录，不调用Watch、工作台或服务器。核对时保留未知与来源，只使用有权读取的最少必要信息；不要公开任务正文、源地址或内部身份标记。 核对顺序 先确认是不是同一来源/事项，再看每个载体承诺的集合与权限。随后核 sourceDate 、失败和裁剪状态；不要仅比较屏幕上显示几行。若要继续到手机或真实回复，仍走已有目标校验、忙碌守卫、手机确认及服务端授权，不能因为Watch能显示就跳过。 修改网页草稿或本地整理稿不会自动改手机源JSON，也不会保证已暂存附件更新。跨端校验只描述证据差异，不提供修复同步、字段转换或跨设备写入工具。 FAQ Watch是否应该显示手机所有tasks字段？ 不是。当前伴侣传递待处理摘要而非完整源台账，字段和数量可能裁剪，应回手机看完整来源。 next变短是否证明源文本被删了？ 不能。桥接有前缀和总载荷边界；显示裁剪不等于源被删除或更改。 capturedAt较新是否代表台账已刷新？ 不代表。封包时间与来源时间不同，手表同步可重发手机已有快照，不是独立源读取。 来源/事项标记是否授予手表直接审批？ 不能。它们用于既有目标保护检查，不取代账号/服务写权限与手机确认，本页不提供构造或绕过办法。 Markdown附件是否包含原录音和全任务？ 不能这样概括。当前笔记分享是文字或Markdown，不附原录音，也不自动成为全量台账快照。 在网页修订文字会同步改回Radar源吗？ 本页不声明这种同步。网页文字、手机源JSON和附件分别核对；没有新增双向字段同步或回写功能。 相关指南与源码 多项目Radar与Watch · 格式改版兼容 · 原文与显式交接 · 跟进证据最小化 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Watch载荷模型 、 手机桥接与裁剪 、 README 。

### Why fields differ across phone, Watch, web and attachments

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/cross-device-field-presentation/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why fields differ across phone, Watch, web and attachments Different carriers are not full replicas; fewer fields do not prove loss or completion Phone Radar, paired Watch summaries, web drafts and share attachments have different data/permission boundaries. Watch receives the phone’s existing pending decision/acceptance summaries and may truncate them. Web drafts/attachments contain selected text, not a phone-ledger mirror. Start with carrier, source identity and collection, then compare time/fields. Similar appearance is not full synchronization or independent refresh. Separate from batches and format revisions Batch comparison inspects two exports from a source; compatibility review inspects producer changes. Here different carriers in one workflow intentionally present different scopes . Missing fields may reflect selection, truncation, absent data or no handoff, rather than sync failure. Do not fabricate values to make screens agree. Cross-device field and scope matrix Carrier/field Current scope Check Do not infer Phone tasks/decisions Ledger versus pending subset; legacy fallback Whether tasks exists and current view/filter scope Few pending items means few ledger tasks Watch items Paired-phone pending summaries Source time, read failures, reachability and truncation Full ledger or independent source refresh Watch title/project/next Bridge prefixes up to 160/80/600 characters Return to phone for full text before deciding Every field complete or characters equal bytes Watch payload Decode limit 50000 bytes and 200 items; bridge can trim further Inspect truncated/more-on-phone signals Guaranteed delivery of 200 items or deletion implied by trimming Source/capture time sourceDate differs from capturedAt Judge freshness using source time Fresh packaging proves a new successful source read Target identity workbench/task and protected source/item markers Existing phone checks resolve originals Markers are account authentication or direct Watch-write authority Web draft Selected text in an unsent destination Actual workbench/page/draft contents Automatic Radar field update or a sent reply Text attachment Tray text/Markdown, without original audio Actual version and later handoff/upload stage Full ledger/audio replica or automatic cross-device updating These are source-level payload/prefix limits, not bandwidth, latency or universal pairing-success results. Swift string prefixes are not UTF-8 byte counts. Total payload size can require trimming before 200 items. A synthetic missing-field comparison Phone: Three sample tasks; one awaits a decision. Watch: Only that pending summary appears, with shortened next text. Web: No handoff selected, so no matching draft exists. Interpretation: Carrier scopes differ; check complete source on the phone. Not established: Other tasks completed, Watch lost data or web synchronization failed. This is not an actual paired-device trace. It calls no Watch, workbench or server. Preserve unknowns/provenance and minimize private material; do not publish task text, feed addresses or protected identity markers. Review order Establish the same source/item first, then each carrier’s collection and permission scope. Inspect sourceDate , failure and truncation rather than counting display rows. Continuing on the phone or replying still requires target/busy checks, phone confirmation and server authority; Watch visibility cannot bypass them. Editing a web/local draft does not automatically update source JSON or staged attachments. This comparison adds no sync repair, field converter or cross-device write tool. FAQ Should Watch display every phone tasks field? No. It carries pending summaries rather than the full source ledger, with possible field/count truncation. Return to the phone for full context. Does shortened next prove deleted source text? No. Prefix and total-size limits can shorten presentation without deleting or changing the original. Does a recent capturedAt establish a refreshed ledger? No. Packaging and source time differ. Sync can republish an existing phone snapshot without an independent source read. Do source/item markers permit standalone Watch approval? No. They protect target checks, not account/server write authority or phone confirmation. This page offers no marker construction/bypass method. Does Markdown contain original audio and all tasks? Not as a general statement. Current note sharing is text/Markdown without original audio, not automatically a ledger snapshot. Does editing a web draft write back to Radar? No such sync is asserted. Check web text, phone source JSON and attachments separately. No bidirectional field sync/writeback is added. Guides and source Radar/Watch · Format compatibility · Originals and handoff · Follow-up evidence minimization · Start · Privacy Evidence: Watch payload model , phone bridge/trimming , README .

### 蓝牙音频切换后会恢复还是停止？短语音与录音笔记源码矩阵

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/audio-route-recovery-matrix/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 蓝牙音频切换后会恢复还是停止？短语音与录音笔记源码矩阵 先确认正在走哪条录音路径，再解释对应事件 一呼短语音采集和长录音笔记使用不同处理路径。短语音在音频引擎配置变化时可能尝试保留转换器和已采PCM，但要求输入格式不变；笔记的输入变化路径会尝试重定向写入格式。恢复失败、来电或某些路由事件仍可能停止/提示中断。本页解释固定源码分支，不是所有蓝牙设备切换的无损恢复承诺，也不新增恢复按钮或故障探针。 与输入排障、网页切换的区别 输入排障先问为什么没有声音/文字，网页切换指南检查输出和采集的互斥；这里面对 录音已经开始之后，某种系统事件会走哪条代码分支 。不能把短语音的条件套到笔记，也不能把笔记有重定向逻辑解读成网页通话必然继续。 路径与事件恢复矩阵 录音路径/事件 当前源码分支 继续所需条件 仍须核对的结果 短语音：引擎配置变化 重建输入tap/图并尝试重启 活跃记录身份匹配、仍录音、原引擎/管线可用且输入格式相同 是否有失败/中断、文字是否完整；不是自动送达 短语音：输入格式变化 转换器不能安全复用则失败停止 不以强转格式绕过检查 保留可用结果与错误，不声称继续无损 短语音：重启失败 标记中断并停止引擎 无继续成功推断 看实际状态，不连续点击重录制造重复 短语音：重复配置通知 条件满足时去抖，不重复触发恢复 同一记录身份、引擎运行、格式/路由不变且在宽限内 去抖不是忽略真正的新设备变化 短语音：来电开始/媒体服务丢失或重置 对应监听分支使采集失败并停止 按实际事件和当前录音状态处理 没有“来电后一定自动接着录”的保证 短语音：被处理的路由通知 oldDeviceUnavailable/noSuitableRouteForCategory进入中断分支 其他原因有过滤，仍可能另有引擎配置事件 不从通知被过滤推断输入可用或录音未受影响 录音笔记：引擎配置变化 停旧tap、尝试writer重定向、重装tap并启动 仍是当前记录/引擎且重定向与启动成功 失败会提示保存到此前，需查音频和接缝 录音笔记：来电/音频服务重置 对应中断提示路径 按实际保存状态核对 不承诺后台持续、任意时长或绝不丢字 短语音当前格式相等检查包括采样率、通道数、公共格式和交错状态。去抖源码默认宽限为2秒，但它是内部事件条件，不是重连耗时、UI等待时长或恢复SLA。不能通过手动等待两秒就证明某款耳机已经恢复。 遇到变化后的人工检查顺序 先在安全静止环境停下业务操作，辨认短语音还是录音笔记。记录不含私人信息的事件类别（例如来电或更换耳机）、前后可见状态以及是否已有文字；不要收集设备唯一标识、真实录音或客户正文来公开复现。 再看当前保存/转写/错误状态，不从“耳机重新连接”跳到“原录音完整”。需要检查的内容包括断点附近的数字、否定和语句接缝；未核就保持未知。若文字已尝试交接，继续原目标与一次标记边界，音频恢复不是重发许可。 本文不要求关闭系统保护、改采样率、清记录或强制重启服务；也不提供让用户人为制造中断的自动脚本。无法安全复现就保留最小错误描述给已有维护流程。 FAQ 短语音和录音笔记能用同一恢复结论吗？ 不能。它们的管线、格式处理和错误路径不同，必须先识别记录入口与实际版本，再对照分支。 短语音格式变化后能强行复用旧转换器吗？ 源码选择失败停止而非不安全复用。本文不提供绕过办法，也不把失败停止解释成无损继续。 等两秒就能确保蓝牙恢复吗？ 不能。两秒是去抖宽限的代码常量，依赖记录身份、引擎、格式和路由条件，不是蓝牙性能指标。 笔记writer支持重定向是否说明任何耳机都能无缝切换？ 不说明。重定向和重启仍可能失败，实际保存及接缝要核；没有本轮型号/固件/场景的真机恢复矩阵。 音频恢复成功可以自动补发刚才的草稿吗？ 不能。音频采集与交接结果是不同状态，已有填入、拒绝或不确定结果仍按原守卫和标记处理。 提交问题需要完整路由UID或真实录音吗？ 不应为公开反馈收集这些资料。先提供版本、设备型号、事件类别和合成内容的可见结果，私有数据仅沿已有获准流程处理。 相关指南与源码 输入分层排障 · 网页输出/采集切换 · 片段复核 · 降级前许可 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 短语音事件、格式检查与去抖 、 笔记输入重定向与中断 。这是源码矩阵，不冒浏览器视觉或真机音频验收。

Parameter/comparison tables (HTML) / 参数对照表：

</tr>

<td>条件满足时去抖，不重复触发恢复</td>
<td>同一记录身份、引擎运行、格式/路由不变且在宽限内</td>
<td>去抖不是忽略真正的新设备变化</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>短语音：来电开始/媒体服务丢失或重置</td>
<td>对应监听分支使采集失败并停止</td>
<td>按实际事件和当前录音状态处理</td>
<td>没有“来电后一定自动接着录”的保证</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>短语音：被处理的路由通知</td>
<td>oldDeviceUnavailable/noSuitableRouteForCategory进入中断分支</td>
<td>其他原因有过滤，仍可能另有引擎配置事件</td>
<td>不从通知被过滤推断输入可用或录音未受影响</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>录音笔记：引擎配置变化</td>
<td>停旧tap、尝试writer重定向、重装tap并启动</td>
<td>仍是当前记录/引擎且重定向与启动成功</td>
<td>失败会提示保存到此前，需查音频和接缝</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>录音笔记：来电/音频服务重置</td>
<td>对应中断提示路径</td>
<td>按实际保存状态核对</td>
<td>不承诺后台持续、任意时长或绝不丢字</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### Recover or stop after an audio switch? Short speech versus recording-note source matrix

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/audio-route-recovery-matrix/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Recover or stop after an audio switch? Short speech versus recording-note source matrix Identify the capture path before interpreting the event Short-speech capture and recording notes use different paths. Short speech can attempt to retain its converter/captured PCM after engine configuration changes only with an unchanged input format. Notes try writer retargeting after an input change. Restart failures, calls and some route events can still stop capture or report interruption. This explains fixed source branches, not lossless Bluetooth-switch acceptance or a new recovery button/probe. Different from input diagnosis and web switching Input diagnosis asks why audio/text is absent; web switching separates output and capture. Here recording has already started and an event selects a source branch . Do not apply short-speech conditions to notes or infer an uninterrupted web call from writer retargeting. Capture path and event matrix Path/event Current branch Continuation conditions Result still needing review Short speech: engine configuration change Rebuild input tap/graph and attempt restart Same active record, still recording, existing engine/pipeline and unchanged input format Failure/interruption and text completeness; not delivery Short speech: changed input format Fail closed rather than reuse an unsafe converter No format-coercion bypass Retained result/error, not lossless continuation Short speech: restart failure Mark interrupted and stop engine No success inference Actual state; no repeated recording that duplicates content Short speech: repeated configuration notification Conditional debounce avoids repeated recovery Same record, running engine, unchanged format/route within grace period Not ignoring genuine device changes Short speech: interruption began/media services lost/reset Corresponding observer fails capture and stops Actual event/current recording state No always-resume-after-call promise Short speech: handled route notification oldDeviceUnavailable/noSuitableRouteForCategory interrupt Other reasons filtered, but an engine event can also occur Filtered does not establish valid input/unaffected capture Notes: engine configuration change Stop tap, try writer retargeting, reinstall tap/start Same active recording/engine with successful retarget/start Failure can report retention up to that point; inspect audio/joins Notes: call/media-service reset Corresponding interruption-message path Check actual saved state No continuous-background, arbitrary-duration or no-loss guarantee Short-speech format equality checks sample rate, channel count, common format and interleaving. The debounce’s current default grace is two seconds, an internal conditional window, not reconnection latency, a UI wait time or recovery SLA. Waiting two seconds does not prove a headset recovered. Manual review after a change Stop business operations in a safe stationary setting and identify short speech versus notes. Record non-sensitive event categories, such as a call/headset switch, visible before/after states and whether text exists. Do not collect unique route/device identifiers, actual audio or customer text for public reproduction. Inspect saved/transcription/error state rather than jumping from reconnected to complete recording. Review quantities, negations and joins near interruption, retaining unknowns. If text was already handed off, original target/one-handoff rules remain: audio recovery is not resend permission. This page does not ask users to disable system protection, alter sample rates, clear records or forcibly restart services. No automatic interruption-generation script is supplied. When safe reproduction is impossible, give the existing maintenance process a minimal error description. FAQ Can short speech and recording notes share one recovery conclusion? No. Their pipelines, format handling and failures differ. Identify the recording entry point and actual version before applying a branch. Can a changed short-speech input forcibly reuse the old converter? The source fails closed instead of unsafe reuse. No bypass is supplied, and failing closed is not lossless continuation. Does waiting two seconds guarantee Bluetooth recovery? No. Two seconds is a debounce constant conditional on identity, engine, format and route, not a Bluetooth performance result. Does writer retargeting guarantee every headset switches seamlessly? No. Retarget/restart can fail; inspect actual retention and joins. This work supplies no device/firmware/scenario recovery acceptance matrix. Can recovered audio automatically resend the earlier draft? No. Capture and handoff are separate states. Prior insertion/refusal/uncertainty keeps original guards and markers. Does a report require full route UIDs or real recordings? Do not collect them for public feedback. Start with version, model, event category and synthetic-content outcomes; private material stays within existing authorized procedures. Reading and source Input diagnosis · Web output/capture transition · Passage review · Fallback permission · Start · Privacy Evidence: short-speech events/format/debounce , note retarget/interruption . A source matrix is not browser-visual or device-audio acceptance.

### 客户跟进证据归档前：最小披露、私有引用与副本范围核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/followup-evidence-minimization/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 客户跟进证据归档前：最小披露、私有引用与副本范围核对 证据足够不等于资料越多越好，先核可保留与可披露的范围 团队若把已有客户跟进任务导出为Radar JSON，应继续按来源权限使用；一呼不是CRM、客户采集器或外贸数据归档平台。这里专门检查归档材料中的不必要正文、身份与链接参数，把私有原始依据和对外合成说明分开。它不是自动脱敏工具、合规认证或一键删除副本功能。 与认领、证据审计和二次核实的分工 责任认领清单核谁确认、资料该存哪里；事后审计核完成主张是否有依据；证据二次核实核单个异常主张真假。此处的任务是 在已有获准证据准备保存或分享时，只保留必要内容并标明私有范围 ，不再决定谁负责或裁定业务真相。 归档/披露前最小材料表 材料 先问的问题 合成/最小化做法 不可据此保证 任务标题与next 是否含客户姓名、订单或内部指令？ 公开说明用无真实含义的样例，不照抄正文 App自动识别并移除敏感内容 evidence URL 参数、路径或片段是否暴露身份/令牌？ 私有引用留在原授权范围；公开样例用example.invalid HTTPS候选已脱敏、内容可信或可公开 来源/任务标识 是否确有必要暴露内部UUID/保护标记？ 使用人工样例代号，不外传实际标记 假名化即匿名或解除访问权限要求 原始音频/转写 是否必须为该归档目的保留？ 优先引用获准最小范围，别为公开演示上传录音 本地存储天然无备份/副本 回执/回复历史 是否含私人事项与原请求信息？ 有权复核者在原流程读必要部分 读取权限等于全文导出/公开授权 截图与日志 是否显示账号、源地址、客户正文或设备信息？ 公开回证仅用合成内容与非敏感结果 官网或App自动遮挡截图内容 文档/剪贴板/附件 是否扩大复制、同步或可访问范围？ 核实际目的地规则和必要副本 删除一份即可撤回全部资料 保存期限与访问 团队已有规则和获准角色是什么？ 引用实际规则，未知就停 统一保留时长、保证删除或合规通过 一个只含合成信息的公开说明 来源：样例项目sample，不是真实客户/订单。 核对范围：字段形态与可见状态，不提供原始业务正文。 证据链接：https://example.invalid/evidence/sample 归档位置：按已有授权规则确认，未创建新共享位置。 尚未确认：私有原记录的保留/访问范围，由原流程处理。 该链接是保留域名，不提供真实可访问证据，也不应被写进生产台账冒充原始记录。公开合成说明和私有真实依据作用不同；不能删掉所有来源信息后又声称公开说明足以证明真实客户事项。 从已获准材料到最小归档包 先定义归档目的和有权阅读者，再逐项判断是否需要正文、音频、标识或仅一个受权限控制的原记录引用。没有权限时，记录未核而不是索取更多材料。不要为实现所谓“完整归档”新建账号、公开共享链接或批量导出私人任务。 原生Radar保留来源文字，并不会因 safeEvidenceURLs 筛出HTTPS就替你移除查询参数。笔记文字交接也不代表原音频或其他副本已删除。人工整理之后仍须核原笔记交接状态和目的地已有内容，不能用脱敏稿绕过一次交接或不确定停止。 FAQ 一呼是否能自动归档客户往来和跟进证据？ 本文不声明这种CRM能力。这里只解释团队自有获准任务数据的最小化检查，不采集客户、发信或自动建档。 HTTPS证据链接会被App自动脱敏吗？ 不能据此推断。当前解析检查链接形态，不保证移除参数、身份或业务路径；公开材料需人工按实际权限核查。 把客户名字改成角色A就一定匿名了吗？ 不一定。正文、时间、路径、订单和其他组合仍可能识别对象。本页不提供匿名化认证，公开示例应使用完全合成内容。 有权看Radar就有权导出全部历史吗？ 不能这样扩大权限。按原事项、服务与团队规则核必要范围，读取和批量导出/公开是不同操作。 归档后删手机记录是否意味着服务端副本也删除？ 不是。工作台、剪贴板、附件、账户同步和备份可能各留副本，需按实际目的地规则核对，不保证远端撤回。 最小化之后仍可声明真实业务已验收吗？ 只有真实且获准的依据支持相应范围时才可作有限结论；合成公开说明本身不是原记录、批准、送达或处理证明。 相关指南与依据 部门认领与归档 · 交接证据审计 · 异常证据二次核实 · 跨端字段呈现 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar原文字段与证据解析 、 README分享/历史/权限边界 。

### Before archiving follow-up evidence: minimal disclosure, private references and copies

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/followup-evidence-minimization/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before archiving follow-up evidence: minimal disclosure, private references and copies Sufficient evidence is not maximum collection; check retention and disclosure scope first Teams exporting existing follow-up tasks to Radar JSON keep the source’s permissions. Yihu is not a CRM, customer collector or trade-data archive. This guide checks unnecessary text, identities and URL parameters in material being retained/shared, separating private originals from public synthetic examples. It is not an automatic redactor, compliance certification or delete-all-copies feature. Different from ownership, claim audit and verification Ownership checks responsibility/storage; evidence audit checks completion claims; second checks assess evidence for one anomaly claim. Here already authorized material is being prepared for retention/disclosure, so minimize content and mark private scope . It does not assign owners or adjudicate business truth. Minimal material before retention/disclosure Material First question Minimal/synthetic treatment Not guaranteed Task title/next Customer names, orders or internal instructions? Use meaningless synthetic examples publicly, not copied business text Automatic sensitive-content detection/removal evidence URL Identity/tokens in query, path or fragment? Private references remain authorized; public examples use example.invalid HTTPS candidates are redacted, trustworthy or public Source/item identity Is an internal UUID/protected marker necessary? Use editorial sample labels, not actual markers Pseudonyms guarantee anonymity or waive permission Original audio/text Necessary for this retention purpose? Prefer authorized minimal scope; no recordings for public demos Local storage has no backup/copies Receipts/history Private items or original-request information? Authorized reviewers inspect only necessary source material Read access permits complete export/publication Screenshots/logs Accounts, feeds, customer text or device identity visible? Synthetic content and non-sensitive outcomes publicly Automatic screenshot masking Documents/clipboard/attachments Expanded copying, syncing or access? Check actual destination rules and necessary copies One deletion recalls everything Retention/access Actual policy and authorized roles? Cite existing policy; stop if unknown One retention period, guaranteed deletion or compliance A fully synthetic public explanation Source: Sample project, not a real customer/order. Scope: Field shape and visible state, without original business text. Evidence example: https://example.invalid/evidence/sample Archive: Confirm existing authorized rules; no new share destination created. Unknown: Private-source retention/access remains with the original process. The reserved-domain example supplies no real evidence and should not be placed in a live ledger as an original record. Public synthetic explanations and private authentic evidence serve different purposes. Removing all provenance does not make a public example proof of a real customer item. From authorized material to a minimal package Define retention purpose and authorized readers before deciding whether text, audio, identifiers or a controlled original reference is necessary. Mark unavailable evidence unreviewed rather than demanding more data. Do not provision accounts, public shares or bulk private-task exports under a complete-archive label. Native Radar retains source text; safeEvidenceURLs selecting HTTPS does not strip queries. Text handoff does not delete original audio or other copies. After editing, still inspect note reservation/destination state. A redacted draft cannot bypass one-handoff or uncertain-stop guards. FAQ Does Yihu automatically archive customer correspondence and evidence? No CRM capability is asserted. This is minimization guidance for your authorized task data, without customer collection, email or automatic record creation. Are HTTPS evidence links automatically redacted? Do not infer that. Parsing checks shape, not removal of parameters, identity or business paths. Review public material manually under actual permissions. Does replacing a name with role A guarantee anonymity? No. Text, time, paths, orders and combinations can remain identifying. No anonymization certification is supplied; use fully synthetic public examples. Does Radar visibility permit exporting all history? No. Check original-item, service and team scope. Reading, bulk export and publication are different operations. Does deleting phone records delete remote copies after archiving? No. Workbenches, clipboard, attachments, account sync and backups can retain separate copies. Check actual policies without a remote-recall guarantee. Does minimization establish acceptance of the real business event? Only actual authorized evidence supports a limited conclusion. A synthetic public explanation is not the original, approval, delivery or handling record. Guides and evidence Ownership/archive planning · Handoff evidence audit · Second-check claims · Cross-device presentation · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar source fields/link parsing , README sharing/history/permissions .

### 多轮语音追问前：指代、工作台页面与Agent上下文核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/follow-up-context-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 多轮语音追问前：指代、工作台页面与Agent上下文核对 网页还在原处不等于Agent记住上一轮，追问先消除指代歧义 一呼把原生语音转成文字并按目标守卫尝试交给兼容网页草稿，不提供通用Agent后端或跨工作台对话记忆。真正的会话上下文由实际网页/服务决定。“上一条”“这个”“继续”在换页、换工作台或历史未核时可能没有明确对象；追问前应先确认所指材料、当前会话与目标输入框，而不是让App推测意图。 与首次接入、改字或重复交接的分工 首次评估判断条件齐备，人工修订检查文本副本；这里专门核对 下一轮文字是否有明确前文和获准目标 。它不建议为了找回上下文自动重发上一段，也不把已经显示在网页的内容当作服务已读取或已执行的证明。 追问上下文预检表 检查项 先确认的材料 合成例子 不应推断 所指对象 上一条究竟是哪段文字/哪个样例 合成句A，不是真实订单 “它”天然指向正确业务对象 工作台 当前获准HTTPS来源 只在已有自有工作台核对 浏览器可达等于服务端身份与写权限 页面/会话 当前页面与实际服务会话 是否仍为已核样例草稿会话 原生导航恢复等于模型记忆恢复 目标输入框 原页面里可编辑、未发送的草稿 先聚焦兼容输入框 可以写入任意编辑器或终端 历史范围 服务是否实际提供所需前文 可见历史仍需核内容和范围 看得见上文就已送入Agent上下文 文字意图 整理、提案与执行请求分开 只改样例措辞，不发送 追问语气等于批准执行 原交接结果 先前是否已填入、暂存或不确定 已有草稿只检查 无回执就允许把上文再交一遍 目标变化 录音/打开笔记时捕获页面与当前状态 换页后重新核对原守卫 打开记录后换源会自动改绑目标 去歧义的合成改写 有歧义：继续，把它改成两项。 更明确的草稿：仅核对本地合成句A中的示例清单措辞；条目数量未确认，不发送、不执行。 仍需确认：当前工作台/会话是否就是获准的样例目的地。 改写只是用户表达建议，不提供模型正确理解保证，也不触发Agent或服务。不要把真实客户信息或完整私人会话复制到公开示例来补上下文。 页面绑定与服务上下文不能互相替代 原生草稿交付有来源、页面、请求和宿主拒绝等守卫；录音笔记显式填入也使用打开记录时捕获的工作台/页面。它们限制文字能去哪里，不决定Agent是否纳入历史、如何解释代词或是否持久保存会话。不能因为守卫通过就称为“上下文理解正确”。 工作台之间的WebKit交互状态恢复只属于已实现的导航范围，不复制跨来源身份，不创建统一对话数据库。若前文来源、原交接或会话状态未知，先保留文字并停止，不通过换页面、复制旧轮或清标记补送来猜测正确上下文。 FAQ 一呼会自动记住所有工作台里的上一轮语音吗？ 本文不声明这种跨工作台记忆。App是浏览器壳和语音草稿增强，真正Agent会话由各服务管理。 页面历史恢复是否意味着模型上下文恢复？ 不是同一事实。导航/滚动等网页交互状态与后端模型使用的历史范围不同，需要实际服务证据。 “继续”或“上一条”可以不说明对象吗？ 不宜在对象不明时这样做。先核所指材料与会话，必要时在获准范围写清合成引用，不让读者推断真实目标。 需要追问可以自动重发上一轮来补上下文吗？ 不能因此盲目重发。原内容可能已交接或结果不确定，应先核目标已有内容并遵守原请求/一次交接边界。 打开笔记后切换页面，显式填入会自动跟随吗？ 不应这样假定。显式笔记交接绑定打开记录时捕获的目标，并在交接前检查；目标变化需按现有守卫处理，不绕过。 模型看起来理解了追问就可以执行全部操作吗？ 不可以。文字理解、用户明确意图和服务端授权是不同层级；原确认、写权限与回执不能省略。 相关指南与源码 语音草稿路径 · 网页输出/采集切换 · 原文与笔记目标 · 人工摘要引用映射 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 草稿目标守卫 、 笔记捕获目标与交接检查 、 README服务边界 。

### Before a voice follow-up: references, workbench page and Agent context

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/follow-up-context-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before a voice follow-up: references, workbench page and Agent context The page staying open does not prove Agent memory; resolve references before following up Yihu transcribes native speech and attempts guarded delivery to compatible drafts. It supplies no universal Agent backend or cross-workbench conversation memory. Actual context belongs to the site/service. Previous, it and continue can become ambiguous after page/workbench changes or unverified history. Identify the referenced material, current conversation and composer first, not an app-inferred intent. Different from setup, correction and repeat delivery Readiness checks prerequisites; correction checks text copies. Here the next utterance needs an explicit antecedent and authorized target . Do not automatically resend the previous passage to restore context, or treat visible page text as proof the service read/executed it. Follow-up context preflight Check Material to establish Synthetic example Do not infer Referent Which previous phrase/item is meant Synthetic phrase A, not a real order It points to the correct business object automatically Workbench Current authorized HTTPS source Existing own workbench only Reachability is server identity/write permission Page/conversation Current page and actual service session Is this the reviewed sample-draft session? Navigation restoration is model memory restoration Composer Editable unsent field on the original page Focus the compatible draft first Arbitrary editor/terminal insertion is permitted History scope Service actually provides the required context Visible history still needs scope/content review Visible history necessarily reached the Agent context Intended operation Organization, proposal and execution differ Edit sample wording only; do not send Follow-up tone grants execution authority Prior handoff Inserted/staged/uncertain state Inspect an existing draft Missing receipt permits another delivery of prior text Changed destination Captured and current page/state Recheck guards after navigation A source switch automatically retargets an opened note A less ambiguous synthetic draft Ambiguous: Continue; change it to two items. More explicit: Review only the wording of local synthetic phrase A. Item count is unconfirmed; do not send or execute. Still check: The current workbench/conversation is the authorized sample destination. This is wording guidance, not guaranteed model interpretation or an Agent/service call. Do not copy a private conversation/customer data into a public example to add context. Destination binding is not backend context Native draft delivery has source/page/request/host-refusal guards. Explicit note insertion uses the workbench/page captured when notes opened. These constrain where text may go; they do not determine which history a model receives, how pronouns are interpreted or whether a service persists conversations. A passed target guard does not establish correct understanding. Implemented WebKit interaction restoration concerns navigation scope, not cross-origin identity copying or a unified conversation database. With unknown source, prior result or conversation, retain text and stop. Do not guess context by changing pages, repeating old rounds or clearing markers. FAQ Does Yihu remember all prior speech across workbenches? No such cross-workbench memory is asserted. It is a browser shell with voice drafts; the actual Agent conversation belongs to each service. Does restored page history establish restored model context? No. Navigation/scroll state and the history supplied to a backend model are different facts requiring actual service evidence. Can continue or previous omit the referenced object? Avoid that when the object is unclear. Check material/conversation and state a synthetic reference within authorized scope rather than asking a reader to infer a real target. Can a follow-up automatically resend the prior round to restore context? No blind resend follows. It may already be delivered or uncertain; inspect destination content and retain original request/one-handoff boundaries. Does explicit note insertion follow page changes after opening notes? Do not assume so. The note target is captured on opening and checked before insertion. Follow existing guards without retargeting by bypass. Does apparent understanding authorize every requested operation? No. Interpretation, explicit user intent and server authority differ. Original confirmation, write permission and receipts remain necessary. Reading and source Voice-draft choices · Web output/capture transition · Originals and note targets · Manual summary provenance · Start · Privacy Evidence: draft-target guards , note target capture/checks , README service limits .

### 商机任务Radar的人工摘要怎样溯源？逐句引用与范围核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-summary-claim-provenance/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 商机任务Radar的人工摘要怎样溯源？逐句引用与范围核对 摘要更短，证据范围不能被写大；每句话都要能回到来源 如果团队把已有询盘/跟进任务提供为PM Radar JSON，可以人工编写简短说明，但一呼不由本文新增商机摘要引擎。逐句溯源先确定来源和范围，再说明哪句话来自哪些字段、哪里仍未知。不能把“源标等待验收”缩写成“已经验收”，也不能因为有引用链接就把提案写成批准或外部真实性结论。 与二次核实和批次比较的分工 证据二查判断一个异常主张的依据是否充分，批次比较判断两份导出是否可比；这里核对 从多字段压缩成一句摘要时，是否丢失限定、归因和范围 。人工句号编号、来源代号与引用表都只是编辑材料，不是App自动生成的引用ID或审计功能。 摘要句子到源字段映射表 摘要要表达的内容 应回查的源字段/依据 可以保留的归因 不应改写成 哪个项目/事项 project、已有id及已核来源 来源中的样例事项 同名标题必定是同一客户/订单 事项标题 title原文及上下文 原文称需要核对 标题语气证明事件真实或紧急 当前状态 status是否明确提供 来源标为“等你验收” 已验收、已批准或已完成 建议下一步 next里的条件、否定与提案 原文建议先核对 已获执行授权或已安排发送 优先级 priority及来源解释 来源提供P0/P1或未提供 具体损失、承诺时限或未提供时视为不重要 来源时间 date_str与读取失败/缓存情况 截至该来源读取范围的记录 当前实时事实或手机刷新即最新 证据引用 evidence及既有获准原记录 此处有可回查引用，内容需核 HTTPS等于可信/无隐私/已批准 未知与总结 哪些字段缺失、哪些主张无映射 保留待核或删除无依据摘要句 为让摘要完整而补造细节 一份合成的逐句映射 人工来源代号S-A：样例事项，status=等你验收；next=建议下次核对，尚未批准；priority未提供。 拟写句1：样例事项已经验收并获准执行。 映射结果：status不支持“已经”，next明确尚未批准；句1不采用。 可支持改写：来源标样例事项为等待验收；下一步为未批准的核对建议，优先级未知。 S-A和句1是人工示意，不是实际任务标识、JSON字段或已跑过的自动检测结果。公开示例不含真实客户正文或私有证据地址，也不调用模型。若外部获准工具协助压缩文字，仍需同样逐句核对，不能由模型表达流畅程度代替证据。 归因、范围和引用位置 建议先保存原句与来源位置，再写带归因的短句，例如“来源标为……”而不是未经核实的全局断言。明确是 tasks 全集合、 decisions 子集、当前筛选还是Watch摘要；只有子集材料不能给全台账下结论。 私有原记录应在原获准范围核对，不为公开摘要复制完整任务或带参数链接。字段存在只说明来源提供了值，不证明记录权威、内容真实或账号拥有写权。找不到映射的句子应保持未核/不采用，而不是补造链接来装饰摘要。 FAQ 一呼会自动生成商机摘要和引用吗？ 本文不声明或新增这种引擎。现有实现读取自有任务JSON与摘要载体，这里的写句、编号和映射是人工建议。 “等你验收”可以缩写成“验收完成”吗？ 不可以。等待与完成语义相反，压缩文字必须保留状态与归因，不能把子集标签改成批准结论。 标题里有客户称呼能直接推断同一客户记录吗？ 不应这样关联。先核来源与稳定事项身份，不凭名字或相似标题推定客户/订单一致，公开说明也不复制私人信息。 每句都加HTTPS链接是否足够溯源？ 不够。还要核引用支持的具体主张、权限、版本与范围；链接形态本身不验证真实性或批准状态。 没有priority或时间信息时，摘要可以省略未知吗？ 不能让省略制造已核假象。若相关结论依赖缺失信息，应明确未知或不作该结论，不默认补当前时间或低优先级。 摘要通过人工核对后能自动发给客户吗？ 本页不提供自动发送或写权限。核对文字、批准交接与客户沟通是不同操作，仍按原授权与目的地规则处理。 相关指南与依据 证据二次核实 · 批次比较 · 格式改版兼容 · 客户证据最小化 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： Radar字段与证据解析 、 README集合与回复边界 。

### Trace a manual opportunity-task summary: sentence-to-field provenance

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-summary-claim-provenance/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Trace a manual opportunity-task summary: sentence-to-field provenance Shorter wording must not expand evidence; trace each sentence to its source Teams supplying existing inquiry/follow-up tasks as PM Radar JSON may write manual summaries; this article adds no opportunity-summary engine. Establish source/scope, then map sentences to fields and retain unknowns. Waiting for acceptance cannot become accepted, and a link cannot turn a proposal into approval or an independently verified external fact. Different from second checks and batch comparison Second checks assess evidence for one anomaly claim; batch comparison establishes comparability of exports. Here compressing several fields into a sentence must preserve conditions, attribution and scope . Sentence numbers, source labels and citation tables are editorial aids, not app-generated reference IDs or an audit feature. Sentence-to-field provenance table Summary content Source field/evidence Supported attribution Do not rewrite as Project/item identity project, existing id and reviewed source Sample item in this source Same title proves the same customer/order Item title Original title/context Source says review is needed Wording proves an actual urgent event Current state Explicit status if supplied Source labels waiting for acceptance Accepted, approved or complete Proposed next step Conditions, negations and proposals in next Source suggests review first Execution authorized or sending scheduled Priority priority and source explanation Supplied P0/P1 or unknown Specific loss/deadline or unknown means unimportant Source time date_str plus read/cache state Within that source-read scope A current live fact or refresh tap means fresh Evidence reference evidence and authorized original record A reference exists; content needs review HTTPS means true, non-private or approved Unknowns/conclusion Absent fields and unmapped claims Pending review or remove unsupported sentence Invented details to complete a summary A synthetic sentence map Editorial source S-A: Sample item; status=waiting for acceptance; next=suggest review next time, not approved; priority absent. Candidate sentence 1: The sample was accepted and execution authorized. Mapping: Status does not support accepted; next explicitly lacks approval. Reject sentence 1. Supported rewrite: Source marks the sample pending acceptance; next is an unapproved review suggestion, priority unknown. S-A and sentence 1 are manual examples, not real task IDs, JSON fields or executed detector output. No real customer text/private evidence address or model call is involved. An authorized external summarizer still requires the same review; fluent prose is not evidence. Attribution, scope and reference locations Retain original wording/location before writing attributed text such as source labels rather than a global assertion. Identify whether material is full tasks , a decisions subset, current filters or a Watch summary. Subset evidence cannot establish a whole-ledger conclusion. Review private originals within existing permissions rather than copying full tasks or parameterized links into public summaries. A supplied field establishes a source value, not authority, truth or write permission. Unmapped sentences remain unreviewed or unused; do not fabricate decorative references. FAQ Does Yihu automatically generate opportunity summaries/citations? No engine is asserted or added. Existing source reads task JSON and summary carriers; sentence writing, numbering and mapping here are manual guidance. Can waiting for acceptance be shortened to accepted? No. Waiting and completion are opposite states. Preserve status/attribution without turning a subset label into approval. Can a customer-like title establish the same customer record? Not by title similarity. Verify source/stable item identity, and do not copy personal information into a public example. Is an HTTPS citation per sentence enough? No. Review which claim the reference supports, permission, version and scope. Link shape alone validates neither truth nor approval. Can missing priority/time simply disappear from a summary? Do not let omission imply verification. Mark unknown or omit conclusions that depend on absent evidence, without invented current time/low priority. Can a reviewed summary automatically be sent to a customer? No automated sending/write authority is supplied. Text review, handoff approval and customer communication are different operations under original permissions. Reading and evidence Second-check evidence · Batch comparison · Format compatibility · Follow-up minimization · Start · Privacy Evidence: Radar fields/link parsing , README collection/reply limits .

### 车停稳或展会录音前：高噪场景外设拾音条件核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/vehicle-exhibition-microphone-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 车停稳或展会录音前：高噪场景外设拾音条件核对 先决定能否安全且获准采集，再检查外设，不用噪声场景证明性能 需要移动办公记录时，应停车到安全位置或离开展会通道/设备危险区，并确认录音范围获准；不得在驾驶或需要注意周边时操作手机。蓝牙、车载或有线外设的名称只说明连接线索，不证明实际输入、模型可用或噪声识别达标。一呼的近场音频配置是源码策略，本页没有高噪实测、型号推荐保证或新外设选择功能。 与已有指南的分工 静止场景指南给出通用文字交接流程；蓝牙排障用于已经失败的采集；恢复矩阵用于录音开始后的系统事件。本页检查的是 开始前外设各自承担输入还是输出、是否有安全与权限条件值得采集 ，不要求通过反复切换设备制造问题。 录音前外设与环境检查表 场景/外设 开始前确认 可用的非敏感依据 停止条件/不能承诺 停车位置 已停稳、不妨碍交通且符合适用规则 仅记录是否有安全静止条件 行驶或需关注环境时不操作，不承诺免提驾驶 展会位置 允许录音，避开无关人员与通道 获准的合成句和限定采集范围 未获准不录，不采集顾客/胸牌/私密洽谈 手机内置输入 实际系统输入与麦克风授权 当前权限/路由可见状态 不从手机在旁边推断正在用内置麦克风 蓝牙耳机 输入与输出角色分别核 型号/系统版本和实际路由，不含唯一标识 已配对不等于耳机麦克风启用或型号兼容 车载蓝牙 当前连接由哪个系统/会话使用 实际可见路由与当前音频操作 车载播放成功不证明App采集或锁屏可用 有线/USB/转接外设 系统是否实际提供输入与兼容格式 设备类型与可见状态 本页不认证任意转接器或要求购买新设备 扬声器/其他播放 是否会影响合成采集或泄露资料 结束自己开启的不必要播放 voiceChat不构成零回声/噪声处理成绩 模型/目标 模型已校验、空白草稿获准且不自动执行 当前版本与目标条件 有外设不替代模型、服务、权限或确认 只在条件齐备时作一次合成检查 先明确想保留的是本地笔记还是自有工作台草稿，不把设备测试送到真实订单或客户沟通里。使用“整理示例物品清单，只留草稿，不发送”这类无真实任务语句；检查录音、转写和目标时仍要把阶段分开。本页不运行测试，不请求权限，也不会连接外设。 遇到环境不适合或输入不明，保留未通过项并停止，不把音量调高、靠近他人谈话或连续重录作为默认解决方案。如果已经开始后换设备或来电，改看相应音频恢复矩阵，不能沿用“开始前已检查”当作录音完整证明。 记录条件，不制作假的性能结论 可用的记录是“在获准静止位置、这次实际路由仍未确认，因此未开始”，而不是“车载蓝牙已支持高噪通话”。型号、固件、距离、背景声音、输入路由和模型都会影响实际结果；源码设置不能替代固定设备与环境的证据。 不承诺风噪抑制、信噪比、距离、准确率、耗电或锁屏持续性。设备选择也不产生群组语音频道、实时调度或紧急通信保证。若需求是安全相关联络，应使用团队已有经验证的通信方式，不靠本静态指南。 FAQ 车载蓝牙连接后可以边开车边操作一呼吗？ 不应按本页这样做。先在安全位置停车并遵守适用规则，不让手机操作或耳机隔绝必要环境声影响安全。 展会上能用真实顾客谈话作识别样例吗？ 不应为公开测试采集真实顾客、胸牌或私人洽谈。先核录音授权与范围，只用获准合成材料。 车载系统能播声音就说明它在采集吗？ 不能。输出和输入不同，当前系统与App会话仍需核路由；本页不提供自动选麦或占用探针。 有线或USB麦克风一定比蓝牙更适合吗？ 不能给脱离实际设备/系统/环境的保证。核实际输入与格式，本文没有外设性能榜、认证清单或购买要求。 近场voiceChat配置是否证明高噪识别可靠？ 不证明。它是请求系统音频处理的策略，不是噪声级别、型号组合、准确率或续航测试结果。 前检通过后换耳机，还能直接引用原结论吗？ 不能。路由和格式可能变化，开始前条件不证明后续恢复；看实际状态并按对应路径核保存/中断与目标。 相关指南与源码 静止场景流程 · 输入排障 · 音频切换恢复矩阵 · 人工文本修订 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 近场配置与采集路径 、 README设备/模型/服务限制 。

### Before recording in a parked vehicle or exhibition: accessory input checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/vehicle-exhibition-microphone-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before recording in a parked vehicle or exhibition: accessory input checks Establish safe authorized capture first, then inspect accessories; noise is not a benchmark For mobile notes, park safely or leave exhibition aisles/hazardous equipment areas and confirm recording permission. Do not operate the phone while driving or needing environmental attention. A Bluetooth/car/wired device name establishes neither the actual input, prepared model nor reliable noisy recognition. Near-field configuration is a source policy; no high-noise test, guaranteed model recommendation or new accessory selector is supplied. Different from earlier guides Stationary preflight covers the overall text workflow; input diagnosis addresses failed capture; the recovery matrix addresses events after recording begins. Here before starting, identify each accessory’s input/output role and whether safety/permission allow capture at all . Do not manufacture failures by repeatedly switching devices. Environment and accessory preflight Context/accessory Confirm before starting Non-sensitive evidence Stop condition/no guarantee Parked location Stationary, not obstructing traffic, applicable rules followed Whether safe stationary conditions exist No phone operation while driving; no hands-free-driving promise Exhibition position Recording permitted, away from bystanders/aisles Authorized synthetic phrase and bounded scope No unauthorized customers, badges or private discussions Phone input Actual system microphone and permission Current visible permission/route state A nearby phone does not prove built-in input is active Bluetooth headset Input/output roles checked separately Model/system version and actual route, not unique IDs Paired does not certify microphone use or compatibility Vehicle Bluetooth Which system/session currently uses the connection Actual route and audio operation Successful car playback is not app capture/lock-screen acceptance Wired/USB/adapter System supplies an input and compatible format Device type/visible state No arbitrary-adapter certification or purchase requirement Speakers/other playback Interference with capture or disclosure risk Stop unnecessary playback you started voiceChat is not zero-echo/noise-performance evidence Model/target Verified available model, authorized non-executing blank draft Actual version and target readiness Accessories do not replace models, services, permission or confirmation One synthetic check only when prerequisites are ready Decide between a local note and a workbench draft before testing. Do not send equipment tests to real orders/customer conversations. Use “Prepare a sample equipment checklist; keep a draft without sending,” then distinguish capture, recognition and destination results. This page runs no test, requests no permission and connects no accessory. Stop with unresolved conditions if the environment/input is unsuitable. Higher volume, approaching other people’s conversations and repeated recording are not default fixes. After a device change or call during capture, use the corresponding recovery matrix rather than treating preflight as proof of complete recording. Record conditions, not invented performance A useful finding is “authorized stationary location, actual input still unconfirmed, capture not started,” not “car Bluetooth supports reliable noisy calls.” Device, firmware, distance, background sound, route and model can affect outcomes. Source settings are not fixed-device/environment evidence. No wind suppression, signal-to-noise ratio, distance, accuracy, battery or lock-screen continuity is promised. Selecting equipment supplies no group channel, real-time dispatch or emergency-delivery guarantee. Safety-related communication needs established validated channels, not this static page. FAQ Does car Bluetooth permit operating Yihu while driving? Not on this guide. Park safely and follow applicable rules. Phone operation or audio isolation must not compromise environmental awareness. Can real exhibition customer conversations be recognition samples? Do not collect real customers, badges or private discussions for public tests. Confirm permission/scope and use authorized synthetic material. Does successful car playback prove microphone capture? No. Output and input differ. Inspect the actual system/app route; this guide provides no automatic microphone selector or occupancy probe. Is wired/USB always better than Bluetooth? No detached-device/environment guarantee is appropriate. Check the actual input/format. There is no performance ranking, certification list or purchase requirement here. Does near-field voiceChat prove reliable high-noise recognition? No. It requests system processing, not a measured noise level, device combination, accuracy or endurance result. Can preflight conclusions survive a later headset change unchanged? Do not assume that. Routes/formats can change. Initial readiness does not establish later recovery; inspect actual retention/interruption and destination state. Reading and source Stationary workflow · Input diagnosis · Recovery source matrix · Manual correction · Start · Privacy Evidence: near-field/capture source , README device/model/service limits .

### 中英混说与术语保留前检：语言提示、常用词顺序和原文核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multilingual-terms-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 中英混说与术语保留前检：语言提示、常用词顺序和原文核对 词表是识别背景提示，不是保证保留原词或自动翻译的字典 一呼现有语言选项为自动、中文、英文，自动选项界面含中英混说说明；常用词作为识别背景上下文使用。语言提示、解析后的词表和最终识别文字仍是不同层级。输入了术语不等于每个词都被模型纳入或正确保留，本页不提供翻译服务、多语言准确率或专名识别保证。 与人工纠错、纪要核对的区别 人工修订处理已经得到的文字；这里在采集前检查 实际语言提示、词表如何解析和哪些原词必须人工回查 。它不重写音频排障，也不把词表内容当作Agent指令、账号身份或审批授权。 多语言术语前检表 检查项 当前源码/界面边界 合成检查例子 不能推断 语言选项 automatic/chinese/english，自动提示不强制固定语言 是否按实际版本选项核对 自动支持所有语言或自动翻译 术语开关 是否识别时参考与保存词表分开 关闭参考不等于删除已存词 有保存就必定参与这次识别 分隔符 换行、英文/中文逗号、顿号和分号等按源码拆项 Sample-A与Sample-B各占一项 逗号属于术语原文时仍被完整保留 空白/重复 去首尾空白、丢空项，大小写去重保留首项顺序 Sample与sample只保留先出现者 有Unicode全面归一化或自动术语合并 数量 最多80个通过解析的术语 超出时不把剩余项算已采用 80项都会完整送进每次模型上下文 长度 单项最多40个Swift Character，过长项丢弃而非截断 长术语先核实际字符数 40字符等于40个UTF-8字节 优先顺序 前面的有效项更优先，实际保留受预算影响 把真正需要的合成词放前面 越长录音仍能带上全部术语 最终文字 仍需核拼写、缩写、数字与否定 保留原词引用，不把建议写成批准 词表可代替原文/真机准确率验收 解析器不以普通空格拆成多个术语，但这不等于模型把整句当成一个不可变词。不要把长提示或操作指令塞进词表来要求执行；它是识别上下文，不是业务命令通道。 合成术语清单的核对 输入示意： Sample-A sample-a 样例代号B，API 人工预期：首个Sample-A保留，后面大小写重复项不另计；样例代号B与API分别成项。 仍未知：具体识别会采用多少上下文，以及输出是否保留拼写。 这个例子不修改App设置，也不执行实际识别。公开例子不用客户姓名、内部产品编码、工作台令牌或真实任务正文。若需要维护团队词汇，应在已有获准范围核对，不为本页新建共享词库或外部授权。 原词与后续简报的边界 语音识别、人工翻译与摘要写作是不同处理。若下游简报把某个英文缩写展开、改成中文或合并别名，应保留修改依据和未知项，不能把编辑决定说成模型原词输出。多人/多端使用同一标签也不证明App会跨设备同步词表。 正式采用前仍需实际版本、兼容模型、权限与安全场景。本文不提供自动术语对齐、跨语言实体消歧或“所有专名必对”的能力，也不通过调整参数绕过模型校验和目标守卫。 FAQ 自动选项能保证任何语言和口音都正确吗？ 不能。当前选项与提示范围不等于任意语言/口音准确率；需实际模型与设备证据，本文未运行识别测试。 超过40字符的术语会被截成前40个吗？ 不是。当前解析直接丢弃不符合长度条件的项，不应把截短后的字串当作源码自动采用结果。 解析出80项是否说明识别时全用上？ 不说明。顺序和识别上下文预算影响采用范围；数量上限不是每次全部纳入保证。 关闭术语参考会删掉词表吗？ 按现有界面说明，两者分开，关闭参考保留词表；实际是否参考需核当前设置与版本，不从存储存在推断启用。 常用词会自动翻译成另一种语言吗？ 本文不提供翻译保证。术语作为识别背景，输出、人工改写和翻译要分别核对并保留来源。 术语包含“发送/执行”是否给Agent授权？ 不会。词表文字不是服务端权限、用户确认或业务命令许可，原交接守卫与回执边界不变。 相关指南与源码 人工文本修订 · 单录音原词核对 · 摘要逐句溯源 · 跨时区时间检查 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 语言选项与术语解析 、 设置界面说明 、 识别上下文前缀 。

### Before mixed-language dictation: language hints, term order and original wording

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/multilingual-terms-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before mixed-language dictation: language hints, term order and original wording A term list is recognition context, not a guaranteed preserve-or-translate dictionary Existing language choices are automatic, Chinese and English; the automatic label mentions mixed Chinese/English. Terms provide recognition background. A language hint, parsed list and final text are different layers. Entering a term does not prove every item reached the model or was preserved correctly. No translation service, universal multilingual accuracy or proper-name guarantee is supplied. Different from correction and minutes review Correction deals with already recognized text. Here before capture, inspect the actual hint, list parsing and original terms requiring later review . This is not another audio diagnosis. Vocabulary is neither an Agent instruction channel, identity nor approval. Language and vocabulary preflight Check Existing boundary Synthetic inspection Not established Language choice automatic/chinese/english; automatic supplies no fixed language hint Actual version/selection Every language supported or automatic translation Term toggle Referencing terms and retaining them are separate Disabling use does not delete stored terms Stored implies used in this recognition Separators Newlines and listed Latin/Chinese commas, enumeration marks/semicolons split terms Sample-A and Sample-B as separate items A comma inside a name remains unsplit Whitespace/duplicates Trim ends, drop blanks, case-insensitive deduplication, first-item order Sample/sample keeps the first Universal Unicode normalization or entity merging Count Up to 80 accepted terms Overflow is not counted as adopted All 80 always reach recognition context Length Up to 40 Swift Characters per item; overlong items are dropped, not truncated Inspect actual character count 40 characters means 40 UTF-8 bytes Order Earlier valid terms have priority, within context budget Put necessary synthetic terms first Longer audio preserves every term Output Check spelling, abbreviations, quantities and negations Retain original references Vocabulary replaces source/device accuracy checks Ordinary spaces do not split terms in this parser, but that does not make an entire phrase immutable to the recognizer. Do not put long operational prompts into the vocabulary to request execution; it is recognition context, not business authority. One synthetic list Input illustration: Sample-A sample-a 样例代号B，API Editorial expectation: First Sample-A retained; its case duplicate is not another term. The Chinese sample label and API are separate items. Still unknown: How much context reaches recognition and whether spelling survives in output. This neither changes app settings nor runs recognition. Use no customer names, private product codes, service tokens or real tasks publicly. Team vocabulary belongs in existing authorized processes, without provisioning a shared service or third-party authorization here. Original words versus later briefs Recognition, editorial translation and summarization are different processing steps. Expanding an acronym, translating a phrase or merging aliases needs a reason and retained unknowns, not a claim the model produced that wording. Shared labels do not prove cross-device vocabulary synchronization. Actual version, compatible models, permission and a safe environment remain prerequisites. No automatic terminology alignment, cross-language entity resolution or every-name-correct feature is provided, and no parameter bypasses model/target guards. FAQ Does automatic guarantee every language and accent? No. Choices/labels are not arbitrary-language accuracy evidence. Check actual models/devices; this page runs no recognition benchmark. Are over-40-character terms truncated to 40? No. Current parsing drops items failing the length condition. Do not present a shortened string as an automatically adopted result. Does parsing 80 entries mean recognition uses them all? No. Order and context budgets affect the adopted scope. An upper bound is not an all-items guarantee. Does disabling term use delete the list? Existing UI distinguishes the two and retains terms. Check actual setting/version rather than inferring enablement from storage. Does vocabulary automatically translate into another language? No translation guarantee follows. Terms are background; output, editing and translation need separate source review. Does send/execute in vocabulary authorize an Agent? No. Term text is not server permission, user confirmation or operation authority. Handoff/receipt guards remain. Reading and source Manual correction · Original-word passage review · Summary provenance · Timezone/time checks · Start · Privacy Evidence: language choices/term parser , settings explanation , recognition context prefixes .

### 跨时区简报时间怎样核对？来源日期、Unix任务时间与载体时间分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/timezone-timestamp-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 跨时区简报时间怎样核对？来源日期、Unix任务时间与载体时间分账 先问这个时间描述哪件事，再比较时区、单位与先后 一呼当前Radar把 date_str 按固定 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 、UTC+08:00解析，来源最后成功读取时间不能用手机请求、缓存命中或文件修改时间替换。任务 timestamp 是另外的可选Unix时间字段；Watch的 sourceDate 与 capturedAt 又有各自含义。跨时区核对应先分事件与契约，不把所有“时间”都当同一种数字。 与缓存排障、批次比较的分工 缓存指南定位旧数据和读取失败，批次比较核两份数据是否可比；这里专门检查 不同口径的日期时间如何被错误比较 。本页不实现自动时区转换、时钟修正、预约调度或跨时区同步，也不写回真实来源时间。 时间字段口径表 时间/位置 当前含义或契约 应核对什么 不能替代什么 date_str 来源最后成功读取；固定UTC+08格式 完整字符串、来源与实际读取状态 手机点刷新或导出文件保存时间 任务timestamp 可选Double，Unix任务更新时间 来源提供的单位、缺失/null与排序范围 整份源读取时间、批准/处理时间 手机请求时间 发起读取的本地事件 是否成功拿到新源，而非仅缓存 来源已更新或任务已变更 Watch sourceDate 手机摘要对应来源时间 来源范围、失败与裁剪信息 手表封包或独立刷新时间 Watch capturedAt 摘要封包时间 与sourceDate分别看待 最新业务状态或最新源读取 文件/编辑时间 保存、复制、整理文档的事件 是否只是副本或人工编辑 原业务事件或来源身份 Unix秒与毫秒 不同数值单位，不可混用 按生产者/消费者契约核单位 仅凭位数猜测后自动改值 其他时区呈现 对同一时刻的人工显示 明确偏移、跨日与适用规则 把本地时区直接写回date_str Watch日期是该载体的Date编码契约，不能把随手看到的底层序列化数字直接与任务Unix字段相减。必须先核双方格式/单位；本页不提供通用时间字段识别器。 两个固定历史示例 示例A：2026-10-18 09:00（按当前date_str契约为UTC+08） 同一时刻的UTC显示：2026-10-18 01:00 UTC 示例B：2026-10-18 00:30（UTC+08） 同一时刻的UTC显示：2026-10-17 16:30 UTC，日期跨到前一天 这是明确偏移下的人工示意，不是真实来源或当前新鲜数据。不要因为文中给出UTC显示，就把 Z 、偏移或ISO分隔符直接加回 date_str ；当前严格格式与回读校验不等于任意ISO8601接受器。 检查顺序 先给每个时间标明事件：源读取、任务更新、请求、封包还是文件编辑。再确认来源身份与范围，随后核格式、时区/偏移和单位。如果出现排序矛盾，先看缺失值、优先级与来源顺序规则，不把它自动解释成时钟错误或任务状态改变。 当前源码把超过24小时的来源标旧，超前超过5分钟提示时钟问题；它们是来源时效判断，不是响应时间、刷新频率、服务SLA或业务逾期判定。未知日期应保持未知/失败，不能填“现在”让警告消失。任何修正应回原来源维护流程，不绕过解析或写授权。 FAQ 手机在另一个时区，date_str会改按手机时区解析吗？ 当前模型使用固定UTC+08解析，不应按手机所在地反推。实际显示与来源语义仍须分开核对。 给date_str加Z或+08:00会更标准吗？ 不能因此假定当前消费者接受。它有固定格式与严格回读检查，改源格式属于兼容性变更，需另核目标版本。 13位数字可以自动除1000当Unix秒吗？ 不应靠位数自动修源。先核生产者契约与实际字段，错误单位可能无效或表示完全不同时间；本页不提供自动强转。 刚刷新或刚封包为什么还显示旧来源？ 请求/封包与源成功读取不同，缓存可继续显示旧值；不能把新请求时间冒充来源更新。 24小时和5分钟是刷新SLA吗？ 不是。它们是当前来源旧值/未来时钟判断阈值，不承诺服务按某周期更新或任务必须何时处理。 时间缺失时填当前时间能帮助比较吗？ 会伪造含义，不应这样做。保留未知及缺口，回来源确认；否则会把旧数据或编辑副本误当新事实。 相关指南与源码 JSON类型与空值 · 批次比较 · 跨端呈现 · 改版兼容 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 来源日期解析、时效与排序 、 Watch日期模型 。

### Review brief timestamps across timezones: source, task and carrier clocks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/timezone-timestamp-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Review brief timestamps across timezones: source, task and carrier clocks Identify the event before comparing timezone, units and ordering Current Radar parses date_str using fixed yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm in UTC+08:00. Last successful source read cannot be replaced with a phone request, cache hit or file modification. Optional task timestamp is a separate Unix-time field; Watch sourceDate and capturedAt also differ. Establish event/contract first instead of treating all times as equivalent numbers. Different from cache diagnosis and batch comparison Cache review locates old data/read failures; batch review establishes comparable exports. Here different time meanings can be compared incorrectly . No automatic timezone converter, clock repair, scheduling or cross-zone sync is added, and no live source time is rewritten. Time meanings and units Time/location Current meaning/contract Check Does not replace date_str Last successful source read, fixed UTC+08 format Exact string, source and successful read state Refresh tap or exported-file save time Task timestamp Optional Double, Unix task-update time Producer units, absence/null and ordering scope Whole-source read, approval or handling time Phone request Local event starting a read New successful source response versus cache Source update or task modification Watch sourceDate Source represented by the phone summary Scope, failures and truncation Watch packaging or independent refresh Watch capturedAt Summary packaging time Inspect separately from sourceDate New business state or successful source read File/editorial time Save/copy/edit event Whether only a copy/document changed Original business event or source identity Unix seconds/milliseconds Different units, not interchangeable Producer/consumer contract Automatic conversion based on digit count Other-zone presentation Another display of one instant Explicit offset, date boundary and applicable rules Writing local-zone text back as date_str Watch dates use that carrier’s Date encoding contract. Do not subtract arbitrary serialized values directly from task Unix fields without verifying format/units. This page supplies no universal timestamp detector. Two fixed historical illustrations A: 2026-10-18 09:00 under date_str's UTC+08 contract Same instant in UTC: 2026-10-18 01:00 UTC B: 2026-10-18 00:30 at UTC+08 Same instant in UTC: 2026-10-17 16:30 UTC, on the preceding date These are explicit-offset illustrations, not real/current source data. A UTC display does not authorize appending Z , offsets or ISO separators to date_str . Its strict round-trip format is not arbitrary ISO8601 acceptance. Review sequence Label the event first: source read, task update, request, packaging or editing. Confirm identity/scope, then format, timezone/offset and unit. If ordering conflicts, inspect absent timestamps, priorities and source-order rules before assuming clock failure or changed task state. Current source marks source age over 24 hours stale and flags time more than five minutes ahead. These are freshness signals, not response latency, refresh frequency, service SLA or a business deadline. Keep unknown/failed times rather than filling now to hide a warning. Corrections belong to the original maintenance process without bypassing parsing/write authority. FAQ Does another phone timezone change date_str parsing? The current model fixes UTC+08 rather than inferring from device location. Keep displayed time and source meaning separate. Is adding Z or +08:00 automatically more compatible? No. The consumer has an exact format/round-trip check. A source-format change needs actual-version compatibility review. Can a 13-digit value automatically be divided by 1000? Do not repair by digit count. Confirm producer contract/field first. Wrong units can be invalid or mean another instant; no automatic coercion is offered. Why is source time old after refresh or packaging? Request/packaging events differ from successful source reads. Cache can retain an old source time; do not substitute now. Are 24 hours and five minutes refresh SLAs? No. They are current stale/future-source thresholds, not promised update schedules or task-handling deadlines. Can missing time be filled with now to help comparison? That fabricates meaning. Keep the gap and confirm at the source instead of presenting old data/edited copies as new facts. Reading and source JSON types/nulls · Batch comparison · Cross-device presentation · Format compatibility · Start · Privacy Evidence: source-date parsing/freshness/sorting , Watch date model .
