### 文本、截图与附件怎样核脱敏范围？载体差异和归档矩阵

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/carrier-redaction-archive-matrix/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 文本、截图与附件怎样核脱敏范围？载体差异和归档矩阵 先确认载体与处理路径：去元数据不是去画面里的敏感文字 归档或分享前，文本、截图、照片和其他文件须分别核查。一呼明确相机/照片图片暂存路径有有界JPEG处理并不复制源元数据，但这不是自动遮挡像素内容、OCR脱敏、所有附件清洗或归档服务。上一轮最小披露指南决定保留哪些材料；这里进一步判断 所选载体的哪一层仍可能保有敏感信息 。 按载体区分的检查矩阵 载体/层 已核实现或人工边界 仍要核的内容 不应声称 纯文本/转写 原文与人工修订分别处理 名称、账号、编号、正文和上下文组合 App自动识别或遮挡敏感词 JSON/链接文字 Radar按源字段读取，链接筛选仅部分形态 路径、查询、片段和任务/来源标识 HTTPS或JSON有效就已经脱敏 截图像素 截图里的文字/头像/二维码仍属于画面 可见客户内容、账号、令牌或可识别细节 去文件元数据就去掉画面文字 明确图片暂存路径 对选定相机/照片输入作JPEG处理，不复制源GPS等元数据 最终图像像素、方向、实际内容与目的地 所有分享文件走同一处理或输出已匿名 图片文件准入 编码输入最多32 MiB、3200万像素 实际输入类型和拒绝状态 尺寸门槛代表隐私/安全认证 相机位图/输出 相机位图另有128 MiB边界；输出边长最多2048 本轮处理是否成功与最终可见内容 降采样是可靠遮挡、性能或保密保证 其他附件 按实际类型和既有工具规则核对 文档正文、批注、修订、隐藏内容或元数据 图片处理器会清理任意PDF/文档/音频 副本/归档位置 原件、修订件、托盘、工作台和同步账户可能不同 已有权限、必要副本与实际保留规则 删本地文件就撤回远端或备份 这些是源码准入/处理边界，不是所有设备已验收的隐私结果。 CollieDiagnosticImage 只说明其明确输入和输出路径，不能扩展成对整个系统分享收件箱里所有文件的统一保证。 合成材料的三层核查 样例载体：一张写有“样例账号A”的合成截图。 层1：检查文件元数据是否属于已核图片处理路径。 层2：检查输出像素里“样例账号A”是否仍可读；降采样不证明它消失。 层3：检查旧截图、附件和目的地是否已有其他版本，归档范围是否获准。 结论：没有足够证据前，不标为已匿名或已撤回所有副本。 这里不提供图片或真实账号，也不执行相机、OCR或脱敏处理。若需要手工遮挡，应在已有获准工具里处理并再次检查最终输出；不从编辑步骤的存在推断遮挡成功，更不把旧版副本忘记计入范围。 归档前先核路径，再核内容 先问文件来自哪种输入：明确照片/相机暂存、系统分享的其他文件，还是文字附件。再确认处理是否成功，保存后的实际内容是什么。只有经过对应路径的输出才可引用该路径的源码属性，不能用文件后缀相同替代证明。 之后核原件与处理稿的权限、目的地和必要副本。图片暂存不自动上传或发送；后续工作台交接可能先上传附件，未发送消息不代表没有远端副本。已尝试交接仍遵守原守卫，不用脱敏稿换名来规避一次标记或不确定状态。 本文不给统一保留期限、法律认证、不可恢复删除或匿名化保证。未知或不合格材料应停在原获准范围，由已有维护/信息处理流程确认，不为了演示公开私有数据。 FAQ 去GPS和源元数据是否把截图正文一起去掉？ 不会由此成立。像素里的文字、头像、二维码或表格仍可能可读，必须单独核最终画面。 所有分享到一呼的文件都会自动清元数据吗？ 不能这样说。这里引用的是明确图片暂存处理路径，不适用于任意文档、PDF、音频或其他文件输入。 2048边长输出能保证细节无法识别吗？ 不能。尺寸上限是有界处理，不是隐私遮挡或匿名化算法；文字与其他识别细节可能仍存在。 文件小于32 MiB就能称为已安全脱敏吗？ 不能。大小/像素准入与内容、权限、隐私是不同维度，还须核输入类型与实际处理结果。 换成修订附件会自动删除服务上的旧附件吗？ 本文不提供此功能。托盘、上传件、草稿和账户同步副本分别核，按实际服务规则处理，不承诺远端撤回。 人工矩阵全勾选就能宣称合法匿名和归档完成吗？ 不能。检查表不是法律或匿名化认证，仍需实际权限、内容和保留依据，且只能说明真正核过的范围。 相关指南与源码 跟进证据最小化 · 认领与归档规则 · 修订与副本 · 交接证据审计 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 明确图片输入、限额、编码与暂存 、 README图片与分享边界 。

### Text, screenshots and attachments: carrier-specific redaction/archive checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/carrier-redaction-archive-matrix/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Text, screenshots and attachments: carrier-specific redaction/archive checks Identify carrier and processing path: metadata removal is not pixel-text redaction Review text, screenshots, photos and other files separately before retention/sharing. Yihu’s explicit camera/photo staging path performs bounded JPEG processing without copying source metadata. This is not automatic pixel masking, OCR redaction, universal attachment cleaning or an archive service. Minimization decides what to retain; here which layer in a selected carrier may still disclose information needs review. Carrier-specific scope matrix Carrier/layer Existing implementation/manual boundary Still inspect Do not claim Text/transcript Originals and manual corrections differ Names, accounts, references, body and combinations Automatic sensitive-word detection/masking JSON/link text Source fields retained; link filtering checks shape only Paths, query, fragments and source/item identities Valid JSON/HTTPS establishes redaction Screenshot pixels Visible text/avatars/QR codes remain image content Customer material, accounts, tokens or identifying details Metadata removal deletes visible text Explicit image staging JPEG processing of selected camera/photo input without source GPS/metadata copying Final pixels, orientation, actual content and destination Every shared file uses this path or output is anonymous Encoded-image admission Up to 32 MiB and 32 million pixels Actual input type and refusal state Size limits certify privacy/security Camera bitmap/output Separate 128 MiB bitmap bound; output side up to 2048 Successful processing and final visible content Resizing is reliable masking or confidentiality/performance evidence Other attachments Actual type/tool policy applies Body, comments, revisions, hidden content and metadata The image helper cleans arbitrary PDFs/documents/audio Copies/archive Original, edited file, tray, workbench and sync may differ Existing permission, necessary copies and retention policy Local deletion recalls remote/backed-up copies These are source admission/processing limits, not device-certified privacy outcomes. CollieDiagnosticImage describes its explicit input/output path, not every file in the system share inbox. Three layers in a synthetic review Carrier: A synthetic screenshot displaying sample account A. Layer 1: Is the file in the reviewed image-processing path? Layer 2: Is sample account A still readable in output pixels? Resizing does not prove removal. Layer 3: Are old versions already in attachments/destinations, and is retention authorized? Conclusion: Do not claim anonymity or recall of every copy without evidence. No image, real account, camera, OCR or redaction operation is supplied. If masking is necessary, use an existing authorized tool and inspect the saved result. An editing step is not proof of successful masking, and older copies remain in scope. Path before content, then retention Identify explicit photo/camera staging versus other system-shared files or text attachments. Check success and actual saved content. Only output from the relevant path supports that path’s source properties; an identical filename suffix is insufficient. Then inspect permissions/destination/necessary copies of originals and edits. Staging does not upload/send automatically. Later workbench handoff can upload before sending, so unsent messages do not establish no remote copy. Prior attempts retain guards; a renamed redacted draft cannot bypass one-handoff/uncertainty. No universal retention period, legal certification, irreversible deletion or anonymity guarantee is provided. Keep unknown/unsuitable material within original permissions for the existing information-handling process, not public demos. FAQ Does removing GPS/source metadata remove screenshot text? No. Text, avatars, QR codes and tables can remain readable in pixels. Review the final image separately. Is every file shared to Yihu automatically stripped? No blanket claim follows. The cited path is explicit image staging, not arbitrary document/PDF/audio or other file input. Does a 2048-side output guarantee unidentifiable details? No. It is bounded processing, not a masking/anonymization algorithm. Text and other identifying detail can remain. Does under 32 MiB mean safely redacted? No. Admission size/pixels differ from content, permission and privacy. Check input type and actual result. Does a replacement attachment delete the older remote one? No such feature is supplied. Inspect tray/uploads/drafts/sync separately under actual service rules, without a recall guarantee. Does checking every box certify lawful anonymity or complete archiving? No. This is neither legal nor anonymization certification. Actual permissions, content and retention evidence remain necessary, limited to reviewed scope. Reading and source Evidence minimization · Ownership/archive rules · Corrections/copies · Handoff evidence review · Start · Privacy Evidence: explicit image inputs/limits/encoding/staging , README image/sharing limits .

### 笔记和Radar简报导出前：编码、换行、引号与分隔符核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/export-encoding-delimiter-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 笔记和Radar简报导出前：编码、换行、引号与分隔符核对 先确认导出载体和消费者，不能把所有逗号都当作字段分隔 一呼较长笔记的现有暂存路径写UTF-8 Markdown；共享收件箱也有自己的内部JSON清单，而Radar读另一套快照模型。三者不能因“都是文字文件”而互换。编码、换行、引号转义、字符数和字段契约须分别核对；本文不提供CSV导出、转码器或自动修复真实文件功能。 与术语解析、JSON类型和改版评审的分工 术语前检解释词表按哪些符号拆项，JSON类型检查关注字段形态，改版评审关注契约变化。这里核的是 已经选定载体中的文字怎样序列化与被读取 ，不是改变术语含义、模型设置或来源字段。 编码与分隔检查表 对象 已核实现/语义 应核对的边界 不应推断 笔记短文字 当前按transcript的Swift Character计数决定文字/附件路径 3000门槛不是UTF-8字节或录音时长 汉字、组合字符都按单字节计算 较长笔记附件 现有路径写Markdown，encoding为utf8 文件正文、标题、换行与实际消费者 任意文件都是同编码，或有CSV/通用转码支持 收件箱manifest JSONEncoder编码内部共享批次 内部清单不是Radar快照契约 改名.json就能导入Radar 源Radar JSON 按实际消费者JSONDecoder与模型读取 语法、类型、大小、日期和身份分别核 本文宣称所有输入只接受一种编码或自动纠错 逗号/分号 在JSON字符串内可以只是数据 引号内外语义，不能套词表拆项规则 逗号必然代表新的任务或字段 换行/引号 JSON字符串须遵守转义语法 \n、双引号和反斜线的实际内容 把字面反斜线n和换行混为同一字节序列 Unicode文字 字符、UTF-8字节与语言语义不同 先核实际编码与保留原文 看起来相同就证明字节完全相同 文件名/副本 扩展名、保存时间和正文契约分开 目的地与已有交接状态 换后缀/文件名可以绕过一次交接或权限 一个JSON字符串语法片段 下例只示意字符串， 不是完整Radar快照 ，缺少真实导入所需的其他模型字段，也不是App生成的样例输出。 { "title" : "Sample, A" , "next" : "Line1 \n Line2" } 解析后逗号仍属于title，转义换行属于next内容。若想保留字面上的反斜线和n，序列化方式又不同；不要用简单的“按逗号切开”处理JSON。词表解析会拆某些标点，不意味着导出正文也适用该规则。 合成文本“样例A”由三个简单字符组成，UTF-8为七字节；这个例子说明计数不同，不提供通用字符计数器，更不能把JavaScript字符串长度直接当Swift Character门槛。 导出前后的保留检查 先用不含真实数据的样例确认目标工具按什么类型读取，再核原文与已读回内容，不为修复显示异常重写真实来源。不要在不了解编码/消费者时直接删字节、去掉引号或把错误字段补为当前时间。 字符显示正常只证明可见结果，不证明来源身份、模型校验或送达；文件写出也只是本地/暂存阶段。笔记原有交接标记、目标许可与不确定停止边界不变，修订编码或改文件名不授予重发权。 FAQ 一呼长笔记导出就是CSV吗？ 不是。引用的现有路径写UTF-8 Markdown，并通过已有收件箱暂存；本文不新增CSV导出或字段转换。 收件箱manifest.json可以当Radar任务源吗？ 不能。内部批次清单和Radar快照有不同模型，扩展名相同不等于契约相同。 JSON里的逗号都能按词表规则拆吗？ 不能。引号内可能是数据，JSON有自己的语法；词表分隔规则不属于JSON/CSV通用解析器。 3000字门槛是不是3000个UTF-8字节？ 不是。当前笔记门槛用Swift Character计数，不能与编码字节、Unicode标量或录音时长混用。 中文显示异常时可以随便重编码再交接吗？ 不要盲目修复。先核来源编码、目标契约和原结果，保留原文；改编码不抹去已尝试交接或重复风险。 语法片段能证明实际App导入通过吗？ 不能。这里只核字符串示意，不替代完整模型、实际版本解码、权限和设备验收。 相关指南与源码 术语分隔与长度 · JSON类型/空值 · 格式改版 · 笔记一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 笔记Markdown写出与门槛 、 内部共享清单 、 Radar模型 。

### Before exporting notes or Radar briefs: encoding, line breaks and delimiters

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/export-encoding-delimiter-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before exporting notes or Radar briefs: encoding, line breaks and delimiters Identify carrier and consumer first; commas are not universally field separators The existing longer-note staging path writes UTF-8 Markdown. The share inbox also has an internal JSON manifest, while Radar consumes another snapshot model. Being text files does not make them interchangeable. Encoding, newlines, escaping, character counts and field contracts need separate review. No CSV exporter, transcoder or automatic repair of live files is added. Different from terms, types and format revisions Vocabulary preflight concerns term splitting, JSON validation concerns field shapes, and revision review concerns contract changes. Here text serialization/readback within a chosen carrier is the task, not changing term meaning, model settings or source fields. Encoding and delimiter checks Object Existing implementation/meaning Check Do not infer Short note text Transcript Swift Character count selects text/attachment path 3000 is not bytes or audio duration CJK/combined characters each use one byte Longer note attachment Existing path writes Markdown with utf8 encoding Body, heading, newlines and actual consumer Every file has identical encoding or CSV/transcoding support Inbox manifest JSONEncoder writes an internal shared batch Not the Radar snapshot contract Renaming .json makes it Radar-compatible Radar source JSON Actual JSONDecoder and model contract Syntax, types, size, dates and identities separately This guide restricts every decoder input to one encoding or repairs it Comma/semicolon Can be data inside JSON strings Quoted/unquoted semantics, not vocabulary splitting Every comma creates a task/field Newline/quotes JSON strings need valid escaping \n, quotes and backslashes as actual content Literal backslash-n and newline have identical bytes Unicode Characters, UTF-8 bytes and meaning differ Actual encoding and retained original Similar display proves identical bytes Filename/copies Suffix/save time differ from body contract Destination and prior handoff state Rename/extension changes bypass reservation/permission A JSON string syntax fragment This demonstrates strings only: not a complete Radar snapshot , missing other required model fields and not an example app-generated export. { "title" : "Sample, A" , "next" : "Line1 \n Line2" } After parsing, the comma remains title data and the escaped newline belongs to next. Preserving literal backslash/n needs a different serialization. Do not split JSON by commas. Vocabulary punctuation splitting does not define exported-body parsing. The synthetic text 样例A has three simple characters and seven UTF-8 bytes. This illustrates different counts, not a universal counter; JavaScript string length must not substitute for Swift Character limits. Retain evidence before and after export Use non-sensitive fixtures to identify how the destination reads the carrier, then compare original/readback without rewriting real source data to hide display errors. Do not remove bytes/quotes or fill now without knowing the encoding/consumer contract. Correct display does not establish source identity, model validation or delivery. Writing a file is a local/staging step only. Original note reservations, destination permission and uncertain-stop states remain. Re-encoding/renaming does not authorize resending. FAQ Are long-note exports CSV? No. The cited path writes UTF-8 Markdown through existing inbox staging. No CSV exporter or field converter is added. Can manifest.json be used as a Radar source? No. The internal share-batch manifest and Radar snapshot have different models. A shared suffix is not a shared contract. Can every JSON comma use vocabulary splitting rules? No. Inside quotes it can be data. JSON has its own grammar; vocabulary splitting is not a general JSON/CSV parser. Is the 3000 threshold 3000 UTF-8 bytes? No. It counts Swift Characters, not encoded bytes, Unicode scalars or recording duration. Can unreadable CJK simply be re-encoded and handed off again? Do not repair blindly. Verify original encoding, destination contract and prior result. Re-encoding does not erase an attempt or duplicate risk. Does the fragment establish app import acceptance? No. It demonstrates strings, not a complete model, actual-version decoding, permission or device acceptance. Reading and source Term splitting/limits · JSON types/nulls · Format revision · One note handoff · Start · Privacy Evidence: Markdown writing/threshold , internal share manifest , Radar model .

### 外设麦克风可用前：权限、16k单声道采样契约与停止边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/microphone-permission-sample-contract/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 外设麦克风可用前：权限、16k单声道采样契约与停止边界 已授权不等于格式可用，内部16k采样也不是任意硬件必定兼容 一呼原生采集入口有自己的麦克风请求与启动时授权检查；识别接口使用有界16 kHz单声道PCM。系统外设实际输入与内部处理契约仍须分开核，转换/启动可能失败。本文不提供降低采样率绕过检查的按钮，不把授权通过、蓝牙配对或模型已下载当作完整采集成功。 与输入排障和录后恢复的分工 输入排障定位已有故障，恢复矩阵解释录音中的事件。本页在准备接入外设时，检查 哪些前提必须同时满足，哪些“降级”不能用来绕过源码条件 。它不请求系统权限，不改音频配置，也不执行录音。 权限与采样契约表 层级 已核契约 核对动作 不可用时不应做什么 原生麦克风授权 请求与start时授权检查分别存在 看实际系统授权与App提示 不绕过拒绝，不把过去授权当永久有效 网页采集 实际网页/系统权限另有边界 区分网页请求和原生录音入口 不把网页能播放或登录当原生授权 外设输入 当前系统路由与输入格式 核实际输入，不只看配对名称 不保证所有耳机/转接器自动兼容 内部音频 识别接口有界16 kHz单声道PCM 核现有管线是否成功准备/转换 不把原始字节任意当成有效PCM 格式变化 短语音比较采样率、通道、commonFormat与交错状态 按实际路径处理不一致 不强制复用不安全的旧转换器 识别设置 当前模型采样/解码设置有固定范围 按实际版本可用选项核对 不捏造8k降级、任意温度或beam调节能力 模型/资源 兼容模型下载校验、存储和权限是不同条件 缺哪层就保留缺口 不因输入有声跳过模型校验 最终文字/交接 partial与final结果、目标守卫各有意义 只按已有最终结果与交接资格处理 不拿未完成partial或格式失败当可送达结果 16 kHz是内部处理契约，不是外设型号认证、音质等级、转写准确率或带宽SLA。系统可能提供不同输入格式，必须由既有实现成功处理；本页不提供通用转换器，也不承诺所有输入都能转入。 合成接入记录 已有：系统麦克风授权状态已核。 未知：当前外设输入格式是否能进入现有采集管线。 模型：按实际版本单独确认，不由权限推断。 决定：未确认格式前不开始业务录音；不改采样率或绕过守卫。 如果实际入口报告权限/格式/启动错误，保留最小非敏感错误类别和版本信息，停止受影响步骤。不要为公开复现录客户谈话、提交设备唯一标识或反复切换系统设置。 不把“降级”变成隐性权限扩张 缺可用外设时，不自动选择另一个输入并开始录音；缺模型时，不自行改走未批准云识别；网页失败时，不把原生文字传给新服务。是否使用另一目标或方法必须沿已有用户选择和授权流程，不能由“为了兼容”推定许可。 若已经有录音或交接尝试，仍保留对应状态与一次标记；权限恢复或换设备不证明原结果未发生。按录后恢复和不确定停止边界处理，不自动重录重发。 FAQ 系统显示已授权是否足够开始任意外设录音？ 不够。路由、格式、管线、模型和安全环境仍需核，授权本身不证明有可用音频或识别结果。 网页可以用麦克风，原生就自动继承吗？ 不能这样推断。网页、系统与原生入口各有检查，播放/登录/网页许可不能代替原生授权与目标守卫。 能调成8k来绕过16k管线失败吗？ 本文不声明这样的用户开关。应遵循实际实现的固定采样/转换契约，不用降低参数名义绕过不一致检查。 硬件不是16k就一定不能用或一定能自动转换吗？ 两种绝对说法都不成立。需要既有管线在实际版本成功处理，不能只看一个数值下结论；本页无全格式矩阵。 看到partial文字就能当最终交付吗？ 不能。接口中的partial是可替换的中间文字，只有返回的最终结果进入原有可交付边界，仍需目标与许可检查。 本地失败是否默认允许用云端转写或另一个麦克风？ 不默认允许。替代输入、服务或目标可能改变数据与权限范围，需独立获准；本页不新增自动回退。 相关指南与源码 输入排障 · 录后恢复矩阵 · 降级许可 · 外设开始前检查 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 权限与格式检查 、 采集/识别接口与partial边界 、 当前设置说明 。

### Before using an external mic: permission, 16 kHz mono contract and stop rules

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/microphone-permission-sample-contract/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before using an external mic: permission, 16 kHz mono contract and stop rules Permission is not format readiness, and internal 16 kHz is not hardware certification Native capture has its own microphone request and authorization check at start. The recognition interface uses bounded 16 kHz mono PCM. Actual system input and the internal contract remain distinct; conversion/start can fail. No user downgrade-sampling switch is provided here, and permission, pairing or downloaded models do not establish complete capture success. Different from input diagnosis and in-progress recovery Diagnosis locates a failure; recovery describes events during recording. Here before adopting an accessory, identify prerequisites and reject unsafe compatibility shortcuts . This page requests no permission, changes no audio configuration and records nothing. Permission and sample-contract checks Layer Existing contract Check Do not bypass failure by Native permission Separate request and start-time authorization check Actual system state/app messages Ignoring refusal or treating prior consent as permanent Page capture Separate site/system conditions Distinguish web capture from native entry point Treating playback/login as native authorization Accessory input Actual route/input format Inspect input, not just paired name Assuming every headset/adapter works Internal audio Bounded 16 kHz mono PCM recognition input Existing pipeline successfully prepared/converted Treating arbitrary raw bytes as valid PCM Changed format Short speech compares rate, channels, commonFormat and interleaving Follow actual-path mismatch handling Forcing an unsafe converter to remain in use Recognition settings Actual model sampling/decoder option scope Real version’s available settings Invented 8 kHz fallback or arbitrary temperature/beam control Model/resources Verified compatible model, storage and permission differ Preserve the missing prerequisite Audio exists, therefore model verification can be skipped Final text/handoff Partial/final results and destination guards differ Existing final-result/eligibility boundaries Delivering unfinished partials or format failures 16 kHz is an internal contract, not device certification, sound-quality ranking, accuracy or bandwidth SLA. The system can supply a different input format which the implementation must successfully handle. No universal converter/all-input guarantee is offered. A synthetic readiness record Known: Actual system microphone permission checked. Unknown: Can this accessory format enter the existing capture pipeline? Model: Confirm separately for the actual app version. Decision: No business recording until format readiness is known; no sample-rate/guard bypass. On permission/format/start errors, keep a minimal non-sensitive category and version, then stop the affected step. Do not publicly reproduce with customer conversations, unique device IDs or repeated system-setting changes. Compatibility is not implicit authority expansion Missing accessory readiness does not authorize starting capture on another input. Missing local models does not authorize an unapproved cloud recognizer. Web failure does not authorize sharing text with a new service. Alternative input/service/destination choices require the existing user-choice/authorization process, not an inferred compatibility exception. Prior capture/handoff attempts keep their state and one-handoff markers. Restored permission or another device does not prove the earlier action did not occur. Preserve in-progress recovery/uncertain-stop boundaries without automatic rerecording/resending. FAQ Is system permission enough for any accessory recording? No. Route, format, pipeline, model and safe environment remain separate. Authorization does not establish audio or recognized text. Does a page's microphone access transfer to native capture? Do not infer that. Page/system/native entry points have checks; playback/login/page permission does not replace native authorization or target guards. Can I choose 8 kHz to bypass a 16 kHz pipeline failure? No such user switch is asserted. Follow actual fixed sampling/conversion contracts instead of bypassing mismatches as a downgrade. Does non-16-kHz hardware always fail or always convert? Neither absolute statement follows. Actual-version pipeline handling must succeed. One number is not a full format matrix. Can visible partial text be delivered as final? No. Interface partials are replaceable intermediate strings. Only the returned final enters original delivery boundaries, still subject to target/permission checks. Does local failure authorize cloud ASR or another microphone? Not by default. Alternatives can change data/permission scope and need separate authorization. This page adds no automatic fallback. Reading and source Input diagnosis · Recovery matrix · Fallback permission · Accessory preflight · Start · Privacy Evidence: permission/format checks , capture/recognition/partial interface , current settings explanation .

### 跨批次改版材料怎样归档？原始引用、消费者版本与评审链核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/batch-change-record-retention/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 跨批次改版材料怎样归档？原始引用、消费者版本与评审链核对 归档的是可复核的对应关系，不用新写的摘要冒充原始批次 完成两批数据比较或格式评审后，团队仍需知道结论针对哪两份原材料、哪个消费者版本和什么确认范围。本文只指导在已有获准工具中人工记录这些关系，不声称一呼有完整快照版本库、迁移记录或不可篡改审计链。现有缓存与回复历史各有边界，不能被改称所有批次的永久档案。 与比较、审计和保留规则的分工 批次比较决定两份是否可比、字段怎么变；格式评审核兼容；交接审计核完成主张；这里专门核 已形成结论与被归档前后材料、消费者和确认依据是否对应 。它不重做业务判断、不创建新批准，也不为团队编造保留期限。 变更材料归档链表 人工记录项 需要对应的已有材料 缺失/混淆风险 处理边界 raw_batch_before 获准的旧批次原引用及范围 用事后摘要冒充原输入 原材料不可得就标缺口，不重建假原件 raw_batch_after 获准的新批次原引用及范围 文件名覆盖、来源或权限变化 先核同源/范围，不靠名称关联 producer_revision 若实际流程提供的生产者版本 写v2就推定存在协商协议 仅记录已知版本，未知不补造 consumer_revision 真正评审的App/模型版本依据 用未来或其他版本结果代替 绑定当前已核版本和范围 comparison_rule 集合、字段、时间和类型比较口径 混全任务/子集或秒/毫秒 规则写清；不要称为所有场景兼容 review_scope 哪些字段/内容已核及未核 只核几项却标全量通过 只保留实际范围与未知 decision_reference 原确认/批准与允许动作 归档说明被当作批准本身 文字说明不授予写权或执行许可 archive_access 既有位置、可读角色与保留规则 公开私有材料或留多余副本 按已有权限最小化，不自行建服务 上面的字段都是人工编辑标签，不是Radar导入格式或App归档API。若已有工具生成文件摘要，摘要值只能用于对应字节的完整性核对；它不能独自证明来源可信、内容真实或评审获批。本页没有内置计算/签署功能。 一份合成的变更材料记录 旧引用：样例批次A，原材料范围未核。 新引用：样例批次B，原材料范围未核。 消费者：仅能确认是待评审版本，不能引用其他版本结果。 评审结论：材料不足，不能给出兼容/增删结论。 归档说明：保留缺口及原引用线索，不制造补写原件、不执行迁移。 样例不含真实任务、账号或私有地址，不是运行后的迁移日志。缺旧批次时，不能用当前批次复制改日期来补齐“历史”；那会破坏结论与输入的关系。复制或整理日期同样不替代 date_str 的源读取含义。 复核前后材料与决定 先核访问权限，再读取最少必要原材料；检查评审规则是否仍对应相同集合与消费者。若中途改过字段或版本，应保留事实变化与重新评审范围，不能让后来文件覆盖早先证据却仍引用旧结论。 批准只支持其明确范围，归档包齐全也不触发自动回写、合并或发布。若结论涉及一次真实交接，继续沿原请求/回执检查；新材料版本不抹去旧操作的不确定性。文档、源数据和副本的保留/删除按实际授权流程处理，本页不提供恢复保证或法律认证。 FAQ 一呼会自动保存全部批次和版本变更历史吗？ 本页不声明这种能力。现有缓存/回复历史不是全量快照版本库，人工归档关系由已有获准工具维护。 旧文件丢失能复制新文件改日期当旧批次吗？ 不应这样做。应标明缺口，不能制造原始证据或用编辑时间替代来源读取时间。 两份文件hash一致就能证明都可信且已批准吗？ 不能。相同摘要至多支持相应字节身份，可信来源、业务真实性、审批与权限另需依据。 换了App版本可以直接沿用旧兼容结论吗？ 不能无条件沿用。核目标消费者与原评审范围，发生变化时由已有流程决定需要哪些重新验证。 材料都归档了就可以执行所有变更吗？ 不可以。归档、评审通过与具体操作批准不同；写权限、手机确认与回执等原门不因资料齐全而取消。 本表能规定统一保留或保证可恢复吗？ 不能。按实际团队规则、目的地与权限核保留/删除，本文不新增备份、恢复或合规服务。 相关指南与依据 两批数据比较 · 格式兼容评审 · 交接完成审计 · 跨时区时间 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 来源缓存边界 、 README回复历史与授权 。人工字段与归档关系是本文建议，不冒充原生功能。

### Retain batch-change review evidence: originals, consumer version and decision scope

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/batch-change-record-retention/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Retain batch-change review evidence: originals, consumer version and decision scope Retain a reviewable relationship, not a new summary pretending to be an original batch After comparing exports or formats, a team still needs to identify the original materials, consumer version and confirmed scope behind its conclusion. Record these relationships in existing authorized tools. Yihu supplies no complete snapshot version store, migration ledger or immutable audit chain here. Existing cache/reply history has its own limits, not permanent archives of every batch. Different from comparison, claim review and retention policy Batch review checks comparability/values; format review checks compatibility; handoff review checks completion claims. Here an existing conclusion must match its archived before/after material, consumer and confirmation evidence . It does not redo the business decision, create approval or prescribe retention periods. Change-material retention mapping Editorial record Existing material referenced Missing/confused risk Boundary raw_batch_before Authorized original older batch/scope Retrospective summary presented as input Mark unavailable, not recreate a false original raw_batch_after Authorized newer batch/scope Overwritten filename or changed source/permission Verify scope/identity, not matching names alone producer_revision Version actually supplied by the workflow v2 text assumed to negotiate a protocol Record known facts; unknown stays unknown consumer_revision App/model version actually reviewed Future/other consumer results substituted Bind to reviewed version/scope comparison_rule Collection, fields, time and type rules Ledger/subset or seconds/milliseconds mixed State rules, not universal compatibility review_scope Reviewed/unreviewed fields and content Few checks labeled full acceptance Retain actual scope and gaps decision_reference Original confirmation/approved action Archive prose treated as approval itself Notes grant no writes or execution archive_access Existing location, readers and retention policy Private disclosure or unnecessary copies Existing minimum permissions, no new service provisioning These are editorial labels, not Radar imports or an app archive API. If an existing tool supplies a digest, it supports byte-integrity checks only. It does not independently establish trusted origin, truth or approval. No hashing/signing feature is implemented here. A synthetic change-material record Before: Sample batch A, original scope unreviewed. After: Sample batch B, original scope unreviewed. Consumer: Intended review version only; no substitution of another version's results. Conclusion: Insufficient material for compatibility/add/remove claims. Retention note: Preserve gaps/references; fabricate no original and perform no migration. This is neither real data/credentials/private URLs nor an executed migration log. Do not copy a current batch and change its date to reconstruct missing history. That breaks the conclusion-input relationship. Copy/edit time does not replace source-read date_str either. Review materials against decisions Check access first, then inspect minimal originals and whether rules still concern the same collection/consumer. If fields/versions changed during review, preserve the change and revised scope; do not overwrite evidence while continuing to cite an earlier conclusion. Approval supports its explicit scope, not automatic writeback, merging or deployment when a package is complete. Real handoffs retain original request/receipt checks; a new material revision does not erase uncertain prior operations. Actual policies govern documents/data/copies, without recovery guarantees or legal certification here. FAQ Does Yihu retain every batch/version change automatically? No such feature is asserted. Existing cache/history is not a full snapshot store. Authorized tools maintain the suggested manual relationships. Can a missing old file be recreated by changing the new file's date? Do not fabricate originals that way. Mark the gap; editing time cannot replace source reading or recreate evidence. Do matching hashes prove trusted and approved contents? No. They support corresponding byte identity at most. Origin, business truth, approval and permission need separate evidence. Can a new app version reuse an old compatibility conclusion? Not unconditionally. Compare the intended consumer and scope; use the existing process to decide necessary revalidation. Does archiving all material authorize every change? No. Retention, review and operation approval differ. Write permission, phone confirmation and receipts remain. Does this prescribe one retention period or guaranteed recovery? No. Actual team/destination policies and permissions govern retention/deletion. No backup, restore or compliance service is added. Reading and evidence Batch comparison · Format compatibility · Handoff claims · Timezone checks · Start · Privacy Evidence: source/cache scope , README reply history/authority . Editorial fields/relationships are suggestions, not native features.

### 空字段与默认显示怎样核？别把“待补”占位写回笔记或Radar源

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/empty-field-display-defaults/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 空字段与默认显示怎样核？别把“待补”占位写回笔记或Radar源 “待补”可能只是界面说明，不是来源已经提供的业务值 一呼的任务卡片会在部分字段为空时显示“任务状态未提供”“优先级待补”“下一步待补”等提示。这些显示分支不表示源码把原字段改成默认业务状态、优先级或下一步。校验时先区分原值与渲染结果，不能为了让界面完整而把未知回填成已确认事实；本文不提供默认值修复器或自动补全源数据。 与JSON类型校验的区别 JSON指南核缺失、null和类型；这里进一步核 通过读取后的占位、兜底排序与权限条件有没有被误当源内容 。它不重讲完整数据契约，不自动修改字段，也不把空字符串一律等同所有空白字符。 空字段、占位与默认处理表 位置 当前消费者行为/边界 人工核查 不能回填/推断 必填身份/标题 decode另核非空project/title等条件 原字段是否存在、类型与非空条件 自动“未命名任务”就可替代有效源 status显示 任务卡片空白状态可显示未提供 显示说明与源status分开 未提供等于待办、完成或已批准 priority显示 nil/空串可显示优先级待补 真正源值与显示标签 把待补写成P2或自动默认优先级 next显示 任务卡片可对去首尾空白后的空串显示待补 原文、具体控件与已知缺口 自动生成执行动作或负责人 session/evidence等 部分缺项显示待补/未提供 源中是否真的有同样字样 占位证明负责会话/证据已存在 排序兜底 未知优先级有比较规则 排序结果不是源字段赋值 排在后面就代表来源设了低优先级 reply_supported 明确true才满足该能力条件 未知和显式false语义分开 按钮不可用就把原值统一写false 空笔记原文 handOff入口拒绝空transcript 原文与界面提示分开 用提示文字冒充转写或自动消除缺口 不同控件是否去首尾空白按各处实现判断，并不统一；不要从一个卡片分支推广成所有字段的清洗规则。界面显示相近也不证明来源层相同。 占位与真实字符串的合成例子 材料A：evidence为null，卡片用“待补”说明缺口。 材料B：evidence为字面字符串“待补”，来源真的写了这个文本。 核查：两者都不足以证明业务证据已提供，但来源值不同。 处理：保留区别，不把占位截图当原始字段，不自动改写真实数据。 这个例子不是完整Radar快照，也不调用实际解码。若要确认字段，应在已有权限范围核原材料；本页不新增原始数据查看器或让私有来源公开。 不用默认值扩大结论 人工整理时可以把“未知”作为说明，但须标明这是编辑标签，不是源字段已更新。来源身份、必填校验与回复能力失败时，不通过填当前时间、空数组或常见优先级来绕过实际条件。 “暂无文字”不等于会议没有发生，“没有匹配任务”不等于任务全部完成，“待补”也不等于后台会自动补齐。只记录实际材料与未知，不因占位或排序产生新业务判断、动作授权或重发资格。 FAQ 界面显示优先级待补，源里就保存了“待补”吗？ 不一定。可能只是显示分支，需要核原字段；不能把截图标签当源数据值。 缺标题可以补个未命名让快照通过吗？ 不应擅自造值。当前消费者有非空身份/标题等要求，应回真实来源维护流程，不用默认名冒充有效原件。 空串、空白字符和缺失在所有位置都相同吗？ 不是。具体解析/控件的条件可能不同，本页不提供统一清洗或把所有空白自动归一的保证。 按钮不可用是否证明reply_supported显式为false？ 不能。未知能力、其他权限/来源条件也会影响可用性。原值和界面结论应分账，不自动回写false。 按默认顺序排后面就能填低优先级吗？ 不能。兜底比较规则不是修改来源优先级，更不是业务紧急程度结论。 空笔记能把“暂无文字”当转写交接吗？ 不应这样做。提示不是原文，既有入口与一次交接守卫不因填占位而取消；真实内容缺口须保留。 相关指南与源码 JSON类型与空值 · 摘要句子溯源 · 跨端显示范围 · 笔记一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 任务卡片占位 、 解码与排序 、 笔记空原文守卫 。

### Empty fields and display defaults: placeholders must not become source values

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/empty-field-display-defaults/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Empty fields and display defaults: placeholders must not become source values A missing-value label may be UI explanation, not supplied business data Some task-card branches display status not provided, priority pending or next step pending when fields are empty. These branches do not mean source fields were assigned a default business state, priority or action. Separate raw values from rendering. Do not fill unknowns with confirmed facts to complete a screen. No default-value fixer or source autocompletion is added. Different from JSON type validation JSON guidance checks missing/null/types. Here rendering, fallback ordering and capability conditions can be mistaken for source contents . This is not another full schema guide, field editor or blanket equivalence between empty strings and all whitespace. Empty values, placeholders and fallbacks Location Existing consumer behavior/boundary Review Do not fill/infer Required identity/title Decode checks nonempty project/title and other conditions Presence, type and nonempty rules Untitled automatically replaces valid source data status rendering Blank task-card state can display not provided Label versus raw status Missing means planned, done or approved priority rendering nil/empty can display pending priority Actual value versus label Replace with P2/default business priority next rendering Task card can show pending after trimming empty text Original, specific control and known gap Invent action or owner session/evidence Some missing values display pending/not provided Whether the source supplied those words literally Label establishes an owner session or evidence Sort fallback Unknown priorities have ordering rules Order is not a field assignment Low position means source assigned low urgency reply_supported Explicit true required for this capability condition Unknown differs from explicit false Disabled UI means rewrite all missing values as false Empty note transcript handOff rejects an empty transcript Original versus UI message Pass a placeholder as transcription or silently remove gaps Trimming depends on each implementation/control; it is not uniform. Do not generalize one card’s condition into universal cleansing. Similar displays do not establish identical raw values. Synthetic placeholder versus literal text A: evidence is null; the card displays a pending label. B: evidence is literally the pending-label string supplied by the source. Review: Neither establishes actual business evidence, but source values differ. Decision: Preserve the distinction; a placeholder screenshot is not the original field. Rewrite no live data. This is not a complete snapshot or actual decoder run. Inspect originals only with existing authorization; no raw-data viewer or public private-source access is added. Defaults must not expand conclusions An editor can label unknowns but must not claim source updates. Identity/required-field/capability failures cannot be bypassed by filling now, empty arrays or familiar priorities. No text does not prove no meeting occurred. No matching tasks does not prove all tasks completed. A pending label does not promise automatic completion. Retain actual facts/unknowns without deriving business status, authority or resend eligibility from placeholders/order. FAQ Does priority pending mean the source saved that string? Not necessarily. Inspect the original field rather than treating screenshot labels as raw values. Can an untitled default make a missing title valid? Do not fabricate values. The consumer has nonempty identity/title conditions; use the real source-maintenance process. Are empty, whitespace and missing identical everywhere? No. Parser/control conditions differ. No universal normalization or cleansing guarantee is supplied. Does disabled UI prove reply_supported is explicitly false? No. Unknown capability and other permission/source conditions affect availability. Preserve raw value versus UI outcome without writing false. Can fallback ordering justify filling low priority? No. Ordering does not modify source priority or establish business urgency. Can no-text placeholder text be handed off as transcription? Do not do so. Messages are not originals; entry/one-handoff guards remain. Preserve the actual content gap. Reading and source JSON types/nulls · Summary provenance · Cross-device display · One note handoff · Start · Privacy Evidence: task-card placeholders , decode/sorting , empty-transcript guard .

### 后台切回前台后先核什么？短语音请求失效、转写恢复与目标重检

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/foreground-audio-rebind-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 后台切回前台后先核什么？短语音请求失效、转写恢复与目标重检 回到前台是状态事件，不是录音、音频重绑或交接成功回执 一呼当前前台回调会进入短语音准备检查，并恢复既有笔记转写；离开活动状态会走相应取消/暂停逻辑。权限弹窗造成的 inactive 与真正 background 不能混为一谈。本页的“重绑前检”是人工重新核状态、路由和目标，不是App承诺所有音频会话自动无缝续上。 与录后音频恢复和格式前检的分工 音频恢复矩阵核路由/引擎通知，权限采样指南核授权和输入格式；这里核 生命周期切换后旧请求是否仍有效、回来后哪些工作可能继续 。它不要求改系统设置、不执行录音，也不新增后台常驻推理或强制重绑开关。 前台返回检查表 事件/状态 当前实现边界 返回前台时核什么 不可推断 准备中权限弹窗 非background且正在请求权限的preparing有特例 仍有效的请求、实际许可与当前相位 每次inactive都已取消，或每次回来都全新录音 真正background 短语音会使可取消请求失效，包括迟到许可结果 旧请求不能被当作新授权会话 迟到granted自动恢复被取消那次录音 普通离开活动状态 短语音走原取消路径，受可取消状态约束 已取消、已完成、仍有待核内容分别看 取消能撤回此前已写入或服务端动作 applicationDidBecomeActive 检查准备状态并可预热模型 UI实际阶段与是否存在有效准备请求 回调本身证明已采集或已识别 笔记转写暂停/恢复 shell离开活动态暂停转写，活动态恢复 待处理文字、错误与实际笔记状态 模型后台持续推理，或所有录音不中断 输入/音频管线 系统路由可能与离开前不同 按权限/格式与恢复指南核现状 所有外设会话已自动无缝重绑 页面/草稿目标 仍有现有插入和目标守卫 当前工作台、页面、草稿与许可 回到同一外观就自动恢复Agent记忆或可重发 既有交接结果 保留一次标记与不确定停止边界 目标内容、已尝试状态和回执 切前台清空旧副作用或允许盲重试 短语音请求在取消路径通过更新会话标识、清理待处理任务等失效；不等于抹除已发生的结果。长笔记的转写恢复与实时音频采集不是同一状态机，不能把一个回调推广成所有录音路径的锁屏连续性保证。 返回后的合成核查 离开前：短语音正在等待权限，尚无最终结果。 中间：实际进入background，旧请求失效。 回来后：即使系统显示granted，也先核当前状态，不把迟到许可接到旧请求。 下一步：沿现有入口作明确用户选择；核目标与旧内容，不自动重录或重发。 这不是实际系统弹窗或设备回归结果。另一个只产生inactive的权限弹窗分支可能保留准备请求；必须识别事件，不能凭“画面回来”判断到底走过哪条路径。 不以重绑名义跳过已有条件 当前路由、格式、模型和目标仍按既有条件核。不为了让旧录音看似继续而任意复用转换器、忽略错误或改走云服务；也不通过替换草稿/文件名消除一次标记。 若界面与内容不确定，停在原范围核现有证据。本页未做锁屏、来电、外设或系统版本矩阵测试，不给零丢失、无延迟或后台续录保证。 FAQ inactive一定等于真正进入后台吗？ 不是。权限弹窗等可能使场景inactive，准备中请求许可存在特例；应按实际事件和相位区分。 后台后迟到的granted会复活旧请求吗？ 当前短语音逻辑使真正后台的可取消请求失效，不能把迟到许可当作恢复旧次录音的依据。 resumeTranscription是否等于麦克风继续采集？ 不是。笔记转写、音频采集与目标交接是不同状态，本页不把方法名当所有路径连续录音保证。 回调进入active是否证明模型已经识别成功？ 不证明。准备检查/预热与实际最终文字不同，要核真实状态与错误，不从回调推断结果。 这里有强制无缝重绑或锁屏续录开关吗？ 没有新增。本文只是重新核状态与绑定条件，不承诺所有外设和系统版本无缝恢复。 切前台能清空旧交接，让我放心重试吗？ 不能。旧尝试和可能副作用仍需核对，一次标记与不确定停止规则不因生命周期变化取消。 相关指南与源码 录后恢复矩阵 · 权限与采样契约 · 追问目标与上下文 · 交接完成审计 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 短语音生命周期与取消 、 shell前后台转写分支 、 原目标守卫 。

### Returning to foreground: request invalidation, transcription resume and target review

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/foreground-audio-rebind-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Returning to foreground: request invalidation, transcription resume and target review Foreground is a state event, not capture, audio-rebind or delivery confirmation The current foreground callback enters short-speech readiness checks and resumes existing note transcription. Leaving the active state follows cancellation/pause logic. A permission dialog’s inactive differs from true background . Rebind preflight here means manual state/route/target review, not a promise that every audio session seamlessly resumes. Different from audio recovery and format preflight Recovery concerns route/engine notifications; permission/sample review concerns authorization and format. Here after lifecycle changes, which request remains valid and which work can continue is the task. No setting change, recording, background inference daemon or forced-rebind switch is supplied. Foreground-return checks Event/state Current implementation boundary Review on return Does not establish Preparing permission dialog Exception when not background, preparing and requesting permission Valid request, actual consent and phase Every inactive cancels, or every return is a new recording True background Invalidates cancellable short-speech requests, including late permission responses Old request is not a newly authorized session Late granted revives the canceled capture Other inactive transition Original short-speech cancellation, subject to cancellable state Canceled, complete and unresolved content separately Cancellation recalls prior insertion/server effects applicationDidBecomeActive Readiness check and possible idle model warm-up Actual UI phase and valid pending preparation Callback establishes capture/recognition success Note transcription pause/resume Shell pauses outside active, resumes when active Pending text, errors and actual note state Background model inference or uninterrupted audio everywhere Audio input/pipeline System route may have changed Current permission/format/recovery conditions Every accessory session seamlessly rebound Page/draft target Existing insertion/target guards remain Workbench, page, draft and authority Same-looking view restores Agent memory or resend eligibility Existing handoff One-handoff and uncertain-stop boundaries remain Target content, attempted state and receipts Foreground clears prior effects or permits blind retry Cancellation invalidates short-speech work through session identity/task cleanup; it does not erase effects already committed. Note transcription and live capture are different state machines. One callback cannot establish lock-screen continuity for all paths. Synthetic return review Before: Short speech awaiting permission, no final result. Transition: True background invalidates the old request. Return: Even with system granted, inspect current state; do not attach late consent to old work. Next: Explicit choice through the existing entry point; check target/prior content, no automatic rerecord/resend. This is not a real permission dialog or device regression result. A dialog causing inactive only can preserve pending preparation. Identify the event rather than assuming a returned screen reveals the path. Rebinding cannot bypass conditions Current route, format, model and destination retain existing checks. Do not force old converters, ignore failures or adopt a cloud service to make old recording appear continuous. Renaming/replacing drafts does not erase reservations. When state/content is uncertain, stop within original scope and inspect evidence. No lock-screen/call/accessory/OS matrix was tested, and no zero-loss, latency or background-continuity guarantee is supplied. FAQ Does inactive always mean true background? No. Permission dialogs can cause inactive; preparing permission requests have an exception. Identify actual event and phase. Can late granted after background revive an old request? Current short-speech logic invalidates cancellable work on true background. Late permission is not evidence the canceled capture resumes. Does resumeTranscription mean microphone capture continues? No. Transcription, audio capture and handoff differ. A method name does not guarantee continuous recording across every path. Does active prove model recognition completed? No. Readiness/warm-up is not returned final text. Inspect actual state and errors rather than inferring results from callbacks. Is there a forced seamless-rebind or lock-screen recording switch? None is added. This is state/binding preflight, not universal device/OS recovery evidence. Does foreground clear handoff history so retry is safe? No. Prior attempts/effects still need review. Lifecycle transitions do not cancel one-handoff/uncertainty rules. ### 多角色审批与签收交接清单：内容通过、手机确认和接收反馈不能代签

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/multi-role-approval-receipt-checklist/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 多角色审批与签收交接清单：内容通过、手机确认和接收反馈不能代签 多人参与不等于权限可以串联：每个确认只证明自己的明确范围 语音笔记或Radar简报可能经过录文人、审核人、操作人和接收方，但一个角色“看过/同意”不能替代另一个角色的权限、手机确认或接收反馈。一呼是工作台壳与来源呈现，不是多角色审批/电子签名引擎。本页提供人工清单，不自动建立组织角色、委托关系或服务端权限。 与认领、完成审计的区别 认领指南核谁负责材料，交接审计核动作是否有完成证据；这里核 不同角色的确认是否被越权代用、确认的内容版本与动作范围是否一致 。它不把责任表变成执行授权，也不靠转述制造签收。 多角色确认边界表 人工角色/确认 只能说明的范围 仍须独立核对 不能替代 录文核对人 某版原词/修订范围已核 原文、未知和是否遗漏 内容审批、接收方同意或实际发送 内容审核人 明确版本与字段符合其审核范围 是否包含附件、目标和条件 服务端写权限或手机端操作确认 审批决定人 已有流程下允许的具体动作 身份依据、有效范围和变更后是否仍适用 任意后续动作、自动委托或代签 笔记交接操作人 既有预览/暂存/交接入口的实际选择 原文和一次标记、目标与结果 收件方读完或业务处理完成 Radar回复手机确认人 原生回复流程中当前目标与确认 源新鲜度、能力、eligible/epoch等原守卫 来源审批流、他人权限或服务端完成 接收方反馈 真实反馈所明确说明的内容 原请求/回复与引用关系 无引用的转述、自动已读或全部处理 归档维护人 既有权限下保存哪些材料 最小化、可读范围与保留规则 批准原动作或追认未授权操作 尚未确认的角色 未知仍未知 在原获准渠道取得明确依据 因其他人通过而自动勾选全部 这些是编辑角色，不是App中的组织权限设置。笔记暂存和Radar原生回复是不同入口，不能把其中一种确认机制推广成所有路径都一样，也不能据此声明有密码学签名或法定签收。 合成确认记录 内容版本：样例稿A，含一份合成附件说明。 内容审核：角色A只核正文；附件和目标未核。 操作许可：未知；不由“正文通过”推定。 接收确认：未知；不由“已暂存”推定。 下一步：保留各自缺口，不代他人勾选，不发送或补造回执。 人工可记录 approval_reference、content_scope、actor_role、recipient_confirmation 和 remaining_unknowns，但它们只是清单标签，不是导入JSON、授权参数或原生审批API。公开样例不用真实姓名、联系方式、私有任务或服务令牌。 看清反馈关联，不制造已读/已处理 当前来源回复历史只按明确引用关联后续update与先前reply，不能从“有一条历史”“有人提到任务”推断某个人已读、同意或处理完毕。即使关联存在，也要看反馈实际内容与范围，不把它当通用签收证书。 版本或目的地变更可能超出原确认范围，应回已有流程核，而不是复制旧“同意”给新材料。一次交接标记、目标守卫与不确定停止继续有效；多一个角色签字样文字不消除旧副作用或开新服务权限。 FAQ 一呼内置多级审批与组织角色分配吗？ 本文不声明这类功能。角色和清单是人工建议，不创建审批流、账户权限或委托关系。 内容审核通过是否默认允许实际发送？ 不默认。版本、附件、目的地、具体操作许可和原有守卫仍需核，内容通过不代替执行授权。 另一角色说“替我签了”就能代手机确认吗？ 不能据转述绕过原确认/身份/能力检查。是否有合法委托须由已有流程提供依据，本页不建立代签能力。 历史里出现反馈就代表接收方已读并处理吗？ 不能。先核明确引用与实际内容，来源关联也不是自动已读、处理或所有角色签收证明。 改正文或附件后能沿用旧审批吗？ 只能按原明确范围判断，不自动沿用；变更超出范围时回原流程核，不能为方便复制批准。 这份表勾满就构成电子签名或法律签收吗？ 不构成本文保证。没有新签署/认证机制，清单不替代实际身份、权限、服务回执或适用规则。 相关指南与源码 认领与归档 · 交接完成审计 · 降级许可 · 变更材料归档 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 原生回复确认守卫 、 历史明确引用关联 、 笔记交接 。

### Multi-role handoff: content approval, phone confirmation and recipient feedback differ

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/multi-role-approval-receipt-checklist/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Multi-role handoff: content approval, phone confirmation and recipient feedback differ Multiple participants do not combine into authority; each confirmation has its own scope A note/brief can involve a transcriber, reviewer, operator and recipient. One person’s seen/approved does not replace another’s permission, phone confirmation or feedback. Yihu is a workbench shell/source presentation, not a multi-role approval or electronic-signature engine. This manual checklist creates no organization roles, delegation or server permissions. Different from ownership and completion review Ownership concerns responsibility; handoff review concerns completed-action evidence. Here one role’s confirmation must not substitute for another’s, and version/action scopes must match . A responsibility table is not authority, and reported speech is not a fabricated receipt. Role-specific confirmation checklist Editorial role/confirmation Establishes only Still review Does not replace Transcript reviewer Reviewed original/corrections for a stated version Gaps, originals and omissions Approval, recipient consent or actual sending Content reviewer Specified fields/version within review scope Attachment, destination and conditions Server writes or phone operation confirmation Approving decision-maker Particular action allowed by existing process Identity evidence, scope and revision applicability All future actions, delegation or proxy signatures Note handoff operator Actual choice at existing preview/staging/handoff entry Text, reservation, target and result Recipient reading or business completion Radar phone confirmer Current target/confirmation in native reply flow Fresh source, capability, eligible/epoch and original guards Workflow approval, another identity or server completion Recipient feedback Exactly what authentic feedback states Original request/reply and explicit references Unlinked hearsay, automatic read status or full handling Archive maintainer Materials retained within existing permission Minimization, readers and retention rules Approving or retroactively authorizing the action Unconfirmed role Unknown remains unknown Explicit evidence in original authorized channel Checking every role because someone else approved These are editorial roles, not organization-permission settings. Note staging and native Radar reply are different entry points; one confirmation mechanism is not universal, cryptographic signing or legal receipt. Synthetic confirmation record Content: Sample draft A, with a synthetic attachment description. Review: Role A checked body only; attachment/destination unchecked. Operation authority: Unknown, not inferred from approved prose. Recipient confirmation: Unknown, not inferred from staged. Next: Keep separate gaps; no proxy boxes, sending or fabricated receipts. Manual approval_reference, content_scope, actor_role, recipient_confirmation and remaining_unknowns are checklist labels, not JSON imports, authorization parameters or a native approval API. Public examples use no real names, contact details, private tasks or tokens. Feedback association is not read/handled status Source reply history links later updates to replies through explicit references. A history entry or mention alone does not establish a person’s reading, consent or completion. Even a valid association needs actual feedback/scope review, not a universal receipt certificate. Version/destination changes can exceed prior confirmation. Recheck through the existing process instead of copying approved to new material. Reservations, target guards and uncertain-stop rules remain; another signature-like string does not erase effects or provision permissions. FAQ Does Yihu include multi-level approval/organization role assignment? No such feature is asserted. These are editorial roles/checklists, not provisioned workflows, permissions or delegation. Does content approval authorize sending by default? No. Version, attachments, destination, actual operation authority and guards remain separate from prose approval. Can someone saying sign for me replace phone confirmation? Do not bypass identity/capability/confirmation from hearsay. Existing processes must establish any delegation; no proxy feature is added. Does feedback history prove recipient read and handled everything? No. Verify explicit references and actual contents. Association is not automatic reading, completion or every role’s receipt. Can old approval carry over after text/attachment changes? Only explicit scope can answer. Recheck out-of-scope changes rather than copying prior approval for convenience. Does checking every box create electronic signing/legal receipt? No guarantee follows. No signing/certification mechanism is added; real identity, permissions, receipts and applicable rules remain. Reading and source Ownership/archive · Completion review · Fallback authority · Change-material retention · Start · Privacy Evidence: native reply confirmation guards , explicit history association , note handoff .

### 批量分享前怎样逐条核？混合文字、链接与附件的阶段边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/share-batch-item-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 批量分享前怎样逐条核？混合文字、链接与附件的阶段边界 批次是暂存容器，不是每条已校验或全有全无发送的证明 一呼共享托盘可以暂存多个批次及文字、链接、文件，条目总数只是数量。现有填入逻辑先处理文件，成功后更新/移除相应暂存项，再填入非文件文字；遇错可以停在某个阶段。因此逐条核内容、类型、权限和目标，不能把一次“填入”说成所有条目业务通过、事务提交或消息批量发送。 与多笔记review和完成审计的区别 多笔记指南核原文/修订与顺序，完成审计核最终主张；这里核 混合批次内各条目的类型和已经到达的阶段是否一致 。本文不执行分享，不新增批量发送/审批、逐条扫描器或全局回滚服务。 批次中的单条核查表 单条/阶段 现有边界 应逐条核什么 不能用什么替代 批次总数 itemCount累计暂存条目 数量之外的原文、类型与必要性 有N条就表示N条都已验证 文字条目 非文件文字最终按换行连接后填入 原意、顺序、来源与指令边界 连接后还有完整结构化单条语义 链接条目 仍要核实际目标和暴露范围 来源、路径/查询与获准目的地 链接可点就证明可信/已脱敏 文件条目 页面自有上传控件另处理 每份附件内容、类型与已有副本 文字审核通过等于附件也通过 文件先行成功 对应暂存项更新/移除，再处理文字 文件可能已在目标服务侧 后续文字失败就等于文件没上传 多文件入口限制 页面可返回一次仅支持一个文件等结果 实际控件限制与保留条目 所有网页都支持任意批量文件 文字填入失败 可在已有阶段后停止并提示 目标内容与剩余托盘状态 盲目重放整批就没有重复风险 所有暂存项放置后 批次离开托盘不等于发送 草稿、附件和服务实际状态 全有全无事务、业务批准或接收回执 这是现有逐批处理的源码描述，不是所有网站行为都已验收。托盘没有“逐条已经业务审核”的自动证据，界面计数也不能替代对每份材料的人工授权范围核对。 合成批次分阶段记录 条目A：合成文字，目标和内容已核。 条目B：合成附件，内容尚未核。 批次决定：不能因A通过就整体视为可分享；先停下核B。 若已发生文件阶段：先看目标与剩余托盘，不假定失败已撤回全部副作用。 这不是实际上传日志，不调用网页或客户数据。若工具把多个文本拼接成一段，不要把段落分隔当作原始任务ID或服务端批处理协议；原始单条对应关系仍须在既有权限范围保留。 不把单条缺口变成批量重试 先核每条再决定是否采用，不以总数或某条通过替代整体范围。一次仅一文件、缺控件或类型不支持，应按实际入口处理，不猜测隐藏上传能力。 若已经尝试，先检查可能上传的文件、已填文字与还在托盘中的材料；本地剩余数不证明远端没有副本。笔记一次交接与目标守卫继续有效，修订、拆分或换名字都不自动取消旧标记或授予重发权。 FAQ 显示六条是不是六条都核完且可发送？ 不是。计数不包含内容、权限和目标核验，也不是消息发送或业务批准回执。 一次填入整批是否全有全无？ 不能这样说。文件先行、文字后填，出错时可能已有阶段发生，没有新增事务回滚保证。 正文通过能代替附件逐份核查吗？ 不能。每个文件的内容、类型、敏感层与目的地要独立核，不能按正文批准范围自动扩展。 页面只支持一文件时会自动变成任意批量模式吗？ 不会由本文提供。现有路径会提示按实际限制处理，不新增通用批量上传入口。 后续填文字失败是否表示先前文件也没上传？ 不表示。先核目标与托盘状态，不能把局部失败等同所有步骤从未发生。 托盘清空是否说明接收方已读或任务处理完？ 不说明。放置、发送、接收、业务处理不同，需各自真实证据，不能从托盘状态补造结论。 相关指南与源码 多笔记review · 载体脱敏范围 · 交接完成审计 · 多角色确认 · 开始 · 隐私 依据： 托盘条目计数与文件先行流程 、 暂存批次模型 。

### Review every item before sharing a mixed batch of text, links and attachments

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/share-batch-item-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Review every item before sharing a mixed batch of text, links and attachments A batch is a staging container, not per-item validation or atomic delivery The share tray can retain multiple batches containing text, links and files. Its total is a count. Existing placement handles files first, updates/removes their staged items after attachment, then inserts non-file text. Errors can stop at a stage. Review each item’s content, type, authority and destination instead of calling one placement business acceptance, a transaction or bulk message sending. Different from multi-note review and completion auditing Multi-note review concerns originals/edits/order; completion auditing concerns final claims. Here mixed items may have reached different stages . No sharing is performed and no bulk sender, approver, per-item scanner or global rollback service is added. Per-item and stage checks Item/stage Existing boundary Inspect individually Does not establish Total itemCount sums staged items Original, type and necessity beyond the count N items means N validated Text Non-file text joined with newlines before insertion Meaning, order, source and instruction boundaries Structured item semantics survive joining Link Actual target/disclosure scope still matters Source, path/query and authorized destination Clickable means trusted/redacted File Page-owned upload control is separate Every attachment’s content, type and copies Approved prose approves attachments Files attached first Staged file entries updated/removed before text A remote copy may exist Later text failure means no file uploaded Multi-file limit Page can report one file at a time Actual control limits/remaining items Every page supports arbitrary bulk files Text insertion failure Can stop after an earlier stage Destination content and remaining tray Replaying everything is duplicate-free Batch leaves tray Placement is not sending Draft, attachments and actual service state Atomic transaction, business approval or receipt This is source-described sequential handling, not acceptance of every website. Neither tray count nor presence provides automatic content/permission review for each item. Synthetic staged review A: Synthetic text, content/destination reviewed. B: Synthetic attachment, content unreviewed. Decision: A passing does not approve the batch; stop and review B. If file handling already occurred: Inspect destination/remaining tray; failure did not necessarily recall everything. This is not an upload log and uses no page/customer data. Joined paragraphs are not original task IDs or a server bulk protocol. Preserve original item relationships within existing permissions. Gaps do not authorize replaying a batch Review every item before adoption. One-file limits, missing controls or unsupported types require actual-entry handling, not guessed hidden upload support. After an attempt, inspect possible uploads, inserted text and remaining items. Local counts do not prove no remote copy exists. Note reservations and target guards remain; edits, splits or renamed files do not erase markers or authorize resending. FAQ Does six items mean six reviewed and ready to send? No. Count does not establish content, permission, destination, sending or business approval. Is one placement atomic for the whole batch? No such claim follows. Files precede text and earlier stages can occur before an error. No transaction rollback is added. Does prose approval replace reviewing every attachment? No. Each file’s contents, type, sensitive layers and destination need independent review. Does a one-file page automatically gain bulk support? No. Follow actual page restrictions. No universal bulk upload interface is added. Does failed text insertion mean earlier files were never uploaded? No. Inspect target/tray state; a local failure does not undo every prior stage. Does an empty tray mean the recipient read or handled the task? No. Placement, sending, receipt and business handling differ and require their own evidence. Reading and source Multi-note review · Carrier redaction scope · Completion audit · Multi-role confirmation · Start · Privacy Evidence: tray counts/files-first flow , staged batch model .

### 低电量或锁屏后先核什么？保存段、待转写与重录范围

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/interruption-recapture-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 低电量或锁屏后先核什么？保存段、待转写与重录范围 先核已有材料与缺口，再决定是否重录或重新比较 锁屏不等于长笔记一定丢失：现有界面说明锁屏后继续录音，转写在一呼打开时进行；长录音写盘，来电/重置/写入失败有对应中断处理。但这不是所有低电量、关机、存储和外设情形的零丢失保证。先核保存内容、待转写与真实缺口，不能默认从头重录或让模型补造没录到的话。 与前台返回和音频恢复的区别 前台指南核旧请求与生命周期，恢复矩阵核路由/引擎事件；这里在中断后决定 是否有真实内容缺口、重录应限于何处 。本文不调整电源、不清理文件、不执行录音或恢复。 核查项 现有边界 人工核对 不能推断 长笔记锁屏 界面说明可继续录音，前台转写 实际笔记状态与可用内容 所有电量/系统条件都不中断 短语音后台 与长笔记不同，沿原取消条件 旧请求与结果是否仍有效 把长录音说明套给短语音 尚未看到文字 转写与采集分开 已保存音频和待处理状态 没有转写就没有录到 写盘材料 长录音保留此前已写部分 实际文件可用性与缺口 掉电后任何未写缓冲都能恢复 来电/服务重置 有中断与此前保存提示 已保存范围和错误 提示等于全程连续或所有文件已验收 低电量/写入失败 不在本文承诺自动降级 电源、存储和既有材料 自动节电补录或云恢复 重新录制 新的采集仍需权限和安全条件 只覆盖确认的缺口并人工核版本 重复全段就自动合并去重 后续交接 一次标记与目标守卫继续 旧尝试/副作用与真实回执 重录清空旧状态 合成缺口记录 已有：样例段A实际可用；未知：段B是否保存；待转写：不能仅凭无文字判断。决定：先核B，不直接宣布全失，也不拼接虚构过渡语。 这里没有实际录音或低电量实测。若需要重录，明确这是新版本，不覆盖原材料来伪装连续记录；原始顺序与人工说明分别保留。对于未知或已尝试交接的结果，先停止并核对，不重复发送。 FAQ 锁屏是否意味着必须从头重录？ 不是。现有长笔记有锁屏继续录音说明，先核保存/待转写状态；不能推广到所有采集路径。 低电量模式能保证自动降采样保全吗？ 本文不声明这种功能或保证。按实际状态与错误核，不能把电量情形当已做兼容性测试。 没有转写文字是否证明音频没保存？ 不能。转写与保存分开，前台处理状态和可用材料需独立核。 中断提示保存到此前是否代表零丢失？ 不代表所有缓冲或所有条件可恢复；核实际可用范围，保留未知。 可以让模型补上缺失会议原话吗？ 不能把生成内容当原录音。保留缺口，若有新录制应明确新版本与依据。 重录后能自动去重并重发吗？ 没有新增自动合并/去重或重发权限；原交接标记与不确定停止仍有效。 相关指南与源码 前台状态 · 音频恢复 · 片段核对 · 一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 锁屏与转写界面说明 · 写盘与中断 · 笔记状态与交接

<td>重复全段就自动合并去重</td>
</tr>

<td>后续交接</td>
<td>一次标记与目标守卫继续</td>
<td>旧尝试/副作用与真实回执</td>
<td>重录清空旧状态</td>
</tr>

### Low power or screen lock: inspect saved segments before rerecording

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/interruption-recapture-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Low power or screen lock: inspect saved segments before rerecording Check saved material before deciding to record or compare again Screen lock does not establish lost long notes. Existing UI says recording continues while locked and transcription runs with Yihu open. Long capture writes to disk and handles calls, resets and write errors. This is not zero-loss evidence for every power, shutdown, storage or accessory condition. Inspect saved material, pending transcription and actual gaps before rerecording; never fabricate missing words. Different from foreground and route recovery Foreground review checks lifecycle requests; route recovery checks engine events. Here whether a content gap exists and what a new capture should cover is the decision. No power setting, file cleanup, recording or recovery is performed. Check Existing boundary Review Not established Locked long notes UI describes recording continuation, foreground transcription Actual note/content state Uninterrupted under every battery/OS condition Short speech Different cancellation path Prior request/result validity Long-note guarantees apply universally No visible text Transcription differs from capture Saved audio/pending work No transcript means no capture Written material Long capture retains prior writes Usable file and actual gap All unwritten buffers survive power loss Call/service reset Interruption/saved-so-far notices Saved scope and errors Continuous audio or every file certified Low power/write error No automatic downgrade promised here Power/storage/material state Automatic power-saving recapture/cloud restore New capture Permission/safe conditions still apply Confirmed gap and manually labeled version Automatic merging/deduplication Later handoff Original reservations/guards remain Prior effects and receipts Rerecording resets old attempts Synthetic gap note Known: sample segment A is usable. Unknown: whether B was saved. Pending transcription: lack of text cannot decide. Decision: inspect B before declaring complete loss or generating invented transition words. No recording or low-power benchmark ran. Label recapture as a new version, not overwrite originals to imply continuity. Retain order/editorial notes separately. Uncertain prior handoffs require review, not repeated delivery. FAQ Does locking mean rerecord everything? No. Long-note UI describes continued capture; inspect actual saved/pending state without generalizing to every path. Does low-power mode automatically downsample safely? No such feature/guarantee is asserted. Actual state/errors need review; no battery compatibility test is claimed. Does no transcript mean no saved audio? No. Saving and transcription differ; inspect material and foreground processing separately. Does saved-so-far guarantee zero loss? No. It does not establish all-buffer/every-condition recovery. Review actual usable scope. Can a model fill missing meeting quotations? Generated text is not recorded speech. Keep gaps and label any new recording/version. Can recapture automatically deduplicate and resend? No merging/deduplication/resend authority is added. Reservations and uncertainty rules remain. Reading and source Foreground state · Audio recovery · Segment review · One handoff · Start · Privacy Lock/transcription UI · Disk writes/interruptions · Note state/handoff

### 历史归档怎样检索比对？来源分页、正文省略与未命中边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/history-retrieval-manual-comparison/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 历史归档怎样检索比对？来源分页、正文省略与未命中边界 先核已有材料与缺口，再决定是否重录或重新比较 一呼来源回复历史不是本地全量归档搜索引擎。当前历史按目标只读加载，每页至多5项，界面最多加载100条；较长正文可标text_omitted并指向原条目。外部归档的检索由已有获准工具承担。未找到匹配项，不等于原操作、材料或反馈从未存在。 与变更材料归档的分工 变更归档指南核结论对应哪份前后材料；这里核 检索覆盖了哪些位置与内容、命中项怎样人工比对 。不新建搜索索引、归档数据库、备份恢复或全文检索API。 核查项 现有边界 人工核对 不能推断 来源历史 目标与当前源检查后加载 身份、目标与权限 全组织所有任务都在同一个搜索结果 分页 每页至多5项，有游标规则 已加载数、总数与剩余页 第一页就是全部历史 界面上限 最多加载100条 未加载范围与原条目 上限外就不存在记录 正文省略 text_omitted可显示原文较长 回获准原条目核全文 空展示代表原始正文为空 批次/版本 翻页核总量/目标版本等一致性 变化时重新按原入口核 任意时刻的页可拼成稳定全集 外部归档 现有工具与权限另核 搜索位置、日期/版本/别名范围 App有跨账户全量索引 人工比对 按原引用、版本和实际文字 同名不同项、条件与未知 文字相似就代表同一批准或已执行 未命中 可能受权限/省略/加载/范围影响 保留检索范围与缺口 证明从未发生或可安全重试 合成检索记录 位置：样例目标的已加载历史；覆盖：首5条；未核：剩余页与正文省略项；结果：未见匹配，只能报告本范围未命中。 检索词、位置、版本和已核范围可以作为人工标签保留，不是App自动出具的检索证书。不要为了查全文公开私有归档或扩张第三方权限。比对不得把相似文字当签收、把新读取时间当原事件发生时间，或据未命中重新执行不确定操作。 FAQ 历史最多100条是否表示源最多只有100条？ 不是。是界面加载边界，源总量与剩余范围应分开看，未加载不等于不存在。 每页5条是否包含所有任务？ 不是。它是目标历史分页，不是全局任务检索或全量归档快照。 text_omitted的空文字能当原始空正文吗？ 不能。它表示内容省略，需在获准原条目核全文。 能把不同版本的页随意拼起来比对吗？ 不能。现有翻页有一致性校验，手工跨版本材料也应标范围，不冒稳定全集。 搜索未命中能证明之前没发送吗？ 不能。先核检索范围与旧操作证据，不能用未命中绕过一次标记或不确定停止。 一呼提供本地归档全文搜索和恢复吗？ 本文不新增这种能力。外部归档按既有获准工具核，来源历史仍是只读回显。 相关指南与源码 变更材料归档 · 完成证据审计 · 时间口径 · 确认范围 · 开始 · 隐私 历史加载上限与省略提示 · 历史分页与一致性模型

### Retrieve and compare history: pagination, omitted text and no-match boundaries

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/history-retrieval-manual-comparison/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Retrieve and compare history: pagination, omitted text and no-match boundaries Check saved material before deciding to record or compare again Source reply history is not a local full-archive search engine. Current target history loads read-only in pages of at most five; UI loads at most 100 entries. Longer text can be text_omitted with a pointer to the original. Existing authorized tools handle external archives. No match does not establish that an operation, material or feedback never existed. Different from change-material retention Retention maps conclusions to originals. Here retrieval coverage and manual comparison of matches matter. No index, archive database, restore service or full-text API is created. Check Existing boundary Review Not established Source history Target/current-source checks before loading Identity, target and access Global organization/task search Pages Up to five with cursor rules Loaded/total and remaining pages First page is complete UI cap At most 100 loaded Unloaded scope/original entries Nothing exists beyond cap Omitted text text_omitted can indicate longer original Authorized original full text Empty display means empty original Version consistency Paging checks totals/target version Recheck changes through original entry point Arbitrary-time pages form a stable whole External archive Separate authorized tools Locations/date/version/alias coverage App has cross-account global indexing Manual comparison Original references/version/actual text Same names, conditions and unknowns Similar prose means same approval/execution No match Access/omission/loading/scope can limit results Record coverage and gaps Never occurred or safe to retry Synthetic retrieval record Location: loaded history for one sample target. Coverage: first five entries. Unknown: remaining pages/omitted text. Result: no match within this scope only. Query/location/version/coverage are editorial labels, not app-issued search certificates. Do not publish private archives or expand third-party access to find full text. Similar words are not receipts, retrieval time is not event time, and no match cannot justify retrying uncertain operations. FAQ Does a 100-entry cap mean only 100 exist at the source? No. UI loading differs from source total/unloaded scope. Unloaded is not absent. Does a five-entry page include every task? No. It is target history pagination, not global task search or a complete archive. Can empty text with text_omitted be treated as an empty original? No. Content was omitted; inspect the authorized original. Can pages from different versions be freely combined? No. Existing paging checks consistency. Mark cross-version manual material instead of claiming a stable whole. Does no match prove nothing was sent? No. Check coverage/prior evidence; no match bypasses neither reservations nor uncertainty. Does Yihu supply archive full-text search and restore? No such capability is added. External archives use existing authorized tools; source history remains read-only. Reading and source Change-material retention · Completion evidence · Time meanings · Confirmation scope · Start · Privacy Loading cap/omission UI · Pagination/consistency model

### 通知负载源码能证明什么？事件模型不等于推送已上线

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/notification-payload-model-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 通知负载源码能证明什么？事件模型不等于推送已上线 只验出事件形状，不等于验过端到端通知或动作授权 当前源码的CollieRadarNotificationEvent解析yihuRadar负载，约束version、subscriptionId与eventKey。它表示不透明事件意图，不是任意URL或写命令。仅看到这个模型，不能宣布订阅/推送/点击导航已完整接入或线上送达；本页不新建推送基础设施。 与来源兼容和手机确认的区别 这里核 源码里一个输入模型能够支持多大结论 ，而不是请求系统通知权限、测试APNs或批准业务动作。注释要求本地注册订阅与新鲜私有源读取后再导航；这些要求仍要在实际调用链另找证据，不能由结构体自动证明。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 外层负载 读取yihuRadar字典 实际调用者与入口是否接入 所有通知都走此模型 键集合 精确version/subscriptionId/eventKey 额外键也不自动视为兼容 任意扩展字段都接受 version 整数1，并排除布尔类型 类型与版本分别核 true可代替版本1 subscriptionId 需可解析UUID 实际订阅是否本地已注册另核 UUID形状正确就证明有订阅 eventKey 64个小写十六进制字符 形状不代替来源关联 证明密码学签名或真实事件 后续导航 注释要求注册与新鲜源读取 实际实现/测试证据和权限 模型解析成功就已打开任务 写入/执行 模型不是写命令 原确认/写权与回执 点击即同意或自动执行 线上验收 本页只核固定源码 部署、权限、设备与送达另验 推送已上线或延迟保证 合成审查结论 已知：固定源码有事件形状检查。未证：实际注册、投递、点击解析调用与目标导航。结论：只报模型检查，不把未证调用链补成已完成。 不要为验证模型而注册第三方服务、填真实设备token或公开私有源。即使未来端到端测试通过，事件意图也不自动授权写操作或证明业务完成。 FAQ 结构体存在是否说明推送已部署？ 不是。模型、调用链、部署和真机送达是不同证据层级。 version为true可当1吗？ 当前模型明确排除布尔，不能以数值外观代替类型要求。 eventKey像hash是否等于签名？ 不是。64个小写十六进制是形状条件，不独立证明签名、真实性或授权。 有效UUID就代表实际订阅吗？ 不代表。注册关系与身份仍须实际调用链核对。 点通知是否同意执行？ 不能这样推断。不透明事件不是写命令，原权限和确认门继续。 本文是否运行APNs或真机？ 没有。只核固定源码，不宣称设备送达、导航或线上延迟验收。 相关指南与源码 契约兼容 · 确认范围 · 目标与上下文 · 开始 · 隐私 事件模型与注释 · 源码发布与产品边界

### What a notification payload model proves: shape is not deployed push

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/notification-payload-model-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What a notification payload model proves: shape is not deployed push Parsing an event shape is not end-to-end notification acceptance or authority CollieRadarNotificationEvent parses a yihuRadar payload with version, subscriptionId and eventKey constraints. It represents an opaque intent, not an arbitrary URL/write command. A model alone does not establish subscription wiring, push delivery or click navigation. No push service is provisioned here. Different from source compatibility and phone confirmation Review how far evidence from one input model can support a claim , not system permission, APNs testing or business approval. Comments require local registration and a fresh private-source read before navigation. Those requirements need independent call-chain evidence; a struct does not implement/prove them by itself. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Envelope Reads yihuRadar dictionary Actual caller/entry wiring Every notification uses this model Exact keys version/subscriptionId/eventKey only Extra keys are not automatically compatible Arbitrary extensions accepted version Integer 1, explicitly excludes boolean Type/version separately true replaces 1 subscriptionId Parseable UUID Actual local registration separately UUID shape proves subscription eventKey 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters Source/event association Cryptographic signature or authentic event Navigation Comments require registration/fresh read Actual implementation/tests/access Parsing means task opened Writes/execution Not a write command Original confirmation/write access/receipt Click equals consent or execution Production Fixed-source review only Deployment/device/delivery separately Push live or latency guaranteed Synthetic review result Known: the fixed source checks event shape. Unproved: registration, delivery, click parser invocation and navigation. Report model review only, not a completed integration. Do not register services, enter device tokens or expose private sources to inspect a model. Even future delivery acceptance would not turn an event intent into write authority or business completion. FAQ Does a struct prove deployed push? No. Model, wiring, deployment and device delivery are separate evidence layers. Can true replace version 1? The model explicitly excludes booleans; numeric appearance is insufficient. Is a hash-looking eventKey a signature? No. A 64-lowercase-hex shape independently proves neither signature, authenticity nor authority. Does valid UUID prove registration? No. Registration/identity need actual call-chain review. Does notification tapping approve execution? No. An opaque event is not a write command. Original permission/confirmation remain. Were APNs/devices tested here? No. Fixed source only, without delivery/navigation/latency acceptance. Reading and source Contract compatibility · Confirmation scope · Target/context · Start · Privacy Event model/comments · Source/product scope

### PCM格式准入怎样核？采样范围、声道与转换失败不等于设备认证

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/pcm-format-admission-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 PCM格式准入怎样核？采样范围、声道与转换失败不等于设备认证 格式在范围内只是准入前提，不是所有外设都能转换的保证 现有ColliePCMStreamConverter要求有限且在8000至192000 Hz的输入采样率、1至8声道、Float32非交错格式，再尝试建立输出16k单声道转换器。满足这些检查仍可能无法创建/转换。本页审查具体输入准入，不提供用户改采样率开关、设备认证或通用音频导入器。 与权限和录中恢复的区别 权限指南核前提是否齐全，恢复矩阵核路由事件；这里核 一个原生PCM格式为什么进不了转换器或后续块检查 。没有调用系统录音或生成格式覆盖实测。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 采样率 有限且8000…192000 Hz 实际格式值与创建结果 范围内所有设备已验证 声道数 1…8 真实声道描述 自动识别说话人或多轨分离 数据格式 pcmFormatFloat32 不是只看扩展名/编码标签 任意整数PCM或压缩文件可直接送入 交错状态 要求非交错 实际缓冲布局 可以只改声明重解释字节 输出 16k单声道 既有转换器成功返回 用户可用8k降级绕过 连续输入块 核isStandard/采样率/声道/格式 是否匹配原sourceFormat 旧转换器永远可复用 PCMChunk 复制有效非空块跨队列 块与缓冲生命周期 复制等于隐私认证或录文准确 失败结果 unsupportedFormat/conversionFailed等 区分格式与处理失败 自动补音、云转换或已交付 合成格式核查 输入：采样率在范围内，但不是Float32非交错。结论：仍不满足该转换器条件；不以“采样率看起来正常”宣布兼容。即使所有条件通过，也需实际创建与转换结果。 参数是实现准入，不是音质/识别率承诺。不要改头信息伪装格式、任意复用转换器或跳过目标/模型条件；错误分类也不是对录音原内容真实性的判断。 FAQ 48000 Hz在范围就必定可用吗？ 不必定。其他格式条件、转换器创建与实际转换仍须成功。 1至8声道是不是多人分离能力？ 不是。它是输入准入，输出契约为单声道，不提供说话人分离。 改成Float32标签能修实际字节吗？ 不能。声明与真实布局须一致，不可用改标签绕过格式检查。 声道相同是否可以复用旧转换器？ 不能只看声道，采样率、标准格式等一致性也要核。 这是硬件型号认证表吗？ 不是。未做设备矩阵、噪声或准确率测试。 失败后会自动去云端或补音吗？ 本文不提供回退/补音。保留错误与缺口，沿原获准流程处理。 相关指南与源码 权限与内部采样 · 路由恢复 · 中断缺口 · 开始 · 隐私 格式/块准入与转换器 · 原生采集入口

### PCM format admission: rates, channels and conversion are not device certification

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/pcm-format-admission-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide PCM format admission: rates, channels and conversion are not device certification Within range is an admission prerequisite, not an all-accessory conversion guarantee ColliePCMStreamConverter requires finite 8000–192000 Hz input, 1–8 channels and non-interleaved Float32 before attempting a 16 kHz mono output converter. Creation/conversion can still fail. This reviews exact admission, not a user rate control, hardware certification or universal audio importer. Different from permission and route recovery Permission checks prerequisites; recovery checks route events. Here why a native PCM format/block fails converter admission matters. No capture or format-coverage benchmark ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Rate Finite 8000…192000 Hz Actual value/creation result Every device in range tested Channels 1…8 Actual channel descriptor Speaker identification or track separation Common format pcmFormatFloat32 Actual data, not suffix/label Any integer PCM/compressed file directly accepted Interleaving Non-interleaved required Actual buffer layout Relabeling reinterprets bytes safely Output 16 kHz mono Existing conversion succeeds User 8 kHz bypass Successive blocks isStandard/rate/channels/format checks Original sourceFormat match Old converter always reusable PCMChunk Copies valid nonempty blocks across queues Block/buffer lifetime Privacy certification or recognition accuracy Failure unsupportedFormat/conversionFailed etc. Format versus processing errors Invented audio, cloud conversion or delivery Synthetic format review Input rate is in range but data is not non-interleaved Float32. Result: still fails this converter’s prerequisites. A normal-looking rate is insufficient. Even passing all conditions needs successful creation/conversion. Parameters are admission rules, not quality/accuracy promises. Do not falsify headers, force converters or skip destination/model guards. Error categories do not authenticate spoken content. FAQ Is 48000 Hz guaranteed usable? No. Other conditions and actual creation/conversion must succeed. Does 1–8 channels mean speaker separation? No. It is input admission; output is mono, not diarization. Can a Float32 label repair actual bytes? No. Description/layout must match; labels cannot bypass checks. Do matching channels justify reusing a converter? Not alone. Rate, standard-format and other conditions also matter. Is this hardware certification? No device/noise/accuracy matrix was tested. Does failure trigger cloud conversion or generated fill? No fallback/fill is added. Keep errors/gaps within the original authorized process. Reading and source Permission/sample contract · Route recovery · Interruption gaps · Start · Privacy Format/block/converter admission · Native capture entry

### 回复归档怎样对应请求？request_id、目标版本与待核回执分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/reply-request-receipt-mapping/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 回复归档怎样对应请求？request_id、目标版本与待核回执分账 同一文字不代表同一次请求，recorded也不代表已执行 原生Radar回复在submit前持久保存含requestID的待核记录，避免不确定写入变成新回复；网络结果不明时先check。recorded会显示已记录、待处理，授权确认的提示更明确说明尚未执行。归档要对应实际请求与目标，不把文字相似、时间接近或HTTP阶段当业务完成。 与最终主张审计、角色清单的区别 这里核 请求身份与待核记录/回执怎样对应 ，不是重新审批正文或给所有服务保证exactly-once。本文不提交请求、不清理本地记录、不提供后台幂等服务。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 request_id 请求用UUID关联 同次操作和原记录 同文自动等于同ID 目标id/version/epoch 按当前目标与来源守卫 确认时版本和来源 只凭标题/URL外观认定同目标 持久待核 先保存submitted再发送 保存是否成功、原请求身份 这是永久归档或备份服务 传输不确定 保留pending并先查回 超时与业务拒绝分开 超时说明从未写入 check recorded 走已记录路径 原请求与真实返回 业务已执行/所有角色处理完 check absent 重新prepare并保留同requestID 遵循原入口与确认 用户可随意删标记制造新ID 明确拒绝 只有对应分支清理后可能新ID 实际错误类别与清理结果 把所有错误都当安全重试 人工归档 请求、版本、范围与回执对应 只留获准必要信息 App新建操作日志库或所有后端恰好一次 合成请求核对 记录A：请求甲，结果待核；记录B：文字相同但请求身份未知。结论：不能合并成一次成功，也不能因B没记录就重发A。先沿原查回流程核。 内部待核记录不是供手工编辑的归档接口；源码有备份排除和文件保护等范围，不构成永久保留/恢复保证。人工档案不能改变请求ID、来源epoch或授权范围来绕过不确定停止。 FAQ 同文就是同一个请求吗？ 不是。应以真实请求身份和目标/来源关系核，不能仅凭文本去重。 超时能生成新ID直接再发吗？ 不应。原路径保留待核并先check，不能把传输不确定当已拒绝。 recorded是否证明执行完成？ 不是。源码提示是已记录待处理；授权确认也明确尚未执行。 查回absent是否一定换新ID？ 当前该路径保留同requestID并重新prepare，不能自造新的重复写入。 本地待核文件就是永久备份吗？ 不是。它为不确定恢复服务，文件保护/备份排除不等于归档与恢复SLA。 这里保证任何服务exactly-once吗？ 不保证。核的是当前客户端及协议路径，不能扩展到任意后端。 相关指南与源码 完成主张 · 角色确认 · 材料归档 · 开始 · 隐私 持久待核/submit/check/recorded · 目标与历史模型

### Map reply evidence to request identity, target version and pending receipts

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/reply-request-receipt-mapping/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Map reply evidence to request identity, target version and pending receipts Identical text is not request identity, and recorded is not executed Native Radar replies persist a pending record with requestID before submit so uncertain writes do not silently become new replies. Unclear network outcomes require check. Recorded means retained/pending handling; authorization-confirmed notices explicitly say not executed. Map evidence to actual request/target rather than similar text, nearby times or transport stages. Different from completion claims and role approval Review request identity against pending state/receipts , not content approval or universal exactly-once delivery. No request is sent, local record cleared or backend idempotency service implemented. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established request_id UUID request association Same operation/original record Same text means same ID Target id/version/epoch Current-target/source guards Confirmed version/source Title/URL appearance identifies target Persisted pending Save submitted state before sending Successful save/original identity Permanent archive/backup service Uncertain transport Keep pending and check Timeout versus explicit rejection Timeout means never written check recorded Recorded path Original request/actual response Business execution/every role done check absent Prepare again, retain same requestID Original entry/confirmation Delete markers to manufacture another ID Explicit rejection Selected branches may clear then renew ID Actual error/cleanup result Every failure safely retryable Editorial retention Request/version/scope/receipt mapping Authorized necessary data only New log database or every backend exactly-once Synthetic mapping review A: request alpha, unresolved. B: same text, unknown request identity. Do not combine into one success or resend A because B lacks a receipt. Follow original check flow. Pending records are not hand-edited archive APIs. Source backup exclusion/file protection does not establish permanent retention/recovery. Editorial archives cannot alter request IDs, source epoch or authority to bypass uncertainty. FAQ Does identical prose identify one request? No. Use actual request/target/source relationships, not text-only deduplication. Can timeout justify a new ID and immediate resend? No. Original handling preserves pending and checks first; uncertain transport is not rejection. Does recorded prove execution? No. It means retained/pending handling; authorization confirmation explicitly remains unexecuted. Does absent always create a new ID? This path keeps the same requestID and prepares again instead of manufacturing another write. Is pending storage a permanent backup? No. It supports uncertain-result recovery; file protection/exclusion is not archival or restore SLA. Is exactly-once guaranteed for arbitrary services? No. Current client/protocol review does not establish every backend’s behavior. Reading and source Completion claims · Role confirmation · Material retention · Start · Privacy Persist/submit/check/recorded · Target/history models

### 证据文本为什么没变可点链接？分隔、HTTPS与去重准入核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/evidence-link-admission-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 证据文本为什么没变可点链接？分隔、HTTPS与去重准入核对 能点只代表通过当前形态筛选，不代表证据可信或已脱敏 Radar保留evidence文字，再从中筛选可点URL。当前解析按空白/换行与列出的分隔符拆项，去边界标点，只接纳HTTPS、非空host、无内嵌用户名密码及有效端口，再按absoluteString去重。它不是完整Markdown解析器、安全扫描或业务证据认证。 与引用溯源、异常证据二查的区别 溯源指南核句子依据、二查核真实性；这里先解释 为什么一段证据文字可能没有生成链接、哪些URL形态被接纳 。源码分隔符为分号、逗号、中文逗号/分号和竖线等；本页不访问示例链接、不改源数据。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 空值/空串 返回空链接列表 真实evidence与显示占位 任务没有任何证据 分词 空白/换行及指定标点 逗号可能切开合法URL文本 自动理解所有引用语法 边界标点 去两端括号/引号等 候选串实际结果 完整解析标签式Markdown scheme/host HTTPS且host非空 协议和实际目的地 安全域名白名单或权限已核 内嵌凭据 user/password必须为空 不在URL放真实凭据 路径/查询里的敏感信息也自动消失 端口 显式端口限1…65535 形态与目标访问权限分开 所有端口服务已验证 去重 按absoluteString首次保留 不同拼法与实际引用关系 语义同址全面归一 结果 只输出可点候选 正文、证据质量与目的地 无风险/真实/已读或已处理 合成链接核查 单独的 https://example.com/review可作为形态示意，不表示真实项目证据；带标签的Markdown链接不保证按完整语法展开。遇到未提取项，先核原文和分词，不删除证据或补造安全结论。 链接里的路径、查询和片段仍可能泄露信息，即使没有user/password。访问前遵守已有权限与目的地范围，不把解析器名称中的safe当恶意内容扫描或所有网络访问安全保证。 FAQ 没有可点链接是否表示没有证据？ 不表示。原文可能不是符合该分词/URL规则的链接，须核原材料。 Markdown标签链接一定提取吗？ 不保证。这里不是完整Markdown解析器，不应假定所有嵌套标记都支持。 HTTPS就证明可信和获准访问吗？ 不是。这里只核形态；来源真伪、内容、身份与访问权限另核。 无用户名密码是否已经脱敏？ 不等于。路径/查询/片段仍可能含敏感信息，需人工核范围。 去重会把所有等价地址合为一条吗？ 不声明语义归一，只按absoluteString去重。 本页是否打开过示例URL？ 没有，未作网站安全或业务证据验收。 相关指南与源码 证据二查 · 句子溯源 · 载体敏感层 · 开始 · 隐私 parseSafeEvidenceURLs · 链接展示
