### Why evidence text has no clickable link: tokenization, HTTPS and URL admission

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/evidence-link-admission-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why evidence text has no clickable link: tokenization, HTTPS and URL admission Clickable means admitted shape, not trusted, redacted evidence Radar retains evidence text and extracts clickable URLs. Parsing splits whitespace/newlines and listed delimiters, trims edge punctuation, requires HTTPS/nonempty host/no embedded user-password/valid port, then deduplicates by absoluteString. This is not full Markdown parsing, security scanning or business-evidence certification. Different from provenance and evidence truth checks Provenance maps claims; second checks assess truth. Here why text does not produce a link and which URL shapes are admitted matters. Delimiters include Latin/Chinese comma/semicolon and vertical bar. No example URL is fetched or source rewritten. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Null/empty Empty URL list Original evidence versus placeholder No business evidence exists Tokenization Whitespace/newlines/listed punctuation Comma can split valid URL text All reference syntax understood Edge punctuation Trims brackets/quotes etc. Actual candidate Full labeled Markdown parsing Scheme/host HTTPS, nonempty host Protocol/destination Safe-domain allowlist or authority Embedded credentials No user/password Keep credentials out of URLs Paths/queries automatically redacted Port Explicit 1…65535 Shape versus access permission Every endpoint tested Deduplication First absoluteString retained Spellings/reference relationships Universal semantic normalization Result Clickable candidates only Body/evidence quality/destination Harmless, true, read or handled Synthetic URL review Standalone https://example.com/review illustrates shape, not real project evidence. Labeled Markdown need not expand through a full grammar. Inspect original/tokenization rather than deleting evidence or inventing safety conclusions. Paths, queries and fragments can disclose information despite no user/password. Existing access/destination permission applies; safe in a method name is neither a malware scan nor universal network safety. FAQ Does no link mean no evidence? No. Text may not meet tokenization/URL rules. Inspect originals. Are labeled Markdown links always extracted? No guarantee. This is not a full Markdown parser supporting all nesting. Does HTTPS prove trust and access permission? No. Shape differs from origin, content, identity and authority. Is no embedded user/password equivalent to redaction? No. Paths/query/fragments can remain sensitive. Are all equivalent URLs merged? No semantic-normalization guarantee; deduplication uses absoluteString. Were example URLs opened? No. No site-security or business-evidence acceptance was performed. Reading and source Evidence review · Claim provenance · Sensitive layers · Start · Privacy parseSafeEvidenceURLs · Link presentation

### 录音处理跟不上输入怎样核？短语音队列、预览快照与最终结果

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/capture-buffer-pressure-checklist/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 录音处理跟不上输入怎样核？短语音队列、预览快照与最终结果 bufferOverflow是失败边界，不应把部分预览当完整录音 短语音PCM管线用串行队列和有界源帧预算；等待帧超过max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096)会记录bufferOverflow并停止接纳，最终走失败。snapshot不等待队列排空，只是当前输出快照。不能凭预览已有文字/音量，宣布完整采集和交付成功。 与PCM准入和路由恢复的区别 格式准入核输入形状，路由恢复核系统事件；这里核 处理压力下的队列、停止、快照和最终结果含义 。只限该短语音管线，不把其预算推广为长笔记限制或设备性能测试。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 队列预算 max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096)源帧 等待量与实际错误 固定半秒端到端延迟SLA 合成算例 48000 Hz对应24000等待源帧 这是帧预算，不是字节 整个App总RAM精确上限 溢出 bufferOverflow失败、停止接纳 实际错误和未完成状态 静默丢块后仍完整成功 snapshot 不为预览排空队列 当前输出与最终输出分开 预览包含所有已入队音频 正常requestStop 停止接纳，处理队列并flush尾部 返回的最终结果或失败 按停按钮立即证明全部完成 时长边界 入参有限且至多30秒 正常到限停止与durationExceeded分开 所有到30秒都报错或长笔记也30秒 cancel 清待处理/输出并重置 取消与已提交副作用分开 还有隐形备份可完整恢复 后续交接 仍依final与原守卫 结果/目标/旧尝试 调参数或重录自动授予重发 合成压力结论 预览存在，但最终返回bufferOverflow。结论：不能把预览当完整最终结果；标明失败与缺口。排查不应任意放大队列、跳过格式/模型条件或据此宣称特定设备算力不足。 源码预算不证明实时性能、噪声或识别准确率；正在转换的块、输出和其他内存也不是只由等待帧数代表。本页没有压测、录音或修改管线。 FAQ 半秒源帧预算就是半秒延迟吗？ 不是。它是等待帧准入量，不能等同端到端延迟或所有系统调度。 24000帧是不是24000字节？ 不是。帧、声道、采样数据布局与总内存不同，不能直接混算。 预览有文字能忽略溢出吗？ 不能。最终失败不因部分预览存在而变成完整成功。 snapshot会等所有输入处理完吗？ 当前实现不为预览排空队列，须与最终停止结果区分。 30秒上限适用于所有长笔记吗？ 不适用。这里是短语音管线，长录音写盘路径不同。 本文是否新增自动调队列或云回退？ 没有。只核源码失败边界，不提供调参/回退/零丢失保证。 相关指南与源码 PCM格式准入 · 路由恢复 · 重录缺口 · 开始 · 隐私 队列预算/snapshot/停止与失败 · 短语音时长入口

<td>调参数或重录自动授予重发</td>
</tr>

### Capture cannot keep up: short-speech queues, previews and final results

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/capture-buffer-pressure-checklist/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Capture cannot keep up: short-speech queues, previews and final results bufferOverflow is a failure boundary; partial previews are not complete recording The short-speech PCM pipeline uses a serial queue and bounded waiting source frames. Exceeding max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096) records bufferOverflow, stops admission and ultimately fails. snapshot does not drain the queue; it captures current output only. Visible previews/levels do not prove complete capture or delivery. Different from format and route review Format admission checks shape; route recovery checks system events. Here queue, stop, snapshot and final meanings under pressure matter. This scope is short speech, not long-note limits or hardware performance testing. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Budget max(ceil(sourceRate / 2), 4096) source frames Waiting amount/error Fixed half-second end-to-end SLA Synthetic arithmetic 48000 Hz → 24000 waiting frames Frames, not bytes Exact whole-app RAM cap Overflow bufferOverflow failure, admission stops Actual error/incomplete state Silent drops still count as full success snapshot Does not drain for preview Current versus final output Every queued block included Normal requestStop Stop admission, process queue/flush tail Returned final/error Stop tap proves instant completion Duration Finite parameter up to 30 seconds Normal limit stop versus durationExceeded Every 30-second capture errors or long notes share limit cancel Clears pending/output and resets Cancellation versus committed effects Hidden complete recovery backup Handoff Final/original guards still apply Result/target/prior attempt Tuning or recapture grants resend Synthetic pressure result A preview exists, but final reports bufferOverflow. Do not present the preview as complete. Retain failure/gap evidence without arbitrarily growing queues, bypassing model/format checks or diagnosing hardware capability from one result. Source budgets are not runtime/noise/accuracy evidence. Processing blocks, output and other allocations are not represented by waiting frames alone. No stress test, recording or pipeline modification ran. FAQ Does half-second frame budget mean half-second latency? No. Waiting admission differs from end-to-end latency/scheduling. Are 24000 frames 24000 bytes? No. Frames, channels/layout and total memory differ. Can visible text justify ignoring overflow? No. Partial preview does not turn final failure into completeness. Does snapshot wait for every block? Not for preview. Distinguish current output from final stop results. Do all long notes have a 30-second limit? No. This is short speech; long-note disk recording differs. Is automatic queue tuning/cloud fallback added? No. This reviews source failure boundaries, not tuning/fallback/zero-loss guarantees. Reading and source Format admission · Route recovery · Recapture gaps · Start · Privacy Budget/snapshot/stop/failure · Short-speech duration entry

### 音频、笔记元数据与转写归档怎样对应？进度不等于逐字真实性

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-audio-text-evidence-mapping/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 音频、笔记元数据与转写归档怎样对应？进度不等于逐字真实性 文字、音频与元数据是不同材料，交接文字不代表音频也已分享 现有笔记按同一id管理audio.caf与note.json，转写从transcribedFrames继续并累积transcript。处理到done不等于每个词都已核对；emptyTranscript分支可以推进帧进度却不增加文字。交给工作台的路径分享转写文字，不含录音文件。本页是人工材料对应清单，不新增音文对齐或原件归档服务。 与片段审校和版本材料归档的区别 片段审校核听到什么，变更归档核评审前后材料；这里核 本地音频、元数据、处理进度和对外交接文字是否被误当同一份证据 。不访问沙盒、不导出实际文件、不建立新索引或备份。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 note id 同一笔记材料定位关系 实际原件与版本 同名文件就同一记录 audio.caf 本地采集文件 实际可读范围/状态 显示文字证明音频完整 note.json 元数据/状态/转写等 原始状态与人工副本 不可篡改审计证书 transcribedFrames 16k帧处理位置 处理覆盖与原内容另核 字级时间对齐或逐词准确率 emptyTranscript 可跳过文字但仍推进位置 实际内容是否需回查 原音频一定无业务内容 done 这次转写流程完成 原文、未知和错误范围 真实性/语义完整自动验收 文字交接 短文本或长Markdown 实际交出的文字与附件 默认分享audio.caf或所有原件 本地保留 源码尝试排除笔记备份 实际权限、保留规则/其他副本 永久备份、灾后恢复或一键原件归档 合成材料对应 笔记甲的元数据为done，正文只有一段文字；不能仅凭done宣布整段音频逐词已核，也不能因托盘有Markdown就标记音频已移交。先核真正材料与范围。 人工可保留原引用、实际文字版本、已核内容与未知，但不要把内部字段当可手改的导入/恢复API。修改副本不改变真实源材料，处理进度不是内容真实性证明；一次交接标记也不因另建档案取消。 FAQ 100%或done是否证明每词正确？ 不是。它反映处理流程，不代替听核、语义与原文验收。 emptyTranscript是否一定说明原音频只有静音？ 不能由该分支独立证明。实现可略过文字并推进进度，真实内容另核。 transcribedFrames是每个词的时间戳吗？ 不是。它是16k帧处理位置，不提供字级强制对齐功能。 交接长Markdown是否连音频一起上传？ 引用路径交接文字，不含录音文件；不能从文字附件推原件分享。 note.json是不可篡改证据吗？ 本文不声明签名或不可篡改机制，元数据与可信/真实性不同。 本地有音频是否等于永久备份？ 不是。源码尝试排除备份且不提供本页新增的恢复保证，按实际保留规则核。 相关指南与源码 片段审校 · 文字附件格式 · 材料归档链 · 逐项分享范围 · 开始 · 隐私 元数据与一次标记 · 音频/帧进度/文字交接 · 仅分享文字说明

### Map audio, note metadata and transcript evidence: progress is not verbatim truth

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-audio-text-evidence-mapping/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Map audio, note metadata and transcript evidence: progress is not verbatim truth Audio, text and metadata differ; handing off text does not share the audio Notes relate audio.caf and note.json by one id. Transcription resumes at transcribedFrames and accumulates transcript. Done does not establish every word was reviewed; the emptyTranscript branch can advance frames without adding text. Workbench handoff shares transcription, not recording files. This is an editorial mapping checklist, not forced alignment or original-file archiving. Different from passage review and revision retention Passage review checks speech; revision retention maps reviewed versions. Here local audio, metadata, progress and handed-off text must not be mistaken for identical evidence . No sandbox access, file export, index or backup is performed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Note id Relates one note’s materials Actual originals/version Same filename means same record audio.caf Local captured file Readable scope/state Text display proves complete audio note.json Metadata/state/transcript etc. Original state versus editorial copy Tamper-proof audit certificate transcribedFrames 16 kHz frame processing position Processing scope versus contents Word alignment or accuracy emptyTranscript May advance position without text Whether actual content needs review Original contained no business speech done Transcription process finished Originals/unknowns/error scope Automatic truth/semantic completeness acceptance Text handoff Short text or long Markdown Actual delivered text/attachment audio.caf/all originals shared by default Local retention Source attempts backup exclusion Permissions/policy/other copies Permanent backup, disaster recovery or original archive button Synthetic mapping review Sample note is done with one text paragraph. That does not prove every audio word was reviewed; a staged Markdown file does not establish audio transfer. Inspect actual materials/scope. Keep authorized references/text versions/reviewed scope/gaps manually, without treating internal fields as editable import/restore APIs. Copies do not change originals, progress does not authenticate contents, and an archive does not erase handoff reservations. FAQ Does 100% or done certify every word? No. Processing state does not replace listening, meaning or original-content review. Does emptyTranscript prove only silence existed? Not independently. Processing can skip text and advance; actual content needs separate review. Is transcribedFrames a timestamp for each word? No. It is a 16 kHz frame position, not forced word alignment. Does long Markdown also upload the audio? The cited path hands off text, not recording files. Text attachments do not prove original transfer. Is note.json tamper-proof evidence? No signing/immutability mechanism is asserted. Metadata differs from trust/truth. Does local audio mean permanent backup? No. Source attempts backup exclusion; actual retention applies without a new restore guarantee. Reading and source Passage review · Text attachment format · Material relationships · Per-item sharing scope · Start · Privacy Metadata/reservation · Audio/frame/text handling · Text-only handoff explanation

### Radar源URL为什么被拒？路径、查询和证据链接的不同边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/radar-feed-url-boundary-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 Radar源URL为什么被拒？路径、查询和证据链接的不同边界 证据链接能点，不代表同一地址能作为Radar源 CollieRadarFeed.validate允许源URL带路径，但要求HTTPS、非空host、无内嵌用户名密码、无query和fragment；端口可省略，若显式指定则须在1至65535。证据URL另用parseSafeEvidenceURLs，规则不能互换。通过源形态校验仍不证明认证、可达、成功读取或快照有效，本页不新增源服务或凭据配置。 与证据URL准入和离线排障的分工 证据指南核可点候选，离线指南核失败状态；这里先核 配置为数据源的地址本身是否符合消费者边界 。不发网络请求、不输入真实凭据、不把有效URL当私有来源身份认证。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 首尾空白 先去首尾空白再解析 原配置与实际返回URL 清洗所有内部字符 协议与host HTTPS且host非空 实际来源身份另核 可信域白名单或TLS实测 path 源可有路径 路径是否实际提供源 浏览器可信origin规则直接代用 内嵌凭据 user/password必须空 沿既有获准认证流程 把密码塞URL就能使用 query/fragment 必须都不存在 即使只是view=demo也不同 证据链接允许就源也允许 端口 可省略；显式指定时为1…65535 服务可达性与访问权限 所有端口和来源已测试 返回内容 形态校验不是JSON解码 真实模型/日期/大小/身份 任意网页地址都是快照源 失败处理 保持原守卫 错误类别和原来源配置 自动改HTTP/换服务/公开私有源 合成地址比较 https://example.com/radar.json只是带path的形态示意；加?view=demo或#part会触及当前源校验的query/fragment限制。示例未访问，不代表实际源存在。 不要为了通过校验删掉真实认证条件或改用未批准公开服务。形态、认证、读取和内容验收是四类证据；其中一项通过不补齐其余，也不产生回复写权。 FAQ HTTPS链接可点就能当源吗？ 不能。证据候选和源URL有不同消费者规则，尤其query/fragment。 源必须只有域名不能有path吗？ 不是。该校验允许path，但路径是否实际有效仍需获准读取证据。 无敏感内容的query也允许吗？ 当前校验要求query不存在，不能按内容无害自行放宽。 通过validate是否证明认证成功？ 不证明。没有发出请求，身份、权限与真实响应另核。 地址失败能改HTTP绕过吗？ 不应。按原错误和获准配置处理，不绕HTTPS边界。 本页是否创建或访问了示例源？ 没有，未注册服务、输入凭据或发网络请求。 相关指南与源码 证据链接准入 · 离线与来源失败 · JSON消费者条件 · 开始 · 隐私 CollieRadarFeed与证据URL校验 · 来源与工作台边界

### Why a Radar feed URL is rejected: paths, queries and evidence-link differences

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/radar-feed-url-boundary-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why a Radar feed URL is rejected: paths, queries and evidence-link differences A clickable evidence URL is not automatically a valid Radar feed CollieRadarFeed.validate permits a path but requires HTTPS, nonempty host, no embedded user/password, no query/fragment. The port may be omitted; if explicitly specified, it must be within 1–65535. Evidence uses separate parseSafeEvidenceURLs rules. Passing feed shape proves neither authentication, reachability, a successful read nor valid snapshot. No source service or credential setup is added. Different from evidence admission and offline diagnosis Evidence admission checks clickable candidates; offline review checks failures. Here whether a configured source address meets consumer boundaries comes first. No network request or real credentials are used, and shape is not private-source identity verification. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Edge whitespace Trim before parsing Original configuration/returned URL Every internal character cleansed Scheme/host HTTPS/nonempty host Actual source identity Trusted-domain allowlist or TLS test Path Allowed on feeds Actual source endpoint Browser-origin rules interchangeable Credentials No user/password Existing authorized auth process Passwords in URLs are supported Query/fragment Both absent Even view=demo differs Evidence allowance transfers to feeds Port Optional; if specified, 1…65535 Access/reachability Every port/source tested Response URL validation is not JSON decoding Model/date/size/identity Any web page is a snapshot Failure Original guards remain Category/original configuration Automatic HTTP/other service/private disclosure Synthetic address comparison https://example.com/radar.json illustrates a path only. Adding ?view=demo or #part meets current query/fragment rejection conditions. Nothing is fetched and no real source is established. Do not remove real authentication conditions or use an unapproved public service to pass a check. Shape, authentication, reading and content acceptance are separate; none silently supplies the others or write access. FAQ Can every clickable HTTPS link be a source? No. Consumers differ, especially query/fragment rules. Must a feed be a bare domain without path? No. A path is allowed; actual endpoint validity still needs authorized evidence. Is a harmless query allowed? The current validator requires no query, irrespective of assumed harmlessness. Does validate prove authentication? No request occurs there. Identity, permissions and response remain separate. Can failure be bypassed with HTTP? Do not bypass HTTPS; inspect actual errors/authorized configuration. Was the example source created or fetched? No service registration, credentials or network request occurred. Reading and source Evidence URL admission · Offline/source failures · JSON consumer conditions · Start · Privacy Feed/evidence URL validators · Source/workbench boundaries

### 近讲偏好不等于路由实测：HFP允许、会话模式与当前输入核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/near-field-policy-route-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 近讲偏好不等于路由实测：HFP允许、会话模式与当前输入核对 allowBluetoothHFP是允许条件，不是外设已被选中或更准确的证明 现有短语音在start读取近讲偏好。启用策略采用playAndRecord、voiceChat及mixWithOthers/allowBluetoothHFP；关闭策略为record/default。输入图策略也随该偏好分支。它们是实现选择，不是当前硬件已成功启用、强制选择某支麦克风或实测准确率；本页不新增降噪/选麦服务。 与外设适用性和恢复矩阵的区别 外设前检核场景条件，恢复矩阵核录中事件；这里核 保存的偏好、启动配置、输入图和实际系统路由的证据层级 。不切换系统设置或录音，长笔记另有自己的采集路径。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 保存偏好 缺值时源码默认true 实际版本与入口 默认值等于系统已授权 启用会话 playAndRecord/voiceChat setCategory/setActive结果 所有设备都成功或无回声 HFP allowBluetoothHFP为允许 实际输入路由 强制选中已配对耳机麦克风 混音选项 mixWithOthers策略 实际输出/页面播放状态 网页TTS与采集无限同时可用 输入图 近讲策略启用voice processing等 实际图配置是否成功 固定高噪成绩或说话人识别 关闭策略 record/default原路径 对应入口与当前状态 所有外设自动兼容 启动快照 本次start读取偏好 本次会话和后续设置区别 改偏好就证明旧录音已重绑 其他采集 长笔记路径单独实现 实际入口与权限/格式 一套策略覆盖所有录音/网页 合成策略核查 已知：偏好启用；未知：实际HFP输入与图配置结果。结论：只能说启动策略允许，不报外设选择或高噪性能。若准备/启动失败，沿原错误处理，不强行复用不一致管线。 voiceChat或voice processing名称不是风噪、距离、延迟或准确率SLA。先核实际路由和安全环境，不让策略标签替代设备/系统验收，也不扩张服务和目标权限。 FAQ 偏好为true说明麦克风已授权吗？ 不说明。保存偏好与系统授权、启动结果是不同条件。 HFP允许是否强制选耳机麦克风？ 不是。必须核实际系统输入路由，不能只看配对或配置选项。 voiceChat是否保证骑行风噪可用？ 没有这种实测或SLA，本页也不建议驾驶/骑行中操作。 mixWithOthers是否保证所有网页朗读和采集同时工作？ 不能保证。实际页面/系统/输入输出边界仍需核。 长笔记也完全沿这套近讲策略吗？ 不能推广。引用的是短语音入口，长笔记采集单独核。 改设置等于旧会话已经重绑吗？ 不能由保存值推断。核本次启动、实际相位/路由与原守卫。 相关指南与源码 外设前检 · 路由恢复 · 权限与格式 · 开始 · 隐私 近讲会话/图策略与启动 · 既有设置入口 · 长笔记独立路径

### Near-field preference versus actual route: HFP allowance and capture policy

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/near-field-policy-route-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Near-field preference versus actual route: HFP allowance and capture policy allowBluetoothHFP is permission to use a route, not proof it was selected or more accurate Short-speech start reads the near-field preference. Enabled policy uses playAndRecord/voiceChat with mixWithOthers/allowBluetoothHFP; disabled policy uses record/default. Input graph policy branches too. These are implementation choices, not successful hardware activation, forced mic selection or measured accuracy. No noise-removal/mic-selection service is added. Different from accessory suitability and recovery Suitability checks environment; recovery checks capture events. Here stored preference, startup configuration, graph and actual route have separate evidence scopes . No setting or recording changes occur; long notes use another capture path. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Preference Default true when absent Actual version/entry Default means system authorization Enabled session playAndRecord/voiceChat Category/activation results Universal success or no echo HFP allowBluetoothHFP permits Actual input route Paired headset mic forced Mixing mixWithOthers policy Actual playback/output Unlimited web TTS/capture coexistence Input graph Voice-processing policy etc. Actual configuration success Noise benchmark or speaker identification Disabled record/default path Actual entry/state All accessories compatible Startup snapshot Preference read at start This capture versus later settings Saved changes prove old capture rebound Other capture Long notes separately implemented Actual entry/permission/format Every recording/page uses one policy Synthetic policy review Known: preference enabled. Unknown: selected HFP input and graph result. Report allowance only, not route selection or noise performance. Startup failures retain original handling rather than forcing mismatched pipelines. voiceChat/voice processing names are not wind, distance, latency or accuracy SLAs. Actual route/safe environment need review without replacing device/OS acceptance or expanding service/target authority. FAQ Does true mean microphone permission granted? No. Preference, system authorization and successful start differ. Does HFP allowance force headset input? No. Inspect the actual route, not pairing or options alone. Does voiceChat guarantee cycling wind performance? No benchmark/SLA is supplied; do not operate while driving/cycling. Does mixWithOthers guarantee all page playback/capture coexistence? No. Actual page/system/input/output boundaries still matter. Do long notes use this exact policy? Do not generalize short-speech configuration to the separate long-note path. Does editing preferences prove old capture rebound? No. Inspect startup, phase/route and original guards. Reading and source Accessory preflight · Route recovery · Permission/format · Start · Privacy Policy/graph/start · Existing settings · Separate long-note path

### 分段转写怎样拼接？低能量切点、ASCII空格与原词证据核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-segment-join-provenance/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 分段转写怎样拼接？低能量切点、ASCII空格与原词证据核对 拼接规则能改变边界空格，但不证明句子、标点和语义已校正 CollieNoteSegmenter用16k采样、28秒窗口，在末8秒按1600帧步长寻找低能量位置，末尾/较短最终窗口另处理。join只在两侧都是ASCII字母或数字时加一个空格；其他边界直接拼接。它不是语义断句、自动补标点、说话人识别或字级对齐，本页不新增结构化纪要引擎。 与听核原话和导出编码的分工 听核检查识别内容，导出指南核序列化；这里核 分段/拼接算法本身给结果增加或保留了什么边界 ，以免把处理产物当未经编辑的逐字原件。未运行识别模型或音频测试。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 窗口 16k、最多28秒处理窗口 实际最后窗口与长度 每28秒必为完整一句 搜索区 末8秒低能量查找 声学切点而非语义 所有词都不会被切断 步长 1600帧约100ms 粒度与实际内容分开 每词100ms对齐 ASCII边界 两侧字母/数字时加空格 API与V2拼成API V2 空格一定来自原始口述 其他边界 直接拼接，不通用修辞 中文/标点/已有空格 自动语法纠错或段落分层 空/首段 按实现保留已有或下一段 实际原词和输出 自动补齐缺句 元数据进度 帧位置与文字不是同一度量 transcribedFrames与原音频 每段已人工审校 归档说明 原引用/实际处理稿/修订分开 新增空格或人工断句依据 自动生成原话真实性证书 合成拼接示意 API + V2得到API V2；样例 + 说明直接得到样例说明。这是简单边界规则示意，不是实际识别准确率。若人工补标点、断句或改别名，应标为编辑动作并保留依据，不能说成模型或源音频已经明确给出。 低能量不保证没有词，不用算法注释代替真实听核。用于后续简报时仍保持条件、否定与未知，不从拼接稿自动推导业务批准或已执行状态。 FAQ 28秒窗口是否就是自动语义分段？ 不是。声学窗口/切点不等于句子边界或说话人分离。 低能量切点能保证不切词吗？ 没有保证。该策略不替代真实音频与识别结果核对。 API V2中的空格必为原话吗？ 不必。join会在ASCII字母数字边界补空格，应区分处理规则与原始证据。 中文边界会自动补空格和标点吗？ 不由该join提供。其他边界直接拼接，不是通用中文排版或纠错器。 帧进度是否说明全部词已听核？ 不说明。处理位置、最终文字与人工验证分别看。 本页是否新增分段编辑或自动纪要？ 没有。只是按固定源码核拼接范围，不提供新界面/API或模型能力。 相关指南与源码 片段原词核对 · 导出文字格式 · 音文材料对应 · 开始 · 隐私 CollieNoteSegmenter与join · 处理帧元数据

### Segment joining: low-energy cuts, ASCII spaces and original-word evidence

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-segment-join-provenance/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Segment joining: low-energy cuts, ASCII spaces and original-word evidence Joining may add a boundary space; it does not certify grammar, punctuation or meaning CollieNoteSegmenter uses 16 kHz, 28-second windows and a low-energy search over the last eight seconds in 1600-frame steps, with final/short-window handling. join inserts one space only when both adjacent characters are ASCII letters/digits; other boundaries concatenate. It is not semantic splitting, punctuation repair, diarization or word alignment. No structured-minutes engine is added. Different from original-word and encoding review Listening reviews content; export review checks serialization. Here what segmentation/joining itself adds or preserves at boundaries matters, so processed text is not mistaken for an untouched verbatim original. No model/audio benchmark ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Window 16 kHz/up to 28 seconds Final window/actual length Each window is a whole sentence Search Last eight seconds, low energy Acoustic versus semantic cut Words never cut Step 1600 frames, about 100 ms Granularity versus content 100-ms word alignment ASCII boundary Letters/digits both sides add space API + V2 → API V2 Space necessarily came from speech Other boundaries Direct join, no rhetoric repair CJK/punctuation/existing spaces Grammar correction/paragraph hierarchy Empty/first piece Existing/next per implementation Original words/output Missing sentences generated Progress Frame position differs from text transcribedFrames/audio Every piece manually reviewed Retention Original/processed/edited text separated Added spaces/editorial reasons Automatic verbatim authenticity certificate Synthetic joining illustration API + V2 becomes API V2; 样例 + 说明 becomes 样例说明. These illustrate boundary rules, not recognition accuracy. Manual punctuation, splitting or alias edits must retain editorial status/evidence rather than claim the model/original explicitly supplied them. Low energy is not guaranteed word absence. Review actual audio/text. Later briefs still preserve conditions, negation and unknowns; joining does not establish business approval or execution. FAQ Are 28-second windows semantic segmentation? No. Acoustic windows/cuts differ from sentence boundaries or speaker separation. Do low-energy cuts guarantee no split words? No. Strategy does not replace actual audio/result review. Must the API V2 space come from speech? No. join can insert it at ASCII letter/digit boundaries. Distinguish processing from originals. Does CJK joining add spaces/punctuation? Not through this join. Other boundaries concatenate; it is not general typography/correction. Does frame progress establish all words heard/reviewed? No. Position, final text and manual acceptance differ. Is new segment editing or automatic minutes added? No. This reviews fixed implementation, not new UI/API/model capability. Reading and source Original-word review · Export format · Audio/text mapping · Start · Privacy Segmenter/join · Frame progress metadata

### 回复超时或响应过大怎样核？传输预算不是服务端未记录证明

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/reply-transport-budget-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 回复超时或响应过大怎样核？传输预算不是服务端未记录证明 字节/超时上限是消费者保护，不是业务结果或响应SLA 原生回复请求体上限为20000字节；非history响应上限40000字节，history为128 KiB，并在流式读取中继续限额。请求/资源超时也按操作分支设置。触及这些边界不证明服务端从未记录，不能把传输异常自动改为安全重发；本页不发请求、不新增API或调参功能。 与源URL、请求身份和历史检索的分工 源URL核地址形状，请求身份核request_id与回执，检索核覆盖范围；这里专门核 客户端传输设置为什么可能终止读取、它能证明什么 。实际消息和历史仍受原模型、身份与目标校验。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 请求体 最多20000字节，含JSON元数据 编码后总量非只数字数 20000字符都可交付 非history响应 最多40000字节 真实响应/解码结果 HTTP成功就业务成功 history响应 最多128 KiB 流式计数与原模型校验 一次返回全部历史 Content-Length 已知过大先拒，读流仍限 未知/不可信长度下的实际字节 没有长度头就无限读 请求超时 history 45秒，其他25秒 客户端配置和实际错误 服务承诺此时限必完成 资源超时 history 60秒，其他45秒 单独资源预算 端到端业务处理SLA 会话/重定向 原生Cookie/凭据存储另设，拒自动重定向 原来源与实际权限 浏览器登录自动成为原生写权 提交结果不明 pending/check原路径保留 请求身份与真实结果 响应读失败就没有副作用 合成传输记录 已有：一次提交后读响应超时；未知：原回复是否已记录。结论：保存待核状态，沿check查回，不从客户端超时编造absent，也不改URL或新request_id盲重试。 这里的字节/时间是固定源码配置，不是压测、线上可用性、网络延迟或成本保证；浏览器页面登录与原生请求不应互相推定权限。原source/epoch/版本和确认守卫继续有效。 FAQ 20k请求体是否等于20k中文字符？ 不是。它是JSON编码后字节，元数据也占用，不能直接当字符门槛。 响应超过上限是否说明服务未写入？ 不说明。读取失败与服务端结果分开，仍需原请求查回。 没有Content-Length就不受限制吗？ 不是。现有读流还有逐字节上限检查。 45/60秒是不是保证服务此时完成？ 不是。分别是客户端操作分支配置，不是业务SLA。 重定向能自动去另一个网站继续吗？ 该原生路径拒绝自动重定向，不为兼容放宽源与权限边界。 本文是否运行接口或负载测试？ 没有。仅核固定源码，不声称真实请求、性能或服务可用性验收。 相关指南与源码 源URL · 请求与回执 · 历史检索范围 · 开始 · 隐私 请求/响应限额、超时与拒重定向 · 消费者模型

### Reply timeout or oversized response: transport limits do not prove no write

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/reply-transport-budget-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Reply timeout or oversized response: transport limits do not prove no write Byte/time limits protect the consumer; they are not business results or response SLAs Native reply bodies are capped at 20000 bytes. Non-history responses are capped at 40000 bytes; history at 128 KiB, including streaming enforcement. Request/resource timeouts vary by operation. Hitting limits does not establish that nothing was recorded server-side and cannot automatically authorize resending. No request, new API or tuning feature is supplied. Different from URL, identity and retrieval review URL preflight checks shape, request mapping checks identity/receipts, and retrieval checks coverage. Here why client transport settings may terminate reading and what that proves matters. Original models, identity and target checks remain. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Request body Up to 20000 bytes, including JSON metadata Encoded total, not text length 20000 characters always deliverable Non-history response Up to 40000 bytes Actual response/decoding HTTP success means business success History response Up to 128 KiB Stream count/model validation All history in one response Content-Length Oversize rejected early; stream still bounded Unknown/untrusted length versus actual bytes No header means unlimited reading Request timeout History 45 seconds, others 25 Client configuration/actual error Service completion deadline promised Resource timeout History 60 seconds, others 45 Separate resource budget End-to-end handling SLA Session/redirect Native cookie/credential stores separate; no automatic redirect Original source/actual authority Browser login becomes native write access Uncertain submit Original pending/check path remains Request identity/real outcome Failed response read means no effects Synthetic transport note Known: response reading timed out after a submit. Unknown: whether the reply was recorded. Preserve pending and use original check; do not invent absent or blindly change URLs/request IDs. Bytes/times are source settings, not load, uptime, network-latency or cost evidence. Page login/native authority cannot be inferred from each other. Source/epoch/version/confirmation guards remain. FAQ Does 20k body mean 20k CJK characters? No. It counts JSON-encoded bytes including metadata, not a direct character allowance. Does an oversized response prove no write? No. Reading failure differs from server outcome; check the original request. Is reading unlimited without Content-Length? No. Streaming enforces byte limits too. Do 45/60 seconds guarantee completion? No. They are separate client configurations, not business SLAs. Can redirects automatically continue on another site? The native path refuses automatic redirects; compatibility does not relax source/access boundaries. Was an endpoint/load test run? No. Fixed source only, without actual requests, performance or availability acceptance. Reading and source Feed URL · Request/receipt mapping · History coverage · Start · Privacy Byte/time/redirect boundaries · Consumer models

### 声纹结果能证明什么？便捷过滤、未就绪与账户权限分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/voiceprint-filter-not-authorization/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 声纹结果能证明什么？便捷过滤、未就绪与账户权限分账 声纹match不是身份认证，bypass也不是成功匹配 CollieVoiceprint源码明确写明“便捷过滤、不是认证，误接受始终可能”。其Decision有bypass、match、mismatch、unavailable；未启用时bypass不表示做过比较。数值阈值0.70也不是70%身份概率。任何过滤结果都不能代替账户、目标权限、手机确认或实际执行回执。 与采样权限、路由和多角色确认的区别 采样指南核音频输入，路由指南核系统状态，角色清单核动作许可；这里核 本地声音过滤分支的结论能否被过度解释为身份/授权 。本页不录制、登记或读取真实声纹，不修改开关与模型。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 未启用 decide返回bypass 没比较与匹配成功分开 证明是本人 match/mismatch 按分数与阈值分类 实际分支与有限上下文 实名认证或不可伪造签名 阈值0.70 实现比较门槛 分数不是校准身份概率 70%置信或真实人群准确率 unavailable 模式不符/样本或向量等条件不足 未就绪与不匹配不同 证明不是本人或应绕过检查 最少有声样本 16000有声样本，16k下约1秒 有声统计与总录音时长 录够1秒就总能判断 收音模式 保存模式与当前模式另核 已有设置提示与原流程 更改偏好后旧资料永远适用 原交付路径 仍有前台/会话/目标守卫 当前入口真实状态 本地声音分支授予服务端写权 归档证据 只记录实际过滤范围 身份、正文真实性与授权另证 自动签收、审批或业务执行完成 合成结论记录 样例结果：bypass；原因：该本地比较未启用。只能记录未比较，不能写成“本人声音验证通过”。若结果unavailable，也保留原因范围，不伪造match或改成已授权。 声纹和声音是敏感材料；公开检查不需要真实录音、向量或资料。本文没有人群/设备、抗伪造或低噪/高噪测试，不为兼容建议关闭保护，也不把便捷功能升级成生物识别认证服务。 FAQ match能当本人已授权的证据吗？ 不能。源码明确非认证，账户、动作范围与确认仍独立核。 bypass和match是同一意思吗？ 不是。未启用时可bypass，不能说实际比较成功。 0.70代表70%身份可信度吗？ 不代表。它是分数阈值，不是经校准的概率或人群准确率。 unavailable证明声音不是本人吗？ 不证明。它可表示模式、样本或资料未就绪，与不匹配分开。 录一秒是否一定够有声样本？ 不一定。总时长和有声样本计数不同，不能拿计时替真实输入条件。 本页是否新增认证、登记或签署能力？ 没有。只核固定源码边界，不采集生物特征、不建立身份认证或授权流程。 相关指南与源码 采样权限 · 收音模式 · 确认与权限 · 开始 · 隐私 非认证注释与Decision · 原生入口与交付守卫

### What voiceprint decisions prove: convenience filtering is not identity or authority

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/voiceprint-filter-not-authorization/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What voiceprint decisions prove: convenience filtering is not identity or authority Voiceprint match is not authentication; bypass is not a successful comparison CollieVoiceprint explicitly describes a local convenience filter, not authentication, with false positives possible. Decision includes bypass, match, mismatch and unavailable. Disabled comparison can bypass without matching. Threshold 0.70 is not a 70% identity probability. No decision replaces account/target authority, phone confirmation or execution receipts. Different from sampling, routes and approval roles Sampling checks input, route review checks system state, role review checks authority. Here local sound-filter conclusions must not be elevated into identity/approval . No real voiceprint is recorded, enrolled or read, and no setting/model is changed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Disabled decide returns bypass No comparison versus match Speaker identity verified match/mismatch Score/threshold classification Actual branch/limited context Identity authentication or unforgeable signature 0.70 threshold Implementation comparison threshold Not calibrated identity probability 70% confidence or population accuracy unavailable Mode/sample/vector prerequisites missing Unready versus mismatch Not the speaker, or permission to bypass Minimum voiced samples 16000, about one second at 16 kHz Voiced count versus total duration One-second recording always sufficient Capture mode Stored/current modes separately checked Existing settings guidance/process Old profile applies after every change Original delivery Foreground/session/target guards remain Actual entry/state Local filtering grants server writes Retention evidence Actual filtering scope only Identity, truth and approval separately Automatic signing/approval/execution Synthetic decision note Result: bypass because comparison was disabled. Record not compared, not speaker verified. Unavailable likewise retains its limited cause rather than inventing match/authority. Voices/profiles are sensitive; public review needs no recordings/vectors. No population/device, anti-spoofing or noise benchmark ran. This does not recommend disabling safeguards or turn a convenience feature into biometric authentication. FAQ Can match establish the speaker authorized an operation? No. Source explicitly says non-authentication; account/scope/confirmation remain separate. Are bypass and match equivalent? No. Bypass can occur without comparison when disabled. Is 0.70 a 70% identity confidence? No. It is a score threshold, not calibrated probability/population accuracy. Does unavailable prove another speaker? No. Mode/sample/profile readiness differs from mismatch. Is one second always enough voiced audio? No. Total duration and voiced sample count differ. Is authentication/enrollment/signing added here? No. Fixed-source review collects no biometrics and establishes no new identity/authorization process. Reading and source Sampling permission · Capture mode · Confirmation/authority · Start · Privacy Non-authentication/Decision · Entry/delivery guards

### waiting分类能当审批吗？原状态、展示别名与回复资格归档核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/status-alias-approval-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 waiting分类能当审批吗？原状态、展示别名与回复资格归档核对 展示类别是派生结果，不是源状态改写、审批或回复权限 CollieRadarTaskState.classify对状态去首尾空白、转小写后匹配显式别名；waiting/pending可归waiting，done/completed可归completed，未知仍unknown。分类说明展示语义，不把源原文改成中文状态，也不独立证明批准、业务完成或具备回复权限。 与空字段默认、角色审批和批次比对的区别 空字段指南核占位，角色清单核谁能确认，批次比较核两批原材料；这里核 非空状态经过展示分类后，原始值与派生类别怎样分别归档 。不修改源、不迁移枚举，不用翻译标签打开写入口。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 原始status 来源实际给出的字符串 原文、来源和版本 类别名就是源值 分类输入 trim/lowercase后按显式别名 展示派生与原始值分开 所有控件/写入口都同样归一 waiting/pending 可分类waiting 等待何事仍需原内容 一定等你审批/验收 done/completed 可分类completed 来源状态与真实证据 证明服务执行或PM验收 未知别名 落unknown 保留原字符串与未知 自动猜成最接近的已知状态 回复资格 实际目标/能力/版本等另核 原生入口与fresh target waiting图标就授予写权 翻译/整理 人工展示标签应标明 源文与编辑说明 改成等你验收就构成批准 归档比较 保留raw status/派生类别/依据 同类不同源值与范围 分类相同就是同一次事件 合成状态归档 材料A的原status为pending，展示类别waiting；材料B原文为等你验收，也可归waiting。两者同类不证明等待对象、操作许可或同一批准相同，不应把A改成B的原文。 source状态也只代表来源声明，真实性和完成证据另核。回复是否可用取决于原有流程及当前目标，不从分类单独得出“必可回复”或“永不可回复”，更不改原值绕过守卫。 FAQ pending归waiting就能当等你验收吗？ 不能。分类合组不代表原文、等待对象或审批范围相同。 done是否证明后台已执行？ 不独立证明。它是显式来源状态的展示分类，实际执行与验收另需证据。 unknown会自动猜最接近的状态吗？ 该分类未匹配时为unknown，不应人工补造业务结论。 展示trim是否说明所有写入口都trim？ 不说明。各入口条件分别核，不能由分类函数推广。 改status标签能获得回复资格吗？ 不应这样做。原生目标/能力/版本与身份条件不由编辑标签授予。 同类状态能自动合并历史或批准吗？ 没有新增此能力。保留原值、事件与确认范围，不以类别替真实关联。 相关指南与源码 显示占位 · 角色与确认 · 批次范围 · 请求身份 · 开始 · 隐私 状态显式分类 · 原状态展示与入口 · 当前回复守卫

### Does waiting mean approval? Archive raw status, display aliases and reply eligibility

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/status-alias-approval-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Does waiting mean approval? Archive raw status, display aliases and reply eligibility A display category is not a source rewrite, approval or reply permission CollieRadarTaskState.classify trims/lowercases then matches explicit aliases. waiting/pending can map to waiting; done/completed to completed; unmatched stays unknown. Display meaning neither rewrites source text into another status nor independently proves approval, completion or reply eligibility. Different from missing defaults, roles and batch review Defaults concern placeholders, roles concern who confirms, batches concern original inputs. Here nonempty raw status versus derived display categories need separate retention. No source edit/enum migration or relabeling to unlock writes is performed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Raw status Actual supplied string Original/source/version Category is the raw value Classification Trim/lowercase explicit aliases Derived versus raw Every control/write path normalizes identically waiting/pending Can map to waiting What is awaited Your approval/acceptance necessarily awaited done/completed Can map to completed Source claim versus actual evidence Execution or PM acceptance proven Unknown alias Falls to unknown Keep original/gap Nearest known state guessed Reply eligibility Actual target/capability/version separately Original entry/fresh target Waiting icon grants writes Translation/editing Label editorial presentation Original versus explanation Relabeling creates approval Comparison/retention Raw status/category/reason Same category/different source/scope Same category means same event Synthetic status record A has raw pending and derived waiting. B has raw 等你验收, also waiting. Shared category does not establish the same recipient, operation authority or approval. Do not replace A with B’s source wording. Source status is still a source claim requiring truth/completion evidence. Reply availability depends on the original flow/current target; classification alone establishes neither always writable nor never writable, and cannot bypass guards. FAQ Can pending be treated as 等你验收? No. Grouping does not equate original text, awaited person or approval scope. Does done prove backend execution? Not independently. It classifies explicit source state; execution/acceptance need evidence. Does unknown guess the nearest state? Unmatched classification stays unknown; invent no business conclusion. Does display trimming apply to every write path? No inference follows. Inspect each entry’s conditions. Can relabeling status grant reply eligibility? No. Target/capability/version/identity authority is not granted by edited labels. Can shared category merge history or approvals? No such feature is added. Retain raw values/events/scopes instead of replacing associations with categories. Reading and source Placeholders · Roles/confirmation · Batch scope · Request identity · Start · Privacy Explicit classification · Raw display/entry · Current reply guards

### 历史反馈怎样关联原回复？目标、位置与references结构核查

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/history-reference-integrity-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 历史反馈怎样关联原回复？目标、位置与references结构核查 有后续文字不等于关联反馈，明确引用也不代表已处理 CollieRadarReplyHistory只把位置晚于原reply、kind为update且references明确指向request_id或非draft回复URL的记录关联为反馈。历史还校验目标、条目身份、位置与URL组件。它是只读来源结构，不是已读、业务完成或真实性认证；本文不新建历史库或关联引擎。 与历史检索和请求回执的分工 检索核覆盖范围，请求回执核提交结果；这里核 取到的历史结构是否属于同一目标、哪些后续记录可关联到原回复 。不访问原条目或手改私有记录。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 entry身份 id非空且不能重复，kind限reply/update 真实记录与已加载集合 同文就是同条 目标URL 核host/port/path/query等组件 不是只看域名外观 任意跨任务评论都可拼入 position 有序位置与加载计数一致 前后记录关系 时间相近就证明关联 request_id reply带合法UUID 与明确引用分别核 UUID形状就是审批/签名 references 数量/唯一性与合法引用形态校验 合法小写UUID或允许评论引用 从正文自动猜关联 feedback 后续update明确引用原reply 关联存在和内容含义分开 已读/已完成/已批准 draft历史 URL/时间字段有专门条件 草稿与非draft模式 两种材料可无条件混拼 人工归档 保留目标、原引用和未知 只记录获准范围 新建跨账户索引或不可篡改日志 合成关联核对 后续记录写“已看”，但references没有指向样例原回复：不能仅凭文字认定该reply已有反馈。反过来，有合法关联也需看实际内容，不能自动标业务处理完成。 相同目标组件不是来源可信认证；结构失败应保留缺口并回原入口核，不补造references让结果看似完整。本文未运行真实历史读取、账号授权或跨目标拼接。 FAQ 后面有人提任务就等于对本次回复反馈吗？ 不等于。当前关联需要明确引用与位置/kind条件，不能靠语义猜。 references合法就表示已处理吗？ 不表示。关联与反馈实际含义、已读和完成不同。 同域名的评论都能合进同一历史吗？ 不能这样推断。还核端口、路径、查询、目标与条目规则。 UUID形状可证明谁批准吗？ 不能。身份、权限与批准依据不是引用形状提供的。 draft与正式历史能直接混拼吗？ 不能无条件混用。两类URL/时间字段和翻页一致性要分别核。 可以补写引用来消除错误吗？ 不应伪造关联。保留原材料与缺口，沿真实来源维护流程处理。 相关指南与源码 历史检索范围 · 请求回执 · 确认范围 · 开始 · 隐私 History.validate/feedback · 只读历史加载

### Associate history feedback: target, position and references checks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/history-reference-integrity-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Associate history feedback: target, position and references checks Later text is not necessarily feedback; an explicit link is not completion CollieRadarReplyHistory associates only later-position updates whose references explicitly identify the reply’s request_id or, outside draft mode, its URL. History also checks target, entry identity, positions and URL components. This read-only structure is not reading, completion or truth certification. No history database/association engine is added. Different from retrieval and request receipts Retrieval checks coverage; receipts check submission. Here whether fetched history belongs to the target and which records associate with a reply matters. No original is fetched or private record edited. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Entry identity Nonempty unique id, reply/update kinds Actual entries/loaded IDs Identical text means same record Target URL Host/port/path/query checks More than domain appearance Any cross-task comment can be merged Position Order/loading counts consistent Earlier/later relationship Nearby times establish association request_id Reply has valid UUID Actual explicit reference UUID proves approval/signature references Count/uniqueness/reference shape Canonical lowercase UUID or permitted comment reference Body semantics guessed Feedback Later update explicitly references reply Association versus meaning Read/done/approved Draft history Specific URL/time-field conditions Draft versus non-draft Unconditional mixed history Editorial retention Target/original links/unknowns Authorized scope only Cross-account index/immutable log Synthetic association review A later entry says seen but references do not identify the original sample reply. Prose alone does not establish feedback for that reply. Conversely, valid association still needs content review instead of automatic handled status. Matching target components does not authenticate origin. Keep structural gaps instead of fabricating references. No real history read, account authorization or cross-target merge ran. FAQ Does any later mention establish feedback? No. Explicit references, position and kind matter; no semantic guessing. Do valid references mean handled? No. Association differs from actual feedback, reading and completion. Can all same-domain comments form one history? No. Port/path/query, target and entry rules also apply. Does UUID shape prove an approver? No. Reference shape provides neither identity nor authority. Can draft and formal history be freely combined? No. URL/time and paging consistency need separate review. Can invented references repair a failure? Do not fabricate associations. Preserve originals/gaps and use real source maintenance. Reading and source Retrieval scope · Request receipts · Confirmation scope · Start · Privacy History validation/feedback · Read-only loading

### 停止、取消与迟到回调怎样区分？短语音activeToken核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/capture-completion-token-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 停止、取消与迟到回调怎样区分？短语音activeToken核对 stop后可有本次排空结果，cancel后旧令牌不能代表新会话 短语音start为采集创建UUID令牌，captureCompleted只接纳与activeToken相同的完成。stop先停止接纳并让管线排空，不立即废掉本次令牌；cancel清activeToken并取消管线。相同界面阶段或迟到回调不能代替会话归属核对；这是进程内完成守卫，不是身份认证或跨服务exactly-once。 与前台生命周期和队列压力的分工 前台指南核请求何时失效，压力指南核snapshot/final；这里核 异步结果属于哪次采集，停止和取消为何不能互换 。不触发录音、取消或回调注入。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 start 每次捕获令牌对应当次完成闭包 当前有效采集 UUID就是用户授权 stop 停止接纳、引擎停止后异步排空 本次final或失败 按钮点下即已完成或完全取消 cancel 清activeToken、取消管线 已取消与已发生结果分别核 撤回服务端副作用 captureCompleted 先比activeToken与token 旧结果不冒新会话 文字相同就可接到当前目标 完成后清理 令牌与管线等状态清理 真实完成结果与错误 所有调用链永不重复 预览/音量 与final/令牌不是同证据 已有预览何时生成 迟到预览证明最终送达 目标交付 仍有控制器/插入等原守卫 当前目标和许可 采集令牌授写权 重新采集 新次操作与旧副作用分开 缺口/版本/旧尝试 自动补录、合并或重发 合成时序核对 采集甲已cancel；随后收到携带甲令牌的完成，而当前令牌不是甲。不能把该结果说成新采集乙或自动交接。若只是stop，仍可能等待甲的正常排空结果；两种情况不可混记。 这里不提供绝对无竞态/无丢失保证，不推断所有路径都会自动恢复。令牌是实现关联，不是账户凭据或签名；旧副作用仍沿原回执和不确定停止检查。 FAQ stop等于cancel吗？ 不等于。stop保留本次异步排空路径，cancel使旧令牌失效并取消管线。 旧回调带UUID就可接新草稿吗？ 不能。先核当前有效令牌，还需原目标/许可守卫。 activeToken是否身份认证？ 不是。它是采集内关联状态，不提供身份或业务操作权。 点停止是否已经拿到final？ 不能直接推断，需等实际完成或失败，不从按钮事件报结果。 取消能撤回之前已写入的内容吗？ 不能由取消推出撤回；实际旧内容/远端副作用另核。 本页是否证明所有回调零竞态？ 没有。只核固定源码守卫，未运行设备/并发测试或新增恢复功能。 相关指南与源码 生命周期 · 队列与最终结果 · 重录范围 · 开始 · 隐私 start/stop/cancel/captureCompleted · 管线停止与取消

### Stop, cancel and late capture callbacks: inspect activeToken ownership

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/capture-completion-token-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Stop, cancel and late capture callbacks: inspect activeToken ownership Stop can yield this capture's drained result; canceled tokens cannot identify a new capture Short-speech start creates a UUID; captureCompleted accepts only the matching activeToken. Stop ends admission and drains without immediately invalidating this capture’s token. Cancel clears activeToken and cancels the pipeline. Similar UI phases/late callbacks do not establish ownership. This is in-process completion guarding, not authentication or cross-service exactly-once. Different from foreground and queue review Foreground checks lifecycle validity; pressure checks previews/final. Here which capture owns an asynchronous result and why stop differs from cancel matters. No capture, cancellation or callback injection ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Start Per-capture token in completion closure Current active capture UUID grants user authority Stop End admission/engine, drain asynchronously Actual final/error Tap means complete cancellation or success Cancel Clear activeToken/cancel pipeline Canceled versus committed effects Remote recall captureCompleted Compare activeToken/token first Old result is not a new capture Same text belongs to current target Cleanup Clears token/pipeline etc. Actual completion/error All call chains duplicate-free Preview/level Different evidence from final/token When preview was generated Late preview proves delivery Delivery Controller/insertion guards remain Actual target/permission Capture token grants writes Recapture New capture versus prior effects Gap/version/old attempt Automatic fill/merge/resend Synthetic timing review Capture A was canceled. A’s late completion arrives while activeToken no longer identifies A. It cannot be presented as new capture B or automatically handed off. If A merely stopped, its drain can still complete; record the distinction. No race-free/zero-loss guarantee is made. Tokens are implementation association, not credentials/signatures. Prior effects retain original receipt/uncertainty review. FAQ Is stop the same as cancel? No. Stop retains asynchronous draining; cancel invalidates the token/pipeline. Can a UUID-bearing old result join a new draft? No. Current ownership and target/permission guards still apply. Is activeToken authentication? No. Capture association does not grant identity or operation authority. Does stop tapping mean final exists? No. Inspect actual completion/error rather than button events. Does cancellation recall prior inserted contents? No inference follows. Inspect actual prior/local/remote effects. Does this establish no callback races? No device/concurrency test or recovery feature is supplied; fixed guards only. Reading and source Lifecycle · Queue/final · Recapture scope · Start · Privacy Capture lifecycle/token · Pipeline stop/cancel

### 恢复的回复草稿属于谁？submitted、原目标与来源绑定核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/reply-draft-restoration-scope/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 恢复的回复草稿属于谁？submitted、原目标与来源绑定核对 恢复文字不是提交回执，也可能仍属于先前目标 原生回复会按工作台读取本地记录，核保存来源后恢复text、target、requestID。submitted明确false视为提交前草稿；缺失等情况保守按待核处理。恢复的目标可与当前选择不同，prepare会提示先处理原草稿。文本出现不代表服务器已收到，也不代表新目标获授权。 与待核回执和材料归档的分工 回执指南核已尝试提交的结果，材料归档核评审引用；这里核 提交前本地草稿怎样恢复，以及它与当前选择/来源的关系 。不编辑或删除实际文件，不新增云草稿、同步或后台代发。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 读取本地记录 有大小/解码/来源URL条件 读取失败与原材料保留 静默丢坏文件再发送 来源匹配 saved.source须匹配当前来源 真实来源和现有状态 同名工作台就是同源 恢复字段 text/target/requestID一起看 草稿原目标与当前选择 文字显示就属于当前点开的任务 submitted=false 提交前草稿分支 实际持久结果与当前许可 服务器已记录或自动批准 submitted缺失/不明 恢复按待核处理 先沿查回流程 当作绝对未提交安全重发 prepare 重新读目标并提示变化 最新状态/next与原目标 本地旧版本永远有效 无法读取 blocked并保留原记录 原错误和维护流程 改名/删标记绕过待核 人工归档 草稿/提交/回执分账 最小获准材料与版本 永久档案、云同步或接力执行 合成恢复核对 当前选中样例任务乙，但恢复草稿targetID为先前任务甲。不能把甲的文字当乙的批准或直接更改归属；先核原草稿与最新目标。submitted未知也不能自动填false。 草稿保存成功仍是本地阶段，保存失败提示保留当前页面输入也不是备份保证。原canSend、来源/目标、4000 Unicode标量等条件仍适用；本文不给改内部字段绕过检查的方法。 FAQ 恢复出文字说明已经发给服务了吗？ 不说明。草稿、submitted待核与recorded是不同状态。 草稿必定属于当前点击的任务吗？ 不必，恢复可指向先前条目，需核target与提示。 submitted缺失是否按false理解？ 当前恢复采取保守待核，而非绝对未提交，不据此盲发。 来源变更后能自动带草稿过去吗？ 不能这样推断。读取核来源，异常会阻塞并保留原记录。 本地草稿算永久云备份吗？ 不是。没有新增云同步/永久保留或恢复SLA。 可以改内部文件来解锁发送吗？ 不应绕过守卫或伪造状态。沿真实来源/目标及既有维护流程核。 相关指南与源码 待核与回执 · 材料归档 · 目标与上下文 · 开始 · 隐私 初始化恢复/prepare/preserveDraft/canSend · PendingReply字段

### Whose restored reply draft is this? submitted, original target and source binding

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/reply-draft-restoration-scope/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Whose restored reply draft is this? submitted, original target and source binding Restored text is not a receipt and may still belong to the earlier target Native replies load per-workbench local records, verify saved source and restore text, target and requestID. Explicit submitted=false denotes an unsent draft; missing/unclear state conservatively restores pending. The target can differ from current selection, with prepare prompting review of the earlier draft. Visible text proves neither server receipt nor authority for a new target. Different from pending receipts and material retention Receipts inspect attempted writes; retention maps review material. Here local pre-submit restoration and its source/selection relationship matter. No file is edited/deleted, and no cloud draft/sync/background sender is added. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Local read Size/decode/source URL conditions Failure/original retained record Silently discard bad files and send Source match saved.source must match Actual source/state Same workbench name means same source Restored fields Text/target/requestID together Original target/current selection Text belongs to newly opened task submitted=false Unsent draft branch Persistence/current authority Server recorded or approved Missing submitted Conservative pending restoration Original check flow Definitely unsent, safely retry Prepare Fresh target read/change notice Status/next/original target Old local version always valid Unreadable record Blocked, original retained Actual error/maintenance Rename/delete markers to bypass Editorial archive Draft/submit/receipt separated Minimal authorized material/version Permanent archive/cloud relay Synthetic restoration review Task B is selected, but restored targetID identifies earlier task A. Do not reinterpret A’s text as B’s approval or silently change ownership. Review original/latest target; unknown submitted cannot be filled false. Saved drafts remain local. Failure notices preserving current-page input are not backup guarantees. Original canSend/source/target/4000-Unicode-scalar conditions remain; no internal-file bypass instructions are supplied. FAQ Does restored text mean service receipt? No. Draft, pending submit and recorded differ. Must a draft belong to the clicked task? No. It can restore an earlier item; inspect target/notices. Does absent submitted mean false? Current restoration conservatively treats it pending, not definitely unsent. Do drafts automatically transfer to a changed source? Do not infer that. Source checks can block while retaining originals. Is a local draft permanent cloud backup? No cloud sync/retention/restore SLA is added. Can internal file edits unlock sending? Do not bypass guards or fabricate state. Use actual source/target and existing maintenance. Reading and source Pending/receipts · Material retention · Target/context · Start · Privacy Restore/prepare/preserveDraft/canSend · PendingReply fields

### 切换Radar源前核什么？旧缓存、待核记录与迟到读取隔离

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/source-switch-cache-isolation/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 切换Radar源前核什么？旧缓存、待核记录与迟到读取隔离 配置改成新源，不表示旧缓存或旧请求可当新源材料 CollieRadarStore在source字段实际变化时先查本地回复记录，未处理时拒绝切源；旧缓存清理失败也不提交本次来源变更。成功路径递增本地sourceRevisions、清内存快照、更新Watch来源标识并重置部分筛选。异步读取写入前核revision，不把旧源迟到结果作为新源成功。 与源URL、离线缓存及草稿恢复的区别 URL指南核地址形状，离线指南核读取失败，草稿指南核原目标；这里核 切换配置时旧数据与新来源的隔离范围 。不切真实源、不删缓存、不修改待核记录或凭据。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 变更判断 去首尾空白后的source比较 真实变更与改名称分开 所有设置修改都等于切源 本地回复记录 存在时先处理草稿/待核 原请求和原目标 改源可清掉不确定状态 旧缓存清理 删除失败则拒本次切源 实际错误与原配置 忽略失败也已安全切换 内存快照 成功路径清该工作台快照 清本地显示与源数据分开 服务器历史/任务被删除 sourceRevisions 本机内部读取隔离计数 旧任务捕获值与当前值 服务端数据版本或认证 Watch标识 更新watchSourceIdentity 本地来源呈现身份 所有手表旧数据已擦除 筛选重置 project/status/priority重置 这些项不代表全部偏好 新源任务不存在/已完成 异步结果 存储前及后续读取核revision 晚到数据不能冒新源 旧网络请求从未发出或已撤回 合成切源核对 旧请求甲捕获revision甲，配置成功切换后当前revision为乙。甲返回不能被说成乙的最新读取。若旧缓存清理失败，则先报告未切源，不把准备动作当已成功保存。 本机标识不是后端身份凭据，显示重置不是业务迁移。本文不承诺跨设备原子同步、恢复或全量清理；原来源权限、未完成回复与实际保留规则继续有效。 FAQ 切源能绕过旧待核回复吗？ 不能。存在回复记录时该变更路径要求先处理，不通过改URL重置不确定性。 清旧缓存失败还会提交新源吗？ 引用路径会报告失败并拒本次来源变更，不能报成功切换。 revision就是服务器任务版本吗？ 不是。sourceRevisions是客户端内部隔离状态，与业务版本/认证分账。 筛选重置表示所有任务消失吗？ 不表示。这里只重置部分显示条件，不改服务器业务材料。 旧请求被忽略说明根本没联网吗？ 不说明。忽略结果与旧请求是否已发出不同，不承诺网络撤回。 本文执行了切源或缓存删除吗？ 没有。只读源码核范围，无真实配置/数据修改。 相关指南与源码 源URL · 离线与旧值 · 草稿所属 · 开始 · 隐私 update/refresh隔离 · 来源与显示模型

### Before changing a Radar source: old cache, pending records and late reads

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/source-switch-cache-isolation/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before changing a Radar source: old cache, pending records and late reads A new configured source cannot make old cache or late reads new-source evidence On an actual source-field change, CollieRadarStore checks local reply records and refuses switching while unresolved. Failed old-cache cleanup also prevents the change. The success path increments local sourceRevisions, clears the snapshot, updates Watch source identity and resets selected filters. Reads check revision before storage instead of treating an old response as new-source success. Different from URL, offline and draft review URL checks shape, offline checks read failure, drafts check original targets. Here configuration-change isolation between old data and new source matters. No live source/cache/record/credential is changed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Change test Trimmed source comparison Actual source change versus rename Every settings edit is a source switch Reply records Resolve draft/pending first Original request/target Switching erases uncertainty Old cache Failure refuses switch Actual error/original configuration Ignored failure is safe success Snapshot Cleared on success path Local display versus server data Server history/tasks deleted sourceRevisions Client-local isolation counter Captured versus current revision Server version/authentication Watch identity watchSourceIdentity updated Local presentation identity All Watch copies erased Filters project/status/priority reset These versus all preferences Tasks absent/completed Async results Revision checked before stores/follow-up Late data is not a new read Old network request never sent/recalled Synthetic switch review Old read A captured revision A; after a successful configuration change current revision is B. A’s response is not B’s latest read. If cleanup failed, report no switch rather than turning preparation into successful persistence. Local IDs are not backend credentials, and display resets are not business migration. No atomic cross-device sync, restore or total-cleanup guarantee is supplied. Original permissions, unresolved replies and retention policies remain. FAQ Can source switching bypass a pending reply? No. This change path requires resolving existing reply records instead of resetting uncertainty through URLs. Does failed cache cleanup still commit the source? The cited path refuses the change; do not report a successful switch. Is revision a server task version? No. sourceRevisions is local isolation, separate from business version/identity. Does a filter reset mean all tasks vanished? No. Selected display conditions reset without modifying server material. Does an ignored response mean no network request happened? No. Discarding results is not recalling an issued request. Was a source/cache changed here? No. Fixed-source inspection only, without live configuration/data modification. Reading and source Feed URL · Offline/old data · Draft ownership · Start · Privacy Update/read isolation · Source/display models

### 音量条能证明什么？RMS电平不是识别概率、风噪评分或送达

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/audio-level-not-accuracy-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 音量条能证明什么？RMS电平不是识别概率、风噪评分或送达 电平有变化不等于说对了，条满也不是100%识别成功 短语音PCM管线从样本RMS缩放并限制到0至1，长笔记写入路径用另一缩放系数。它们是电平显示，不是识别置信度、声纹身份、风噪等级或送达回执。不同路径同一条长也不能直接比较音质；本页不新增声学评分或校准工具。 与无声排障、声纹和原话核对的区别 排障核哪里无声，声纹核便捷过滤范围，听核核实际内容；这里核 电平公式与UI显示最多能支持什么结论 。不采集真实音频或设置系统音量。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 短语音电平 RMS乘2后限制范围 显示比例与原始样本 0.5就是50%识别概率 长笔记电平 RMS乘12并上限1 不同路径缩放不同 同条长代表同音压/音质 上限裁剪 较大值可都显示满 信号与显示饱和区别 100%就每词正确 接近0 可能安静/尚无新样本等 实际状态、输入和错误 必定没权限/没录到任何内容 定时显示 读当前管线电平 显示时点与final分开 实时无延迟或全程已保存 RMS度量 样本能量统计 未校准设备/环境 标准dB SPL或噪声认证 文字与身份 ASR/声纹另有路径 实际结果和原文 有电平就识别/本人确认通过 交接证据 目标/回执仍另核 已保存与已送达分别看 电平截图代替业务完成 合成数值示意 用两个合成样本0.1与-0.1，RMS为0.1。短语音公式示意约0.2；长笔记缩放到1.2后裁剪为1。只是数学示意，不是麦克风实测、物理音压或路径对比成绩。 看到满条应继续核实际内容与错误，不从显示推导权限、模型就绪或目标选择。声音是敏感材料，公开检查不需要客户录音；本文未做设备、风噪或识别准确率验收。 FAQ 满条是否100%识别成功？ 不是。它是电平显示裁剪，不是ASR置信度。 两条路径同样长度可比较音质吗？ 不能直接比，缩放不同且未校准声学量。 零电平就能证明没授权吗？ 不能单独证明，应核实际授权、路由、采集和错误。 RMS是否标准分贝读数？ 不是本文提供的校准dB SPL测量，不推标准声学认证。 电平正常是否证明说话人正确或内容完整？ 不证明。声纹、原词、保存和转写结果分别核。 本文运行过噪声/麦克风测试吗？ 没有。合成数学示意不冒设备或真实场景成绩。 相关指南与源码 输入排障 · 声纹范围 · 音文材料 · 预览与final · 开始 · 隐私 短语音RMS · 长笔记电平 · 电平显示读取

</tr>

<td>交接证据</td>
<td>目标/回执仍另核</td>
<td>已保存与已送达分别看</td>
<td>电平截图代替业务完成</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### What an audio meter proves: RMS is not accuracy, wind score or delivery

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/audio-level-not-accuracy-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What an audio meter proves: RMS is not accuracy, wind score or delivery A moving meter is not correct speech, and full scale is not 100% recognition Short-speech PCM scales sample RMS into a 0–1 range; long-note writes use another multiplier. These are level displays, not recognition confidence, voiceprint identity, wind rating or delivery receipts. Matching bar lengths across paths do not directly compare sound quality. No acoustic scoring/calibration tool is added. Different from silence, voiceprint and original-word review Diagnosis checks missing audio, voiceprint review checks filtering scope, listening checks content. Here what meter formulas/displays establish matters. No real capture or system-volume change occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Short speech RMS multiplied by 2, bounded Display scale/raw samples 0.5 means 50% recognition confidence Long note RMS multiplied by 12, capped at 1 Different path scaling Same length means same pressure/quality Clipping Many large values look full Signal versus display saturation Full means every word correct Near zero Can be quiet/no new samples etc. Actual state/input/errors Permission absent or nothing captured Timer display Reads current pipeline level Display time versus final Zero latency/all audio saved RMS Sample-energy statistic No device/environment calibration Standard dB SPL/noise certification Text/identity Separate ASR/voiceprint paths Actual results/originals Energy proves recognition/speaker match Handoff Target/receipt separately checked Saved versus delivered Screenshot proves business completion Synthetic arithmetic Two synthetic samples 0.1 and -0.1 have RMS 0.1. The short-speech illustration is about 0.2; long-note scaling gives 1.2 capped to 1. This is math, not microphone measurement, physical pressure or comparative performance. Inspect real content/errors even with a full meter. Display does not establish permission, model readiness or selected target. Public checks need no customer recordings; no device/wind/accuracy test ran. FAQ Does full scale mean 100% recognition? No. Display clipping is not ASR confidence. Can equal bars compare path quality? Not directly; scaling differs and no acoustic calibration is supplied. Does zero prove no permission? Not independently. Review permission, route, capture and errors. Is RMS a standard decibel reading? No calibrated dB SPL measurement/certification is provided here. Does a normal meter prove identity or complete content? No. Filtering, original words, saving and transcription differ. Were noise/microphone tests run? No. Synthetic arithmetic is not actual device/scenario evidence. Reading and source Input diagnosis · Voiceprint scope · Audio/text evidence · Preview/final · Start · Privacy Short-speech RMS · Long-note levels · Meter reads

### 笔记从列表删除后能证明什么？异步回写、磁盘与远端材料分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-removal-retention-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 笔记从列表删除后能证明什么？异步回写、磁盘与远端材料分账 列表移除不是所有副本已删除，也不是可恢复或不可恢复证明 笔记delete路径拒绝删除当前recordingID；为其他笔记记入内存deleted集合，必要时暂停转写，尝试移除本地目录后移出列表并清进度。save会检查deleted避免异步回写。但目录移除用try?，列表变化不独立验证物理删除成功，也不提供永久墓碑、安全擦除或远端撤回。 与材料最小化和音文映射的分工 最小化核该保留什么，音文映射核材料对应；这里核 实际删除入口的本地状态、异步防回写和保留证据范围 。本页不删除任何文件、不恢复备份，也不建议改内部状态绕过守卫。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 当前录音 note.id等于recordingID则返回 实际录音状态 任意时刻都可无损删除 deleted集合 内存记录被删id 本实例save检查范围 跨重启永久墓碑 异步save 命中deleted则不再回写 旧转写结果与原材料分开 所有磁盘/同步副本都消失 正在转写 暂停并按流程恢复其他待处理 任务状态与实际内容 永久停止所有录音/转写 目录移除 try?尝试删除 不能仅凭列表报磁盘验证 安全擦除/不可恢复保证 列表与进度 移出notes并清progress 显示变化不等物理结果 不会在任何条件再出现 已交接副本 上传/草稿/服务状态另核 实际目的地与回执 本地删除等远端撤回 归档决定 既有目的/权限/保留规则 必要原件与批准范围 本表授权销毁全部证据 合成本地移除记录 观察：样例笔记不在当前列表。未证：目录移除是否成功、其他目的地是否有副本。只能报告当前列表状态，不宣布所有原件已安全擦除或能从备份找回。 删除涉及真实数据时仍按实际授权流程执行，不能为演示清理资料。本文只读源码，不提供永久删除、灾后恢复、合规认证或撤销已发生交接的服务。 FAQ 列表没了就证明文件成功删除吗？ 不能单独证明。该路径尝试移除并更新列表，不能替代真实文件状态核查。 deleted集合是不是永久删除证书？ 不是。它是内存防回写守卫，不是永久墓碑或擦除认证。 删除能让先前服务附件也撤回吗？ 不能这样推断，目的地副本和服务规则另核。 当前正在录的笔记会被这个入口直接删吗？ 源码有recordingID守卫，不把所有状态都说成可删。 移除失败是否保证可恢复？ 没有此保证，实际文件/副本和权限另核，不自动当备份。 本文是否删除或恢复了数据？ 没有。真实删除/恢复需实际授权，本文仅核源码和证据范围。 相关指南与源码 材料最小化 · 音文对应 · 旧副作用与回执 · 开始 · 隐私 delete/save/recordingID · 元数据与交接标记

### After a note leaves the list: async saves, disk removal and remote copies differ

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-removal-retention-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide After a note leaves the list: async saves, disk removal and remote copies differ List removal proves neither deletion of every copy nor recoverability Note deletion refuses the current recordingID. For other notes it records an in-memory deleted id, pauses transcription if needed, attempts directory removal, updates the list and clears progress. save checks deleted against async rewrites. Removal uses try?, so list changes do not independently verify disk deletion, permanent tombstones, secure erasure or remote recall. Different from minimization and audio/text mapping Minimization decides what to retain; mapping identifies material. Here local removal state, async-save guards and retention evidence matter. No actual file deletion, restore or internal-state bypass is performed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Active recording Matching recordingID returns Actual recording state Lossless deletion at any moment deleted set In-memory removed IDs This instance’s save scope Permanent cross-restart tombstone Async save Skip deleted IDs Old work versus originals All disk/sync copies erased Transcribing note Pause then resume other pending work Actual task/content state Every recording/transcription permanently stops Directory try? removal attempt List alone is not disk verification Secure/irrecoverable erasure List/progress Remove notes/clear progress Presentation versus physical result Never reappears under any condition Prior handoff Uploads/drafts/service separately Destination/receipts Local deletion recalls remote files Retention decision Existing purpose/authority/policy Necessary originals/approval scope Checklist authorizes all evidence destruction Synthetic removal note Observed: sample note absent from current list. Unknown: directory-removal success and other destinations. Report list state only, not complete erasure or available backup recovery. Real deletion still needs actual authorization; do not destroy material for demonstrations. This read-only guide offers no permanent erasure, disaster recovery, compliance certification or handoff recall service. FAQ Does absent-from-list prove successful file deletion? Not independently. Attempted removal/list updates do not verify disk state. Is deleted a permanent deletion certificate? No. It is an in-memory save guard, not a permanent tombstone/erasure certificate. Does deleting recall a previously shared attachment? No inference follows. Destination copies/service policy need review. Can this entry delete the active recording? The source has a recordingID guard; not every state is deletable. Does removal failure guarantee recovery? No. Actual files/copies/permissions need evidence; do not assume a backup. Was any data deleted/restored here? No. Actual deletion/restore needs authorization; source scope only. Reading and source Minimization · Audio/text mapping · Prior effects/receipts · Start · Privacy Delete/save/recordingID · Metadata/handoff marker

### 笔记存为Radar草稿前：候选目标为什么不等于已具备回复写权

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-radar-draft-candidate-preflight/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 笔记存为Radar草稿前：候选目标为什么不等于已具备回复写权 看见候选只说明本地筛选通过，保存草稿不是提交回复 writableDraftCandidates从本地工作台与快照枚举目标：源URL形态有效、无本地回复记录、指定待决策/验收状态及非空id。该枚举不额外证明reply_supported或快照时效。保存后target设eligible=false、epoch/version为空且submitted=false，仍需原生prepare/确认；不是自动发送或商机采集后台。 与草稿恢复、状态别名和多笔记交接的分工 恢复核旧草稿所属，别名核展示语义，多笔记核原文顺序；这里核 语音笔记进入Radar本地草稿前的候选范围和保存结果 。不操作真实笔记、候选或服务。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 候选来源 本地ordered工作台及snapshot.allTasks 实际来源与原条目 全组织任务发现/同步 候选条件 有效源URL、无本地记录、原状态/非空id 缺项原因与已有记录 有候选等服务已开放写权 非候选保证 枚举未额外核reply_supported/时效 后续真实目标与能力 候选就是新鲜可提交 保存时复核 工作台/source/id/url/状态等再比 候选是否已变更 列表快照永远有效 文字 去首尾空白且最多4000 Unicode标量 原文与实际保存范围 字符/字节预算可混用 保存草稿 eligible=false、epoch/version空、submitted=false 本地记录与后续prepare 已提交/授权/执行 笔记标记 shell先reserveHandOff再保存 失败可能已有预留 保存失败可盲重放 后续动作 原canSend/来源/目标/确认仍核 真实回执与旧副作用 自动批量分发或回写CRM 合成候选核对 有样例候选甲，但服务能力/时效尚未核。结论：候选不是可提交证明；即使本地草稿保存成功，仍不能标已发送。若保存失败，先核笔记一次标记与本地记录，不跳过旧尝试。 本文没有创建新目标发现器或回复适配服务。候选名称含writable不代表所有写条件已满足；界面动作只支持它真实执行的阶段。 FAQ 候选出现证明reply_supported=true吗？ 不证明。该枚举不额外检查此字段，原生后续能力/目标仍需核。 没候选就表示没有任务吗？ 不能，可能无快照、状态/id不符或已有本地记录；不从筛选缺项推全局不存在。 存为草稿是否提交到后台？ 引用路径写本地未提交记录，不把它当服务已收或审批。 为什么eligible是false？ 本地草稿不预授写权，后续沿原prepare和确认取得真实目标状态。 保存失败能直接换目标再试吗？ 不能盲试，shell可先预留笔记交接标记，需核旧状态与结果。 本文新增自动商机归档或批量写入吗？ 没有。只核已有本地草稿候选路径，不提供托管后台或自动分发。 相关指南与源码 草稿所属 · 状态与资格 · 笔记一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 候选与本地草稿 · 预留后保存顺序 · 已有候选入口

### Before saving a note as a Radar draft: candidates do not grant reply access

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-radar-draft-candidate-preflight/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Before saving a note as a Radar draft: candidates do not grant reply access A visible candidate passed local filters; draft saving is not reply submission writableDraftCandidates enumerates local workbenches/snapshots with valid feed shape, no local reply record, specified decision/acceptance states and nonempty id. Enumeration does not additionally establish reply_supported or freshness. Saved targets use eligible=false, empty epoch/version and submitted=false; original prepare/confirmation remains. No automatic sender or opportunity-collection backend is added. Different from restoration, aliases and multi-note review Restoration checks old ownership, aliases check display, multi-note review checks originals/order. Here local Radar draft candidate scope and save results matter. No real note, target or service is operated. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Enumeration Local ordered workbenches/snapshot.allTasks Actual source/original item Organization-wide discovery/sync Filters Feed shape/no local record/status/nonempty id Gaps/existing records Service write access established Not established No extra reply_supported/freshness check Later actual target/capability Candidate is fresh/submittable Save recheck Workbench/source/id/url/state etc. Candidate changed since enumeration List snapshot permanently valid Text Trimmed, at most 4000 Unicode scalars Original/actual saved scope Bytes/characters interchangeable Draft eligible=false, empty epoch/version, submitted=false Local record/later prepare Submitted/authorized/executed Reservation Shell calls reserveHandOff before save Failure may follow reservation Blind replay safe after save failure Later action Original source/target/canSend/confirmation Real receipts/prior effects Automatic bulk dispatch/CRM writes Synthetic candidate review Sample candidate A exists; capability/freshness unreviewed. A candidate does not prove submission readiness. A successful local save is not sent. On failure inspect note reservation/local state before another attempt. No target-discovery/reply-adapter service is created. writable in a name does not establish every write prerequisite; report the stage actually performed. FAQ Does appearing prove reply_supported=true? No. Enumeration does not additionally check that field; later capability/target review remains. Does no candidate mean no tasks exist? No. Snapshot/status/id/local-record filters can exclude entries. Does saving a draft submit to a backend? The cited path writes a local unsent record, not server receipt/approval. Why eligible=false? A local draft grants no writes; actual target preparation/confirmation remains. Can failed save be retried with another target immediately? Not blindly. The shell may already have reserved the note handoff; inspect state/results. Is automatic opportunity archiving/bulk writing added? No. Existing local draft flow only, without hosted backend or dispatch. Reading and source Draft ownership · Status/eligibility · One handoff · Start · Privacy Candidates/local draft · Reservation/save order · Existing candidate UI

### 恢复通知为什么被抑制？2秒去抖窗口不是恢复时限或零漏报保证

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/audio-recovery-debounce-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 恢复通知为什么被抑制？2秒去抖窗口不是恢复时限或零漏报保证 2秒是通知抑制策略，不是两秒内必恢复或必须等待两秒 CollieAudioRecoveryChangeDebouncer默认窗口2秒。匹配expectedToken、未过deadline、引擎运行且格式/路由未变时可抑制通知，并保留整个窗口的预期。源码也说明窗口内真实同路由/格式变化可能被忽略。这是策略权衡，不是零漏报、零延迟或所有音频恢复成功证明。 与恢复矩阵、回调令牌的分工 矩阵核不同系统事件，完成令牌核结果属于哪次采集；这里核 为何等价通知没有按每次通知重新报告，以及抑制条件的证据范围 。不发送系统事件、不改时间窗口或音频配置。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 arm 保存token与deadline 本次预期窗口 新权限或恢复已完成 默认2秒 配置的gracePeriod 范围不是响应SLA 两秒必恢复/要先等两秒 token不符 不抑制该通知 采集关联 UUID提供账户认证 其他条件不符 过期/停引擎/格式或路由变化则重置并不抑制 实际输入条件 所有异常都永不漏报 全条件满足 可抑制并保留窗口 多个同类通知可在窗口内 只抑制第一条 真实同形态变化 仍可能被窗口策略忽略 源码承认的边界 每条真实变化都会提示 UI/内容 通知处理与录文不同 当前音频/错误/final 无提示就证明录音完美 后续操作 原恢复/目标/交接门继续 旧副作用和未知 自动重录重发或强制重绑 合成去抖核对 同token、窗口内、引擎仍运行、格式和路由未变：可报告命中抑制条件，而不是宣称事件不存在或恢复性能达标。实际条件变了则沿原入口核，不手动伪造相同标志让通知被吞。 这是固定源码逻辑，不是来电/蓝牙/风噪真机矩阵。本页不承诺所有系统通知都可判真伪，也不将时间配置升级为服务SLA。 FAQ 2秒是不是恢复服务承诺？ 不是。它是去抖窗口，不等于必恢复、时延或硬件成绩。 只会抑制第一次通知吗？ 不是，匹配条件时预期保留整个窗口，可覆盖多个同类通知。 相同路由/格式的真实变化一定会提示吗？ 不保证，源码明确窗口内可被抑制，这是需保留的边界。 token匹配是否证明本人授权？ 不证明，只是当前恢复预期的关联条件。 没有提示就可以报录文完整吗？ 不能。通知状态、实际音频、最终文字和交接各自核。 本文做了系统通知/外设测试吗？ 没有。只核条件逻辑，未改配置或注入事件。 相关指南与源码 恢复矩阵 · 采集令牌 · 显示与证据 · 开始 · 隐私 RecoveryChangeDebouncer与调用路径

### Why recovery notifications are suppressed: a two-second window is not a recovery SLA

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/audio-recovery-debounce-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why recovery notifications are suppressed: a two-second window is not a recovery SLA Two seconds is notification policy, not guaranteed recovery or a mandatory wait CollieAudioRecoveryChangeDebouncer defaults to two seconds. Matching expectedToken, unexpired deadline, running engine and unchanged format/route permit suppression while retaining expectation for the window. Source also acknowledges genuine same-route/format changes can be ignored then. This tradeoff is not zero-miss, zero-latency or universal recovery evidence. Different from event recovery and completion tokens Recovery matrices cover event types; completion tokens identify capture results. Here why equivalent notices need not each surface and what suppression proves matters. No events, timing configuration or audio settings are changed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Arm Save token/deadline Current expected window Authority/recovery completed Default two seconds Configured gracePeriod Scope, not response SLA Guaranteed recovery/mandatory wait Wrong token Do not suppress Capture association Account authentication Other mismatch Expired/stopped/changed format or route resets without suppression Actual inputs Every anomaly always detected All match Suppress, keep expectation Multiple notices in window First notice only Genuine same-shape change Can still be ignored Acknowledged boundary Every genuine event surfaces UI/content Notice handling differs from speech Audio/errors/final No notice means perfect capture Later action Original recovery/target/handoff guards Prior effects/unknowns Automatic recapture/resend/forced rebind Synthetic debounce review Same token, inside the window, engine running, unchanged format/route: report matching suppression conditions, not that no event occurred or recovery performance passed. Changed conditions retain original handling; do not falsify flags to suppress notices. Fixed-source logic is not call/Bluetooth/wind device acceptance. No universal event-truth detector or SLA follows from timing settings. FAQ Is two seconds a recovery promise? No. Debouncing is not guaranteed recovery, latency or hardware evidence. Is only the first notice suppressed? No. Matching expectations persist through the window for multiple notices. Must every real same-route/format change surface? No. Source acknowledges suppression within this policy window. Does matching token prove user authority? No. It associates recovery expectation only. Can no warning prove complete transcription? No. Notices, audio, final text and handoff need separate evidence. Were system/accessory tests run? No. Condition review only, without setting changes/event injection. Reading and source Recovery matrix · Capture tokens · Display/evidence · Start · Privacy Recovery debouncer/call path

### 本地文件保护能证明什么？atomic、备份排除与不同载体分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/local-file-protection-scope/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 本地文件保护能证明什么？atomic、备份排除与不同载体分账 本地写选项不能替代传输、远端、备份与保留规则 源码不同路径使用不同文件选项：部分iOS缓存/待核/临时图片写入带completeFileProtection，收件箱manifest和笔记元数据有atomic写入；部分目录设置备份排除。必须按实际路径核，不能把单个选项扩展为端到端加密、全部文件统一保护或所有副本消失。 与脱敏、删除与材料归档的分工 脱敏核内容层，删除核移除范围，归档核证据对应；这里核 存储选项到底覆盖哪些载体、哪些结论还需实际属性与系统条件 。不读取私有文件、不改属性、不备份或恢复数据。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 atomic 用于写入替换的一致性选项 具体文件与失败结果 加密/签名/整个目录事务 iOS缓存/待核 引用路径有completeFileProtection 实际文件/系统条件 所有平台/文件同一保护 临时图片 明确暂存JPEG路径有保护写入 暂存文件与后续副本分开 所有分享文件自动加同类选项 manifest/笔记元数据 某些写出只显式atomic 默认/继承属性另核 未显式选项就证明明文 备份排除 按目录设置，错误处理不同 设置是否成功及其他副本 完全没有备份或永不留存 传输/远端 本地选项不覆盖服务端 实际网络/目标与权限 端到端加密或远端已擦除 平台分支 iOS与测试平台写选项不同 条件编译与实际运行环境 代码有macOS分支就有Mac发行 安全/保留结论 需实际范围和规则 内容脱敏/副本/权限独立 隐私认证、永久备份或恢复SLA 合成保护核对 已知：样例路径的写调用显式带completeFileProtection；未证：其他副本属性与目的地保留。只能报告该调用选项，不能宣布整个材料包已端到端加密或不可恢复删除。 没有显式保护选项也不能直接宣布明文，默认/继承属性需在获准测试中核。本文不运行安全审计或解锁设备，不从atomic或排除备份推出业务证据可信与合规。 FAQ atomic是不是加密？ 不是本文所称加密/签名，它不能独自证明内容保密或身份。 一个路径有completeFileProtection能覆盖全部附件吗？ 不能。按写出路径和后续副本分别核，不概括所有文件。 仅写atomic就一定明文吗？ 不能这样推断，默认/继承属性及实际系统条件另核。 备份排除能保证所有副本都不存在吗？ 不能。设置成功、其他备份/远端/人工副本是不同范围。 macOS条件分支代表Mac App上线吗？ 不代表。测试/条件编译不证明发行、商店或生产能力。 本页能当隐私或恢复认证吗？ 不能。没有新增认证/备份/恢复服务，实际权限与保留依据仍需核。 相关指南与源码 内容脱敏 · 删除范围 · 材料归档 · 开始 · 隐私 待核写入与目录属性 · 缓存/草稿平台写选项 · 笔记写入与备份排除 · 临时图片 · manifest写入

### What local file options prove: atomic writes, backup exclusion and carrier scope

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/local-file-protection-scope/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What local file options prove: atomic writes, backup exclusion and carrier scope Local write options do not replace network, remote, backup and retention review Source paths use different options: some iOS cache/pending/temporary-image writes specify completeFileProtection; inbox manifests and note metadata use atomic writes, with backup exclusion on selected directories. Review actual paths instead of claiming end-to-end encryption, uniform protection or disappearance of every copy. Different from redaction, removal and retention mapping Redaction checks content, removal checks deletion scope, retention maps evidence. Here which carriers options cover and what needs actual attributes/system checks matters. No private files/properties, backups or restores are operated. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established atomic Write-replacement consistency option Actual file/failure Encryption/signature/directory transaction iOS cache/pending Cited paths specify completeFileProtection Actual file/system conditions Every platform/file identical Temporary image Explicit staged JPEG protection write Staged file versus later copies All shared files get identical options Manifest/note metadata Some writes specify only atomic Defaults/inheritance separately Missing explicit option proves plaintext Backup exclusion Per-directory, differing error handling Success/other copies No backups or permanent non-retention Network/remote Local options do not cover service Actual target/network/authority End-to-end encryption or remote wipe Platform branches iOS/test-platform options differ Conditional code/runtime macOS branch proves a shipped Mac app Security/retention Actual scope/policy required Content/copies/access separately Certification/permanent backup/restore SLA Synthetic protection review Known: one sample write explicitly specifies completeFileProtection. Unknown: other-copy attributes/destination retention. Report that call only, not whole-package end-to-end encryption or irreversible deletion. Absent explicit options do not prove plaintext; defaults/inheritance need authorized inspection. No security audit/device unlock ran, and atomic/exclusion does not establish evidence truth or compliance. FAQ Is atomic encryption? No encryption/signing follows from that option alone. Does one protected path cover every attachment? No. Writes/later copies need separate review. Does atomic alone guarantee plaintext? No. Defaults/inheritance/actual system conditions matter. Does backup exclusion prove no copies exist? No. Setting success, other backups/remotes/manual copies differ. Does macOS conditional code prove a live Mac app? No. Test/conditional paths establish neither distribution nor store/production support. Is this privacy or recovery certification? No certification/backup/restore service is added; actual permissions/policies remain. Reading and source Content redaction · Removal scope · Material retention · Start · Privacy Pending writes/attributes · Cache/draft platform options · Note writes/exclusion · Temporary image · Manifest writes
