### 提到我为何命中或漏项？固定展示规则不等账户与负责人识别

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/attention-filter-identity-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 提到我为何命中或漏项？固定展示规则不等账户与负责人识别 “提到我”是派生筛选，不是服务端认领、身份或授权结论 当前requiresMyAttention在状态去首尾空白后匹配等你决策/等你验收，或检查next是否包含源码固定字样Alex。它没有在这个getter中读取当前登录账户。命中不等于任务属于某个真实用户，也不授予回复权；未命中同样不能证明没有工作需要处理。 与状态别名、认领与空字段的区别 别名指南核展示类别，认领清单核责任范围，空字段指南核占位；这里核**“只看提到我”的匹配原因和过滤覆盖**。源码固定字样仅作代码条件说明，不是真实顾客记录或新账户识别服务。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 状态分支 trim后两个明确状态可命中 原status与匹配条件 正文必须含名字才命中 next分支 localizedStandardContains检查固定Alex 检查的是next而非所有正文 动态读取当前账号/联系人 过滤开启 matchingActions可基于allTasks 全台账/来源范围另核 后台发现全部待办 其他条件 项目/状态/优先级/搜索/历史仍可过滤 当前显示配置 匹配后一定显示 未命中/空列表 受来源与多重条件影响 原材料、范围和未知 没人找我或任务全完成 派生Bool 不把原状态改写 源字段与显示结论分开 自动认领/批准 回复资格 实际目标/能力/权限另核 原生prepare/确认 匹配即可提交 人工归档 保留原值与实际核查范围 编辑说明非原生reason API 自动生成负责人证据 合成筛选记录 样例A的状态为等你验收，即使next不含固定字样也可命中；样例B的next包含该字样，也不由此证明实际登录人是负责人。列表被项目过滤后变空，不能报告原来源没有待处理项。 若要用匹配结果整理简报，注明来源和已核范围，不把UI筛选截图当账户、审批或签收证明。不修改名字/状态来绕过写入口条件。 FAQ 提到我是否读取当前登录账号？ 该getter用固定状态/字样条件，不提供动态账户身份识别保证。 没有名字为什么仍命中？ 明确待决策/验收状态本身可命中，不只检查next。 标题提了名字就必命中吗？ 该名字分支检查next，不等于扫描所有字段；其他条件仍可能影响结果。 列表为空就证明没有待办吗？ 不能。来源范围、其他显示条件和数据缺口都要核。 命中后自动成为负责人或可回复吗？ 不会由这个筛选授予责任/写权，原生目标和权限仍独立。 本页新增多用户身份或自动认领吗？ 没有。只核派生展示逻辑，不创建账户/授权或分发流程。 相关指南与源码 状态别名 · 认领责任 · 显示占位 · 开始 · 隐私 requiresMyAttention/matchingActions · 显示过滤入口

### Why attention filtering matches or misses: fixed display rules are not account identity

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/attention-filter-identity-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why attention filtering matches or misses: fixed display rules are not account identity Attention filtering is derived display, not server ownership, identity or authority Current requiresMyAttention trims status and checks the two decision/acceptance states, or tests next for the fixed source string Alex. This getter does not read the signed-in account. A match does not establish actual ownership or reply access; a miss does not prove nothing needs handling. Different from aliases, ownership and placeholders Aliases concern categories, ownership concerns responsibility, placeholders concern missing data. Here attention-match reasons and display coverage matter. The literal is a public code condition, not customer content or a new account-identification service. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established State branch Two explicit trimmed states can match Raw status/condition Name must occur in prose Next branch localizedStandardContains for fixed Alex next, not all contents Current account/contact inferred Filter enabled matchingActions can use allTasks Actual ledger/source coverage Every pending task discovered Other conditions Project/status/priority/search/history still filter Current display configuration Matches always visible No match/list empty Source/multiple conditions matter Originals/scope/unknowns Nobody awaits action/all done Derived Bool No source-status rewrite Raw versus display Automatic claiming/approval Reply eligibility Actual target/capability/authority separately Original prepare/confirmation Match grants submit Editorial retention Original values/reviewed scope Not a native reason API Automatic owner evidence Synthetic filter note A can match an acceptance state without the literal in next. B containing the literal does not prove the signed-in user owns it. A project-filtered empty list does not establish no pending source items. Briefs should state source/scope instead of treating filter screenshots as account, approval or receipt evidence. Do not edit names/states to bypass write guards. FAQ Does attention read the logged-in account? This getter uses fixed states/text, without dynamic account-identity guarantees. Why match without a name? The explicit decision/acceptance states can match independently. Does a name in title guarantee matching? The name branch checks next, not every field; other filters also apply. Does empty mean no tasks? No. Source coverage, filters and gaps need review. Does matching assign ownership or replies? No. Responsibility/target/authority remain separate. Is multi-user identification or claiming added? No. Derived display only, without provisioning accounts/authority/dispatch. Reading and source Status aliases · Ownership · Placeholders · Start · Privacy Attention/matchingActions · Display controls

### 音频块结束不等录音结束：noDataNow、endOfStream与尾部排空

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/pcm-stream-end-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 音频块结束不等录音结束：noDataNow、endOfStream与尾部排空 暂时没有下一块，不该被解释成整段音频已经结束 现有PCM转换器跨tap块保留状态，普通块之后用noDataNow，而非每块endOfStream。finish才发出流结束并在有界循环中排出延迟样本，最多16次且可提前结束。它是内部流处理，不是文件转码工具、语义分段或录音完整性认证。 与格式准入、队列压力和分段转写的区别 格式指南核输入形状，队列指南核积压，分段指南核后续识别窗口；这里核 块间状态与整条流的结束契约 。没有执行音频转换、重置或实际录音。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 转换器寿命 整次采集保留有状态实例 原sourceFormat与块序列 每块重建都无边界影响 普通输入 一次供给当前块后可noDataNow 暂缺数据与结束分开 每块都能当完整流 endOfStream 留给finish阶段 实际停止/排空结果 看到空块就全部处理完 尾部循环 最多16次，遇结束/空样本可停 调用预算不是时间/帧数 16秒/16帧完成SLA reset 取消/原路径按实现重置 旧状态与新采集分开 重置能恢复未采到内容 块复制 PCMChunk将数据复制跨队列 可复用输入缓冲的生命周期 源码复制就是内容真实性 最终结果 仍核管线失败/时长/空结果 final与预览/按钮分开 finish必定成功且每词无损 对外交接 原目标/一次标记继续 真正文字和服务回执 内部转换等于可发送或云转码 合成流序列 块甲后暂时没有块乙：实现使用noDataNow维持转换状态；真正结束才进入finish。不能把每次tap回调的结束当整段结束，也不能把有尾部输出当每个原词完整的证明。 源码注释解释保留状态是为避免重置造成边界历史损失，但这不是实际设备的零丢失成绩。本文不建议通过反复reset、改结束标志或扩大循环绕过错误，也不把内部转换宣传为新导入/转码服务。 FAQ 每个tap块结束都该endOfStream吗？ 当前实现不是这样，普通块间用noDataNow，finish才结束流。 16次就是16秒或16帧吗？ 不是。它是排空调用次数上限，不是时延或音频长度单位。 每块重新建转换器是否完全等价？ 不能这样说。有状态转换保留历史/priming，重建不等原设计连续处理。 finish有输出是否证明整段无损？ 不证明。实际音频、错误、最终文字与完整性仍需核。 块复制是不是归档原件校验？ 不是，它处理缓冲生命周期，不提供签名或内容真实性。 这里能转换任意文件吗？ 没有新增这类工具，只核现有内部PCM流，不运行文件转换。 相关指南与源码 格式准入 · 队列与final · 识别分段 · 开始 · 隐私 转换器/convertOnce/finish · tap与停止入口

### A block ending is not capture ending: noDataNow, endOfStream and converter tails

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/pcm-stream-end-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide A block ending is not capture ending: noDataNow, endOfStream and converter tails Temporarily missing another block is not the end of the entire audio stream The PCM converter persists across tap blocks, using noDataNow between ordinary blocks rather than endOfStream for each. finish ends the stream and drains delayed samples in a bounded loop, up to 16 calls with early exits. This internal stream processing is not file transcoding, semantic segmentation or completeness certification. Different from format, queues and transcription segments Format checks shape, queues check pressure, segments concern later recognition. Here cross-block state and whole-stream ending matter. No conversion/reset/capture is executed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Lifetime Stateful instance across capture Original format/block sequence Rebuilding every block has no boundary effect Ordinary input Supply block once, then noDataNow Temporarily unavailable versus ended Each block is a complete stream endOfStream Used by finish Actual stop/drain result Empty input proves complete processing Tail loop Up to 16, stop on end/empty samples Call budget, not time/frames 16-second/frame SLA Reset Original cancellation/reset paths Old state/new capture Reset recovers uncaptured contents Block copy PCMChunk copied across queues Reusable input-buffer lifetime Copy authenticates contents Final Pipeline failure/duration/empty checks remain Final versus preview/buttons finish always succeeds losslessly Handoff Original target/reservation remain Text/receipts Internal conversion grants sending/cloud transcoding Synthetic stream sequence After A, B is not yet available: noDataNow retains converter state. Actual ending enters finish. Each tap callback ending is not the whole stream, and tail output does not certify every original word. Comments explain state retention to avoid reset-related boundary-history loss; this is not a device zero-loss result. Do not reset repeatedly, falsify end flags or expand loops to bypass failures. No new importer/transcoding service is supplied. FAQ Should every block end with endOfStream? Not in this implementation. Ordinary gaps use noDataNow; finish ends the stream. Do 16 calls mean 16 seconds/frames? No. Call count is not latency/audio length. Is a new converter per block equivalent? Do not assume that. Stateful conversion retains history/priming. Does tail output prove no loss? No. Actual audio, errors, text and completeness remain separate. Does block copying verify an archival original? No. It handles lifetime, not signatures/content truth. Can this convert arbitrary files? No general tool is added; fixed internal PCM review only. Reading and source Format admission · Queue/final · Recognition segments · Start · Privacy Converter/convertOnce/finish · Tap/stop entry

### manifest出现后代表什么？本地批次可见点与残留目录核查

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/share-manifest-visibility-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 manifest出现后代表什么？本地批次可见点与残留目录核查 manifest是本地批次可见条件，不是服务回执或不可变归档 共享收件箱save先复制文件、组装条目，最后atomic写manifest.json；pending读取并解码manifest后列出批次。该列表并不在此逐个验证附件仍存在或内容已审核。后续update可重写manifest，所以它不是服务器提交、送达、业务批准或不可变归档凭证。 与混合批次交接、导出编码和文件保护的区别 交接指南核文件先行的网页阶段，导出指南核序列化契约，保护指南核写选项；这里核 本地构造可见点、读取失败和残留目录的解释 。不访问收件箱、执行清理或删除任何数据。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 构造顺序 文件复制而非移动，manifest最后写 原件与暂存副本 来源文件已被转移或业务已发送 可见条件 有可读取/解码manifest的批次可列出 列表与实际附件分开 每份文件存在/已审/完整校验 pending失败 读目录/manifest/解码可缺项 真实错误和范围 空列表就是全部材料不存在 update 部分放置后可重写manifest 当前批次阶段 永久不可变原始档案 缺manifest目录 sweepIncomplete按条件尝试清理 是否缺manifest与目录时间 所有批次都按TTL删除 默认3600秒 比较修改时间，缺值可用distantPast 年龄条件与调用时点 每小时定时清空/至少保存一小时 移除尝试 try?不独立证明成功 实际目录/其他副本 安全擦除或全量回收 归档/服务 本地元数据与远端分账 实际草稿/附件/回执 服务器事务或接收确认 合成本地观察 目录甲没有manifest，因此不在pending解码列表；不能据此宣布文件从未复制或都已清除。目录乙有manifest并可解码，仍应分别核附件和阶段，不自动标全量归档。 默认清理年龄是3600秒、按目录修改时间判定；缺时间可用distantPast，不是从创建起至少保留一小时。清理需被调用，不是本页新建的定时服务；源原件、暂存和远端副本仍按实际授权范围核。 FAQ 有manifest就证明全部附件仍在吗？ pending只读取解码清单，不在此逐个核附件存在/内容，需另外验证。 空列表能证明没有残留文件吗？ 不能。目录、读取/解码失败或缺manifest等情况需分开看。 3600秒是不是所有材料保留期？ 不是，针对缺manifest目录的年龄条件，既非统一TTL也非固定定时清理承诺。 缺修改时间也保证至少留一小时吗？ 不保证，该路径可用distantPast判断，不能推创建后的最低保留。 manifest是否不可变？ 不是。已有update会随阶段重写，不是不可篡改日志。 本页执行了清理/上传吗？ 没有。只核本地结构，不访问、删除、上传或提供新归档服务。 相关指南与源码 混合批次阶段 · 编码与内部清单 · 文件保护 · 移除范围 · 开始 · 隐私 save/update/pending/sweepIncomplete · 调用清理与放置阶段

### What a share manifest establishes: local visibility and incomplete directories

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/share-manifest-visibility-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What a share manifest establishes: local visibility and incomplete directories A manifest makes local batches visible; it is not a service receipt or immutable archive Inbox save copies files/builds items before atomically writing manifest.json last. pending reads/decodes manifests to list batches, without verifying every attachment still exists or was reviewed. update can rewrite a manifest. It therefore certifies neither server submission, delivery, business approval nor immutable archiving. Different from mixed handoff, encoding and protection Handoff checks page stages, encoding checks serialization, protection checks write options. Here local construction visibility, missing entries and incomplete directories matter. No inbox access, cleanup or deletion occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Construction Copy, not move; manifest last Original versus staged copy Source moved or business message sent Visibility Readable/decodable manifest listed List versus actual attachments Each file exists/reviewed/integrity-checked pending failure Directory/read/decode can omit entries Actual errors/scope Empty means no material Update Manifest can change after partial placement Current stage Permanent immutable original No manifest sweepIncomplete conditionally attempts cleanup Absence/directory timestamp Every batch has deletion TTL Default 3600 seconds Modification age; missing time can use distantPast Age/call time Hourly clearing/minimum one-hour retention Removal try? is not independent success proof Actual directories/copies Secure erasure/complete collection Service/archive Local metadata differs Actual drafts/attachments/receipts Server transaction or recipient confirmation Synthetic local observation A lacks a manifest and is absent from pending: that does not establish no file was copied or every copy was removed. B has a decodable manifest: inspect attachments/stage separately instead of claiming complete archiving. Default cleanup age is 3600 seconds against modification time. Missing time can use distantPast, not a minimum hour after creation. Cleanup must be called; no timer service is added. Original/staged/remote copies retain actual permission boundaries. FAQ Does a manifest prove every attachment exists? pending decodes the list, not every file’s existence/content. Verify separately. Does an empty list prove no residual files? No. Missing manifests and directory/read/decode failures differ. Is 3600 seconds every material's retention period? No. It is incomplete-directory age, not universal TTL or scheduled-cleanup promise. Does missing modification time guarantee an hour? No. This path can use distantPast; no creation-based minimum follows. Is the manifest immutable? No. Existing update rewrites it; not a tamper-proof log. Was cleanup/upload run here? No. Local structure review only, without access/deletion/upload or new archive service. Reading and source Mixed-batch stages · Encoding/internal manifest · File options · Removal scope · Start · Privacy Save/update/pending/sweep · Cleanup invocation/placement

### 同源为什么仍不能填入？浏览器origin、页面与存储范围核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/workbench-origin-page-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 同源为什么仍不能填入？浏览器origin、页面与存储范围核对 同origin不是同页面、同草稿或已获得操作许可 CollieWebSession的isTrusted比较配置baseURL的scheme、host和有效端口，并检查会话未失效；不是靠页面标题或域名看起来相似。WebKit持久存储键从归一origin派生，路径或工作台名称不同不自动变成独立存储。插入路径仍可核expectedPageURL、requestID和适配器条件，同源通过不等可发送。 与Radar源URL、追问上下文和草稿恢复的区别 源URL指南核数据源地址，追问指南核上下文，恢复指南核本地草稿；这里核 浏览器origin比较、存储隔离键与具体页面插入条件 。不打开网页、读Cookie或改配置。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 原生origin比较 scheme/host按小写比较及有效端口 配置边界与当前URL 可信账户/内容认证 默认端口 HTTPS 443、HTTP 80按实现比较 省略与显式默认值 可为兼容随意降级HTTP path/标题 不是该origin比较的身份键 具体页面与完整URL条件 同标题/路径就有授权 持久存储键 归一origin的SHA摘要派生identifier 同origin容器可能复用 每个工作台名字独立Cookie仓 同存储不等账号 服务Cookie路径/登录状态另核 实际账户与权限 共享容器就保证同一登录人 页面/请求 可选expectedPageURL和准备请求等条件 当前页面与请求归属 origin通过即跳过目标守卫 适配结果 拒绝/未知不随便降级重试 真实结果与草稿状态 填入即发送/审批 原生其他数据 Radar/笔记有独立路径 不同存储面分别核 WebKit容器就是全部档案 合成origin比较 https://example.com/a与https://example.com:443/b可归同origin存储键；并不因此成为同一页面或草稿。若具体交接绑定原页面，页面变化仍需按该路径的条件处理。 这里不把isTrusted名字当网站安全、账户真实性或AI会话记忆认证，也不把持久存储容器相同当业务登录有效。示例未访问，未读取任何用户浏览数据。 FAQ 同源就能向任何输入框写吗？ 不能。页面、请求、焦点/适配器及调用者许可等原守卫仍在。 工作台名字不同就各有独立Cookie吗？ 不能由名称推断，引用存储键由归一origin派生。 HTTPS省端口和写443是否一定不同源？ 该有效端口比较将默认端口对应起来，但完整页面条件另核。 同一个容器就证明同一账号吗？ 不证明。实际Cookie范围、登录与服务权限独立核。 isTrusted是否安全或真实性认证？ 不是本文提供的认证，它是实现边界条件，不能代内容/身份/权限。 本页打开网页或检查Cookie了吗？ 没有，只核固定源码，不执行登录、数据读取或配置变更。 相关指南与源码 源URL区别 · 追问目标 · 原生草稿 · 工作台边界 · 开始 · 隐私 isTrusted/origin存储/insertTranscript · 页面适配守卫

<td>WebKit容器就是全部档案</td>
</tr>

### Same origin but insertion refused: browser origin, page and storage boundaries

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/workbench-origin-page-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Same origin but insertion refused: browser origin, page and storage boundaries Same origin is not the same page, draft or operation authority CollieWebSession.isTrusted compares baseURL scheme/host/effective port and invalidation state, not similar-looking titles/domains. Persistent WebKit storage is derived from normalized origin; paths/workbench names do not automatically create separate stores. Insertion can still check expectedPageURL, requestID and adapters. Origin acceptance is not sending permission. Different from feed URLs, context and restored drafts Feed review concerns source addresses, context concerns conversation, drafts concern local ownership. Here browser-origin comparison, storage keys and page insertion conditions matter. No page, Cookie or setting is accessed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Native comparison Lowercased scheme/host and effective port Configured boundary/current URL Trusted account/content certification Default ports HTTPS 443/HTTP 80 per implementation Implicit/explicit default Downgrade to HTTP for compatibility Path/title Not this origin identity key Actual page/full-URL conditions Matching appearance grants authority Persistent key Identifier derived from normalized-origin SHA Same-origin container reuse Every workbench name has isolated cookies Store versus account Cookie path/login separately Actual account/access Shared container guarantees one identity Page/request Optional expectedPageURL/prepared request etc. Current page/request ownership Origin bypasses target guards Adapter outcome Refusal/unknown is not blind fallback Actual result/draft state Insertion means sending/approval Other native data Radar/notes use separate paths Separate storage surfaces WebKit is the entire archive Synthetic origin comparison https://example.com/a and https://example.com:443/b can derive the same origin storage key without being the same page/draft. A handoff bound to the original page still follows that path’s conditions. isTrusted is not site-safety, account-truth or Agent-memory certification. Shared storage does not establish effective business login. Examples were not fetched and no browsing data was read. FAQ Can same origin write into any input? No. Original page/request/focus/adapter/caller guards remain. Do different workbench names isolate cookies? Not by naming; the cited key derives from normalized origin. Are implicit HTTPS port and explicit 443 necessarily different origins? This effective-port comparison relates defaults; full-page conditions are separate. Does one container prove one account? No. Actual Cookie scope/login/service authority remain. Is isTrusted security/truth certification? No. Implementation conditions do not replace content/identity/permission evidence. Were pages/Cookies checked? No login, data access or configuration change occurred; fixed source only. Reading and source Feed URL differences · Target/context · Native drafts · Workbench scope · Start · Privacy Origin/storage/insertion · Adapter guards

### 语音预览为何会改字？可替换partial、最终返回与归档范围

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/replaceable-voice-preview-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 语音预览为何会改字？可替换partial、最终返回与归档范围 partial是可替换显示，不是一段段可直接相加的录文 识别接口把onPartialText定义为完整、可替换的部分文字，只有返回的最终结果进入原可交付边界。控制器用bufferingNewest(1)处理更新，并核sessionID、阶段和取消状态。预览可能被重解码或最终结果纠正，不能把多次显示拼成多条原话、批准或执行证据。 与电平、分段拼接和最终回执的区别 电平是能量显示，长笔记join处理识别片段，回执核实际交接；这里核 同次识别预览更新的替换语义与取证范围 。没有运行模型或保存实际讲话。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 接口语义 onPartialText是完整可替换字符串 不是增量token追加合同 每次更新都是新句子 更新缓冲 bufferingNewest(1)保留最新 中间事件可不逐一显示 完整逐token时间线 会话/阶段 sessionID/expectedPhase/取消条件 更新属于哪次识别 旧预览可接新目标 长度门槛 部分显示按调用前长度条件筛 最终返回仍可纠正 显示始终单调不改字 最终识别 停止后完整pass优先 真正返回/错误与旧预览 预览有字就final成功 previewUnavailable 可只表示预览路径失败 最终流程另核 模型必损坏/应删模型 后续过滤/目标 final还受声纹/目标等原条件 文字存在不代写权 最终文字必已送达 人工归档 最终稿/处理/原音频分账 实际已核范围 预览截图是真实逐字证书 合成预览序列 先显示“样例”，后显示“样例需要复核”，最终返回“样例暂缓”。它们不是三句可直接串接的原话；不能拼成多项决策。这里仅示意替换，不代表真实模型输出或准确率。 若预览失败、取消或最终结果不同，保留实际状态和未知，不复制旧预览绕过最终/交接条件，也不把bufferingNewest当所有中间事件永久档案。 FAQ 每次partial都该append到档案吗？ 不能。接口语义为完整可替换文本，追加会制造重复或冲突。 看见预览就说明最终成功吗？ 不说明。最终识别、过滤与交接仍可能失败或未获准。 预览文字会永远只增长吗？ 不作这种保证，重解码/最终结果可纠正，显示门槛也不是语义稳定性认证。 bufferingNewest是否完整保存每个token？ 不是。它不是全量事件档案或时间对齐功能。 previewUnavailable就应删除模型吗？ 不能由它推断，源码保留最终路径另核，不为预览故障自动删模型。 最终文字一定已写入目标吗？ 不一定。声纹/目标/原许可与实际回执仍需独立确认。 相关指南与源码 电平区别 · 长笔记拼接 · 回调归属 · 实际回执 · 开始 · 隐私 partial接口契约 · 预览/最终/目标路径

### Why voice previews change: replaceable partials, final returns and evidence scope

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/replaceable-voice-preview-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why voice previews change: replaceable partials, final returns and evidence scope A partial is replaceable display, not another transcript fragment to append The recognition interface defines onPartialText as complete replaceable strings; only returned final text enters original deliverable boundaries. The controller uses bufferingNewest(1) with sessionID, phase and cancellation guards. Redecoding/final results can correct previews. Multiple displays cannot be joined into extra quotations, approvals or executed actions. Different from meters, segment joins and receipts Meters show energy, long-note join handles recognition pieces, receipts concern handoff. Here replacement semantics and evidence scope within one preview sequence matter. No model or actual speech is processed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Interface Complete replaceable onPartialText Not an incremental-token append contract Each update is a new sentence Buffer bufferingNewest(1) keeps latest Not every intermediate update displayed Full token timeline Session/phase sessionID/expectedPhase/cancellation Actual recognition ownership Old preview can join a new target Length condition Partial display uses prior-call length condition Final return can correct Text always grows without revision Final pass Full pass gets priority after stop Actual return/error versus preview Visible words guarantee final success previewUnavailable Preview-path failure can be separate Actual final flow Model corrupt/must delete Later guards Final still subject to voiceprint/target etc. Text versus authority Final is always delivered Editorial retention Final/processing/audio separately Actual reviewed scope Screenshot is verbatim certification Synthetic preview sequence Display sample, then sample needs review, then final sample deferred. These are not three quotations to concatenate into additional decisions. This illustrates replacement, not actual model output/accuracy. Retain real errors/cancellation/differences instead of copying old previews around final/handoff guards. bufferingNewest is not permanent retention of every intermediate event. FAQ Should every partial append to an archive? No. Complete replacement semantics make append create duplicates/conflicts. Does visible preview establish final success? No. Recognition, filtering and delivery remain separate. Does preview always grow monotonically? No guarantee. Redecoding/final corrections and display thresholds do not certify stable meaning. Does bufferingNewest retain every token? No. It is neither a full event archive nor alignment. Should previewUnavailable trigger model deletion? Do not infer corruption. Source retains final handling separately without deleting for preview failure. Is returned final necessarily inserted? No. Voiceprint/target/permission/actual receipts still need review. Reading and source Meter distinction · Long-note joins · Callback ownership · Actual receipts · Start · Privacy Partial contract · Preview/final/delivery

### 模型校验通过代表什么？revision、资产SHA、加载与预热分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/model-artifact-validation-evidence/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 模型校验通过代表什么？revision、资产SHA、加载与预热分账 固定资产匹配不是识别准确率，下载/加载/预热也非同一个门 Qwen3ModelStore.isInstalled会核固定revision标记，并对清单资产核大小和SHA-256，不只是检查目录存在。加载时仍有完整性门，之后CoreML加载和预热也可能失败；validateInstalledModel可复用已加载/预热实例，不代表每次都全盘重读。文件证据不证明每词准确或真实场景可用。 与首次试用、声纹和材料hash的区别 试用核整条链路，声纹是另一便捷过滤，材料hash核某份字节；这里核 本地ASR固定资产、安装判定、内存加载与预热的证据层级 。不下载模型、读取私有声音、卸载或运行推理。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 固定清单 指定repository revision和每项字节/SHA 对应固定源码清单 任意同名权重都兼容 isInstalled 标记及列出资产逐项大小/摘要 false的取消/缺项/失配等区别 仅有目录就已通过 清单范围 核列出的资产 已核文件与其他材料分开 整个目录全部文件真实性认证 发布安装树 已验证staging后再替换/移动 实际安装结果和错误 下载进度数字即加载成功 加载 loadIfNeeded先看内存实例 新加载需要完整性/代际条件 每次调用都重新全盘校验 代际隔离 installGeneration变化保护旧等待加载 旧准备与当前模型分开 数字提供身份签名 预热 validate调用/已预热可复用 实际失败与结果 预热成功等真实讲话准确 归档证据 版本/清单/实际通过范围 设备/权限/原音频/内容另验 模型安全认证、语义正确或恢复SLA 合成校验说明 已知：某固定清单资产匹配；未证：本机CoreML加载、预热和真实语音效果。只能写文件完整性范围通过，不报告识别成绩。若已加载实例被复用，也不写“刚刚全盘重新验过”。 不要改revision标记或清单来掩盖失配，不为页面演示下载/移除真实模型。哈希对应预期字节，不替代发布信任、使用许可、运行兼容或真实准确率验收；本页没有测这些项。 FAQ isInstalled只看文件夹存在吗？ 不是。当前实现核固定revision及清单资产的大小和SHA。 全部hash对就每句话准确吗？ 不能推出，文件完整性与运行、设备、语音内容和语义分别核。 validate每次都重新读全部文件吗？ 不能这样说，已加载/预热实例可复用，首次加载仍需完整性门。 安装返回后还可能加载失败吗？ 可能，CoreML加载/预热是不同阶段，不能用下载状态替代。 isInstalled为false必定是恶意篡改吗？ 不能单独判断，取消、缺项、读取/大小/摘要或版本等条件都需核。 本页运行过模型或下载吗？ 没有。只核源码和证据层级，不称模型性能或真实设备验收。 相关指南与源码 整链试用 · 声纹区别 · 材料与版本 · 预览与最终 · 开始 · 隐私 固定清单/isInstalled/install · loadIfNeeded/validateInstalledModel · 现有准备入口

### What model validation proves: revision, asset SHA, loading and warm-up differ

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/model-artifact-validation-evidence/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What model validation proves: revision, asset SHA, loading and warm-up differ Pinned asset identity is not accuracy; installation, loading and warming are separate gates Qwen3ModelStore.isInstalled checks a fixed revision marker and listed asset sizes/SHA-256, not directory existence alone. New loading still has an integrity gate, while CoreML load/warm-up can fail separately. validateInstalledModel can reuse a loaded/warmed instance rather than reread every file each call. File evidence does not establish every word’s accuracy or scenario readiness. Different from trial, voiceprint and material digests Trial checks the whole chain; voiceprint is another convenience filter; digests identify bytes. Here pinned ASR assets, installation, memory loading and warming have separate evidence scopes. No download, private voice access, removal or inference ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Pinned manifest Repository revisions/per-asset bytes/SHA Actual fixed-source manifest Any same-name weights compatible isInstalled Marker and listed sizes/digests Cancellation/missing/mismatch causes Directory presence suffices Manifest scope Listed assets checked Reviewed files versus other material Every directory file authenticated Publish tree Verified staging then replace/move Actual install/error Progress means loaded Load loadIfNeeded checks memory first New load integrity/generation Every call rescans all files Generation installGeneration guards suspended old load Old preparation/current model Identity signature Warm-up validate can reuse warmed instance Actual results/errors Real speech accuracy accepted Retention evidence Version/manifest/actual checks Device/permissions/audio/content separately Security certification/semantic truth/restore SLA Synthetic validation note Known: assets match one pinned manifest. Unknown: this device’s CoreML load, warming and speech quality. Report file integrity only, not recognition performance. Reusing a loaded instance cannot be described as a just-completed full disk recheck. Do not falsify revision markers/manifests or download/remove real models for demonstration. Digests match expected bytes, not release trust, usage permission, runtime compatibility or speech accuracy. None was benchmarked here. FAQ Does isInstalled check only folder existence? No. Fixed revision, listed sizes and SHA are checked. Do matching hashes guarantee every sentence? No. Integrity differs from runtime, device/audio and meaning. Does validate reread all files every time? Not necessarily. Loaded/warmed instances can be reused; new loading still needs integrity. Can loading fail after installation? Yes. CoreML load/warm-up differ from download status. Does false prove malicious modification? No. Cancellation, missing/read/size/hash/version conditions need separate review. Was a model run/downloaded? No. Source/evidence review only, without performance/device acceptance. Reading and source Whole-chain trial · Voiceprint distinction · Material/version mapping · Preview/final · Start · Privacy Manifest/install/verification · Load/validation · Existing preparation

### 桥拒绝与桥不可用能混同吗？accepted/refused/unavailable核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/host-bridge-outcome-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 桥拒绝与桥不可用能混同吗？accepted/refused/unavailable核对 refused不是unavailable，accepted也不是服务端处理回执 当前页面collieBridgeScript先核origin、完整pageURL与页面可见性，再观测事件detail的读取/accepted设置及preventDefault。结果为accepted/refused/unavailable；原生分支只有明确unavailable才继续受守卫DOM适配，拒绝、异常或其他结果不因此变成安全降级。accepted也只是协议回报，不证明已发送或业务处理。 与origin、一次交接和完成审计的区别 origin指南核页面边界，一次交接核原尝试，审计核实际结果；这里核 可选页面桥的三态观测与何时允许走下一适配分支 。不注入事件、不伪造桥或改网页全局。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 前置条件 origin/pageURL/hidden等检查 具体页面与当前相位 标题相同就可信 accepted detail明确设置为true时优先返回 宿主回报与实际目标内容 服务器收到/执行/审批 observed 读取text/accepted或设置accepted可被观测 是否按约定消费事件 全站能力已扫描 refused 未accepted且observed或defaultPrevented等情况 拒绝或不满足边界 可当没桥继续绕过 unavailable 未观察到协议处理的分支 仅这个结果可进入后续DOM尝试 页面绝对没有任何能力 DOM下一分支 仍核allowed和适配器条件 焦点/草稿/页面/请求 无条件写入或发送 异常/未知 不自动当unavailable 副作用和未知保留 失败就绝无写入可盲重试 不同回执层 隔离世界Bool回执与页面桥分别处理 明确哪一层实际返回 任意非Bool值都是发送成功 合成桥结果记录 结果refused：停止该路径，不把它改写成unavailable去尝试别的输入框。结果accepted：只报告宿主按协议接纳，再核真实目标内容，不填已发送/已执行。这里没有实际网页交接。 这条原生链路没有submit调用，但并不等于任意网站行为都已验收。协议观测不是安全扫描、账户认证或所有后端幂等保证；不以“兼容”为由注册假桥或改锁定/发送状态。 FAQ refused可以当没有桥吗？ 不能。原生分支不因拒绝继续DOM降级。 unavailable证明整个站点没有适配能力吗？ 不证明，只说明本协议观测路径的结果，后续尝试仍受守卫。 accepted说明业务已处理吗？ 不说明。宿主接纳、实际填入、发送、接收、业务完成分别核。 preventDefault一定压过accepted吗？ 不是这么概括，源码accepted=true优先；未accepted时取消事件可归refused。 异常后能自动换框重发吗？ 不应，保留未知与原请求/目标状态，不盲降级或重放。 本文配置或测试了新桥吗？ 没有，只核固定协议分支，不改页面或新增服务。 相关指南与源码 页面与origin · 一次交接 · 实际完成证据 · 开始 · 隐私 collieBridgeScript三态 · insertTranscript分支

### Refused is not unavailable: inspect accepted/refused/unavailable bridge outcomes

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/host-bridge-outcome-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Refused is not unavailable: inspect accepted/refused/unavailable bridge outcomes refused differs from unavailable; accepted is not a backend handling receipt collieBridgeScript checks origin/full pageURL/visibility and observes detail reads, accepted writes and event cancellation. It returns accepted/refused/unavailable. Native handling continues to guarded DOM only for explicit unavailable, not refusals, exceptions or arbitrary results. accepted is a protocol report, not sending or business completion. Different from origin, reservations and completion review Origin concerns boundaries, reservations concern attempts, auditing concerns results. Here optional page-bridge observation and permission to try the next adapter branch matter. No event injection, fake bridge or global-page modification occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Preconditions Origin/pageURL/hidden etc. Actual page/phase Same title implies trust accepted Explicit accepted=true wins Host report versus target content Server received/executed/approved Observed Reads text/accepted or writes accepted Protocol consumption All site capabilities scanned refused Without accepted, observed/defaultPrevented etc. Refusal/boundaries Treat as absent and bypass unavailable No observed protocol handling Only this permits next DOM attempt No capability anywhere on the page DOM continuation allowed/adapter guards remain Focus/draft/page/request Unconditional writing/sending Exception/unknown Not automatically unavailable Effects/unknowns retained Definitely no write, safely replay Receipt layers Isolated Bool receipts differ from page bridge Actual layer/outcome Any non-Bool means sent Synthetic bridge note refused: stop rather than relabel unavailable to try another composer. accepted: report protocol acceptance, inspect actual content, and do not invent sent/executed. No real handoff ran. The native path makes no submit call, but arbitrary site behavior is not certified. Protocol observation is not scanning, account identity or universal idempotency. Compatibility cannot justify fake bridges or changing locks/sending state. FAQ Can refused be treated as absent bridge? No. Native refusal does not continue DOM fallback. Does unavailable prove no site capability? No. It is this observed protocol outcome; later adaptation remains guarded. Does accepted prove business handling? No. Acceptance, placement, sending, receipt and handling differ. Does preventDefault always override accepted? No. accepted=true wins; otherwise cancellation can yield refused. Can exceptions trigger another composer/replay automatically? Do not blindly downgrade/replay; retain unknown request/target state. Was a bridge configured/tested? No. Fixed protocol review only, without page changes/services. Reading and source Page/origin · One handoff · Completion evidence · Start · Privacy Three-state bridge · Insertion branches

### 按钮可用为什么未必在录音？采集、转写、声纹测试的忙态分层

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/audio-busy-state-admission/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 按钮可用为什么未必在录音？采集、转写、声纹测试的忙态分层 可点击、可取消、可采集和可转写不是同一个布尔状态 主语音primaryActionEnabled会按phase决定动作，needsModel时可点击不等于正在录音；canCancel覆盖准备/录音/转写而不只采样。笔记canRecord与前台canTranscribe分别检查，声纹测试另有保留标记。不能从某一个true推全局音频互斥、权限或任意并发能力。 与权限、生命周期和声纹结论的区别 权限核系统许可，生命周期核前后台，声纹核过滤结果；这里核 资源/入口忙态的不同含义与调用范围 。不启动录音、校准、模型或清空待处理文字。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 主按钮 needsModel/recording/failed等动作可不同 当前phase与实际动作 enabled就是新录音可开始 ready 还看pendingTranscript/测试标记 已有文字与测试状态 ready就是全部空闲 canCancel preparing/recording/transcribing 可取消阶段非只采样 麦克风始终在录 delivering 部分入口单独阻止 实际交付状态 不可取消就必定空闲 笔记录音 canRecord与isStarting等入口条件 实际调用链/权限结果 一个guard证明所有异步阶段互斥 笔记转写 让步主语音，要求前台 可转写与已在采集分开 后台持续推理或录音已丢 声纹测试 claimVoiceprintTestMic保留入口标记 测试保留与真正采集不同 标记就系统授权/身份通过 共享模型 笔记使用voice.transcriber 共享对象与让步条件 两个模型任意多路并行/无竞态 合成忙态记录 界面主按钮可用，但phase=needsModel：不能把一次点击称为已开始采集。另有ready且pendingTranscript存在时，也不能说无待处理结果。按具体入口和实际返回核，不用一个busy标签代替全部状态。 这些是现有局部守卫，不是全局并发安全或延迟SLA。await前后的状态可能变化，仍沿原流程条件，不为吞吐反复点录音、删除待核文字或关闭保护。 FAQ 按钮enabled是否证明正在收音？ 不是。不同phase可对应准备、模型或停止等不同动作。 canCancel=true是否只可能录音中？ 不是，准备和转写阶段也可满足该属性。 phase=ready是否总能开始？ 不能，只看phase不足，待处理文字/测试标记等仍要核。 笔记不能转写是否等于没录到？ 不等于。录音、转写、前台与模型忙态分开。 共享transcriber是否承诺多路同时推理？ 不承诺，源码有让步策略，不能从共享对象推出并发或性能保证。 本文证明所有入口全局互斥吗？ 没有。只核局部条件及调用范围，不运行并发/设备测试或新增调度器。 相关指南与源码 权限与采样 · 前后台 · 声纹结果 · 预览与final · 开始 · 隐私 按钮/phase/测试保留 · 笔记canRecord/canTranscribe · 笔记录制与worker入口

### Enabled is not recording: separate capture, transcription and test busy states

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/audio-busy-state-admission/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Enabled is not recording: separate capture, transcription and test busy states Clickable, cancellable, recordable and transcribable are different states primaryActionEnabled depends on phase; clickable in needsModel is not capture. canCancel covers preparing/recording/transcribing, not sampling alone. Notes use separate canRecord/foreground canTranscribe checks, and voiceprint testing has a reservation flag. One true boolean establishes neither global exclusion, permission nor arbitrary concurrency. Different from permission, lifecycle and voiceprint decisions Permission checks consent, lifecycle checks foreground, voiceprints check filtering. Here entry/resource busy meanings and call-chain scope matter. No recording, calibration, model execution or pending-text clearing occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Primary action Actions vary across needsModel/recording/failed etc. Actual phase/action Enabled means start new recording Ready pendingTranscript/test flag also matter Existing text/test state Everything idle canCancel Preparing/recording/transcribing Cancellable versus sampling Mic continuously active Delivering Some guards block separately Actual delivery state Not cancellable means idle Note capture canRecord/isStarting and entry checks Actual chain/permission result One guard proves every async stage excluded Note transcription Yields to dictation, foreground required Processing versus existing capture Background inference or lost recording Voiceprint test claimVoiceprintTestMic reserves entry state Reservation versus capture Permission/identity passed Shared model Notes use voice.transcriber Shared object/yield conditions Arbitrary parallel models/race freedom Synthetic busy note The button is enabled but phase=needsModel: a click is not proof capture started. Ready with pendingTranscript is not no outstanding result. Inspect actual entry/return rather than collapsing every state into one busy flag. Local guards are not global concurrency/latency certification. Conditions can change across awaits; follow original checks instead of repeated capture, discarding unresolved text or disabling safeguards for throughput. FAQ Does enabled prove the mic is capturing? No. Phases can correspond to model/preparation/stop and other actions. Does canCancel imply recording only? No. Preparation/transcription can also be cancellable. Does ready always permit starting? No. Pending text/test state and other conditions remain. Does unavailable note transcription mean no audio? No. Capture, foreground and model processing are separate. Does shared transcriber promise parallel inference? No. Sharing plus yield policy is not concurrency/performance evidence. Are all entry points proven mutually exclusive? No. Local guards/call scope only, without a new scheduler or device/concurrency tests. Reading and source Permission/sampling · Foreground · Voiceprint results · Preview/final · Start · Privacy Action/phase/test reservation · Note admission closures · Capture/worker entry

### 关闭历史是否撤回提交？迟到历史、generation与已记录回执优先级

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/history-generation-receipt-priority/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 关闭历史是否撤回提交？迟到历史、generation与已记录回执优先级 关闭历史回显不撤回提交，先发出的历史也不能抢走已确认回执 历史读取捕获historyGeneration，返回后还核historyActive、当前来源、generation和任务取消。cancelHistory更新本地活动/代际；写回复complete也使旧历史代际失效，避免预提交读取抢在已确认回执后生效。它不是服务器撤回，不能把迟到/被忽略的历史当最新absent或业务状态。 与历史检索、引用结构和请求ID的区别 检索核覆盖，结构核目标/引用，请求ID核写入关联；这里核 异步历史查询与确认写回执的时序优先级 。不发送/取消真实网络请求，不清本地记录或操作旧回复。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 本地代际 每次读取捕获generation 查询生命周期 服务器版本/request_id 返回守卫 active/currentSource/代际/取消条件 这次响应是否仍适用 网络有响应就最新 cancelHistory 标非活动、递增代际、清本地busy 视图状态与提交状态分开 撤销已发POST或服务写入 旧读取defer 只在同代际清busy 新读取忙态不被旧回包接管 全局网络请求已取消 complete 使先前历史读失效，recorded=true 确认回执与新查历史分账 业务已处理/审批通过 迟到响应 不满足守卫不应用 原响应范围与未知 自动判absent可重发 读失败/无历史 按实际错误/原结果核 未显示不等没写入 记录从未存在 人工归档 保留读取/提交/回执各自范围 真实关联与实际时间 本地代际成永久审计证书 合成竞序核对 历史查询甲先发出，随后写回复已有recorded回执；甲后来返回。不能把甲当确认之后的最新全貌或据它重发。源码通过代际守卫保护时序，真实结果仍要按请求与原条目核。 关闭历史不意味着底层网络一定没发生或服务副作用被撤销；generation也不是账户凭据、来源epoch或持久日志。本文无并发回归/服务端测试，不承诺所有系统下零竞态。 FAQ 关历史能撤回已提交回复吗？ 不能。只读视图状态与写操作/服务结果不同。 historyGeneration就是request_id吗？ 不是，一个是本地读取代际，一个关联真实写请求。 旧响应最后到达就最新吗？ 不是，须看发起范围、代际和实际事件顺序，不以到达顺序判真。 recorded后还可用旧查询宣告absent吗？ 不应，旧读取失效不能推翻确认，也不能由未显示自动授权重发。 cancelHistory保证杀掉全部网络吗？ 本文不作此保证，源码主要更新本地状态/代际，是否已发请求与副作用另核。 这些守卫能当永久档案或零竞态证书吗？ 不能。固定本地逻辑不代真实服务、并发或归档验收。 相关指南与源码 历史检索 · 引用结构 · 请求与回执 · 开始 · 隐私 cancelHistory/loadHistory/complete

### Does closing history undo a submit? Late reads, generations and confirmed receipts

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/history-generation-receipt-priority/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Does closing history undo a submit? Late reads, generations and confirmed receipts Closing history does not recall a submit; earlier reads cannot supersede a confirmed receipt History reads capture historyGeneration and recheck historyActive, current source, generation and cancellation after awaiting. cancelHistory changes local state/generation; reply complete also invalidates old history reads so pre-submit results do not win over confirmed receipts. This is not server recall or permission to treat late/ignored history as current absent/business state. Different from retrieval, references and request identity Retrieval checks coverage, references check structure, request IDs associate writes. Here asynchronous history versus confirmed-write ordering matters. No actual network submit/cancel, record cleanup or prior-reply modification occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Generation Captured for each read Query lifecycle Server version/request_id Return guard Active/source/generation/cancellation Response still applicable Any response is latest cancelHistory Inactive/increment generation/clear local busy View versus submit state Recall issued POST/service write Old-read defer Clear busy only for matching generation New read not overtaken by old cleanup All network canceled Complete Invalidate old reads, recorded=true Receipt versus new history Business handling/approval done Late response Do not apply failed guards Original scope/unknowns Absent, therefore safely resend Failure/no history Actual error/prior result still matters Not displayed differs from never written Record never existed Editorial retention Read/submit/receipt scopes separate Real associations/times Local counter is permanent audit certificate Synthetic ordering review Read A starts, then a submit receives recorded; A returns later. A is not a new post-confirmation whole view or a resend basis. Generation guards protect local ordering, while actual requests/originals still need review. Closing does not establish no network happened or server effects recalled. A generation is neither account credential, source epoch nor durable ledger. No concurrency/service regression ran; no universal race-free guarantee follows. FAQ Does closing history undo a reply? No. Read-only view state and writes/service outcomes differ. Is historyGeneration request_id? No. Local read generations differ from write-request identity. Is the last arriving response newest truth? No. Scope/generation/event order matter, not arrival alone. Can an old query declare absent after recorded? Do not supersede confirmation with invalidated old reads or infer resend authority from missing display. Does cancelHistory kill every network request? No such guarantee is asserted. Local invalidation differs from issued requests/effects. Are these permanent archives/race-free certificates? No. Local guards do not replace service/concurrency/retention acceptance. Reading and source Retrieval scope · Reference structure · Requests/receipts · Start · Privacy History lifecycle/complete

### 键盘开关亮了就就绪吗？本地状态、异步回执与页面焦点核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/keyboard-acknowledgement-scope/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 键盘开关亮了就就绪吗？本地状态、异步回执与页面焦点核对 本地enabled/visible不等网页已确认，更不等文字已填入 setKeyboardEnabled先更新本地keyboardEnabled/keyboardVisible，再等enqueueKeyboard的脚本Bool回执，并用keyboardRequest排除旧结果。失败可回退显示并提示进入会话。dismissKeyboard发起UIKit结束编辑并排队禁用页面；本地隐藏不独立证明网页立即确认，也不代表草稿保存或发送。 与origin、页面桥及音频忙态的区别 origin核边界，桥回执核文字插入分支，音频忙态核资源；这里核 键盘状态是意图、页面确认还是实际输入会话 。不启用键盘、输入文字或修改网页。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 乐观状态 先设enabled/visible 调用阶段与最终结果 true就是已成功弹出 脚本回执 返回Bool true才视为接纳 页面实际条件和错误 所有输入框都支持 keyboardRequest 新请求使旧UI结果不适用 本地顺序与请求归属 账户/服务request_id 串行任务 等待前一键盘任务再核当前请求 已派发和待派发区别 旧事件从未执行 原生焦点 启用时尝试becomeFirstResponder 原生/DOM/实机显示分开 DOM focus保证物理键盘出现 隐藏路径 清本地状态、endEditing、排队disable UI意图与页面确认分开 网页已立即完成所有变更 页面守卫 当前webView与isTrusted仍核 真实页面/输入槽 同名会话就可输入 后续交接 文字/草稿/回执另核 实际内容与权限 键盘状态证明已发送 合成键盘时序 刚请求启用时本地字段为true，但脚本尚未回报。只能报告请求中，不称网页已就绪。若随后发出禁用，较早enable的返回也不能替新请求更新UI结论。 键盘行为需要实际设备/输入环境证据，本页未测试。源码避免忙网页阻塞原生隐藏/麦克风准备的设计意图不构成零延迟或所有网页兼容保证，不靠改本地Bool绕过页面条件。 FAQ 开关true就证明键盘实际出现吗？ 不能，先有乐观状态、后有回执，物理设备输入环境另核。 Bool回执能证明文字已填入吗？ 不能，它属于键盘设置，不是转写插入/发送回执。 keyboardRequest是服务端请求ID吗？ 不是，是本地键盘请求顺序，不授身份或写权。 隐藏后网页一定同时完成禁用吗？ 不能独立推断，页面操作排队执行，本地显示与异步结果分开。 DOM focus是否保证实机软键盘？ 不保证，原生输入会话及实际设备条件仍要验证。 本页是否点了键盘或输入真实数据？ 没有，只核固定源码，不做浏览器/设备验收。 相关指南与源码 页面与origin · 文字桥回执 · 忙态区别 · 开始 · 隐私 setKeyboardEnabled/enqueueKeyboard/dismissKeyboard · 页面键盘策略

### Does an enabled keyboard mean ready? Local state, asynchronous ack and page focus

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/keyboard-acknowledgement-scope/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Does an enabled keyboard mean ready? Local state, asynchronous ack and page focus Local enabled/visible is not page acknowledgement or inserted text setKeyboardEnabled updates keyboardEnabled/keyboardVisible before awaiting enqueueKeyboard’s Bool result, then rejects stale results through keyboardRequest. Failure can revert state/show an entry notice. dismissKeyboard requests UIKit end-editing and queues page disable. Local hiding proves neither immediate page acknowledgement nor saved/sent drafts. Different from origin, insertion bridges and audio busy states Origin checks boundaries, bridges check text adaptation, busy states check resources. Here keyboard intent versus page confirmation versus actual input session matters. No keyboard, typing or page change ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Optimistic state Enabled/visible set first Call phase versus final result true means physically shown Script ack Bool true counts as accepted Actual page conditions/errors Every input supported keyboardRequest New request invalidates old UI result Local order/ownership Account/server request_id Serial tasks Await prior task, recheck current request Dispatched versus waiting Older operation never ran Native focus Attempt becomeFirstResponder Native/DOM/device visibility DOM focus guarantees software keyboard Hide Local state/endEditing/queued disable Intent versus page ack Every page change instantly complete Guards Current webView/isTrusted required Actual page/composer Same name permits input Handoff Text/draft/receipt separately Actual contents/authority Keyboard state proves sending Synthetic keyboard timing Local fields become true on enable request while script acknowledgement is pending. Report intent, not readiness. A later disable means the old enable response cannot update the newer UI conclusion. Actual device/input evidence remains necessary. Avoiding busy-page delay is a design intent, not zero-latency/universal-page acceptance. Do not change local booleans to bypass conditions. FAQ Does true prove a visible keyboard? No. Optimistic state precedes ack; physical input conditions differ. Does Bool ack prove inserted transcription? No. It acknowledges keyboard configuration, not insertion/sending. Is keyboardRequest a server request ID? No. Local ordering grants no identity/write authority. Does hiding instantly confirm page disable? No inference follows; queued page operations differ from local display. Does DOM focus guarantee a device soft keyboard? No. Native input-session/device conditions need validation. Was real typing/device testing performed? No. Fixed-source scope only, without browser/device acceptance. Reading and source Page/origin · Text bridge · Busy states · Start · Privacy Keyboard request flow · Page keyboard policy

### 点重试会从头转写吗？已有文字、transcribedFrames与pending核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-transcription-retry-checkpoint/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 点重试会从头转写吗？已有文字、transcribedFrames与pending核对 retry保留原字段并排队，不是自动清空全文从头识别 笔记retry把传入笔记状态设pending、清failure后保存，未在此清空transcript或transcribedFrames。转写读取音频时从已记帧位置继续并拼接后续结果；加载时遗留recording/transcribing也可转pending。状态重置不是完整恢复或逐词准确率验收，更不是自动重新录制。 与重录前检、音文映射和拼接的区别 重录核缺口是否需新采集，映射核材料对应，join核边界规则；这里核 重试动作保留哪些旧结果、从什么位置继续 。不点实际重试、不改内部帧位、不执行模型或文件恢复。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 retry 设pending并清failure 保留的原笔记字段 全文被清空/开始新录音 已有文字 transcript仍在 旧结果和后续新增分开 全部都由这次重试新生成 已记帧位 从transcribedFrames读取 记录断点与实际音频 每词已对齐/完整性已证 加载遗留状态 recording/transcribing转pending 排队与实际成功分开 崩溃后所有缓冲已恢复 worker 处理pending且检查canTranscribe 前台/忙态与实际结果 点击后立即或后台必完成 空转写分支 可推进帧而不加文字 真实内容仍需听核 没有遗漏业务话语 保存/失败 实际错误与持久结果另核 内存/磁盘/版本范围 无损或永久恢复SLA 交接标记 重试不在此清handOffAttempted 旧尝试与权限保留 再转写就允许重复交接 合成续点记录 样例笔记已有甲段文字、记录了帧位置N，状态failed。retry仅把它排为pending；后续按记录的N继续，不把甲段称为新录文，也不凭pending宣布恢复成功。 实际音频、最近保存与调用对象是否一致仍需证据，不能用手改transcribedFrames来隐藏缺口。新录制应另标版本，原一次交接与不确定停止不因重试取消。 FAQ retry一定从0开始吗？ 当前方法没有清帧位/文字，转写按已记位置继续，不可概括为从头重跑。 pending等于成功恢复吗？ 不是，只是待处理状态，实际文件/模型/权限和错误仍需核。 旧文字是否全算新一次输出？ 不能，已有transcript与新增片段须分开说明。 空片段推进位置说明没有业务内容吗？ 不能独立证明，原音频与语义另核。 转写重试是否自动清交接标记？ 不会由该方法提供，不把重试当重发授权。 本文执行了重试或模型吗？ 没有，只核源码；不提供无损恢复、云续传或新录音服务。 相关指南与源码 是否重录 · 音文材料 · 片段拼接 · 一次交接 · 开始 · 隐私 retry/load/worker/transcribe · 帧位与交接字段

### Does retry start over? Existing text, transcribedFrames and pending state

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-transcription-retry-checkpoint/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Does retry start over? Existing text, transcribedFrames and pending state retry queues preserved fields; it does not automatically clear and re-recognize everything Note retry sets the supplied note pending, clears failure and saves without clearing transcript/transcribedFrames there. Transcription opens audio at the recorded frame position and joins later results. Loading leftover recording/transcribing can also mark pending. State reset proves neither complete recovery nor word accuracy, and does not start a new recording. Different from recapture, mapping and joining Recapture assesses missing capture, mapping relates material, joining checks boundaries. Here what retry retains and where processing resumes matters. No actual retry, frame edit, model run or restore occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Retry Set pending/clear failure Retained original fields All text cleared/new capture Existing text transcript retained Earlier versus appended output Everything generated by this retry Checkpoint Read from transcribedFrames Recorded position versus audio Word alignment/integrity accepted Reloaded status recording/transcribing becomes pending Queue versus successful processing All crash buffers restored Worker Pending work with canTranscribe checks Foreground/busy/result Instant/background completion Empty transcript branch Can advance without adding words Actual speech still reviewed No missing business contents Save/failure Actual errors/persistence separately Memory/disk/version scope Lossless/permanent restore SLA Reservation retry does not clear handOffAttempted here Prior attempts/authority New transcription authorizes replay Synthetic checkpoint note A failed sample has old text A and position N. Retry queues pending; later work resumes at recorded N. Do not call A new output or pending successful recovery. Audio, latest persistence and supplied object still need correspondence evidence. Do not edit transcribedFrames to hide gaps. New capture needs a new version; reservations/uncertainty survive retry. FAQ Does retry always start at zero? This method clears neither text nor position; processing resumes from recorded frames. Does pending prove recovery? No. It is queued state, not actual file/model/access acceptance. Is old text all new output? No. Separate existing transcript from later pieces. Does advancing an empty piece prove no business speech? Not independently. Original audio/meaning need review. Does retry clear handoff reservations? Not through this method; it grants no resend authority. Was retry/inference performed? No. Source review only, without lossless restore/cloud resume/new capture services. Reading and source Recapture decision · Material mapping · Segment joining · One handoff · Start · Privacy Retry/load/worker/transcribe · Checkpoint/reservation fields

### 隐私manifest和权限文案能证明什么？声明、运行时与网页服务分账

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/privacy-declaration-evidence-scope/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 隐私manifest和权限文案能证明什么？声明、运行时与网页服务分账 有声明不等全路径已验，权限说明也不是数据从未离机的证明 当前PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy列出UserDefaults和FileTimestamp访问API类别及理由码；Info.plist另有麦克风/相机用途等配置。它们说明源码声明/文案，不是运行时所有入口、第三方工作台脚本或后续交接的审计证据，不能据此宣传零收集、App Store已审核或合法合规认证。 与内容脱敏、文件保护和网站隐私说明的区别 脱敏核内容，保护核具体存储选项，站点/服务隐私有各自范围；这里核 静态声明在证据链中的位置 。不解释法律结论、不读私人数据、不发网络请求或更改权限。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 PrivacyInfo 列NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes 当前实际文件与版本 全量运行时数据流已审 类别/理由 UserDefaults/FileTimestamp及CA92.1/C617.1 按源码所列范围说明 补造未列Tracking/CollectedData字段 Info.plist文案 麦克风/相机用途文字 文案与各入口实现另核 一句话证明所有路径行为 后台配置 audio等配置声明 运行状态/系统条件另验 所有锁屏/低电量场景保证 原生与网页 不同代码/服务范围 目标脚本/Cookie/账户与后续动作 原生声明涵盖所有网页 本机转写与交接 不同处理阶段 实际目标与发送/上传证据 本地识别就全链永不离机 发行/审核 声明文件不等外部审核 真实发行证据另核 有App Store链接或sameAs可填写 归档结论 版本/声明/实测范围分账 只报告真正核过的证据 安全/隐私认证或法律结论 合成声明记录 已知：固定版本包含两类API用途声明；未证：设备所有运行路径、第三方网页或后续目标的数据处理。只能写声明已查阅，不写全链零收集/全合规。 文件未列某字段也不能被自动解读为某项运行时保证。权限文案、用户选择、代码行为和实际网络/目的地证据分别保留；本文不填写商店身份、注册认证或执行隐私测试。 FAQ PrivacyInfo是否完整运行时审计报告？ 不是，它是当前源码声明，实际数据流和第三方行为仍需实证。 没有列某收集字段就证明全链零收集吗？ 不能这样推出，不补造字段含义或覆盖范围。 用途文案能代替测试所有入口吗？ 不能，各原生/快捷入口、网页与后续动作需按实际实现核。 本机识别是否证明后续文字永不上传？ 不证明。识别与获准交接/目标服务是不同阶段。 manifest存在说明App Store已上线审核吗？ 不说明，不因此生成未核实商店链接或sameAs。 本页是否给出法律或隐私认证？ 没有。仅核静态证据范围，不运行测试、不作合规结论。 相关指南与源码 文件选项 · 内容敏感层 · 壳与服务 · 实际交接证据 · 开始 · 隐私 实际API声明 · 用途/后台配置 · 原生与工作台产品边界

</tr>

### What privacy manifests and permission copy prove: declarations versus runtime and sites

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/privacy-declaration-evidence-scope/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What privacy manifests and permission copy prove: declarations versus runtime and sites A declaration is not whole-path acceptance or proof that data never leaves Current PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy lists UserDefaults/FileTimestamp accessed-API categories and reason codes. Info.plist separately contains microphone/camera purpose text and other configuration. These are source declarations/copy, not audits of every runtime entry, third-party page or later handoff. They establish neither zero collection, App Store review nor legal/privacy certification. Different from redaction, file options and service privacy Redaction concerns content, protection concerns actual writes, sites/services have separate scopes. Here static declarations within an evidence chain matter. No legal conclusion, private-data access, request or permission change occurs. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established PrivacyInfo Lists NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes Actual file/version All runtime data flows audited Categories/reasons UserDefaults/FileTimestamp and CA92.1/C617.1 Only listed source scope Invent missing Tracking/CollectedData fields Info.plist copy Mic/camera purpose text Copy versus entry implementation One sentence proves every path Background configuration audio etc. declared Actual runtime/system evidence All locked/low-power scenarios guaranteed Native/pages Different code/service scopes Scripts/Cookies/accounts/later actions Native declarations cover every site Local ASR/handoff Separate stages Actual destination/upload/send Local recognition means data never leaves Distribution/review Files are not external acceptance Real release evidence Unverified App Store/sameAs Retention evidence Version/declarations/tests separated Actually reviewed scope Security/privacy/legal certification Synthetic declaration note Known: two API categories are declared in fixed source. Unknown: every device path, third-party page and destination’s processing. Report reviewed declarations, not whole-chain zero collection/compliance. Absent fields do not automatically create runtime guarantees. Preserve copy, choice, implementation and actual network/destination evidence separately. No store identity, certification or privacy test is supplied. FAQ Is PrivacyInfo a complete runtime audit? No. Source declarations differ from actual flows/third-party evidence. Does an absent collection field prove whole-chain zero collection? No. Invent neither meanings nor coverage. Does purpose copy replace testing every entry? No. Native/shortcut/page/later actions need implementation-specific evidence. Does local ASR mean later text is never uploaded? No. Recognition and authorized handoff/services differ. Does a manifest prove App Store release/review? No. Do not generate unverified store links/sameAs. Is legal/privacy certification provided? No. Static evidence scope only, without testing or compliance conclusions. Reading and source File options · Sensitive content layers · Shell/services · Actual handoff · Start · Privacy Actual API declarations · Purpose/background settings · Native/workbench boundaries

### 文件分块交接代表什么？768KiB桥传输不是断点上传或服务回执

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/file-chunk-bridge-not-upload-receipt/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 文件分块交接代表什么？768KiB桥传输不是断点上传或服务回执 跨WK桥分块，不等于目标服务已收到完整文件 attachFiles将本地文件按最多768 KiB原始数据分块读成base64，交给页面侧helper，再请求页面自己的文件控件接纳。JS会累积parts并组装File；因此分块不证明所有端总内存恒定，也不是服务端流式/断点上传协议。attached是页面阶段结果，不是远端完成或消息发送回执。 与混合批次、manifest和文件保护的区别 批次指南核文件先行与文本后填，manifest核本地可见点，保护核写选项；这里核 原生文件到JS再到控件的跨进程阶段 。不读取或上传真实附件，不新增文件传输服务。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 原生读取 最多768 KiB/块，按offset继续 本地读取与实际错误 服务端断点位置 base64 转换为桥参数字符串 编码开销与传输层分开 原始字节数就是全部RAM JS暂存 incoming/parts累积后组File 页面内存与本地文件分开 全端恒定内存 chunk回报 逐块Bool结果可能失败 这层接纳不是服务确认 后端已存每一块 最终控件 原页面上传input与accept等条件 实际控件限制/接纳 支持任意网站/类型/大文件 页面边界 此路径按isTrusted等核 不要套用文字通道所有页面条件 所有通道守卫完全一样 discard 清页面helper暂存ID 本地暂存与远端副本 撤销已发生的服务上传 预算与结果 本地暂存预算/attached另核 实际阶段和剩余材料 200MiB暂存就保证网页能收 合成分块记录 已知：样例文件若干块已被helper接纳；未知：最终控件/服务状态。不能写“上传完成”，也不能从后续失败推前面都从未发生。保持目标页面稳定并核真正结果，不靠改扩展名或重复整批绕过限制。 分块避免单个巨型JS字符串是实现目的，不构成全局RAM、速度或后台续传SLA。源码没有在这条原生桥中提供通用服务端上传/恢复协议，本页也未测网络或设备。 FAQ 分块是否就是服务端流式上传？ 不是，原生到JS桥与网站到服务端是不同阶段。 768KiB是否总内存上限？ 不是，还涉及base64/parts/File等，不作全端恒定内存保证。 attached能证明对方服务保存了吗？ 不能，只报页面接纳阶段，真实远端状态另核。 discard是否能撤回远端附件？ 不能由清helper暂存推出服务撤回。 200MiB暂存预算代表所有网站兼容吗？ 不代表，页面控件/服务还有各自限制和权限。 本文执行了上传或断点测试吗？ 没有，只核固定源码，不提供新传输/转码/续传功能。 相关指南与源码 批次阶段 · 本地可见点 · 文件保护 · 开始 · 隐私 attachFiles/base64Chunk · incoming/parts/控件适配 · 本地暂存预算

### What file chunks establish: a 768 KiB bridge is not resumable upload or a receipt

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/file-chunk-bridge-not-upload-receipt/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What file chunks establish: a 768 KiB bridge is not resumable upload or a receipt Chunks crossing a WebKit bridge do not prove the destination saved a complete file attachFiles reads up to 768 KiB raw data per chunk, base64-encodes bridge arguments, then asks the page’s own file control to accept them. JS accumulates parts and constructs File objects. Chunking proves neither constant memory everywhere nor server streaming/resume. attached is a page-stage result, not remote completion or sending. Different from mixed batches, manifests and protection Batches concern placement order, manifests concern local visibility, protection concerns writes. Here native-to-JS-to-input stages matter. No real attachment is read/uploaded and no transfer service is added. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Native reads Up to 768 KiB with offset Local read/errors Server resume offset Base64 Bridge string encoding Overhead versus transfer stage Raw bytes equal all RAM JS staging incoming/parts accumulate into File Page memory versus local file Constant memory across all sides Chunk response Per-chunk Bool can fail Local acceptance versus service Backend saved every chunk Final control Page input/accept conditions Actual control/service limits Every site/type/size supported Page boundary isTrusted etc. on this path Not all text-path conditions transfer All channels have identical guards Discard Clear helper IDs Local staging versus remote copies Recall a prior service upload Budget/result Local staging/attached separately Actual stage/remaining items 200 MiB staging guarantees site acceptance Synthetic chunk note Known: helper accepted several sample chunks. Unknown: final input/service status. Do not report upload complete or infer nothing happened from later failure. Keep the intended page stable and inspect actual results rather than renaming types/replaying batches. Avoiding one giant JS string is implementation intent, not total-memory/speed/background-resume SLA. No general server upload/recovery protocol or device/network benchmark is supplied here. FAQ Are chunks server streaming? No. Native-to-JS and site-to-service are different stages. Is 768 KiB a whole-memory limit? No. Base64/parts/File and other allocations remain. Does attached prove server storage? No. Page acceptance differs from remote evidence. Does discard recall a remote attachment? No. Clearing helper state does not establish recall. Does 200 MiB staging certify every site? No. Inputs/services retain limits and permissions. Was upload/resume tested? No. Fixed source only, without a transfer/transcoding/resume feature. Reading and source Batch stages · Local visibility · File protection · Start · Privacy Attachment/chunk flow · Parts/input adaptation · Staging budget

### 识别参数什么时候生效？每pass快照与输出token预算核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/recognition-pass-parameter-budget/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 识别参数什么时候生效？每pass快照与输出token预算核对 一次识别的参数快照，不等整段会话永久同设置或实时调参 Qwen3OnDeviceTranscriber每次transcribe先读取语言、usesTerms和maxTokens偏好，再按该pass使用。默认最大输出448 token，配置范围64–1024并作clamp。token不是字数或音频时长；提高只增输出上限，仍受模型缓存等条件影响，不直接证明准确率。UI忙态会禁用该设置区，本页不新增录音中实时调参。 与术语列表、PCM格式和预览的区别 术语指南核列表解析，PCM指南核输入采样，预览指南核替换语义；这里核 每次识别调用的参数时点与输出预算单位 。不改设置、不运行模型，也不调整Agent服务端温度/费用。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 偏好快照 每pass读取language/usesTerms/maxTokens 本次调用与以后调用分开 整个录音会话所有pass永远相同 语言 单一modelHint或自动 实际语言选项 自动翻译/准确率保证 输出预算 默认448，64–1024配置范围 token非Character/字节 能录448秒或448字必完整 clamp 偏好值按允许范围限制 实际消费者与源值 任意数值都执行 词表开关/内容 开关快照与构造contextTerms分别核 解码入参不混为全会话实时配置 输出token数就是可带词表项数 预算不足 可能截断输出，缓存仍有限 真实结果与原音频 调高必更准/覆盖全部内容 音频限制 16k单声道及原输入长度门仍在 采样/时长与输出预算分开 maxTokens能绕30秒采集/识别门 证据比较 记录实际调用参数与已核范围 旧预览/最终/重试不同pass 设置标签就是准确率或送达 合成参数核查 两次识别的输出上限不同，不能只按字数长短判更准确，也不能说较长结果一定保留全部条件。若UI忙态不可改，不为测试绕过它；源码快照语义不是承诺有实时调参入口。 contextTerms在构造解码入参时取得，不能把每项配置读取描述成一个全会话永久锁定时点。结果用于简报仍须核原文、否定和未知，本文没有模型基准或参数优化成绩。 FAQ 448 token就是448字吗？ 不是。token、字符、标量和字节不同，也不是音频秒数。 调到1024就一定更准确吗？ 不会直接保证，只增加输出预算，仍受模型/缓存/输入等限制。 改maxTokens会延长音频准入吗？ 不会由这个参数绕过原16k/时长等输入条件。 所有预览和final必须同一参数吗？ 不能从每pass快照推出整个会话永久相同，比较需核实际调用。 这是Agent云端温度或beam设置吗？ 不是。现有识别设置不提供任意温度/top-p/beam控制或通用Agent后台。 本文改了参数或跑了优化吗？ 没有。只核源码单位/时点，不承诺设备性能或准确率。 相关指南与源码 词表 · PCM准入 · 预览语义 · 重试范围 · 开始 · 隐私 每pass偏好与入参 · 默认值/范围/clamp · 设置文案与忙态

### When recognition settings apply: per-pass snapshots and output-token budgets

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/recognition-pass-parameter-budget/

All scenarios · Related practical guide When recognition settings apply: per-pass snapshots and output-token budgets Per-pass settings are not a permanently fixed session or real-time tuning feature Each Qwen3OnDeviceTranscriber.transcribe reads language, usesTerms and maxTokens preferences for that pass. Maximum output defaults to 448 tokens with a clamped 64–1024 range. Tokens are neither character count nor audio duration. Raising the ceiling does not directly improve accuracy and remains model-cache bounded. Busy UI disables the section; no live capture-time tuning is added. Different from terms, PCM and previews Terms concern list parsing, PCM concerns sampling, previews concern replacement. Here parameter timing and output-budget units per recognition call matter. No settings/model/cloud temperature or budget is changed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Snapshot language/usesTerms/maxTokens per pass This versus later calls Every pass in a capture always identical Language One modelHint or automatic Actual choice Translation/accuracy guarantee Output budget Default 448, range 64–1024 Tokens versus Characters/bytes 448 seconds or complete 448 characters Clamp Limit preference to allowed range Actual consumer/value Any number executes Terms Toggle snapshot/content argument separately Actual decoding inputs Output-token count equals term count Low budget Output can truncate, cache limited Actual output/audio More always better/complete Audio conditions Original 16 kHz mono/length guards Audio versus output limits maxTokens bypasses 30-second boundaries Comparison Actual parameters/reviewed scope Preview/final/retry passes differ Labels certify accuracy/delivery Synthetic parameter note Two calls have different output ceilings. Text length alone does not establish accuracy or retention of all conditions. Do not bypass busy UI to test; snapshot semantics are not a live-control promise. contextTerms is obtained when constructing decoder arguments; avoid claiming every setting was atomically fixed forever across the whole session. Briefs still need original/negation/unknown review. No benchmark/optimization result is supplied. FAQ Are 448 tokens 448 characters? No. Tokens, Characters, scalars and bytes differ, and none is audio duration. Does 1024 guarantee better accuracy? No. It raises output budget within model/cache/input constraints. Does maxTokens extend audio admission? No bypass of original sampling/length guards follows. Must previews/final share one configuration? Per-pass snapshots do not prove a permanently identical session; inspect actual calls. Is this cloud Agent temperature/beam tuning? No. Existing ASR settings do not provide arbitrary temperature/top-p/beam or a universal Agent backend. Were settings/model optimizations run? No. Source units/timing only, without performance/accuracy acceptance. Reading and source Vocabulary · PCM admission · Preview meaning · Retry scope · Start · Privacy Pass snapshot/arguments · Defaults/range/clamp · Settings/busy scope

### 同名附件加2是新版本吗？批次命名、MIME与大小元数据核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/attachment-name-metadata-provenance/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 同名附件加2是新版本吗？批次命名、MIME与大小元数据核对 暂存重命名只是区分文件，不是版本、去重或内容认证 收件箱save为每个批次新建usedNames，uniqueName不区分大小写检测命名冲突，保留文件并加数字区分；不是丢弃或合并同名内容。contentType由扩展名推断，byteCount为来源大小统计。它们都不能证明业务版本、真实格式、字节一致或已脱敏，本页不新增档案去重/鉴定服务。 与批次逐项、编码和变更档案的区别 逐项指南核内容/阶段，编码指南核序列化，变更档案核前后关系；这里核 原文件名到暂存名的对应及元数据能证明什么 。不复制真实文件，不改名或公开附件。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 局部命名 usedNames在本批次内使用 批次/条目ID与原引用 全收件箱或全账户去重 大小写 候选lowercased后检测冲突 原名与暂存名保留对应 仅大小写不同可当同内容 数字后缀 冲突时保留文件并编号 编号由命名占用产生 版本2/最新批准稿 路径清理 uniqueName处理名称字符 显示名与实际材料区别 安全扫描/内容鉴定 类型提示 UTType按扩展名取MIME 真实格式/目的地另核 扩展名正确就内容可信 byteCount 文件/目录包大小统计，读取失败需另核 大小测量与实际副本 同大小就是相同SHA 暂存预算 按测得文件大小累计200MiB门 非全部文字/网页限制 任意网页都能上传200MiB 归档身份 batch/item/id/原引用分账 实际版本/内容证据 名字、数字和MIME就是业务身份 合成命名示意 同一批次先有sample.txt，再来SAMPLE.TXT，后者可暂存为SAMPLE 2.TXT。只是命名冲突处理，两份仍不同条目，不能称第二份为业务v2，也不能据此认定两份内容相同或已合并。 不同批次可重复使用同名，类型和大小元数据也不是密码学摘要。若需要版本比对，沿已有获准原引用和实际字节/内容核；不要改扩展名伪装格式或用命名绕过交接/权限。 FAQ 文件名2是不是版本v2？ 不是，数字是局部冲突编号，不是业务版本或批准顺序。 大小写不同会保留两个未改名的同名项吗？ 当前uniqueName按小写检测冲突，会给冲突候选编号；并不合并内容。 是否全局删除重复内容？ 没有，这里是每批次命名唯一性，不是内容去重。 MIME能证明文件真实格式吗？ 不能，它由扩展名推断，真实内容和目的地条件另核。 byteCount相同是否字节一致？ 不能，只是大小，非SHA或原件真实性证据。 本文执行了复制/改名/鉴定吗？ 没有，只核合成例子和源码，不操作实际附件或新增服务。 相关指南与源码 逐项检查 · 编码与文件名 · 版本材料 · 文件桥阶段 · 开始 · 隐私 uniqueName/byteCount/save · 附件条目与后续放置

### Does attachment 2 mean version two? Batch names, MIME and byte-count evidence

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/attachment-name-metadata-provenance/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Does attachment 2 mean version two? Batch names, MIME and byte-count evidence A staged rename distinguishes files; it does not certify versions, deduplication or contents Each save creates batch-local usedNames. uniqueName detects conflicts case-insensitively and preserves files under numbered names instead of merging/dropping contents. contentType comes from the extension; byteCount estimates source size. None establishes business version, actual format, byte identity or redaction. No archive deduplication/inspection service is added. Different from item review, encoding and revision retention Items concern content/stages, encoding concerns serialization, retention relates revisions. Here original-to-staged names and metadata evidence matter. No real file is copied, renamed or disclosed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Local names usedNames for one batch Batch/item IDs/original reference Whole-inbox/account deduplication Case lowercased collision checks Original/staged mapping Case variants prove identical content Suffix Preserve/number conflicting files Name occupancy Version 2/latest approval Name cleanup Name-character processing Label versus actual material Security scan/content identification Type hint Extension-derived UTType/MIME Actual format/destination Suffix proves trusted contents byteCount File/package size estimate; read failures separately Measured size/actual copy Same size means same SHA Staging budget 200 MiB measured-file accumulation Not every text/page limit Every site accepts 200 MiB Retention identity Batch/item/id/reference separately Real version/content evidence Name/number/MIME are business identity Synthetic naming illustration One batch contains sample.txt followed by SAMPLE.TXT; the latter can become SAMPLE 2.TXT. This is a collision suffix, not business v2, equal contents or automatic merging. Other batches can reuse names. Type/size are not cryptographic digests. Use authorized originals/actual bytes/content for revision review instead of disguising formats or bypassing handoff/access through renaming. FAQ Does suffix 2 mean business v2? No. Local naming occupancy is not approval/version order. Are case variants retained without renaming? Current checks lowercase conflicts and number candidates, without merging contents. Does this globally remove duplicate contents? No. Batch-local name uniqueness is not content deduplication. Does MIME prove real format? No. Extension inference differs from content/destination evidence. Does equal byteCount prove equal bytes? No. Size is neither SHA nor authenticity. Were files copied/renamed/inspected? No. Synthetic/source review only, without attachment operations/services. Reading and source Per-item checks · Encoding/names · Version material · File bridge stages · Start · Privacy Naming/sizes/save · Files/later placement

### 焦点框为什么不能接收录文？DOM可编辑、可用与草稿准入

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/focused-editable-admission-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 焦点框为什么不能接收录文？DOM可编辑、可用与草稿准入 有焦点只是一项条件，不是任意输入框都能接收原生文字 现有DOM适配关注textarea、指定text类input和contenteditable，并进一步核连接、禁用、只读/键盘策略例外、inert/aria状态及可见性。已知Collie结构还须证明单一草稿模式。不是看到框或placeholder就自动识别所有表单，未知布局也不应被假定兼容。 与origin、桥回执和键盘的区别 origin核边界，桥回执核分支，键盘核输入会话；这里核 DOM候选本身是否满足适配条件 。不点击、注入或改属性，不测试真实页面。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 类型 textarea、指定text/search/url/email等input、contenteditable 实际元素类型 所有password/number/按钮都支持 焦点跟踪 focusin/composedPath记录最后目标 可观测目标与当前页 任意闭合shadow/iframe自动可达 脚本范围 forMainFrameOnly主框架 主文档与其他frame分开 所有跨域iframe支持 usable 连接、未disabled/无inert/aria-busy等 真实状态 有节点就可写 readOnly 普通限制，键盘策略canInsert可有例外 按原策略核，不一概而论 改属性可绕锁或所有只读绝对相同 可见检查 clientRects/visibility等 代码条件非完整视觉验收 一定在视口可点/安全 Collie结构 已知字段/控件须满足草稿条件 单一目标与状态 结构匹配就账户/审批通过 最终结果 框架可接受或拒正常编辑 实际回执和值 候选通过就已发送 合成DOM核查 一个已聚焦input若类型为password，不是这组text类型候选；一个普通textarea也仍须通过可用/草稿条件。不能把“看见输入框”当成功，也不通过解除disabled/aria-busy等绕过原界面。 原生仅在已允许范围尝试正常编辑，未知框架不保证兼容。本文不把主框架、shadow事件路径或isSafeDraft当完整安全/身份认证，也没有新通用表单自动化。 FAQ 焦点在框里就必能插入吗？ 不能，还核类型、可用状态、页面和具体适配条件。 所有只读框都绝对相同吗？ 不能概括，源码允许App键盘策略明确认可的例外，不据此绕过其他只读。 所有iframe或shadow都支持吗？ 没有这种保证，脚本主框架范围与可观测事件目标要分开。 placeholder能证明是正确任务草稿吗？ 不能，结构与状态及原目标条件另核，不靠显示文字认身份。 已知Collie标记出现就自动放宽吗？ 不是，已知结构要求证明草稿条件，不借通用框假设绕门。 本文实际改过网页属性吗？ 没有，只核固定适配源码，不作页面/框架兼容认证。 相关指南与源码 页面边界 · 桥回执 · 键盘确认 · 开始 · 隐私 editable/usable/isSafeDraft/主框架 · 原生插入条件

### Why a focused field refuses transcription: editable, usable and draft conditions

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/focused-editable-admission-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why a focused field refuses transcription: editable, usable and draft conditions Focus is one prerequisite, not permission for every field to receive native text The guarded adapter considers textarea, specified text-like inputs and contenteditable, then checks connection, disabled/readOnly-with-keyboard-exception, inert/aria and visibility conditions. Known Collie structures must prove a unique draft mode. Visible boxes/placeholders do not establish universal form identification or compatibility. Different from origin, bridge and keyboard review Origin checks boundaries, bridges check branches, keyboards check sessions. Here DOM candidate eligibility matters. No clicks, injections or attribute changes ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Types textarea/text/search/url/email etc./contenteditable Actual element type Every password/number/button supported Tracking focusin/composedPath retains last target Observable target/current page Every closed shadow/iframe reachable Script scope forMainFrameOnly Main document versus frames All cross-origin iframe support Usable Connected/not disabled/inert/aria-busy etc. Actual state Any node writable readOnly Keyboard canInsert can permit scoped exception Original policy Attribute edits bypass locks/all readonly identical Visibility Rects/visibility conditions Code versus visual acceptance In viewport/clickable/safe Known Collie Field/control draft conditions Unique target/state Structure proves account/approval Final result Framework can accept/reject edit Receipt/actual value Candidate acceptance means sent Synthetic DOM review A focused password input is not in this text-type set. An ordinary textarea still needs usability/draft conditions. Seeing a box proves no success; do not remove disabled/aria-busy to bypass the UI. Normal editing remains scoped and unknown frameworks unguaranteed. Main-frame/shadow tracking/isSafeDraft are not security/identity certification or new general form automation. FAQ Does focus guarantee insertion? No. Type/state/page/adapter checks remain. Are all readonly elements treated identically? No. An App keyboard-policy exception exists; do not extend it to bypass other locks. Are every iframe/shadow supported? No. Main-frame scope and observable focus targets differ. Does a placeholder identify the task draft? No. Structure/state/original-target conditions remain. Do known Collie markers relax checks? No. Known structures must prove draft conditions, not exploit generic assumptions. Were page attributes changed? No. Fixed source only, not framework compatibility certification. Reading and source Page boundary · Bridge results · Keyboard ack · Start · Privacy Editable/usable/draft/frame · Native insertion guards

### 没有文字就坏模型吗？采集、输入、模型与空转写错误分层

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/recognition-error-layer-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 没有文字就坏模型吗？采集、输入、模型与空转写错误分层 同样“没有文字”，可能是不同层失败，不能自动归为模型损坏 控制器将权限拒绝、录音/PCM失败和模型missing/load失败分到不同提示。ASR还检查非空、有限样本和长度；最终空文字会产生emptyTranscript。短语音将空结果视作录音类失败，长笔记可略过该片段文字并推进帧位。提示是分类，不是完整底层诊断或原音频无内容证明。 与格式准入、模型校验和续点的区别 格式核输入形状，模型校验核资产/运行准备，续点核重试位置；这里核 错误从哪一层产生、显示类别不能推出哪些结论 。不运行录音、模型、重试或文件操作。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 权限拒绝 captureFailure有microphonePermission分支 真实系统授权 所有失败都因为权限 录音/PCM 受控错误或录音fallback 格式/中断/实际输入 模型一定坏了 ASR数组 非空/有限/长度门 数组与硬件格式不同层 数组通过即语音有效/有业务内容 模型missing/load 归模型提示 原校验与加载证据 唯一原因就是SHA被改 emptyTranscript 最终空文字错误 实际音频/语义/阶段 原来一定无人说话 短语音/长笔记 空结果处理分支不同 失败提示与略过片段分账 所有入口相同结果 卡片文案 有意不展示任意系统原始错误 可见分类非完整日志 所有底层原因都已确定 后续处理 原授权/目标/待核条件仍在 最小非敏感错误与范围 自动删模型/上云/盲重发 合成分层记录 收到emptyTranscript，只能记这次识别没有返回可用最终文字，不能宣布模型损坏或原会议信息为空。若是模型加载提示，也应核原完整性/运行证据，不能直接下篡改结论。 长笔记推进处理帧不保证每词捕获；错误文案不是服务回执。本文没有设备/真实语音回归，不为排错公开原录音、系统路径或账户内容。 FAQ 没文字一定是模型坏了吗？ 不是，输入、采集、权限、空结果和模型阶段需分开。 emptyTranscript证明原音频只有静音吗？ 不能独立证明，原音频与内容另核。 短语音和长笔记空结果一样吗？ 不是，引用路径分别走失败提示或片段略过/进度逻辑。 模型加载提示能证明恶意改文件吗？ 不能，它不是完整根因诊断，版本/缺项/加载等证据另核。 提示是否显示了全部系统原始异常？ 没有，控制器对用户提示作分类和fallback，不把卡片当完整日志。 本文是否删模型、重录或切云端？ 没有，不新增自动回退/删除/重发；真实操作仍需既有授权和条件。 相关指南与源码 输入格式 · 模型证据 · 重试续点 · 权限分层 · 开始 · 隐私 captureFailure/recognitionFailure · 样本/非空检查 · 空片与进度

### No text does not mean a broken model: capture, input, model and empty-result layers

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/recognition-error-layer-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide No text does not mean a broken model: capture, input, model and empty-result layers The same missing-text symptom can come from different layers The controller separates permission denial, recording/PCM failures and missing/load-model errors. ASR checks nonempty finite samples/length, and empty final text produces emptyTranscript. Short speech maps empty results to recording failure; long notes can skip text and advance frames. Notices are categories, not complete diagnosis or proof the original contained nothing. Different from admission, integrity and retry checkpoints Admission checks input, integrity checks assets/readiness, checkpoints check retry position. Here error origin and limits of visible categories matter. No capture/model/retry/file operation ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Permission captureFailure has microphonePermission case Actual system state Every error is permission Recording/PCM Vetted errors/recording fallback Format/interruption/input Model certainly broken ASR array Nonempty/finite/length checks Array versus hardware format layers Valid array proves meaningful speech Model missing/load Model notice category Integrity/loading evidence Only cause is hash tampering emptyTranscript Empty returned final Actual audio/meaning/stage Nobody spoke Caller difference Short speech/long notes differ Failure versus skipped-piece progress Every entry has identical outcomes Notice copy Arbitrary raw system errors not exposed Category versus full diagnostics All causes established Next steps Original authority/target/pending guards Minimal nonsensitive scope Automatic deletion/cloud/replay Synthetic layered note emptyTranscript establishes no usable final from this pass, not a corrupt model or empty meeting. A model-load notice likewise needs actual integrity/runtime review instead of a tampering claim. Advanced frames do not certify every word; notices are not service receipts. No device/real-speech regression ran. Do not publish recordings/system paths/account contents to investigate. FAQ Does no text always mean corrupt model? No. Input, capture, permission, empty results and loading differ. Does emptyTranscript prove silence? Not independently. Actual audio/content need review. Are empty-result callers identical? No. Short failure and long-note skip/progress differ. Does load failure prove malicious files? No. It is not complete root-cause diagnosis. Are notices full raw system errors? No. Classification/fallback differs from full diagnostics. Was a model deleted/recording/cloud fallback invoked? No. No automatic deletion/fallback/replay is added; actual operations retain authority/guards. Reading and source Input format · Model evidence · Retry position · Permission layers · Start · Privacy Error categories · Sample/final checks · Empty pieces/progress

### 列表只显示40字或两行代表什么？预览、正文与分享范围核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/list-preview-not-transcript-archive/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 列表只显示40字或两行代表什么？预览、正文与分享范围核对 看到短预览，不等保存或交接的内容也只有这么短 共享文字的displayName返回前40个Swift Character，而URL/文件名走其他分支；笔记done行用完整transcript的Text配lineLimit(2)限制布局。一个是派生前缀，一个是显示行数，都不是自动纪要、隐私脱敏或原文已截短的证明。分享应核真正text/transcript，不凭列表截图认定范围。 与空字段占位、摘要溯源和音文对应的区别 占位核缺项显示，溯源核人工摘要句子，音文核文件关系；这里核 列表预览怎样派生、它与真实存储/交接材料的差别 。不读取用户记录或导出真实正文。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 共享text预览 displayName取prefix(40) 单位是Swift Character 40 token/字节或全文 URL/文件分支 返回text或fileName等 不能套同一个40限制 所有附件名都仅有40字符 笔记done行 Text(transcript).lineLimit(2) 布局和源字符串分开 原文固定截成两行保存 其他笔记状态 pending/failed等显示不同 旧字段/实际状态另核 卡片没正文就是正文丢了 交接字段 共享路径使用实际text等 实际内容/附件/权限 只会交出屏幕看见部分 语义 前缀/行限制非总结 原文与编辑稿分开 系统已抽出会议要点 敏感内容 短显示仍可能含识别信息 全文/复制/目的地分别核 省略号等于脱敏或匿名 归档证据 截图只说明显示范围 授权原引用与完整材料 预览就是全量/真实性凭证 合成预览核对 一份合成记录远长于40 Character，列表只显示开头；不能报告只保存了开头，或用这个截图证明后面的敏感内容不会被分享。两行显示位置也受布局影响，不等固定字数合同。 需要归档时在既有权限内核真实字段与版本，不为查全文扩张私有来源访问。本文未做屏幕/读屏/复制或实际交接测试，不把任何视图当全量档案和隐私保证。 FAQ prefix40说明原text被改短了吗？ 不能由派生displayName推原字段被修改，实际存储/交接另核。 lineLimit2是否保存两行正文？ 不是，它限制布局，不在此把transcript截为两行。 URL和文件名也都按40截吗？ 不能推广，源码有不同kind分支，视觉布局又是另一层。 failed列表无正文说明旧文字被清空吗？ 不说明，状态分支显示与真实transcript分开。 短预览就是自动摘要/脱敏吗？ 不是，前缀与行限制不是语义总结或内容清洗。 本页导出或查看了完整用户记录吗？ 没有。只核静态显示/数据路径，不作真实显示或分享验收。 相关指南与源码 显示占位 · 摘要溯源 · 音文材料 · 逐项分享范围 · 开始 · 隐私 displayName分支 · 状态行与lineLimit · 实际text放置
