### What forty characters or two lines prove: previews, originals and sharing scope

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/list-preview-not-transcript-archive/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What forty characters or two lines prove: previews, originals and sharing scope A short list preview does not mean saved or shared contents are equally short Shared text displayName takes 40 Swift Characters; URLs/filenames use other branches. A done-note row displays Text(transcript) with lineLimit(2). Prefix derivation and line layout are different, and neither proves automatic minutes, redaction or truncated originals. Review actual text/transcript, not screenshots, for handoff scope. Different from placeholders, summary provenance and material mapping Placeholders concern missing values, provenance concerns editorial claims, mapping concerns audio/text. Here list derivation versus stored/shared material matters. No user records or actual body export is accessed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Shared text displayName uses prefix(40) Swift Characters Forty tokens/bytes/full contents URL/file Different text/fileName branches Do not apply one cap Every filename limited to forty Done note Text(transcript).lineLimit(2) Layout versus source Two lines stored as original Other states Pending/failed show different views Actual fields/state No body on card means lost text Handoff Actual text fields used Contents/attachments/authority Only visible prefix leaves Meaning Prefix/layout is not summarization Original versus editorial copy Meeting key points extracted Sensitive material Short display can still identify Full contents/copy/destination Ellipsis means anonymous Retention evidence Screenshot shows limited display Authorized references/full material Preview certifies completeness/truth Synthetic preview review A synthetic record exceeds 40 Characters; only its start is shown. This proves neither only the prefix was saved nor later private content cannot be shared. Two-line cut points also vary with layout, not a fixed character contract. Inspect actual fields/versions within existing authorization, without expanding private-source access. No screen/assistive-reading/copy/handoff test ran. A view is not a full archive or privacy guarantee. FAQ Does prefix40 mean original text changed? Not from the derived displayName alone. Actual storage/handoff need review. Does lineLimit2 save only two lines? No. It limits layout rather than truncating transcript there. Are URLs/filenames all cut to forty? Do not generalize across kind branches or visual layout. Does a failed-row message prove old text cleared? No. State-specific display differs from transcript contents. Is a short preview a summary/redaction? No. Prefixes/line limits are not semantic summarization or cleansing. Were full user records read/exported? No. Static display/data-path scope only, without actual rendering or sharing acceptance. Reading and source Placeholders · Summary provenance · Material mapping · Per-item sharing · Start · Privacy DisplayName branches · State rows/line limit · Actual text placement

### 取消导航等于断网吗？加载替换、转圈复核与进程重载边界

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/navigation-cancel-process-reload-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 取消导航等于断网吗？加载替换、转圈复核与进程重载边界 导航被替换、页面加载失败与Web进程关闭，不是同一结论 isSupersededNavigation过滤NSURLErrorDomain的取消和WebKitErrorDomain的102；它们不直接设置加载失败卡片。延迟500ms仅在没有继续加载/错误时复核spinner。Web进程终止则尝试reload；连续终止间隔小于15秒会停下提示手动处理。这些是UI控制，不是网络、草稿或服务动作恢复保证。 与离线预检、origin和识别错误的区别 离线预检核业务链，origin核页面范围，识别错误核语音层；这里核 导航回调/加载替换与进程终止展示策略 。不重载真实页面，不修改证书/网络/服务。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 取消分类 domain与code合核 NSURLErrorCancelled所属域 所有取消都断网 策略交接 WebKitErrorDomain/102 非HTTP业务状态 外部页面一定打开/服务已处理 500ms复核 只在无继续加载且无error时清spinner 条件与调度分开 500ms恢复SLA 普通加载错误 userFacingMessage按域/代码归类 可见提示非完整根因 所有错误都一个原因 进程终止 先走reload策略 Web进程与业务服务分开 Agent任务一定失败/成功 15秒门 相邻终止太近则停自动重载 防环不等可用性保证 后台无限重试 重载结果 页面/草稿/动作另核 原请求实际状态 所有未提交字段/已执行动作恢复 安全边界 不为错误关闭HTTPS校验 原地址/权限保持 忽略安全错误换可用性 合成回调记录 旧加载被替换而回调取消，不能写整个工作台已离线；出现WebKit 102也不能当成HTTP102或业务确认。spinner和错误卡片只说明这一层状态，未独立核服务动作。 发生重载前后，材料/请求仍可能有待定结果，不能盲重发或承诺恢复。本文无真实页面、网络或进程回收测试；不把源码延迟当设备性能承诺。 FAQ 取消加载一定是断网吗？ 不一定，替换或策略交接可被过滤，具体域/代码要合核。 102就是HTTP处理成功吗？ 不是，此处指WebKitErrorDomain代码，不是服务器业务回执。 500ms代表半秒恢复吗？ 不代表，只是条件性spinner复核的调度延迟。 15秒后一定能重载成功吗？ 不保证，它是防连续重载门，不是恢复SLA。 reload能保证原草稿和动作恢复吗？ 不能，需要原材料/实际服务状态另核，勿盲重发。 本文改了网络或做过故障注入吗？ 没有，只核固定导航策略，无网络/视觉/设备验收。 相关指南与源码 离线链路 · 页面边界 · 语音错误层 · 开始 · 隐私 取消分类/导航失败/进程终止

### Is cancelled navigation offline? Replaced loads, spinner checks and process reloads

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/navigation-cancel-process-reload-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Is cancelled navigation offline? Replaced loads, spinner checks and process reloads Replaced navigation, failed loading and a terminated Web process mean different things isSupersededNavigation filters NSURLErrorDomain cancellation and WebKitErrorDomain 102 instead of directly setting failure UI. A 500 ms delayed recheck clears the spinner only when no load/error remains. Process termination tries reload; adjacent terminations less than 15 seconds apart stop automatic reload. These UI rules do not guarantee network, draft or service-action recovery. Different from offline, origin and recognition review Offline reviews chains, origin reviews scope, recognition reviews audio. Here navigation callbacks/replacement and termination display policy matter. No actual reload, certificate/network/service change ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Cancellation Domain and code together NSURLErrorCancelled domain All cancellations offline Policy handoff WebKitErrorDomain/102 Not HTTP business status External page opened/service completed 500 ms Clear spinner only without load/error Conditions versus scheduling Half-second recovery SLA Load failures userFacingMessage categories Visible class versus root cause Every error one cause Termination Reload policy Web process versus service Agent task definitely failed/succeeded 15 seconds Close terminations stop automatic reload Loop guard versus availability Unlimited background retries Reload result Page/draft/action separately Actual original request All fields/actions restored Security Retain HTTPS validation Original address/authority Disable security for availability Synthetic callback note A replaced load reports cancellation, not necessarily a completely offline workbench. WebKit 102 is not HTTP102/business confirmation. Spinner/error state does not independently establish service effects. Requests/materials can remain uncertain across reloads. Do not replay blindly or promise restoration. No real page/network/process test ran; source delays are not device performance claims. FAQ Does cancellation prove offline? No. Replacement/policy handoff can be filtered; inspect domain/code. Is 102 successful HTTP processing? No. This WebKit error code is not a business receipt. Does 500 ms mean recovery in half a second? No. It schedules a conditional spinner recheck. Must reload succeed after fifteen seconds? No. This is a loop guard, not a recovery SLA. Does reload restore drafts/actions? Not guaranteed; review actual material/service state instead of replaying. Were network/fault tests performed? No. Fixed navigation policy only, without network/visual/device acceptance. Reading and source Offline chain · Page boundary · Recognition errors · Start · Privacy Cancellation/failure/termination

### Watch语音queued和ready代表什么？手机转写结果不是已存回复草稿

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/watch-voice-queued-ready-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 Watch语音queued和ready代表什么？手机转写结果不是已存回复草稿 Watch语音接纳、手机转写就绪、回复草稿保存是不同阶段 receiveVoice可对新请求、同请求或缓存复用回queued；不能仅据此称已转写。新转写核目标、busy/前台和音频门，再次核目标后缓存ready结果；源码明确这一个有界重试回报不是phone reply草稿或网页插入。后续保存草稿是另一条请求，不是服务端提交。 与跨端显示、PCM和草稿恢复的区别 跨端显示核字段，PCM核形状，草稿恢复核phone待定记录；这里核 Watch语音请求/结果回报阶段及接收门 。不录Watch音频，不运行配对、转写或发送。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 目标指纹 sourceToken/taskToken与当前目标匹配 本地字段指纹非签名 账户认证/服务批准 queued 接纳、同请求或缓存复用确认 实际请求/后续结果 识别完成/持久后台队列保证 音频门 16k单声道、0<帧数≤176000、有限样本 接收格式非任意转码 原始文件任意格式可上传 新转写 前台/忙态/模型等门 缓存回送和新执行分开 永远可后台接力 ready 再次核目标并校验结果codec/缓存 有界回报非phone草稿 网页已填/回复已发送 配对传递 WCSession即时/后台通道另核队列门 原请求结果与实际接收 云中继/常驻轮询/必达 重试 原请求一致才复用已知缓存 不要改ID/token猜测重发 新ID就是原动作续传 最终交接 保存草稿和服务提交另核 实际目标/状态/用户确认 转写结果已完成业务 合成阶段记录 只有queued，没有ready或后续草稿证据，就记接纳阶段待定。即使ready带文字，也不能写手机草稿已保存；接收函数有意不调用web-composer交接回调。 缓存回报不是无限历史或恢复保证，配对后台传递不是云服务。声纹过滤亦非身份授权。本文无Watch/手机/网络实测，不为排错上传真实语音。 FAQ queued能证明转写完成吗？ 不能，它可表示新接纳、同请求或缓存复用，仍需结果。 ready是不是手机回复草稿已保存？ 不是，源码明确有界结果回报不等phone草稿或网页插入。 176000帧是不是支持任意文件？ 不是，还需16k单声道、有效长度/有限样本及其他门，采集能力另核。 所有请求都必须当场重新转写吗？ 不一定，一致原请求可复用缓存，新转写和回送条件分开。 这是云语音中继或必达消息服务吗？ 不是，只核配对通道和本地缓存，不作送达/后台可用性保证。 本文实际配对或发送了Watch回复吗？ 没有，只核固定接收/转写/结果路径，不获真实跨端验收。 相关指南与源码 跨端字段 · PCM门 · phone草稿 · 声纹界限 · 开始 · 隐私 receiveVoice/缓存/回送 · transcribeWatchAudio前台与回调边界

### What Watch voice queued and ready mean: a transcription is not a saved phone draft

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/watch-voice-queued-ready-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide What Watch voice queued and ready mean: a transcription is not a saved phone draft Watch acceptance, phone transcription readiness and saved reply drafts are separate stages receiveVoice can return queued for new acceptance, the same request or cache reuse; it does not alone establish transcription completion. New execution checks target, busy/foreground/audio conditions, then rechecks target before caching ready. This bounded retry result explicitly is not a phone reply draft or web insertion. Saving a draft is a separate request, not server submission. Different from presentation, PCM and draft restoration Presentation checks fields, PCM checks shape, restoration checks pending phone records. Here Watch voice request/result stages and admission matter. No pairing/audio/transcription/sending ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Target sourceToken/taskToken matches Local field hashes not signatures Account/approval authentication queued Acceptance/same request/cache confirmation Actual request/later result Completed ASR/durable background queue Audio 16 kHz mono, 0<frames≤176000, finite samples Admission versus transcoding Every original format supported New execution Foreground/busy/model guards Cache resend versus execution Always-on background relay ready Recheck target/codec/bounded cache Result versus phone draft Web filled/reply sent Paired delivery WCSession channels and queue guards Result versus actual receipt Cloud/polling/guaranteed delivery Retry Reuse consistent original request No invented ID/token replay New ID resumes original action Final handoff Draft save/submission separately Target/state/confirmation Transcription completes business Synthetic stage note Only queued without a result/draft record leaves later stages unknown. Even ready text does not establish a saved phone draft: this path intentionally avoids web-composer delivery callbacks. A cache is not unlimited history or recovery guarantee, paired background delivery is not cloud service, and voiceprint filtering is not authority. No Watch/phone/network test ran or real audio was uploaded. FAQ Does queued prove ASR completion? No. Acceptance/same request/cache reuse still require result evidence. Does ready mean a saved phone reply draft? No. Bounded result explicitly differs from phone draft/web insertion. Do 176000 frames allow any file? No. Sampling/channel/length/finite and other gates remain; capture capabilities differ. Does every request run fresh ASR? No. Consistent requests can reuse cached results; execution/resend differ. Is this cloud relay or guaranteed messaging? No. Paired channels/cache do not certify delivery/background availability. Was a Watch paired or reply sent? No. Fixed paths only, without actual cross-device acceptance. Reading and source Cross-device fields · PCM guards · Phone drafts · Voiceprint scope · Start · Privacy Voice/cache/result flow · Foreground/delivery scope

### 共享收件箱不可访问就是网络坏了吗？AppGroup声明、签名与本机容器

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/app-group-inbox-access-evidence/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 共享收件箱不可访问就是网络坏了吗？AppGroup声明、签名与本机容器 AppGroup本机容器、产物权限与网站网络/账户，是不同证据 App和Share Extension的Info.plist、entitlements引用YIHU_APP_GROUP；运行代码读取YihuAppGroup，再向系统请求containerURL。shared()未取到容器就返回nil。相同声明只能说明配置意图，不证明产物签名权限或真实设备可访问；本机共享不等公网上传或第三方账户授权。 与manifest可见点、文件保护和网站缓存的区别 manifest核批次发布，保护核写选项，网站缓存核origin；这里核 容器入口及声明/签名/运行三类证据 。不读真实容器，不注册AppGroup、不改配置或签名。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 变量声明 YIHU_APP_GROUP用于两端配置 源码意图 发布签名已正确 Bundle键 YihuAppGroup供运行时读取 键名与构建变量分层 两个名字可互换 entitlement com.apple.security.application-groups 最终签名另核 plist相同就获系统授权 运行入口 containerURL取不到则shared()==nil 实际系统结果 唯一根因就是断网或模型损坏 示例fallback 缺键有源码后备标识 非生产权限证据 示例ID能直接当生产配置 测试root init(root:)可注入位置 测试代码与系统授权分开 本地构造root验证跨Extension权限 工作台边界 容器名不是网页账户/部门身份 目标页面权限另核 按每个origin自动独立收件箱 后续写入 访问、批次发布、文件保护另核 入口成功非全链完成 成功取容器就已安全交付 合成入口记录 若shared()为nil，只记录未得到容器入口，不直接诊断网络、模型或某一唯一签名故障。声明相同、测试目录可写、运行时可访问，各自不能替另一层证明。 本页不指导用任意目录绕过系统权限，也不把AppGroup注册当网页登录或新存储服务。未检查安装产物/签名或真机，不把源码配置宣称为已生效。 FAQ 共享收件箱不可访问一定是断网吗？ 不能这样推，shared容器入口与网站网络是不同层。 两个配置文件相同能证明签名正确吗？ 不能，最终产物权限及运行结果仍需各自证据。 YihuAppGroup和YIHU_APP_GROUP是同一种键吗？ 不是，前者为Bundle读取键，后者为构建替换变量。 测试能注入root就是系统授予共享权限吗？ 不是，测试构造与系统AppGroup访问不是同一证据。 容器是否天然按每个工作台网站隔离？ 不能由这段共享容器入口推出，网页权限/存储边界另核。 本文注册AppGroup或验证了签名吗？ 没有，不改配置、第三方授权或签名，不做真机能力验收。 相关指南与源码 批次发布 · 保护选项 · 网站缓存 · 声明证据 · 开始 · 隐私 appGroup/shared/root · App Bundle键 · Extension Bundle键 · App声明 · Extension声明

### Is an inaccessible share inbox offline? App Group declarations, signing and local containers

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/app-group-inbox-access-evidence/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Is an inaccessible share inbox offline? App Group declarations, signing and local containers Local App Group access, signed authority and website network/accounts are separate evidence App and Share Extension Info.plist/entitlements reference YIHU_APP_GROUP. Runtime reads YihuAppGroup and asks the system for containerURL; shared() returns nil without it. Matching declarations establish intent, not signed entitlement or real-device access. Local sharing is not public upload or third-party account authority. Different from manifest visibility, file protection and site caches Manifests check publication, protection checks writes, caches check origins. Here container entry and declaration/signing/runtime evidence matter. No real container, registration, configuration or signing operation is accessed. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Variable YIHU_APP_GROUP on both sides Source intent Release signing correct Bundle key YihuAppGroup at runtime Key versus build variable Names interchangeable Entitlement com.apple.security.application-groups Final signature separately Matching plist grants authority Runtime entry No containerURL means shared()==nil Actual system result Only cause offline/broken model Fallback Source default identifier if key absent Not production entitlement Example ID is production setup Test root init(root:) injects location Test versus system grant Injected root validates Extension access Workbench scope Container name is not site/account identity Destination permissions One automatic inbox per origin Later writes Access/publication/protection differ Entry versus end-to-end Container success guarantees safe handoff Synthetic entry note shared()==nil establishes no obtained container entry, not a unique network/model/signing diagnosis. Matching declarations, writable test roots and runtime access cannot replace each other’s evidence. Do not bypass system authority through arbitrary directories or call App Group registration website login/new storage service. No installed artifact/signature/device was checked; source configuration is not proven effective setup. FAQ Does inaccessible inbox mean offline? No. System container entry and website networking differ. Do matching files prove valid signing? No. Final entitlement/runtime evidence remain separate. Are YihuAppGroup and YIHU_APP_GROUP interchangeable keys? No. The Bundle key differs from the build substitution variable. Does injected root prove system shared access? No. Test construction differs from App Group authority. Is every workbench origin automatically isolated here? Not from this shared-container entry; site/storage permissions need separate review. Was an App Group registered or signature verified? No. No configuration/third-party grant/signing/device operation ran. Reading and source Batch publication · Protection · Site caches · Declaration evidence · Start · Privacy Group/container/root · App key · Extension key · App declaration · Extension declaration

### Watch点了在手机打开就打开了吗？queued、前台路由与本地任务核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/watch-open-request-ui-boundaries/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 Watch点了在手机打开就打开了吗？queued、前台路由与本地任务核对 接纳打开请求，不等手机已经显示正确事项 open消息的queued仅确认基本字段形状，随后才设置openRequest。phone须前台，再核UUID、当前本地snapshot事项、待处理状态及sourceToken，且通过切换/交接门才呈现。不能把queued当已打开，也不能把voice/draft路径的taskToken检查搬到这条open路径。打开不是提交或审批。 与跨端字段、Watch语音和草稿恢复的区别 字段核显示，语音核queued/ready转写，恢复核phone草稿；这里核 打开请求从配对消息到手机UI路由的时点 。不操作Watch/手机或触发真实跳转。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 接收形状 kind/open与workbench/task/sourceToken字符串 更深验证在phone路由 queued已验证全部语义 pending请求 openRequest含nonce 本地待处理触发值 任务版本或审批凭证 前台 scenePhase.active才路由 未前台可仍保留请求 必能唤醒/解锁手机 事项 当前本地snapshot查id/状态 本地已知，不是保证网络最新 点击必自动刷新后台 来源 sourceToken对配置字段 指纹非账户授权 登录/任务签字完成 不同通道 open不是voice/draft准入集合 不套taskToken规则 所有消息检查一样 阻塞/无效 切换受阻可保留，无效清请求并提示 实际剩余请求/台账 失败就后台盲重试业务 显示设置 调整tasks/筛选/标题搜索后呈现 UI选择非源数据变更 完成审批或服务回执 合成打开记录 只有queued，手机仍未前台，便记录待路由而非已展示事项。若提示事项变化或不可见，在既有权限内核手机台账，不用旧表卡作最终业务判断。 nonce和筛选更新不代表服务动作、来源真实性或新审批。本文未测配对/唤醒/视觉，不保证外部源实时刷新或后台接力。 FAQ queued能证明手机已打开吗？ 不能，接纳与后续UI验证/呈现分开。 open也核taskToken吗？ 不能从voice/draft路径套用，引用的open路由核sourceToken及本地任务等。 手机后台会自动解锁展示吗？ 没有此保证，路由要求前台，消息接纳不是解锁授权。 查到任务就是服务器最新吗？ 不是独立证明，此处查当前本地snapshot，真实源状态另核。 改筛选意味着改了事项状态吗？ 不意味着，UI显示设置与源事项业务状态不同。 本文实际发起了打开或审批吗？ 没有，只核消息与UI路由，不执行真实跳转或业务动作。 相关指南与源码 跨端字段 · 语音回报 · 草稿恢复 · 开始 · 隐私 open接纳 · openWatchTask路由

### Did Open on iPhone actually open? Watch queued messages, foreground routing and local tasks

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/watch-open-request-ui-boundaries/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Did Open on iPhone actually open? Watch queued messages, foreground routing and local tasks Accepting an open request does not prove the correct task appeared on iPhone Open-message queued acknowledges basic field shape before openRequest is set. Foreground phone routing then checks UUID, task in the current local snapshot, eligible status and sourceToken, plus switching/handoff guards. queued is not opened UI. The voice/draft taskToken checks cannot be copied onto this open path; opening is not submission or approval. Different from fields, Watch voice and draft restoration Fields concern display, voice concerns transcription stages, restoration concerns phone drafts. Here paired open messages through phone UI routing matter. No Watch/phone/navigation operation ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Shape kind/open and string workbench/task/sourceToken Deeper routing checks later queued validates all meaning Pending openRequest has nonce Local trigger value Task revision/approval receipt Foreground scenePhase.active for routing Request may remain pending Guaranteed wake/unlock Task ID/status in current local snapshot Local knowledge versus live source Click always refreshes server Source sourceToken checks configured identity Hash versus account grant Login/signature complete Channel Open differs from voice/draft No imported taskToken guard Every message checks identically Blocked/invalid Blocked can retain; invalid clears/notices Actual pending/source state Blind background business replay Presentation Tasks/filters/title search updated UI versus source mutation Approval/service receipt Synthetic open note queued while the phone is not foreground leaves routing pending, not task presentation established. Changed/invisible notices require authorized phone/source review instead of a final decision from an old Watch card. Nonce/filter updates establish no service effects, truth or approval. No pairing/wake/visual test ran; live refresh/background relay is not promised. FAQ Does queued prove opened phone UI? No. Acceptance and later validation/presentation differ. Does open also check taskToken? Do not import voice/draft guards; this route uses sourceToken/local task checks. Does background phone automatically unlock? No guarantee. Foreground routing is not unlock authority. Is a locally found task server-latest? Not independently; this path reads a local snapshot. Does filter change update task status? No. Display settings differ from source business state. Was an actual open/approval sent? No. Static message/UI routing only, without navigation or business action. Reading and source Cross-device fields · Voice stages · Draft restoration · Start · Privacy Open acceptance · Open routing

### 选了会议纪要就生成纪要了吗？整理模板、原文与交接载荷

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/note-organization-prompt-not-minutes/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 选了会议纪要就生成纪要了吗？整理模板、原文与交接载荷 “会议纪要”是交接提示模板，不是已完成的本机纪要 整理方式Picker选择instruction文本，不重写保存的transcript。直接填入可加指令前缀；托盘短文带指令和正文，长文以Markdown全文加单独指令；存Radar草稿直接传transcript。三路不能互当同一payload，也不能从选择标签推出本机已生成纪要、补齐负责人/时间或目标服务已执行。 与字段简报、多笔记复核和草稿候选的区别 简报核人工字段，多笔记核材料范围，候选核目标资格；这里核 整理模板是请求还是产物、不同出口究竟带什么文字 。不运行摘要模型或交接真实笔记。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 Picker 三种现有instructions模板 UI选择与产物分开 已自动生成会议纪要 原文 transcript作为材料 模板选择不重写原文 点击标签就修正识别 直接填入 非空instruction可前置正文 实际文本/目标/条件 只交原文或已代发送 托盘短文 指令+正文 保存材料非目标完成 进入托盘就纪要完成 托盘长文 UTF-8 Markdown正文，指令说明见附件 文本和文件分别核 本机转码/批量导入服务 Radar草稿 传current.transcript 不套模板前缀规则 三路payload一模一样 重复防线 状态/长度/handOffAttempted等仍在 换模板不绕准入 可通过改模板无条件重发 产物验收 目标若整理仍需独核原文/未知 人名/时间不臆补 模板保证准确/完整/批准 合成模板记录 只选择“会议纪要”尚无目标结果，应记已选择请求模板而非纪要已完成。若目标仅收到原文Radar草稿，不因Picker标签存在就宣称指令前缀也随行。 最终编辑稿应与原录文、未知和获准范围分账；提示“不要遗漏”不是完整性保证。本文未生成或分享真实内容，不提供新纪要、CSV、转码或审批服务。 FAQ 选会议纪要会修改保存的录文吗？ 这个Picker选instruction，不在此重写transcript。 整理任务是本机ASR自动完成吗？ 不能由模板推出，原生这里构造交接提示，不是纪要产物。 三条出口带同样文字吗？ 不是，direct/托盘可含指令，Radar草稿传原transcript，长文还有文件材料。 长文附件就是转码服务吗？ 不是，这里写UTF-8 Markdown录文材料，不是通用音频/文件转码。 模板能保证负责人和时间吗？ 不能，目标结果/原文/未知另核，不能补造姓名或截止时间。 本文跑过摘要或实际交接吗？ 没有，只核模板与载荷，不执行真实模型或目的地操作。 相关指南与源码 字段简报 · 多笔记范围 · 目标候选 · 材料对应 · 开始 · 隐私 instructions/三路入口 · 短文/Markdown托盘材料

### Does choosing Meeting Minutes generate minutes? Templates, originals and handoff payloads

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/note-organization-prompt-not-minutes/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Does choosing Meeting Minutes generate minutes? Templates, originals and handoff payloads Meeting Minutes is a handoff prompt template, not completed native minutes The organization Picker selects instruction without rewriting stored transcript. Direct insertion can prepend it; short tray text includes instruction/body, long tray material uses Markdown body plus separate instruction. Radar draft save passes transcript directly. These are not identical payloads, and a selected label establishes no generated minutes, filled owners/dates or destination execution. Different from brief fields, multi-note review and candidate admission Briefs concern editorial fields, multi-note concerns material scope, candidates concern targets. Here template request versus product and actual outlet text matter. No summarizer or real note handoff ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Picker Three existing instructions Selection versus product Minutes generated Original transcript remains material No rewrite from choice Label corrects recognition Direct Nonempty instruction can prefix body Actual text/target/guards Only original/already sent Short tray Instruction plus body Material save versus destination Minutes complete on staging Long tray UTF-8 Markdown body/separate instruction Text/file evidence Generic transcoding/import service Radar draft Pass current.transcript No imported prefix rule All outlets identical Repeat guards State/length/handOffAttempted remain Choice is not bypass Changing template allows blind replay Result review Actual target result/original/unknown No invented owners/dates Accuracy/completeness/approval guaranteed Synthetic template note Choosing Meeting Minutes without destination output establishes a prompt choice, not completed minutes. A Radar draft carrying only original text does not include template instructions merely because the Picker showed them. Review editorial outputs separately from recordings, unknowns and authorized scope. A request to omit nothing is no completeness proof. No real material was generated/shared and no minutes/CSV/transcoding/approval service is added. FAQ Does choosing minutes edit saved transcription? No rewrite occurs here; the Picker selects instruction. Does native ASR perform the organization task? Not from this template. Prompt construction is not a minutes product. Do all three outlets carry the same text? No. Direct/tray can include instruction; Radar passes transcript, and long tray material includes a file. Is the long attachment a transcoding service? No. UTF-8 Markdown text material is not universal audio/file transcoding. Does the template guarantee owners/dates? No. Review result/original/unknown without inventing people/deadlines. Was summarization or handoff run? No. Static template/payload review only, without real model/destination operations. Reading and source Brief fields · Multi-note scope · Target candidates · Material mapping · Start · Privacy Templates/three outlets · Short/Markdown tray material

### 声纹为什么要六句？注册有效帧、旧档版本与采集模式核对

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/guides/voiceprint-enrollment-profile-version-review/

场景指南 · 相关使用指南 声纹为什么要六句？注册有效帧、旧档版本与采集模式核对 六句、有效语音计数与旧档兼容，是不同的注册条件 当前注册要求6句，注册每句有效语音门为32000帧，区别匹配阶段16000帧。计数由voicedRange估计，不是总录音秒数或语义真值。当前v2档要求6组，旧v1分支为3组且还有维度/有限值/一致性等条件；并非任意三句都能导入，模式匹配也不能省略，更不是身份认证。 与声纹匹配、近场策略和模型资产的区别 匹配核便捷过滤结果，近场核采集策略，资产核固定文件；这里核 注册样本完备性、profile版本及模式前提 。不录音、不读取或替换真实声纹档案。 检查项 已核范围 人工复核 不应推断 当前注册 enrollmentPhraseCount=6 安静/日常提示与实际材料 录满6秒即注册成功 每句有效门 enrollmentMinimumVoicedSamples=32000 16k计数约2秒有效估计非墙钟 总录音两秒一定够 匹配门 minimumVoicedSamples=16000 注册和匹配不同阶段 两个门可互换 逐步一致性 enrollmentIsConsistent可核部分集合 部分通过非六句完备 一两句通过就是完成 版本 当前v2六组；legacy v1三组分支 格式/维度/有限/一致性仍在 任意旧档都兼容 文件选择 当前文件存在优先，不直接借旧档绕过 实际加载结果 坏v2自动靠v1恢复 模式 profileCaptureModeMatches等前提 采集开关与其他路由分开 换模式原档必然一样可用 身份边界 注册/相似度是本地便捷策略 真实授权另核 生物认证/抗伪造/准确率保证 合成注册记录 已有三组向量通过某个辅助检查，不能写当前六句注册完成；引用旧v1分支也不能省略版本、维度和一致性条件。若采集模式变化，按原设置提示核对，不自动覆盖或导入其他人的资料。 有效帧与相似度均是算法条件，不是说话内容、身份或真实场景成绩。本文不收集生物特征或做真人/设备测试，也不承诺跨环境、距离或噪声表现。 FAQ 六句是不是六秒总录音？ 不是，是样本句数；每句还有有效帧等门。 录满两秒就满足32000有效帧吗？ 不能推，总时长与voicedRange估计的有效计数不同。 旧三句profile都能无条件用吗？ 不能，只有相应v1分支且须其他校验，当前v2要求六组。 部分一致性通过就是注册完成吗？ 不是，辅助检查与最终样本完备性分开。 当前档坏了会自动用旧档恢复吗？ 不能如此保证，源码先按当前文件是否存在选择路径，不能借旧档绕过失败。 本文读取或重新注册了声纹吗？ 没有，只核源码条件，不处理真实生物特征或宣称身份能力。 相关指南与源码 匹配与授权 · 采集模式 · 模型证据 · 开始 · 隐私 注册常量/版本加载/一致性 · 注册有效帧与界面流程

### Why six enrollment phrases? Voiced frames, legacy profile versions and capture mode

Canonical: https://getyihu.com/en/guides/voiceprint-enrollment-profile-version-review/

All scenarios · Related practical guide Why six enrollment phrases? Voiced frames, legacy profile versions and capture mode Phrase count, voiced estimates and legacy compatibility are separate enrollment conditions Current enrollment requires 6 phrases and 32000 voiced frames per phrase, unlike the 16000-frame matching floor. voicedRange estimates counts, not total recording seconds or semantic truth. Current v2 profiles require six groups; legacy v1 allows three only with dimension/finite/consistency conditions. This is not arbitrary three-phrase import, mode bypass or identity authentication. Different from matching, near-field policy and model assets Matching checks convenient filtering, near-field checks capture policy, assets check fixed files. Here enrollment completeness, profile versions and mode prerequisites matter. No recording or real profile read/replacement ran. Check Verified scope Manual review Not established Current enrollment enrollmentPhraseCount=6 Quiet/everyday prompts versus material Six seconds completes enrollment Per phrase enrollmentMinimumVoicedSamples=32000 At 16k about two voiced-estimate seconds, not wall time Two seconds recorded always enough Matching minimumVoicedSamples=16000 Separate stage Floors interchangeable Incremental consistency enrollmentIsConsistent can inspect subsets Partial pass versus completeness One/two phrases finishes Version Current v2 six/legacy v1 three Format/dimensions/finite/consistency Every old profile compatible File selection Existing current chosen first Actual loading outcome Broken v2 automatically restores v1 Mode profileCaptureModeMatches prerequisite Capture toggle versus other routes Changing mode always retains compatibility Authority Local enrollment/similarity policy Actual authority separately Biometric/spoof/accuracy certification Synthetic enrollment note Three vectors passing a helper do not complete current six-phrase enrollment. Legacy paths still require version/dimension/consistency. Capture-mode changes require original-setting review, not automatic profile replacement or importing another person’s data. Voiced counts/similarity are algorithmic conditions, not content/identity or real-scene scores. No biometrics/person/device test ran; cross-environment/distance/noise performance is not promised. FAQ Are six phrases six total seconds? No. Phrase count and per-phrase voiced conditions differ. Do two recorded seconds meet 32000 voiced frames? Not necessarily; wall duration and voicedRange estimate differ. Are all old three-phrase profiles accepted? No. The v1 branch retains other checks, while current v2 needs six groups. Does partial consistency complete enrollment? No. Helpers and final completeness differ. Will broken current profiles automatically restore legacy? Not guaranteed; file existence selects the path rather than bypassing failed current validation. Were real profiles read/re-enrolled? No. Source conditions only, without biometrics or identity claims. Reading and source Matching versus authority · Capture policy · Model evidence · Start · Privacy Constants/version/consistency · Enrollment flow
